CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_LOADSUPPLIERSDIMENSION   @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						    @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						    @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */
						    @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
						    @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						    @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						    @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
						    @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						    @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
						    @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						    @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
						    @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
						    @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
						    @tB_debug              bit,
						    @tB_isRepair           bit,
						    @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
						    @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
						    @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit OUTPUT,
						    @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare  @nNumRecs  int
declare  @nNumDimensionRecs int
declare  @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
declare  @sChk              nvarchar(6)
declare  @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
declare  @bSurrogateFound   bit
declare  @bDimensionFound   bit
declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare  @nUnkKey		int
declare  @sUnkKey   nvarchar(30)
declare  @sUnkCode	nvarchar(30)
declare  @nNewKey		int
declare @nReturn int
declare @rS_com_code       nvarchar(30)  -- r5companies.com_code%TYPE,
declare @rS_com_desc       nvarchar(80)  -- r5companies.com_desc%TYPE,
declare @rS_com_orgcode    nvarchar(15)  -- r5companies.com_org%TYPE,
declare @rS_com_orgdesc    nvarchar(80)  -- r5descriptions.des_text%TYPE,
declare @rS_com_classcode  nvarchar(8)  -- r5companies.com_class%TYPE,
declare @rS_com_classorg   nvarchar(15)  -- r5companies.com_class_org%TYPE,
declare @rS_com_classdesc  nvarchar(80)  -- r5descriptions.des_text%TYPE,
declare @rS_com_buyercode  nvarchar(255)  -- r5companies.com_buyer%TYPE,
declare @rS_com_buyername  nvarchar(80)  -- r5descriptions.des_text%TYPE,
declare @rS_com_parentcode nvarchar(30)  -- r5companies.com_parent%TYPE,
declare @rS_com_parentorg  nvarchar(15)  -- r5companies.com_parent_org%TYPE,
declare @rS_com_parentdesc nvarchar(80)  -- r5descriptions.des_text%TYPE
declare @rS_zsu_key          numeric(18,0) --r5dwsuppliers.zsu_key%TYPE,
declare @rS_zsu_code         nvarchar(30)  --r5dwsuppliers.zsu_code%TYPE,
declare @rS_zsu_desc         nvarchar(80)  -- r5dwsuppliers.zsu_desc%TYPE,
declare @rS_zsu_orgcode      nvarchar(80)  -- r5dwsuppliers.zsu_orgdesc%TYPE,
declare @rS_zsu_orgdesc      nvarchar(80)  -- r5dwsuppliers.zsu_orgdesc%TYPE,
declare @rS_zsu_classcode    nvarchar(8)   -- r5dwsuppliers.zsu_classcode%TYPE,
declare @rS_zsu_classorg     nvarchar(15)  -- r5dwsuppliers.zsu_classorg%TYPE,
declare @rS_zsu_classdesc    nvarchar(80)  -- r5dwsuppliers.zsu_classdesc%TYPE,
declare @rS_zsu_buyercode    nvarchar(255)  -- r5dwsuppliers.zsu_buyercode%TYPE,
declare @rS_zsu_buyername    nvarchar(80)  -- r5dwsuppliers.zsu_buyername%TYPE,
declare @rS_zsu_parentcode   nvarchar(30)  -- r5dwsuppliers.zsu_parentcode%TYPE,
declare @rS_zsu_parentorg    nvarchar(15)  -- r5dwsuppliers.zsu_parentorg%TYPE,
declare @rS_zsu_parentdesc   nvarchar(80)  -- r5dwsuppliers.zsu_parentdesc%TYPE)
declare @sKeyvalues nvarchar(4000)
declare @sQuotes nvarchar(5)
declare @nError int
declare @nHasUnknownRec numeric(18, 0)
declare @sSTEP_SUPPLIERS_HAS_TYPE2SCD nvarchar(160)
declare @dStDate datetime
begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_DIMENSION', @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
							    @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION, N'r5dwsuppliers', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	select @nNumDimensionRecs = count(1) from r5dwsuppliers

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkKey', @sUnkKey OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sUnkKey is not null and isnumeric(@sUnkKey) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	set @nUnkKey = cast(@sUnkKey as int)

	if @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		select @nHasUnknownRec = count(1) from r5dwsuppliers where zsu_key = @nUnkKey
	end

   if @nNumDimensionRecs = 0 or (@tB_isRepair = 1 and @nHasUnknownRec = 0)
	begin
        -- Insert the special dimension record
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkCode', @sUnkCode OUTPUT
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
        BEGIN TRANSACTION    
        insert into r5dwsuppliers (zsu_key) values (@nUnkKey)
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
		-- Use unkCode placeholders for null values (can't have a null PK)
         BEGIN TRANSACTION       
         insert into r5dwsupplierkeys( ksu_code, ksu_orgcode, ksu_key )
         values (@sUnkCode, @sUnkCode, @nUnkKey)
         COMMIT TRANSACTION
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
        set @nNumRecs = 1
    end

    -- Now process the source records

	-- Normally we would use srcSelectFull when repairing a dimension,
	-- but this dimension has type 2 SCD fields that might have been
	-- updated during the life of the data warehouse. When this happens
	-- there will be multiple dimension records having the same business
	-- keys (zsu_code and zsu_orgcode for this table), and when this
	-- is the case, it becomes impossible to know which dimension
	-- record to update during repair. We must therefore use srcSelectIncr 
	-- and hope that we have no old object records that should have been 
	-- present in the dimension but weren't. This is generally a safe
	-- assumption.
    
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
    if @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD or (@tB_isRepair = 1 and @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges = 0)
	begin
	declare cSource cursor local for
	select   com_code,
                 com_desc,
                 com_org,
                 dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@tS_defaultLanguage, N'ORG', com_org, N'*', null),
                 com_class,
                 com_class_org,

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_LOADTEMPINVENTORYTURNS
							@tD_loadFromDate datetime,
							@tD_loadToDate   datetime
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
begin
    BEGIN TRANSACTION
    truncate table r5dwtmpinventoryturns
    insert into r5dwtmpinventoryturns( zti_datekey, zti_storekey, zti_orgkey, zti_partclasskey, zti_valueissuedwo, zti_valueretnwo, 
           zti_valuerecvsupplier, zti_valueretnsupplier )
		     select zdt_key,
				zso_key, 
				zor_key,
				zpc_key,              
				sum( CASE trl_rtype WHEN 'I' THEN CASE sign(coalesce(trl_qty,0)) WHEN 1 THEN coalesce(trl_qty,0) * coalesce(trl_price,0) END END  ),
				sum( CASE trl_rtype WHEN 'I' THEN CASE sign(coalesce(trl_qty,0)) WHEN -1 THEN coalesce(trl_qty,0) * coalesce(trl_price,0) END END ),
				sum( CASE trl_rtype WHEN 'RECV' THEN CASE tra_fromrentity WHEN 'COMP' THEN coalesce(trl_qty,0) * coalesce(trl_price,0) END END ),
				sum( CASE trl_rtype WHEN 'RETN' THEN coalesce(trl_qty,0) * coalesce(trl_price,0) END )
		     from   r5translines,
				r5dwstores, 
				r5stores, 
				r5parts, 
				r5dwpartclasses, 
				r5dworganizations, 
				r5transactions, 
				r5dwdates
		     where  zso_code   = trl_store 
		     and    trl_trans  = tra_code
		     and    trl_part   = par_code
		     and    par_class  = zpc_code
		     and    zso_code   = str_code
		     and    zor_code   = str_org
		     and    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(trl_date, N'DD') = zdt_date
		     and    tra_rstatus = N'A'
		     and    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(trl_date, N'DD') between @tD_loadFromDate and @tD_loadToDate
		     group by zdt_key,
			  zso_key, 
			  zor_key,
			  zpc_key
    COMMIT TRANSACTION
end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_LOADTEMPPARTS
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare @nReturn		int
declare @sGpriceLevel	nvarchar(200)
begin

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		return -1
	end
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		return -1
	end
	truncate table r5dwtmpparts
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		return -1
	end
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'gPriceLevel', @sGpriceLevel OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		return -1
	end

	insert into r5dwtmpparts( ztp_part, ztp_partorg, ztp_store, ztp_storeorg, ztp_partclass, ztp_partclassorg, ztp_qtyonhand, ztp_qtytorepair, ztp_qtyintransit,
		ztp_qtytorepairintransit, ztp_qtyatshop, ztp_qtyatsupplier, ztp_price, ztp_corevalue, ztp_saveparthistory )
	select sto_part,
             sto_part_org,
             sto_store,
             str_org,
             par_class,
             par_class_org,
             isnull(sto_qty,0),
             isnull(sto_repairqty,0),
             isnull(dbo.O7DWETLDM_GETINTRANSITQTY(sto_part, sto_part_org, sto_store), 0),
             isnull(dbo.O7DWETLDM_GETINTRANSITREPAIRQTY(sto_part, sto_part_org, sto_store) ,0),
             isnull(sto_shopqty,0),
             isnull(sto_vendorqty,0),
             isnull(dbo.O7GETPRC2(sto_store, sto_part, sto_part_org, str_org, N'B', @sGpriceLevel, null),0),
             dbo.O7GTCORE2(sto_store, sto_part, sto_part_org, str_org, @sGpriceLevel, null),
             par_savehistory
      from   r5stores,
             r5parts,
             r5stock
      where  str_code = sto_store
      and    par_code = sto_part
      and    par_org = sto_part_org  
end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_LOADTRADESDIMENSION @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						   @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						   @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */
						   @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
						   @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						   @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						   @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
						   @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						   @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
						   @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						   @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
						   @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
						   @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
						   @tB_debug              bit,
							@tB_isRepair           bit,
							@tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
							@tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
							@tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
							@tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
							@tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
as
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare  @nNumRecs  int --        pls_integer = 0
declare  @nNumDimensionRecs int
declare  @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
declare  @sChk              nvarchar(6)
declare  @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
declare  @bSurrogateFound   bit
declare  @bDimensionFound   bit
declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare  @nUnkKey	  int
declare  @sUnkKey	  nvarchar(30)
declare @rS_trd_code 	  nvarchar(15)
declare @rS_trd_desc      nvarchar(80)
declare @rS_trd_classcode nvarchar(8)
declare @rS_trd_classorg  nvarchar(15)
declare @rS_trd_classdesc nvarchar(80)
declare @rN_ztr_key       numeric(18,0)
declare @rS_ztr_code      nvarchar(15)
declare @rS_ztr_desc      nvarchar(80)
declare @rS_ztr_classcode nvarchar(8)
declare @rS_ztr_classorg  nvarchar(15)
declare @rS_ztr_classdesc nvarchar(80)
declare @nReturn int
declare @sKeyvalues nvarchar(4000)
declare @sQuotes nvarchar(5)
declare @nError int
declare @nHasUnknownRec numeric(18, 0)
begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_DIMENSION', @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
							@sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION, N'r5dwtrades', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING

	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	select @nNumDimensionRecs = count(1) from r5dwtrades
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkKey', @sUnkKey OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sUnkKey is not null and isnumeric(@sUnkKey) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	set @nUnkKey = cast(@sUnkKey as int)

	if @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		select @nHasUnknownRec = count(1) from r5dwtrades where ztr_key = @nUnkKey
	end

   if @nNumDimensionRecs = 0 or (@tB_isRepair = 1 and @nHasUnknownRec = 0)
	begin
        -- Insert the special dimension record
      BEGIN TRANSACTION
      insert into r5dwtrades (ztr_key) values (@nUnkKey)
      COMMIT TRANSACTION
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
         set @nNumRecs = 1
    end

    -- Now process the source records
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	if @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD or @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
	    declare cSource cursor local for
	    select trd_code,
                   trd_desc,
                   trd_class,
                   trd_class_org,
                   dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@tS_defaultLanguage, N'CLAS', trd_class + N'#' + trd_class_org, N'TRAD', null)
            from   r5trades
	end
	else
	begin
	    declare cSource cursor local for
	    select trd_code,
                   trd_desc,
                   trd_class,
                   trd_class_org,
                   dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@tS_defaultLanguage, N'CLAS', trd_class + N'#' + trd_class_org, N'TRAD', null)
            from   r5trades	
	    where (trd_created >= @tD_loadFromDate or trd_updated >= @tD_loadFromDate)
	end  
	open cSource
	fetch next from cSource into  @rS_trd_code, @rS_trd_desc, @rS_trd_classcode, @rS_trd_classorg, @rS_trd_classdesc
	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
		if @tS_loadType = @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD
		begin
			select @nSurrogateKey = ztr_key 
			from r5dwtrades 
			where ztr_code = @rS_trd_code
  
			if @@rowcount > 0
				set @bSurrogateFound = 0
			else
				set @bSurrogateFound = 1
		end
        else
            set @bSurrogateFound = 1
        
		if @bSurrogateFound  = 0
		begin
			select @rN_ztr_key = ztr_key,@rS_ztr_code = ztr_code, @rS_ztr_desc = ztr_desc, 
				   @rS_ztr_classcode = ztr_classcode,@rS_ztr_classorg = ztr_classorg,@rS_ztr_classdesc = ztr_classdesc 
			from r5dwtrades where ztr_key = @nSurrogateKey
           
			if @@rowcount > 0
				set @bDimensionFound = 0
			else
				set @bDimensionFound = 1
  
            if @bDimensionFound = 0
		begin
		-- Check SCD type 1 fields for changes
		if (isnull(@rS_trd_desc,N'~')     != isnull(@rS_ztr_desc,N'~') or
                   isnull(@rS_trd_classcode,N'~') != isnull(@rS_ztr_classcode,N'~') or
                   isnull(@rS_trd_classorg,N'~')  != isnull(@rS_ztr_classorg,N'~') or
                   isnull(@rS_trd_classdesc,N'~') != isnull(@rS_ztr_classdesc,N'~'))
                   
                begin
		    -- Update all the SCD type 1 fields for each dimension record
                    -- whose natural key matches the changed source record.
            BEGIN TRANSACTION
			update r5dwtrades
                  	set  ztr_desc  = @rS_trd_desc,
                         ztr_classcode = @rS_trd_classcode,
                         ztr_classorg  = @rS_trd_classorg,
                         ztr_classdesc = @rS_trd_classdesc
                  	where  ztr_code    = @rS_trd_code
            COMMIT TRANSACTION
			set @nError = @@ERROR 
			if @nError <> 0
			begin
				set @sKeyvalues = 'r5trades.trd_code = '+@sQuotes+@rS_trd_code+@sQuotes
				execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dwtrades', @sKeyvalues
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					close cSource
					deallocate cSource
					goto ERROR_HANDLER
				end
				GOTO fetch_again
			end
                    set @nNumRecs = @nNumRecs + 1
				end
			end -- dimension record found
		end
        else -- Surrogate not fo

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_LOADUNITSDIMENSION @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						   @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						   @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1), 
						   @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
						   @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						   @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						   @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
						   @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						   @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),
						   @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						   @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),
						   @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),
						   @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),
						   @tB_debug              bit,
						   @tB_isRepair           bit,
						   @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
						   @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
						   @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
						   @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
						   @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
as
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare  @nNumRecs  int --        pls_integer = 0
declare  @nNumDimensionRecs int
declare  @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
declare  @sChk              nvarchar(6)
declare  @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
declare  @bSurrogateFound   bit
declare  @bDimensionFound   bit
declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare  @nUnkKey	  int
declare  @sUnkKey	  nvarchar(30)
declare @rS_uom_code 	  nvarchar(30)
declare @rS_uom_desc      nvarchar(80)
declare @rS_uom_classcode nvarchar(8)
declare @rS_uom_classorg  nvarchar(15)
declare @rS_uom_classdesc nvarchar(80)
declare @rN_zum_key       numeric(18,0)
declare @rS_zum_code      nvarchar(30)
declare @rS_zum_desc      nvarchar(80)
declare @rS_zum_classcode nvarchar(8)
declare @rS_zum_classorg  nvarchar(15)
declare @rS_zum_classdesc nvarchar(80)
declare @nReturn int
declare @sKeyvalues nvarchar(4000)
declare @sQuotes nvarchar(5)
declare @nError int
declare @nHasUnknownRec numeric(18, 0)
begin
	set @sQuotes = N''''
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_LOAD_DIMENSION', @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
							@sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION, N'r5dwuoms', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	select @nNumDimensionRecs = count(1) from r5dwuoms

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkKey', @sUnkKey OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or ( @sUnkKey is not null and isnumeric(@sUnkKey) = 0 )
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	set @nUnkKey = cast(@sUnkKey as int)

	if @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
		select @nHasUnknownRec = count(1) from r5dwuoms where zum_key = @nUnkKey
	end

   if @nNumDimensionRecs = 0 or (@tB_isRepair = 1 and @nHasUnknownRec = 0)
	begin
        -- Insert the special dimension record
      BEGIN TRANSACTION
      insert into r5dwuoms (zum_key) values (@nUnkKey)
      COMMIT TRANSACTION
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
         set @nNumRecs = 1
    end

    -- Now process the source records
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
    if @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD or @tB_isRepair = 1
	begin
	    declare cSource cursor local for
	    select uom_code,
                   uom_desc,
                   uom_class,
                   uom_class_org,
                   dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@tS_defaultLanguage, N'CLAS', uom_class + N'#' + uom_class_org, N'UOM', null)
            from   r5uoms
    end
    else
	begin
	    declare cSource cursor local for
	    select uom_code,
                   uom_desc,
                   uom_class,
                   uom_class_org,
                   dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@tS_defaultLanguage, N'CLAS', uom_class + N'#' + uom_class_org, N'UOM', null)
            from   r5uoms	
	    where (uom_created >= @tD_loadFromDate or uom_updated >= @tD_loadFromDate)
    end  
	open cSource
	fetch next from cSource into  @rS_uom_code, @rS_uom_desc, @rS_uom_classcode, @rS_uom_classorg, @rS_uom_classdesc
	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
		if @tS_loadType = @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD
		begin
			select @nSurrogateKey = zum_key 
			from r5dwuoms 
			where zum_code = @rS_uom_code
  
			if @@rowcount > 0
				set @bSurrogateFound = 0
			else
				set @bSurrogateFound = 1
		end
        else
            set @bSurrogateFound = 1
        
		if @bSurrogateFound  = 0
		begin
			select @rN_zum_key = zum_key,@rS_zum_code = zum_code, @rS_zum_desc = zum_desc, 
				   @rS_zum_classcode = zum_classcode,@rS_zum_classorg = zum_classorg,@rS_zum_classdesc = zum_classdesc 
			from r5dwuoms where zum_key = @nSurrogateKey
           
			if @@rowcount > 0
				set @bDimensionFound = 0
			else
				set @bDimensionFound = 1
  
            if @bDimensionFound = 0
		begin
		-- Check SCD type 1 fields for changes
		if (isnull(@rS_uom_desc,N'~')     != isnull(@rS_zum_desc,N'~') or
                   isnull(@rS_uom_classcode,N'~') != isnull(@rS_zum_classcode,N'~') or
                   isnull(@rS_uom_classorg,N'~')  != isnull(@rS_zum_classorg,N'~') or
                   isnull(@rS_uom_classdesc,N'~') != isnull(@rS_zum_classdesc,N'~'))
                   
                begin
		    -- Update all the SCD type 1 fields for each dimension record
                    -- whose natural key matches the changed source record.
            BEGIN TRANSACTION
			update r5dwuoms
                  	set  zum_desc  = @rS_uom_desc,
                         zum_classcode = @rS_uom_classcode,
                         zum_classorg  = @rS_uom_classorg,
                         zum_classdesc = @rS_uom_classdesc
                  	where  zum_code    = @rS_uom_code
			COMMIT TRANSACTION
            set @nError = @@ERROR 
			if @nError <> 0
			begin
				set @sKeyvalues = 'r5uoms.uom_code = '+@sQuotes+@rS_uom_code+@sQuotes
				execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dwuoms', @sKeyvalues
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					close cSource
					deallocate cSource
					goto ERROR_HANDLER
				end
				GOTO fetch_again
			end
                    set @nNumRecs = @nNumRecs + 1
				end
			end -- dimension record found
		end
        else -- Surrogate not found
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSequenceNum OUTPUT, N'ZUM', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT

			if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

   if @nNumDimensionRecs = 0 or (@tB_isRepair = 1 and @nHasUnknownRec = 0)
	begin
        -- Insert the special dimension record
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkCode', @sUnkCode OUTPUT
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
        insert into r5dwwarrantyclaims (zwc_key) values (@nUnkKey)
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
         set @nNumRecs = 1
    end

    -- Now process the source records
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	if @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD
		begin
		    set @nEarliestDate = dbo.O7DWETLDM_GETEARLIESTDATE() * -1
		    set @dStartDate = DATEADD(dd,@nEarliestDate, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@tD_loadFromDate, N'DD') )
		end
	    else
        set @dStartDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@tD_loadFromDate, N'DD')

    declare cSource cursor local for
    select wcl_code,
           wcl_desc,
           wcl_warranty,
           wcl_class,
           wcl_class_org,
           dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@tS_defaultLanguage, N'CLAS', wcl_class + N'#' + wcl_class_org, N'CLAI', null),
           wcl_open,
           wcl_status,
           dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@tS_defaultLanguage, N'UCOD', wcl_status, N'CLST', null),
           wcl_rstatus,
           dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@tS_defaultLanguage, N'RCOD', wcl_rstatus, N'CLST', null)           
    from   r5warclaims
    where  wcl_filed >= @dStartDate
	open cSource
	fetch next from cSource into      @rS_wcl_code          ,
					  @rS_wcl_desc          ,
					  @rS_wcl_warrantycode  ,
					  @rS_wcl_classcode     ,
					  @rS_wcl_classorg      ,
					  @rS_wcl_classdesc     ,
					  @rS_wcl_open          ,
					  @rS_wcl_status	,
					  @rS_wcl_statusdesc	,
					  @rS_wcl_rstatus	,
					  @rS_wcl_rstatusdesc

	while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
		if @tS_loadType = @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD
		begin
			select @nSurrogateKey = zwc_key 
			from r5dwwarrantyclaims 
			where zwc_code = @rS_wcl_code
			
			if

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
AS
	--This procedure will be called from all procs and funcs within
	--this package.  This is to simulate package initialization scripts in Oracle
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sInitHasRun	nvarchar(8)
	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @nCommitfreq	int
	declare @sCommitfreq    nvarchar(50)
	declare @dLoadfirstdate datetime
	declare @sLoadfirstdate nvarchar(80)

begin
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'InitHasRun', @sInitHasRun OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sInitHasRun = N'false'
	begin
		select @dLoadfirstdate = run_loadfirstdate from r5dwetlrunctrl
		set @sLoadfirstdate = cast(@dLoadfirstdate as nvarchar(80))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'Loadfirstdate', @sLoadfirstdate
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		select @nCommitfreq = run_commitfreq from r5dwetlrunctrl
		set @sCommitfreq = cast(@nCommitfreq as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkKey', N'-1'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'invKey', N'-2'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'unkCode', N'!Unk'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'commitFreq', @sCommitfreq
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'safetyDays', N'3653'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'minDate', N'01/01/1753'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'invDate', N'01/02/1753'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'maxDate', N'12/31/9999'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'minWarehouseDate', null
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'RPPRCCAL', null
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'gPriceLevel', null
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'debugFirstTime', null
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'startDate', null
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'delCode', N'Deleted'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1

		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'InitHasRun', N'true'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1

		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'originalStartDate', null
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'SupplierHasType2SCDChanges', N'false'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'ObjectHasType2SCDChanges', N'false'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'MustTruncMatlTransDailySnap', N'false'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'MustTruncPartTransDailySnap', N'false'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'MustTruncWarClaimsAccumSnap', N'false'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'MustTruncPoAccumSnap', N'false'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'MustTruncPoLinesDailySnap', N'false'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'MustTruncStoresDailySnap', N'false'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'MustTruncMetersDailySnap', N'false'
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

	end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_POPULATER5DWTMPWOCOSTS   @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						    @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						    @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */
						    @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
						    @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						    @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						    @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
						    @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						    @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
						    @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						    @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
						    @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
						    @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
						    @tB_debug              bit,
						    /*@tB_isRepair           bit,
						    @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
						    @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
						    @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime,*/
						    @dStartDate datetime,
						    @bAddBudgetInfo bit
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare  @nNumRecs  int
declare  @nNumDimensionRecs int
declare  @sSequenceNum      nvarchar(30)
declare  @sChk              nvarchar(6)
declare  @nSurrogateKey     numeric(18,0)
declare  @bSurrogateFound   bit
declare  @bDimensionFound   bit
declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_FACTS nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare  @nUnkKey		int
declare  @nNewKey		int
declare  @sExchType		nvarchar(200)
declare @nReturn int
declare @nNumInserts int  --        pls_integer = 0
declare @nExistingRecordCount int --number = 0
declare @nKeyval      numeric(18,0) --  number = 1
declare @rD_ztc_date               datetime  --#r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_datetime%TYPE,
declare @rS_ztc_wocode             nvarchar(30) --#r5dwtmpwocosts.declare @rS_ztc_wocode%TYPE,
declare @rS_ztc_woorg              nvarchar(15) -- #r5dwtmpwocosts.declare @rS_ztc_woorg%TYPE,
declare @rS_ztc_woobject           nvarchar(30) -- #r5dwtmpwocosts.declare @rS_ztc_woobject%TYPE,
declare @rS_ztc_woobjectorg        nvarchar(15) -- #r5dwtmpwocosts.declare @rS_ztc_woobjectorg%TYPE,
declare @rS_ztc_budobject          nvarchar(30) -- #r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_budobject%TYPE,
declare @rS_ztc_budobjectorg       nvarchar(15) -- #r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_budobjectorg%TYPE,
declare @rS_ztc_wolocation         nvarchar(30) -- #r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_wolocation%TYPE,
declare @rS_ztc_wolocationorg      nvarchar(15) -- #r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_wolocationorg%TYPE,
declare @rS_ztc_budlocation        nvarchar(30) -- #r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_budlocation%TYPE,
declare @rS_ztc_budlocationorg     nvarchar(15) -- #r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_budlocationorg%TYPE,
declare @rS_ztc_mrc                nvarchar(15) -- #r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_mrc%TYPE,
declare @rS_ztc_jobtype            nvarchar(8) -- #r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_jobtype%TYPE,
declare @rS_ztc_costtype           nvarchar(4) -- #r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_costtype%TYPE,
declare @rS_ztc_orgcur             nvarchar(4) -- #r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_orgcur%TYPE,
declare @rN_ztc_ownlabcostorgcur   numeric(24,6) -- #r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_ownlabcostorgcur%TYPE,
declare @rN_ztc_hiredlabcostorgcur numeric(24,6) --#r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_hiredlabcostorgcur%TYPE,
declare @rN_ztc_fixedlabcostorgcur numeric(24,6)  --#r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_fixedlabcostorgcur%TYPE,
declare @rN_ztc_stockmatcostorgcur numeric(24,6)  --#r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_stockmatcostorgcur%TYPE,
declare @rN_ztc_dirmatcostorgcur   numeric(24,6)  --#r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_dirmatcostorgcur%TYPE,
declare @rN_ztc_toolcostorgcur     numeric(24,6)  --#r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_toolcostorgcur%TYPE)
declare @rNsource2_ztc_key     numeric(18,0) --#r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_key%TYPE,
declare @rSsource2_ztc_budcode nvarchar(30)  --#r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_budcode%TYPE,
declare @rSsource2_ztc_budget  nvarchar(17)  --#r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_budget%TYPE,
declare @rSsource2_ztc_year    nvarchar(8)   --#r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_year%TYPE,
declare @rSsource2_ztc_period  nvarchar(4)   --#r5dwtmpwocosts.ztc_period%TYPE)

begin
    set @nKeyval = 1
    -- Truncate the temporary work table
    truncate table #r5dwtmpwocosts
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1
	declare cSource cursor local for
	select boo_date dt, 
              boo_event wo, 
              evt_org wo_org, 
              evt_object obj, 
              evt_object_org obj_org, 
              zto_structure bud_obj, 
              zto_structure_org bud_obj_org, 
              evt_location loc, 
              evt_location_org loc_org, 
              ztl_structure bud_loc, 
              ztl_structure_org bud_loc_org, 
              evt_mrc mrc, 
              evt_jobtype jobtype, 
              dbo.O7DWETLDM_GETCOSTTYPE(boo_event, boo_act, boo_order, act_order) costtype, 
              org_curr, 
              sum(CASE dbo.O7DWETLDM_GETCOSTTYPE(boo_event, boo_act, boo_order, act_order) WHEN 1 THEN coalesce(boo_cost,0) ELSE 0 end ) ownlabcost,
              sum(CASE dbo.O7DWETLDM_GETCOSTTYPE(boo_event, boo_act, boo_order, act_order) WHEN 3 THEN coalesce(boo_cost,0) ELSE 0 END) hiredlabcost,
              sum(CASE dbo.O7DWETLDM_GETCOSTTYPE(boo_event, boo_act, boo_order, act_order) WHEN 5 THEN coalesce(boo_cost,0) ELSE 0 END) fixedlabcost,
              null stockmatcost, 
              null dirmatcost, 
              null toolcost 
       from   r5activities a, 
              r5organization,  
	      r5bookedhours b, 
              r5events e left outer join #r5dwtmplocations l on  l.ztl_element = e.evt_location and
								 l.ztl_element_org = e.evt_location_org
			  left  outer join #r5dwtmpobjects o  on o.zto_element  = e.evt_object  and
							         o.zto_element_org = e.evt_object_org	
       where  dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(b.boo_entered, N'DD') between @dStartDate and @tD_loadToDate 
       and    b.boo_cost <> 0 
       and    b.boo_event = a.act_event 
       and    b.boo_act = a.act_act 
       and    b.boo_event = e.evt_code 
       and    e.evt_org = org_code  
       group by boo_date, 
              boo_event, 
              evt_org, 
              evt_object, 
              evt_object_org, 
              zto_structure, 
              zto_structure_org, 
              evt_location, 
              evt_location_org, 
              ztl_structure, 
              ztl_structure_org, 
              evt_mrc, 
              evt_jobtype, 
              dbo.O7DWETLDM_GETCOSTTYPE(boo_event, boo_act, boo_order, act_order), 
              org_curr 
       union all  
        -- Insert stock material costs into temporary table
       select   dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(t.trl_date, N'DD') dt,  
                evt_code wo, 
                evt_org wo_org, 
                evt_object obj, 
                evt_object_org obj_org, 
                zto_structure bud_obj, 
                zto_structure_org bud_obj_org, 
                evt_location loc, 
                evt_location_org loc_org, 
                ztl_structure bud_loc, 
                ztl_structure_org bud_loc_org, 
                evt_mrc mrc, 
                evt_jobtype jobtype, 
                N'2' costtype,  
                org_curr,  
                null ownhours, 
                null fixedhours, 
                null hiredhours, 
                sum(coalesce(t.trl_qty,0) * coalesce(t.trl_price,0)) stockmatcost,  
                null dirmatcost, 
                null toolcost 
       f

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_PREPAREWOCOSTWORKTABLES  @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						    @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						    @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */
						    @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
						    @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						    @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						    @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
						    @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						    @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
						    @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						    @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
						    @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
						    @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
						    @tB_debug              bit
as
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare @nReturn int
declare @sZto_structure nvarchar(30)
declare @sZto_structure_org nvarchar(15)
declare @sZtl_structure nvarchar(30)
declare @sZtl_structure_org nvarchar(15)
begin
      -- Set earliest date for qualifying events, to reduce the impact
      -- Truncate the temporary work tables
    execute('truncate table #r5dwtmpobjects')
	if @@ERROR <>0
	begin
		rollback
		return -1
	end
    execute('truncate table #r5dwtmplocations')
	if @@ERROR <>0
	begin
		rollback
		return -1
	end
    execute('truncate table #r5dwtmpbudgetdetailitems')
	if @@ERROR <>0
	begin
		rollback
		return -1
	end

    -- Insert temporary table for lookup of budgetdetailitems.
    -- This is similar to the query in o7insbub() that populates r5tmpbudgetdetails.
    -- NOTE: we need to constrain on dates somehow, so we don't include budget
    -- details we no longer need.
    BEGIN TRANSACTION
    insert into #r5dwtmpbudgetdetailitems
    select bdt_code bdti_code,
             acp_start bdti_start,
             acp_end   bdti_end,
             bdt_budget bdti_budget,
             bdt_year bdti_year,
             bdt_period bdti_period,
             s.bus_obj uses_object,
             isnull (bdt_object, a_object.bit_code) bdti_object,
             isnull (bdt_object_org, a_object.bit_code_org) bdti_object_org,
             bdt_objectgr bdti_objectgr,
             s.bus_loc uses_location,
             isnull (bdt_location, a_location.bit_code) bdti_location,
             isnull (bdt_location_org, a_location.bit_code_org) bdti_location_org,
             bdt_locationgr bdti_locationgr,
             s.bus_jbtp uses_jobtype,
             isnull (bdt_jobtype, a_jobtype.bit_code) bdti_jobtype,
             bdt_jobtypegr bdti_jobtypegr,
             s.bus_mrc uses_mrc,
             isnull (bdt_mrc, a_mrc.bit_code) bdti_mrc,
             bdt_mrcgr bdti_mrcgr,
             isnull (bdt_costtype, a_costtype.bit_code) bdti_costtype,
             bdt_costtypegr bdti_costtypegr
      from   r5budgetstructure s,
             r5periods p,
             r5budgetdetails b left outer join r5budgetgroups g_mrc on g_mrc.bgr_code = bdt_mrcgr and g_mrc.bgr_rentity = N'MRC'
								left outer join r5budgetitems a_mrc on a_mrc.bit_group = g_mrc.bgr_code
				left outer join r5budgetgroups g_jobtype on g_jobtype.bgr_code  = bdt_jobtypegr and    g_jobtype.bgr_rentity = N'JBTP'
								left outer join r5budgetitems a_jobtype on a_mrc.bit_group = g_mrc.bgr_code
				left outer join r5budgetgroups g_location on g_location.bgr_code = bdt_locationgr and    g_location.bgr_rentity  = N'LOC'
								left outer join r5budgetitems a_location on a_location.bit_group = g_location.bgr_code
				left outer join r5budgetgroups g_object on g_object.bgr_code = bdt_objectgr and  g_object.bgr_rentity = N'OBJ'
								left outer join r5budgetitems a_object on a_object.bit_group = g_object.bgr_code
				left outer join r5budgetgroups g_costtype on g_costtype.bgr_code = bdt_costtypegr and g_costtype.bgr_rentity = N'CSTP'
								left outer join r5budgetitems a_costtype on a_costtype.bit_group = g_costtype.bgr_code
      where  bdt_year = acp_year
      and    bdt_period = acp_period
      and    s.bus_code = bdt_budget
      and    bdt_level in (select max(b2.bdt_level)
                           from   r5budgetdetails b2
                           where  b2.bdt_budget = b.bdt_budget) 

      COMMIT TRANSACTION

      -- Insert temporary table to roll down any structures of objects.
      -- Adapted from r5budget.o7insbub()

      -- a. Insert all specified objects
      BEGIN TRANSACTION
      insert into #r5dwtmpobjects (
               zto_structure,
               zto_structure_org,
               zto_element,
               zto_element_org)
      select   bdti_object,
               bdti_object_org,
               bdti_object,
               bdti_object_org
      from     r5budgetdetailitems,
               r5periods
      where    bdti_year = acp_year
      and      bdti_period = acp_period
      and      acp_end >= @tD_loadFromDate
      and      bdti_object is not null
      group by bdti_object, bdti_object_org
      COMMIT TRANSACTION   
      -- b. Add children contained of any  specified object
	declare cAddchildobj cursor local for
		select zto_structure, zto_structure_org
        from   #r5dwtmpobjects
		open cAddchildobj
		fetch next from cAddchildobj into @sZto_structure, @sZto_structure_org
        while @@fetch_status = 0
		begin
        BEGIN TRANSACTION    
		insert into #r5dwtmpobjects (
                    zto_structure, zto_structure_org,
                    zto_element, zto_element_org)
         	select @sZto_structure, @sZto_structure_org,
					CHILD,CHILD_ORG
					FROM   dbo.O7DWETLDM_PREPAREWOCOSTWORKTABLES_GET_HIERARCHY_1 (@sZto_structure, @sZto_structure_org)
        COMMIT TRANSACTION            
			fetch next from cAddchildobj into @sZto_structure, @sZto_structure_org
		end
		close cAddchildobj
		deallocate cAddchildobj

    -- Insert temporary table to roll down any structures of locations
    -- Adapted from r5budget.o7insbub()

    -- a. Insert all specified locations.
    BEGIN TRANSACTION
    insert into #r5dwtmplocations (
               ztl_structure,
               ztl_structure_org,
               ztl_element,
               ztl_element_org)
      select   bdti_location,
               bdti_location_org,
               bdti_location,
               bdti_location_org
      from     r5budgetdetailitems, r5periods
      where    bdti_year = acp_year
      and      bdti_period = acp_period
      and      acp_end >= @tD_loadFromDate
      and      bdti_location is not null
      group by bdti_location, bdti_location_org
    COMMIT TRANSACTION    
    -- b. Add children contained in any location group
	declare cAddchildloc cursor local for
		select ztl_structure, ztl_structure_org
        from   #r5dwtmplocations
		open cAddchildloc
		fetch next from cAddchildloc into @sZtl_structure, @sZtl_structure_org
        while @@fetch_status = 0
		begin
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
		insert into #r5dwtmplocations(
                    ztl_structure, ztl_structure_org,
                    ztl_element, ztl_element_org)
         	select @sZtl_structure, @sZtl_structure_org,
					CHILD,CHILD_ORG
					FROM   dbo.O7DWETLDM_PREPAREWOCOSTWORKTABLES_GET_HIERARCHY_2 (@sZtl_structure, @sZtl_structure_org)
        COMMIT TRANSACTION            
			fetch next from cAddchildloc into @sZto_structure, @sZto_structure_org
		end
		close cAddchildloc
		deallocate cAddchildloc

    -- Truncate the temporary work tables we no longer need
    execute('truncate table #r5dwtmpobjects

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7DWETLDM_PREPAREWOCOSTWORKTABLES_GET_HIERARCHY_1 (@sCode	nvarchar(30),
								    @sOrg	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
			child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
                      )
as
begin
declare @nLevel			int
declare @sCurrentType	nvarchar(4)
declare @sCurrentRtype	nvarchar(4)
declare @tStack table ( stc_child		nvarchar(30), 
			stc_child_org	nvarchar(15), 
			LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_child, 
		        stc_child_org, 
			1 
		from	r5structures
		where	stc_parent	= @sCode and 
			stc_parent_org	= @sOrg	 and
			stc_rollup 	= N'+'	

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
			BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= stc_child,
						@sOrg	= stc_child_org
					from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_child, 
									stc_child_org, 
									@nLevel + 1
								 from	r5structures
								 where	stc_parent	= @sCode  and 
									stc_parent_org	= @sOrg	  and
									stc_rollup 	= N'+'	
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_PURGEAVAILLABORDAILYSNAP @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						    @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						    @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */

						    @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,

						    @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
						    @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
						    @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
						    @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare @nNumRecs int 
declare @nReturn int
declare  @sOP_PURGE     			nvarchar(30)
declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD      nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING 		nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTEP_PURGE_FACTS 		nvarchar(30)
declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED 		nvarchar(9)
declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
declare @nError int
begin
	set @nNumRecs = 0 
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_PURGE', @sOP_PURGE OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_PURGE_FACTS', @sSTEP_PURGE_FACTS OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @sOP_PURGE,
							    @sSTEP_PURGE_FACTS, N'r5dwavaillabordailysnap', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

    BEGIN TRANSACTION
    delete from r5dwavaillabordailysnap
    where  zla_datekey >= 0
    and    @tD_purgeToDate >= (select zdt_date from r5dwdates where zdt_key = zla_datekey)
    COMMIT TRANSACTION

    set @nNumRecs = @@ROWCOUNT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @sOP_PURGE,
							    @sSTEP_PURGE_FACTS, N'r5dwavaillabordailysnap', @nNumRecs, @sSTATUS_COMPLETED
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
 return			
 ERROR_HANDLER:
        rollback
 		execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dwavaillabordailysnap', null
 		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
 		begin
 			return -1
 		end
 		execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @sOP_PURGE,
								    @sSTEP_PURGE_FACTS, N'r5dwavaillabordailysnap', @nNumRecs, @sSTATUS_ABORTED
 		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
 		begin
 			return -1
		end
end

AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

declare @nNumRecs int 
declare @nReturn int

declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD  nvarchar(30)

declare  @sSTEP_PURGE_DIMENSION nvarchar(30)

declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED 	nvarchar(9)
declare @sMaxDate nvarchar(30)
declare @dMaxDate datetime
declare @nExistingRecordCount int
declare @nError int
declare @nErrorKeys int
begin
	set @nNumRecs = 0 
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_PURGE', @sOP_PURGE OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR

	set @nError = @@ERROR

	set @nError = @@ERROR

	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @sOP_PURGE,

	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

       -- Delete the fact records
        execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETLDM', N'maxDate', @sMaxDate OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR

	set @dMaxDate = cast(@sMaxDate as datetime)
    BEGIN TRANSACTION
    delete from r5dwworkorders
    where zwo_key in
        (select w.zwo_key
         from   r5dwworkorders w,
                r5events e
         where  w.zwo_code = e.evt_code
         and    e.evt_date <= @tD_purgeToDate

return

    		begin

    		end
    		execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @sOP_PURGE,
   								    @sSTEP_PURGE_DIMENSION, N'r5dwworkorders', @nNumRecs, @sSTATUS_ABORTED

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_SUMPARTVALUES @nCommitFreq int
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
begin
	truncate table r5dwtmpstoresdailysnap
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	insert into r5dwtmpstoresdailysnap( zts_storekey, zts_orgkey, zts_partclasskey, zts_orgcur, zts_valueonhand, zts_valuetoberepaired, 
		zts_valueintransit, zts_valueatshop, zts_valueatsupplier )
	select isnull(zso_key, -1),
               isnull(zor_key, -1),
               isnull(zpc_key, -1),
               org_curr,
               sum(ztp_qtyonhand * ztp_price),
               sum(ztp_qtytorepair * isnull(ztp_corevalue, ztp_price)),
               sum(ztp_qtyintransit * ztp_price),
               sum(ztp_qtyatshop * isnull(ztp_corevalue, ztp_price)),
               sum(ztp_qtyatsupplier * isnull(ztp_corevalue, ztp_price))
    from       r5organization,
               r5dwstores,
               r5dworganizations,
               r5dwtmpparts left outer join r5dwpartclasses on zpc_code = ztp_partclass and
					                       zpc_orgcode = ztp_partclassorg
    where    ztp_storeorg = org_code
    and      ztp_store = zso_code
    and      ztp_storeorg = zor_code
    group by isnull(zso_key, -1),
             isnull(zor_key, -1),
             isnull(zpc_key, -1),
             org_curr
end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7DWETLDM_TODEFCURR(@nFromValue numeric(30,6), @sFromCurr nvarchar(30), @sToCurr nvarchar(30),
                      @sOrg nvarchar(30), @dExchDate datetime)
returns numeric(30,6)
as
begin
declare @sFromCurrency     nvarchar(3)  /* r5currencies.cur_code%TYPE */
declare @sToCurrency       nvarchar(3)  /* r5currencies.cur_code%TYPE */
declare @sDualcurr         nvarchar(200) /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE */
declare @nVdual            numeric(30,6)
declare @nToCurrencyDual   numeric(30,6)
declare @nFromCurrencyDual numeric(30,6)
declare @nBasevalue        numeric(30,6)
declare @nNvalue           numeric(30,6)
declare @sOrgcurr          nvarchar(3) /* r5exchrates.crr_orgcurr%TYPE */
declare @nExch             numeric(30,6)

  set @nNvalue = 1000
  set @nExch = null
  set @sFromCurrency = @sFromCurr
  set @sToCurrency   = @sToCurr

    -- If no to-currency is supplied, then return without doing anything.
    -- In practice, this should never be the case.
    if @sToCurrency is null
        return(@nFromValue)

    -- If the currency equals the base currency, then do no conversion.
    if @sFromCurrency = @sToCurrency
        return(@nFromValue)
     
    -- If no from-currency is supplied, then org must not be null. If it is, then
    -- return without converting. Otherwise, get the organization currency
    if @sFromCurrency is null
	begin
        if @sOrg is null
            return(@nFromValue)
        else
	    begin
		
         	select @sFromCurrency = org_curr
         	from   r5organization
         	where  org_code = @sOrg
         
            end 
        end

      -- If we get to this point, it is because the fromCurrency parameter is
      -- null, so we had to fetch it using the org parameter. Therefore, we must
      -- check the retrieved organization currency against the default currency
      -- and return the original value if they are the same. This avoids a
      -- unnecessary trip to the exchange rate table, with the possibility that
      -- no exchange rate will be available.

    if @sFromCurrency = @sToCurrency
        return(@nFromValue)      

    -- Get the dual currency

	select @sDualcurr = ins_desc
	from   r5install
	where  ins_code = N'DUALCURR'

	select @nToCurrencyDual = cur_dual
	from   r5currencies
	where  cur_code = @sToCurrency

	select @nFromCurrencyDual = cur_dual
	from   r5currencies
	where  cur_code = @sFromCurrency

    -- If from-currency = dual currency and to-currency belongs to Euro then
    -- return reciprocal of above retrieved rate.
    if @nToCurrencyDual is not null and @sFromCurrency = @sDualcurr
         return (@nFromValue / round( 1 / @nToCurrencyDual, 6 ))

    -- If to-currency = dual currency and from-currency belongs to Euro then
    -- return above retrieved rate.
    if @nFromCurrencyDual is not null and @sToCurrency = @sDualcurr
         return (@nFromValue / @nFromCurrencyDual)

    if @nToCurrencyDual is null and @nFromCurrencyDual is null 
	begin
         -- Normal exchange rate.
	
         select @nExch = crr_exch
         from   r5exchrates
         where  crr_curr    = @sFromCurrency
         and    crr_orgcurr = @sToCurrency
         and    isnull(dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dExchDate,'DD'), dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dbo.O7GTTIME2(@sOrg), N'DD'))
                between dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_start,'DD') and dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end,'DD')
   
	end
    else if @nToCurrencyDual is null and @nFromCurrencyDual is not null 
         -- Triangular!!
	begin
		 
	 select @nVdual = crr_exch
         from   r5exchrates
         where  crr_curr    = @sDualcurr
         and    crr_orgcurr = @sToCurrency
         and    isnull(dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dExchDate,'DD'), dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dbo.O7GTTIME2(@sOrg), N'DD'))
                between dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_start,'DD') and dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end,'DD')
        
        set @nBasevalue = round( @nNvalue / @nFromCurrencyDual / @nVdual, 4 )
        set @nExch      = round( @nNvalue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
	end
    else if @nToCurrencyDual is not null and @nFromCurrencyDual is null 
         -- Triangular!!
	begin
		
	 select  @nVdual = crr_exch
         from   r5exchrates
         where  crr_curr    = @sFromCurrency
         and    crr_orgcurr = @sDualcurr
         and    isnull(dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dExchDate, N'DD'), dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dbo.O7GTTIME2(@sOrg), N'DD'))
                between dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_start, N'DD') and dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD')		
		
        set @nBasevalue = round( @nNvalue / @nVdual * @nToCurrencyDual, 4 )
        set @nExch      = round( @nNvalue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
	end
    else
         --Triangular!!
	begin
        set @nBasevalue = round( @nNvalue / @nFromCurrencyDual * @nToCurrencyDual, 4 )
        set @nExch      = round( @nNvalue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
    end

    return(@nFromValue / @nExch)
end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_TRUNCATEDATAMARTS       @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						   @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						   @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1), 
						   @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
						   @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						   @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						   @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
						   @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						   @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1), 
						   @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						   @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),  
						   @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200), 
						   @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3), 
						   @tB_debug              bit,
						   @tB_isRepair           bit,
						   @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime,
						   @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime,
						   @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit,
						   @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit,
						   @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
        declare  @nNumRecs   int 
	declare  @sOP_FULL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
	declare  @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD     nvarchar(30)
	declare  @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
	declare  @sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION nvarchar(30)
	declare  @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
	declare  @sSTATUS_ABORTED nvarchar(9)
	declare  @sSTEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE nvarchar(9)
	declare  @nReturn int
	declare  @nError int
        declare  @sEtl_dmttable  nvarchar(30)
        declare  @sSql           nvarchar(2000)

	set @nNumRecs = 0
        set @sEtl_dmttable = ''

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETLDM_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE', @sSTEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_COMPLETED', @sSTATUS_COMPLETED OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

	declare cTruncFact cursor local for select distinct etl_dmttable
					    from r5dwetldatamarts, r5install
					    where ins_code = etl_module
					    and ins_desc = 'TRUNCATE'

    open cTruncFact
    fetch next from cTruncFact into @sEtl_dmttable
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    begin

	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_DISABLEFOREIGNKEYS @tN_runNumber, @sEtl_dmttable

	  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	    begin
		    rollback
		    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
									    @sSTEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE, @sEtl_dmttable, @nNumRecs, @sSTATUS_ABORTED
		    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		    begin
		    close cTruncFact
		    deallocate cTruncFact
			    return -1
		    end
		close cTruncFact
		deallocate cTruncFact
		    return
	    end

	    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
								    @sSTEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE, @sEtl_dmttable, @sSTATUS_EXECUTING

	    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	    begin
		    rollback
		    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
									    @sSTEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE, @sEtl_dmttable, @nNumRecs, @sSTATUS_ABORTED
		    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		    begin
		    close cTruncFact
		    deallocate cTruncFact
			    return -1
		    end
		close cTruncFact
		deallocate cTruncFact
		    return
	    end

	    set @sSql = 'truncate table ' + @sEtl_dmttable
	    exec (@sSql)

	    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
								    @sSTEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE, @sEtl_dmttable, 1, @sSTATUS_COMPLETED
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		    begin
		    close cTruncFact
		    deallocate cTruncFact
			    return -1
		    end

	    fetch next from cTruncFact into @sEtl_dmttable
	end
    close cTruncFact
    deallocate cTruncFact

	declare cTruncDim cursor local for select distinct  etl_dimtable
					from r5dwetldatamarts, r5install
					where ins_code = etl_module
					and   ins_desc = 'TRUNCATE'
					and  etl_dimtable not in  (select distinct etl_dimtable
							    from r5dwetldatamarts , r5install
							    where ins_code = etl_module
							    and ins_desc = 'ON' )

    open cTruncDim
    fetch next from cTruncDim into @sEtl_dmttable
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	begin
	    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
								    @sSTEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE, @sEtl_dmttable, @sSTATUS_EXECUTING

	    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	    begin
		    rollback
		    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
									    @sSTEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE, @sEtl_dmttable, @nNumRecs, @sSTATUS_ABORTED
		    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		    begin
		    close cTruncDim
		    deallocate cTruncDim
			    return -1
		    end
		close cTruncDim
		deallocate cTruncDim
		    return
	    end


	    set @sSql = 'delete from ' + @sEtl_dmttable
	    exec (@sSql)

	    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
								    @sSTEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE, @sEtl_dmttable, 1, @sSTATUS_COMPLETED
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		    begin
		    close cTruncDim
		    deallocate cTruncDim
			    return -1
		    end

	    fetch next from cTruncDim into @sEtl_dmttable
	end
    close cTruncDim
    deallocate cTruncDim

    execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	 GOTO ERROR_HANDLER


    if @tS_loadType = @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD
	begin
		declare cTruncFact cursor local for select distinct etl_dmttable
					from r5dwetldatamarts, r5install
					where ins_code = etl_module
					and ins_desc = 'TRUNCATE'

	    open cTruncFact
	    fetch next from cTruncFact into @sEtl_dmttable
	    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin

		    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_ENABLEFOREIGNKEYS @tN_runNumber, @sEtl_dmttable
		    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		    begin
			    rollback
			    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
										    @sSTEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE, @sEtl_dmttable, @nNumRecs, @sSTATUS_ABORTED
			    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			    begin
			    close cTruncFact
			    deallocate cTruncFact
				    return -1
			    end
			close cTruncFact
			deallocate cTruncFact
			    return
		    end    
		    fetch next from cTruncFact into @sEtl_dmttable
		end
return
ERROR_HANDLER:
  rollback
  execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @tS_loadType,
							@sSTEP_LOAD_DIMENSION, @sEtl_dmttable, @nNumRecs, @sSTATUS_ABORTED
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		return -1
	end

end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETLDM_UPDATEPARTHISTORY @sPartcode nvarchar(30),  @sTableName nvarchar(50)
   as
		SET NOCOUNT ON
      declare @sSavehistory nvarchar(1)
      declare @nPartkey numeric(38,0)
      
   begin
     	-- Check the part save history flag for the part during dimension load
     	if @sTableName = N'r5dwparts' 
		begin   

			update r5dwparts
			set zpa_savehistory = N'-'
			where zpa_code in
			(select par_code from r5parts where par_savehistory = N'-')


	        select @sSavehistory = zpa_savehistory,
			@nPartkey = zpa_key 
	        from r5dwparts
	        where exists (select par_code from r5parts 
	   	 	      where par_code = zpa_code 
	   		      and par_savehistory = N'+' and par_code = @sPartcode)
	        
	        if @sSavehistory = N'-'
			begin
                BEGIN TRANSACTION
	        	delete from r5dwpartsdailysnap
	     	  	where zas_partkey = @nPartkey
			    
	     	  	delete from r5dwpartstransdailysnap
	     	  	where zpt_partkey = @nPartkey
                COMMIT TRANSACTION
	   	 	end
	   	end  
	   	
	    else
	    
	     -- Update the save history flag after the fact loads
            BEGIN TRANSACTION
	     	update r5dwparts
	        set zpa_savehistory = N'+'
	        where zpa_code = @sPartcode
	     	COMMIT TRANSACTION
    end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY     @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						    @sOperation    nvarchar(30),
						    @sStep         nvarchar(30),
						    @sTargetObject nvarchar(30),
						    @nNumRecs      numeric(18,0), 
						    @sStatus       nvarchar(9)--,
							--@sMessage      nvarchar(2000)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare @dStartTime   datetime
declare @dEndTime     datetime
declare @nElapsedTime numeric(18,0)
declare @sSqlStatement nvarchar(4000)
declare @nReturn int
declare @nError int
declare @nLogsequence int
begin
    set @dEndTime = getdate()
    set @nElapsedTime = 0
    select @dStartTime = lgd_starttime from r5dwetlrunlogdetail where lgd_logrunnumber = @tN_runNumber
				 		 		and lgd_operation = @sOperation
								and lgd_step = @sStep
								and lgd_targetobject = upper(@sTargetObject) 
	
    if @dStartTime is not null
        set @nElapsedTime = DATEDIFF(second, @dStartTime, @dEndTime)

	select @nLogsequence = lgd_sequence
    from   r5dwetlrunlogdetail
	where  lgd_logrunnumber     = @tN_runNumber
    and    lgd_operation        = @sOperation
    and    lgd_step             = @sStep
    and    lgd_targetobject     = upper(@sTargetObject)
    
    BEGIN TRANSACTION
    update r5dwetlrunlogdetail
    set    lgd_endtime          = @dEndTime,
           lgd_elapsedtime      = @nElapsedTime,
           lgd_numrecsprocessed = @nNumRecs,
           lgd_status           = @sStatus --,
    --       lgd_message          = @sMessage
	where  lgd_logrunnumber     = @tN_runNumber
	and		lgd_sequence = 		@nLogsequence
--    and    lgd_operation        = @sOperation
--    and    lgd_step             = @sStep
--    and    lgd_targetobject     = upper(@sTargetObject)
    COMMIT TRANSACTION
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0
	begin
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
		execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dwetlrunlogdetail', null
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			return -1
		end
		return
	end
end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_CREATEINDEX    @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
					    @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
					    @sIndexName  nvarchar(128),
					    @sTableName  nvarchar(128),
					    @sFieldNames nvarchar(2000),
					    @sTblSpace   nvarchar(30),
					    @sIndexType  nvarchar(1),
					    @nFallbackIndexNum int OUTPUT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
declare @sCreateStmt nvarchar(2000)
declare @nNumIndexes int
declare @sFallbackIndexName nvarchar(20)
declare @sMessage nvarchar(2000)	/* r5dwetlrunlogdetail.lgd_message%TYPE */
declare @bNRecs bit
declare @nReturn int
declare @sSTATUS_EXECUTING 	nvarchar(9)
declare @sSTATUS_ABORTED	nvarchar(9)
declare @sSTEP_CREATE_INDEX	nvarchar(30)
declare @sSTATUS_COMPLETED	nvarchar(9)
declare @sOP_FULL_LOAD		nvarchar(30)
declare @sSQLStatement		nvarchar(4000)
declare @sIDX_UNIQUE nvarchar(1)
declare @sIDX_NORMAL nvarchar(1)
declare @sIDX_BITMAP nvarchar(1)
declare @nError	int

	set @nNumIndexes = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_CREATE_INDEX', @sSTEP_CREATE_INDEX OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'IDX_UNIQUE', @sIDX_UNIQUE OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'IDX_BITMAP', @sIDX_BITMAP OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'IDX_NORMAL', @sIDX_NORMAL OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_COMPLETED', @sSTATUS_COMPLETED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber,
														@sOP_FULL_LOAD, @sSTEP_CREATE_INDEX,
                               							@sIndexName, @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INDEXEXISTS @bNRecs OUTPUT, @sIndexName
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	if @bNRecs = 0 and @tS_tenantID is null
		begin
			set @sSQLStatement = N'drop index ' + @sTableName + '.' + @sIndexName
			EXECUTE(@sSQLStatement)
			set @nError = @@ERROR
			if @nError <> 0
			goto ERROR_HANDLER
		end 

	if @sIndexType = @sIDX_UNIQUE
		begin
			--make sure that the index was dropped earlier
			execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INDEXEXISTS @bNRecs OUTPUT, @sIndexName
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @bNRecs = 1
				begin
					set @sSQLStatement = N'create unique index ' + @sIndexName + N' on ' +
									   @sTableName + N' (' + @sFieldNames + N') '
					EXECUTE(@sSQLStatement)
					set @nError = @@ERROR
					if @nError <> 0
					goto ERROR_HANDLER
				end
		end

	--SQL Server does not support bitmap indexes.  Therefore we are treating bitmap indexes as normals
	if @sIndexType = @sIDX_BITMAP or @sIndexType = @sIDX_NORMAL
		begin
			--make sure that the index was dropped earlier
			execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INDEXEXISTS @bNRecs OUTPUT, @sIndexName
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @bNRecs = 1
				begin
					set @sSQLStatement = N'create index ' + @sIndexName + N' on ' +
									   @sTableName + N' (' + @sFieldNames + N') ' 
					EXECUTE(@sSQLStatement)
					set @nError = @@ERROR
					if @nError <> 0
					goto ERROR_HANDLER
				end
		end

    set @nNumIndexes = 1

    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY 	@tN_runNumber,
														@sOP_FULL_LOAD, @sSTEP_CREATE_INDEX,
                             							@sIndexName, @nNumIndexes, @sSTATUS_COMPLETED
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

return	

ERROR_HANDLER:  execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, @sTableName, @sIndexName
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			return -1
		end
		execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY 	@tN_runNumber,
														@sOP_FULL_LOAD, @sSTEP_CREATE_INDEX,
                             							@sIndexName, @nNumIndexes, @sSTATUS_ABORTED
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			return -1
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_CREATEINDEXS       @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
					    @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
					    @sTableName  nvarchar(30)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
declare @nNumIndexes integer
declare @nFallbackIndexNum int
declare @sIndexName  nvarchar(30)   /* r5dwindexes.idx_indexname%TYPE */
declare @sFieldNames nvarchar(2000) /* r5dwindexes.idx_fields%TYPE */
declare @sTblSpace   nvarchar(30)   /* r5dwindexes.idx_tablespace%TYPE */
declare @sIndexType  nvarchar(1)    /* r5dwindexes.idx_indextype%TYPE */
declare @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare @sSTATUS_ABORTED		nvarchar(9)
declare @sSTEP_CREATE_INDEX	nvarchar(30)
declare @sSTATUS_COMPLETED			nvarchar(9)
declare @sOP_FULL_LOAD	nvarchar(30)
declare @nReturn int
declare @sErrmsg		nvarchar(200)
declare @nError			int

	set @nNumIndexes = 0
	set @nFallbackIndexNum = 100
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_CREATE_INDEX', @sSTEP_CREATE_INDEX OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_COMPLETED', @sSTATUS_COMPLETED OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

    	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber,
														@sOP_FULL_LOAD, @sSTEP_CREATE_INDEX,
                               							@sTableName, @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	declare cIndexes cursor local for
         select idx_indexname,
                idx_fields,
                idx_tablespace,
                idx_indextype
         from   r5dwindexes
         where  idx_table = upper(@sTableName)
         order by idx_indextype, idx_indexname

    open cIndexes
	fetch next from cIndexes into @sIndexName, @sFieldNames, @sTblSpace, @sIndexType
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_CREATEINDEX @tN_runNumber, @tS_tenantID,  
													@sIndexName, @sTableName, @sFieldNames, @sTblSpace,
                     								@sIndexType, @nFallbackIndexNum
			set @nError = @@ERROR
			if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					close cIndexes
					deallocate cIndexes
					execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, @sTableName, @sIndexName
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					goto ERROR_HANDLER
				end

			set @nNumIndexes = @nNumIndexes + 1
			fetch next from cIndexes into @sIndexName, @sFieldNames, @sTblSpace, @sIndexType
		end
	close cIndexes
	deallocate cIndexes

    	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY 	@tN_runNumber,
														@sOP_FULL_LOAD, @sSTEP_CREATE_INDEX,
                             							@sTableName, @nNumIndexes, @sSTATUS_COMPLETED
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
return	
ERROR_HANDLER:
		execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY 	@tN_runNumber,
														@sOP_FULL_LOAD, @sSTEP_CREATE_INDEX,
                             							@sTableName, @nNumIndexes, @sSTATUS_ABORTED
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			return -1
		end
