CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_DISABLEFOREIGNKEYS @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
					    @sTableName nvarchar(128)
as
SET NOCOUNT ON
declare @nNumRecs int
declare @sConstraintName nvarchar(30)       /* constraintName user_constraints.constraint_name%TYPE */
declare @nError int
declare @nReturn int
declare @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare @sOP_INIT			nvarchar(30)
declare @sSTEP_DISABLE_FOREIGN_KEYS	nvarchar(30)
declare @sTARGET_NA			nvarchar(30)
declare @sSTATUS_COMPLETED		nvarchar(9)
declare @sSQLStatement			nvarchar(4000)
begin
	set @nNumRecs = 0
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INIT', @sOP_INIT OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_DISABLE_FOREIGN_KEYS', @sSTEP_DISABLE_FOREIGN_KEYS OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber,
														@sOP_INIT, @sSTEP_DISABLE_FOREIGN_KEYS,
                               							@sTableName, @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	declare cFK cursor local for
      	select constraint_name
        from   user_constraints
        where  table_name = upper(@sTableName)
        and    constraint_type = N'F'
        open cFK
	fetch next from cFK into @sConstraintName
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	begin
        set @sSQLStatement = N'alter table ' + @sTableName + N' nocheck constraint ' + @sConstraintName
		EXECUTE(@sSQLStatement)
	
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
		begin
			close cFK
			deallocate cFK
			execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, @sTableName, @sConstraintName
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				return -1
			end
			return
		end
		set @nNumRecs = @nNumRecs + 1
		fetch next from cFK into @sConstraintName
	end
	close cFK
	deallocate cFK
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_COMPLETED', @sSTATUS_COMPLETED OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY 	@tN_runNumber, 
														@sOP_INIT, @sSTEP_DISABLE_FOREIGN_KEYS,
                             							@sTableName, @nNumRecs, @sSTATUS_COMPLETED
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

end

			execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_DROPINDEX @tN_runNumber, @tS_tenantID, @sIndexName, @s_tableName
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				close cIndexes
				deallocate cIndexes
				return -1
			end
			fetch next from cIndexes into @sIndexName
		end
		close cIndexes
		deallocate cIndexes
	end
end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_ENABLEFOREIGNKEYS @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
					    @sTableName nvarchar(128)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
declare @nNumRecs int
declare @sConstraintName nvarchar(30)
declare @nError int
declare @nReturn int
declare @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare @sOP_INIT			nvarchar(30)
declare @sSTEP_ENABLE_FOREIGN_KEYS	nvarchar(30)
declare @sTARGET_NA			nvarchar(30)
declare @sSTATUS_COMPLETED		nvarchar(9)
declare @sSQLStatement			nvarchar(4000)
begin
	set @nNumRecs = 1
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INIT', @sOP_INIT OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_ENABLE_FOREIGN_KEYS', @sSTEP_ENABLE_FOREIGN_KEYS OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
        execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber,
														@sOP_INIT, @sSTEP_ENABLE_FOREIGN_KEYS,
                               							@sTableName, @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	declare cFK cursor local for
      	select constraint_name
        from   user_constraints
        where  table_name = upper(@sTableName)
        and    constraint_type = N'R'
        open cFK
	fetch next from cFK into @sConstraintName
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	begin
        set @sSQLStatement = N'alter table ' + @sTableName + N' check constraint ' + @sConstraintName
		EXECUTE(@sSQLStatement)
		
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
		begin
			close cFK
			deallocate cFK
			execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, @sTableName, @sConstraintName
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				return -1
			end
			return
		end
		set @nNumRecs = @nNumRecs + 1
		fetch next from cFK into @sConstraintName
	end
	close cFK
	deallocate cFK
     
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_COMPLETED', @sSTATUS_COMPLETED OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
        execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY 	@tN_runNumber,
														@sOP_INIT, @sSTEP_ENABLE_FOREIGN_KEYS,
                             							@sTableName, @nNumRecs, @sSTATUS_COMPLETED
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_GETRUNPARAMETERS   @tN_runNumber          numeric(18,0)  OUTPUT,
					    @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50)   OUTPUT,
					    @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1)    OUTPUT,   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */
					    @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255)   OUTPUT,
					    @tD_loadFromDate       datetime		  OUTPUT,
					    @tD_loadToDate         datetime       OUTPUT,
					    @tD_nextStartDate      datetime       OUTPUT,
					    @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime       OUTPUT,
					    @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1)    OUTPUT,   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
					    @tD_purgeToDate        datetime       OUTPUT,
					    @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2)    OUTPUT,   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
					    @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200)  OUTPUT,   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
					    @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3)    OUTPUT,   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
					    @tB_debug              bit            OUTPUT, 
					    @tB_isRepair           bit            OUTPUT,
					    @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime     OUTPUT,
					    @tD_originalLoadToDate datetime       OUTPUT,
					    @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit      OUTPUT,
					    @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit    OUTPUT,
					    @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime       OUTPUT,
					    @nRunNumber numeric(38,0), 
					    @bBdebug bit

AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare @sChk nvarchar(3)
declare @dNow datetime 
declare @dYesterday datetime
declare @nError int
declare @nReturn int
declare @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare @sOP_INIT			nvarchar(30)
declare @sSTEP_GET_RUN_PARAMETERS	nvarchar(30)
declare @sTARGET_NA			nvarchar(30)
declare @sOP_FULL_LOAD			nvarchar(30)
declare @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD		nvarchar(30)
declare @sSTATUS_COMPLETED		nvarchar(9)
declare @SRepair nvarchar(1)
begin
	set @sChk = null
	set @dNow = getdate()
	set @dYesterday = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(getdate(),N'DD') - 1
	set @tN_runNumber  = @nRunNumber
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'initialization package error', null
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			return -1
		end
		return
	end

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'TARGET_NA', @sTARGET_NA OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INIT', @sOP_INIT OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_GET_RUN_PARAMETERS', @sSTEP_GET_RUN_PARAMETERS OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber, @sOP_INIT, @sSTEP_GET_RUN_PARAMETERS, @sTARGET_NA, @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	declare cRunParameters cursor local for
        select  run_loadflag,
		CASE run_loadtype WHEN N'F' THEN @sOP_FULL_LOAD ELSE @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD END,
                dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(run_loadfromdate, N'DD'),         -- Load from the beginning of the day
                run_purgeflag,
                dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(run_purgetodate, N'DD') + .99999, -- Purge to the end of the day
                run_defcur,
                run_repair,
                run_loadfirstdate
         from   r5dwetlrunctrl
    open  cRunParameters
    fetch next from cRunParameters into @tS_loadFlag,
					@tS_loadType,
					@tD_loadFromDate,
					@tS_purgeFlag,
					@tD_purgeToDate,
					@tS_oldDefaultCurrency,
					@SRepair,
					@tD_loadFirstDate
    close cRunParameters
	deallocate cRunParameters

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @tS_defaultCurrency OUTPUT, N'DEFCURR', @sChk OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

    if @tS_oldDefaultCurrency is null or @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD
	begin
        set @tS_oldDefaultCurrency = @tS_defaultCurrency
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
        update r5dwetlrunctrl
        set    run_defcur = @tS_defaultCurrency
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
	    end

    -- loadFromDate should never be later than the beginning of yesterday
    if @tD_loadFromDate > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dNow, N'DD') - 1
	begin
        set @tD_loadFromDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dNow, N'DD') - 1
    end

      -- Load to the end of yesterday
    set @tD_loadToDate = @dYesterday + .99999

      -- Note: If the ETL load is started after midnight (which is recommended),
      -- then nextStartDate becomes today's date (the current run loads data through
      -- yesterday's date), and there is no overlap of time between this run and
      -- the next. If the load is started before midnight, then there will be a
      -- little overlap in time between runs. This is perfectly ok, though not
      -- quite as efficient.

    set @tD_nextStartDate  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dNow, N'DD')

    set @tS_tenantID   = dbo.o7getten()

	execute @nReturn = O7LANG @tS_defaultLanguage OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

      -- Reset the OPS Pac data load
    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_SETOPSPACSETTING N'LOADOPSDATA', N'0'
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

    if @bBdebug is not null
	begin
        set @tB_debug = @bBdebug
    end 

    if @SRepair = N'+'
    begin
        set @tB_isRepair = 1
    end
    else
    begin
    	  set @tB_isRepair = 0
    end 
    
    set @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges = 0
    set @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges = 0
    
    set @tD_originalLoadFromDate = @tD_loadFromDate
    set @tD_originalLoadToDate = @tD_loadToDate

    if @tB_debug = 0 
	begin
        PRINT N'runNumber = ' + cast(@tN_runNumber as nvarchar(50))
        PRINT N'loadFlag = ' + @tS_loadFlag
        PRINT N'loadType = ' + @tS_loadType
        PRINT N'loadFromDate = ' + cast(@tD_loadFromDate as nvarchar(50))
        PRINT N'loadToDate = ' + cast(@tD_loadToDate as nvarchar(50)) 
        PRINT N'nextStartDate = ' + cast(@tD_nextStartDate as nvarchar(50))
        PRINT N'purgeFlag = ' + @tS_purgeFlag
        PRINT N'purgeToDate = ' + cast(@tD_purgeToDate as nvarchar(50))
        PRINT N'defaultLanguage = ' + @tS_defaultLanguage
        PRINT N'defaultCurrency = ' + @tS_defaultCurrency
        PRINT N'oldDefaultCurrency = ' + @tS_oldDefaultCurrency 
        PRINT N'originalLoadFromDate = ' + cast(@tD_originalLoadFromDate as nvarchar(50))
        PRINT N'originalLoadToDate = ' + cast(@tD_originalLoadToDate as nvarchar(50))
        if @SRepair = N'+'
        begin
          PRINT N'isRepair = true'
        end 
        else
        begin
          PRINT N'isRepair = false'
        end        
    end

						   @sTargetObject nvarchar(30),

as
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare @nError int
declare @nReturn int
declare @sLognum nvarchar(40)
declare @nLognum int
begin
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'LOGNUM', @sLognum OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	set @nLognum = cast(@sLognum as int)
	set @nLognum = @nLognum + 1
	set @sLognum = cast(@nLognum as nvarchar(40))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'LOGNUM', @sLognum 
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	BEGIN TRANSACTION
	insert into r5dwetlrunlogdetail
             (lgd_logrunnumber,
              lgd_operation,
              lgd_step,
              lgd_targetobject,
              lgd_starttime,
              lgd_status,

       values (@tN_runNumber,
              @sOperation,
              @sStep,
              upper(@sTargetObject),
              getdate(),
              @sStatus ,
	      @nLognum)
	COMMIT TRANSACTION
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
return
ERROR_HANDLER:
	BEGIN TRANSACTION
    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'r5dwetlrunlogdetail', null
    COMMIT TRANSACTION
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		return -1
	end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_INITIALIZEFORREPAIR
						    @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
						    @tD_loadFromDate       datetime output,
						    @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						    @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						    @tB_isRepair           bit output,
						    @tD_loadFirstDate      datetime,
						    @sOP_FULL_LOAD         nvarchar(160)
						    
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSTEP_REPAIR_DATES nvarchar(160)
	declare @nReturn int
	declare @sLoadFromDate nvarchar(32)
	declare @sLoadToDate nvarchar(32)
	declare @msg nvarchar(80)
begin

	if @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD
		set @tB_isRepair = 0
	else
	begin
		if @tD_purgeToDate is not null and dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@tD_purgeToDate, N'DD') + 1 > @tD_loadFirstDate
		begin
			set @tD_loadFromDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@tD_purgeToDate, N'DD') + 1
		end
		else
		begin
			set @tD_loadFromDate = @tD_loadFirstDate
		end

		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_REPAIR_DATES', @sSTEP_REPAIR_DATES OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1

		set @sLoadFromDate = convert(nvarchar(32), @tD_loadFromDate, 111)
		set @sLoadToDate = convert(nvarchar(32), @tD_loadToDate, 111)
		set @msg = @sSTEP_REPAIR_DATES + @sLoadFromDate + N' - ' + @sLoadToDate
		execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_WRITEREPAIRMESSAGE @msg
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	end
end

		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'ERRORLOGNUM', @sErrorlognum 
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1

        BEGIN TRANSACTION
	    insert into r5dwetlrunerrorlog
         	   	   (elg_runnumber,
   	   		    elg_sequence,
   	   		    elg_targetobject,
   	   		    elg_errornum,
   	   		    elg_message,
   	   		    elg_keydata)
        	values 	   (@tN_runNumber,
 	  		    @nErrorlognum,
 			    @sTableName,
 			    @nErrorCode,
 			    @sErrorMsg,
 			    @sKeydata)
        COMMIT TRANSACTION                
        
	end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_O7RUNETL_WITHONEPARAM @bDebug bit

declare @sOP_INIT	nvarchar(30)
declare @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD nvarchar(30)
declare @sOP_FULL_LOAD nvarchar(30)
declare @sOP_PURGE nvarchar(30)
declare @sTARGET_NA nvarchar(30)
declare @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0)
declare @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50)
declare @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1)   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */
declare @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255)

declare @tD_loadToDate         datetime
declare @tD_nextStartDate      datetime
declare @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime

declare @tD_purgeToDate        datetime
declare @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2)   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
declare @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200)   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
declare @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3)   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
declare @tB_debug              bit
declare @tS_loadToDate	       nvarchar(50)
declare @tS_loadFromDate       nvarchar(50)
declare @tB_isRepair           bit
declare @tD_originalLoadFromDate datetime
declare @tD_originalLoadToDate   datetime
declare @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges bit
declare @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges bit
declare @tD_loadFirstDate   datetime
declare @sLogmessage	       nvarchar(4000)
declare @sDEF_LANG	       nvarchar(5)
declare @sChk		       nvarchar(4)
declare @bNRun 		       int
declare @sRunNumber            nvarchar(40)
begin
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZERUNLOGENTRY @nRunNumber OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
		
	set @sRunNumber = cast(@nRunNumber as nvarchar(40))

	-- Store this as a global value for convenience
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'gRunNumber', @sRunNumber
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_ENABLEETL @bNRun OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	
	if @bNRun = 1
	begin
	
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_GETRUNPARAMETERS @tN_runNumber             OUTPUT,
						    @tS_tenantID              OUTPUT,
						    @tS_loadFlag              OUTPUT,   
						    @tS_loadType              OUTPUT,
						    @tD_loadFromDate          OUTPUT,
						    @tD_loadToDate            OUTPUT,
						    @tD_nextStartDate         OUTPUT,
						    @tD_minWarehouseDate      OUTPUT,
						    @tS_purgeFlag             OUTPUT,   
						    @tD_purgeToDate           OUTPUT,
						    @tS_defaultLanguage       OUTPUT,   
						    @tS_defaultCurrency       OUTPUT,   
						    @tS_oldDefaultCurrency    OUTPUT,   
						    @tB_debug                 OUTPUT, 
						    @tB_isRepair              OUTPUT,
						    @tD_originalLoadFromDate  OUTPUT,
						    @tD_originalLoadToDate    OUTPUT,
						    @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges OUTPUT,
						    @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges OUTPUT,
						    @tD_loadFirstDate         OUTPUT,
						    @nRunNumber, 
						    @bDebug
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_PURGE', @sOP_PURGE OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_ABORTED', @sSTATUS_ABORTED OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	
	if @tS_defaultCurrency != @tS_oldDefaultCurrency and

         @tS_loadType = @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD

	--set @sLogmessage = dbo.BAIMERROR_GETERRORMESSAGE(28275)

		return -1
	set @sLogmessage = dbo.R5O7_O7GET_TEXT(N'BSWHSE',@sDEF_LANG,738)

	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETERUNLOGENTRY @nRunNumber, @sSTATUS_ABORTED, @sLogmessage
        -- N'The installation default currency has been changed. You must run a Full (initial) load to re-initialize the data warehouse.'
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	end
	else
	begin

	if @tS_loadFlag = '+' and @tS_loadType = @sOP_FULL_LOAD
	begin

	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEWAREHOUSEOBJECTS 	@tN_runNumber, @tS_tenantID, @tS_loadFlag, @tS_loadType,
														@tD_loadFromDate, @tD_loadToDate, @tD_nextStartDate, @tD_minWarehouseDate, 
															@tS_purgeFlag, @tD_purgeToDate, @tS_defaultLanguage,
														@tS_defaultCurrency, @tS_oldDefaultCurrency, @tB_debug
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	return -1 


        -- Reset the purge settings - tables have been truncated

	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_UPDATERUNPARAMETERS  @tN_runNumber, @tS_tenantID, @tS_loadFlag, @tS_loadType,
												@tD_loadFromDate, @tD_loadToDate, @tD_nextStartDate, @tD_minWarehouseDate, 
													@tS_purgeFlag, @tD_purgeToDate, @tS_defaultLanguage,
												@tS_defaultCurrency, @tS_oldDefaultCurrency, @tB_debug, 
													@sOP_PURGE

	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1 

	end
        else
	begin
            if @tS_purgeFlag = N'+'
	    begin

                execute O7DWETLDM_PURGEDATAWAREHOUSE    @tN_runNumber, @tS_tenantID, @tS_loadFlag, @tS_loadType,
						        @tD_loadFromDate, @tD_loadToDate, @tD_nextStartDate, @tD_minWarehouseDate, 
							@tS_purgeFlag, @tD_purgeToDate, @tS_defaultLanguage,
							@tS_defaultCurrency, @tS_oldDefaultCurrency, @tB_debug
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1 
		execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_UPDATERUNPARAMETERS  @tN_runNumber, @tS_tenantID, @tS_loadFlag, @tS_loadType,
								@tD_loadFromDate, @tD_loadToDate, @tD_nextStartDate, @tD_minWarehouseDate, 
								@tS_purgeFlag, @tD_purgeToDate, @tS_defaultLanguage,
								@tS_defaultCurrency, @tS_oldDefaultCurrency, @tB_debug, 
								@sOP_PURGE

		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1 
           end
        end
		if @tS_loadFlag = N'+'
		begin

			if @tB_isRepair = 1
			begin
				execute O7DWETL_INITIALIZEFORREPAIR @tS_loadType,@tD_loadFromDate OUTPUT, @tD_loadToDate, @tD_purgeToDate, 
							@tB_isRepair OUTPUT, @tD_loadFirstDate, @sOP_FULL_LOAD
			end

		execute O7DWETLDM_LOADDATAWAREHOUSE     @tN_runNumber, @tS_tenantID, @tS_loadFlag, @tS_loadType,
							@tD_loadFromDate, @tD_loadToDate, @tD_nextStartDate, @tD_minWarehouseDate, 
							@tS_purgeFlag, @tD_purgeToDate, @tS_defaultLanguage,
							@tS_defaultCurrency, @tS_oldDefaultCurrency, @tB_debug, @tB_isRepair,
						    @tD_originalLoadFromDate, @tD_originalLoadToDate, @tB_hasObjectType2SCDChanges,
						    @tB_hasSupplierType2SCDChanges, @tD_loadFirstDate

		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			return -1 
		end

		execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_UPDATERUNPARAMETERS  @tN_runNumber, @tS_tenantID, @tS_loadFlag, @tS_loadType,
								@tD_loadFromDate, @tD_loadToDate, @tD_nextStartDate, @tD_minWarehouseDate, 
								@tS_purgeFlag, @tD_purgeToDate, @tS_defaultLanguage,
								@tS_defaultCurrency, @tS_oldDefaultCurrency, @tB_debug, 
								@tS_loadType

		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1 
        	end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_RECREATESEQUENCES  @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
					    @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
					    @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */
					    @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
					    @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
					    @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
					    @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
					    @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
					    @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
					    @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
					    @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
					    @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
					    @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
					    @tB_debug              bit
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
declare @sSequenceName      nvarchar(30)    /*  r5dwdimensions.dim_table%TYPE */
declare @sTableName         nvarchar(30)    /* r5dwdimensions.dim_table%TYPE */
declare @sCreateKeySequence nvarchar(1)     /* r5dwdimensions.dim_createkeysequence%TYPE */
declare @nReturn int
begin
	declare cTables cursor local for
         select   dim_table,
                  dim_createkeysequence
         from     r5dwdimensions
         order by dim_table
    open cTables
	fetch next from cTables into @sTableName, @sCreateKeySequence
    while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
		if @sCreateKeySequence = N'+'
		begin
			set @sSequenceName = N'S5' + substring(@sTableName, 3, len(@sTableName)-2) + isnull(@tS_tenantID,'')
			execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_DROPSEQUENCE @tN_runNumber, @sSequenceName
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				close cTables
				deallocate cTables
				return -1
			end
			execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_CREATESEQUENCE @tN_runNumber, @sSequenceName
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				close cTables
				deallocate cTables
				return -1
			end
        end
		fetch next from cTables into @sTableName, @sCreateKeySequence
	end
	close cTables
	deallocate cTables
end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_RECREATETABLESEQUENCE  @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
					    @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
					    @S_tableName           nvarchar(30)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
declare @sSequenceName      nvarchar(30)    /*  r5dwdimensions.dim_table%TYPE */
declare @sCreateKeySequence nvarchar(1)     /* r5dwdimensions.dim_createkeysequence%TYPE */
declare @nReturn int
begin
	if exists (select N'X' from r5dwdimensions where dim_table = @S_tableName and dim_createkeysequence = N'+')
	begin
		set @sSequenceName = N'S5' + substring(@S_tableName, 3, len(@S_tableName)-2) + isnull(@tS_tenantID,'')

		if exists (select N'X' from SYSOBJECTS where name = @sSequenceName and type = N'U')
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_DROPSEQUENCE @tN_runNumber, @sSequenceName
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				return -1
			end
		end
		
		execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_CREATESEQUENCE @tN_runNumber, @sSequenceName
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			return -1
		end
	end
end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_SETOPSPACSETTING @sSetting nvarchar(50), @sValue nvarchar(50)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare @nNRecs int
declare @sStmt nvarchar(255)
begin
	SELECT @nNRecs = count(1) from r5opsettings where ost_setting = @sSetting
	
    if @nNRecs > 0 
	begin
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
        update r5opsettings
        set    ost_audituser = N'ETL',
               ost_audittimestamp = getdate(),
               ost_curvalue = @sValue
        where  ost_setting = @sSetting
        COMMIT TRANSACTION
	end
    else
	begin
         BEGIN TRANSACTION
         insert into r5opsettings( ost_audituser, ost_audittimestamp, ost_setting, ost_curvalue )
         values (N'ETL',
                 getdate(),
                 @sSetting,
                 @sValue)
        COMMIT TRANSACTION         
	end
end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_TRUNCATETABLE  @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
					    @sTableName nvarchar(30)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
declare @nError int
declare @nReturn int
declare @sSTATUS_EXECUTING      nvarchar(9)
declare @sOP_INIT		nvarchar(30)
declare @sSTEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE	nvarchar(30)
declare @sSTATUS_COMPLETED	nvarchar(9)
declare @sSQLStatement		nvarchar(4000)
begin
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'O7DWETL_TRUNCATETABLE init package error', null
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			return -1
		end
		return
	end

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INIT', @sOP_INIT OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE', @sSTEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
       execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber,
														@sOP_INIT, @sSTEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE,
                               							@sTableName, @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
-- we cannot use truncate table here as it doesn't work with disabling foreign key constraint'
    set @sSQLStatement = N'DELETE FROM ' + @sTableName
	EXECUTE(@sSQLStatement)
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_COMPLETED', @sSTATUS_COMPLETED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
        execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY 	@tN_runNumber,
														@sOP_INIT, @sSTEP_TRUNCATE_TABLE,
                             							@sTableName, 1, @sSTATUS_COMPLETED
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
return
ERROR_HANDLER:
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, @sTableName, null
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		return -1
	end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_TRUNCATETABLES @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
declare @sTableName nvarchar(30)     /* r5dwdimensions.dim_table%TYPE */
declare @sSurrogateLookupTableName nvarchar(30)     /* r5dwdimensions.dim_surrogatekeylookuptbl%TYPE */
declare @bNRecs bit
declare @nReturn int
begin
    declare cTables cursor local for
         select dim_table tablename,
                dim_surrogatekeylookuptbl keytablename
         from   r5dwdimensions
         where  dim_tabletype = N'T'
         union
         select dmt_table tablename,
                null keytablename
         from   r5dwdatamarts
		 where  dmt_tabletype = N'T'
        open cTables
	fetch next from cTables into @sTableName, @sSurrogateLookupTableName
        while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
        execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_TABLEEXISTS @bNRecs OUTPUT, @sTableName
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			close cTables
			deallocate cTables
			return -1
		end
		if @bNRecs = 0
		begin
            execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_TRUNCATETABLE 	@tN_runNumber, @sTableName
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				close cTables
				deallocate cTables
				return -1
			end
		end
        
		execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_TABLEEXISTS @bNRecs OUTPUT, @sSurrogateLookupTableName
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			close cTables
			deallocate cTables
			return -1
		end
        if @sSurrogateLookupTableName is not null and @bNRecs = 0
		begin
            execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_TRUNCATETABLE 	@tN_runNumber, @sSurrogateLookupTableName
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				close cTables
				deallocate cTables
				return -1
			end
		end
		fetch next from cTables into @sTableName, @sSurrogateLookupTableName
	end
	close cTables
	deallocate cTables
end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_UPDATERUNPARAMETERS    @tN_runNumber numeric(18,0),
						    @tS_tenantID           nvarchar(50),
						    @tS_loadFlag           nvarchar(1),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_loadFlag%TYPE, */
						    @tS_loadType           nvarchar(255),
						    @tD_loadFromDate       datetime,
						    @tD_loadToDate         datetime,
						    @tD_nextStartDate      datetime,
						    @tD_minWarehouseDate   datetime,
						    @tS_purgeFlag          nvarchar(1),   /*r5dwetlrunctrl.run_purgeflag%TYPE, */
						    @tD_purgeToDate        datetime,
						    @tS_defaultLanguage    nvarchar(2),   /* r5languages.lan_code%TYPE, */
						    @tS_defaultCurrency    nvarchar(200),   /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE, */
						    @tS_oldDefaultCurrency nvarchar(3),   /* r5dwetlrunctrl.run_defcur%TYPE, */
						    @tB_debug              bit,
						    @sOperation    nvarchar(30)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
declare @nError int
declare @nReturn int
declare @sSTATUS_EXECUTING nvarchar(9)
declare @sOP_INIT					nvarchar(30)
declare @sSTEP_UPDATE_RUN_PARAMETERS	nvarchar(30)
declare @sTARGET_NA					nvarchar(30)
declare @sOP_FULL_LOAD				nvarchar(30)
declare @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD		nvarchar(30)
declare @sOP_PURGE					nvarchar(30)
declare @sSTATUS_COMPLETED			nvarchar(9)
begin
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_PACKAGE_INIT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, 'O7DWETL_UPDATERUNPARAMETERS initialization package error', null
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			return -1
		end
		return
	end

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'TARGET_NA', @sTARGET_NA OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STEP_UPDATE_RUN_PARAMETERS', @sSTEP_UPDATE_RUN_PARAMETERS OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_EXECUTING', @sSTATUS_EXECUTING OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
        execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_INITIALIZEDETAILLOGENTRY @tN_runNumber,
														@sOperation, @sSTEP_UPDATE_RUN_PARAMETERS,
                              							@sTARGET_NA, @sSTATUS_EXECUTING
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_FULL_LOAD', @sOP_FULL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD', @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_PURGE', @sOP_PURGE OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

    if @sOperation = @sOP_FULL_LOAD
	begin
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
		update r5dwetlrunctrl
        set    run_loadtype = N'I', -- Incremental load
               run_loadfromdate = @tD_nextStartDate,
               run_loadfirstdate = @tD_loadFromDate,
               run_repair = N'-'
		COMMIT TRANSACTION
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
	end
	else if @sOperation = @sOP_INCREMENTAL_LOAD
	begin
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
		update r5dwetlrunctrl
        set     run_loadtype = N'I', -- Incremental load
                run_loadfromdate = @tD_nextStartDate,
                run_repair = N'-'
		COMMIT TRANSACTION
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
	end
	else if @sOperation = @sOP_PURGE
	begin
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
		update r5dwetlrunctrl
        	set    run_purgeflag = N'-'
        COMMIT TRANSACTION    
		set @nError = @@ERROR
		if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		goto ERROR_HANDLER
	end
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_COMPLETED', @sSTATUS_COMPLETED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
    execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_COMPLETEDETAILLOGENTRY 	@tN_runNumber,  
														@sOperation, @sSTEP_UPDATE_RUN_PARAMETERS,
                            							@sTARGET_NA, 1, @sSTATUS_COMPLETED
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
return
ERROR_HANDLER:
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @tN_runNumber, @nError, @sTARGET_NA, null
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		return -1
	end
	
end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7DWETL_WRITEREPAIRMESSAGE @sStep nvarchar(80)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS OFF
	declare @sLognum nvarchar(40)
	declare @nLognum int
	declare @sOperation nvarchar(30)
	declare @sTargetObject nvarchar(30)
	declare @sSTATUS_COMPLETED nvarchar(9)
	declare @sRunNumber nvarchar(40)
	declare @nRunNumber numeric(18, 0)
	declare @nReturn int
	declare @nError int
begin
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'LOGNUM', @sLognum OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	set @nLognum = cast(@sLognum as int)
	set @nLognum = @nLognum + 1
	set @sLognum = cast(@nLognum as nvarchar(40))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'LOGNUM', @sLognum
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'OP_REPAIR', @sOperation OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'TARGET_NA', @sTargetObject OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'STATUS_COMPLETED', @sSTATUS_COMPLETED OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7DWETL', N'gRunNumber', @sRunNumber OUTPUT
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @nRunNumber = cast(@nRunNumber as numeric(18, 0))
	
    BEGIN TRANSACTION
	insert into r5dwetlrunlogdetail
             (lgd_logrunnumber,
              lgd_operation,
              lgd_step,
              lgd_targetobject,
              lgd_starttime,
              lgd_status,
              lgd_sequence)
       values (@sRunNumber,
              @sOperation,
              @sStep,
              upper(@sTargetObject),
              getdate(),
              @sSTATUS_COMPLETED,
              @nLognum)
	COMMIT TRANSACTION
    
	set @nError = @@ERROR
	if @nError <> 0
	goto ERROR_HANDLER
	
return
ERROR_HANDLER:
	execute @nReturn = O7DWETL_LOADETLERRORLOG @nRunNumber, @nError, 'r5dwetlrunlogdetail', null
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	begin
		return -1
	end
	
end

CREATE PROCEDURE o7eadiff 
  @sSessionid    NVARCHAR(30),
  @sEvent        NVARCHAR(30),
  @sLang         NVARCHAR(2),
  @sChk          NVARCHAR(4)    OUTPUT
AS
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  DECLARE @sElacols     NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sElacols2    NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sEvtcols     NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sEvtcols2    NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sPromcols    NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sActcols     NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sInrhcols    NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sEtpcols     NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sEstcols     NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sPartcols    NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sDocucols    NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sAddcols     NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sKsfcols     NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sPevcols     NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sElaparent   NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sDetailstext NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sInsstring   NVARCHAR(40)
  DECLARE @sUpdstring   NVARCHAR(40)
  DECLARE @sDelstring   NVARCHAR(40)
  DECLARE @sHdrstring   NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sActstring   NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sEpostring   NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sEtpstring   NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sEststring   NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sDocstring   NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sDocsstring  NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sDocpstring  NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sPasstring   NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sCmtstring   NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sCmtsstring  NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sCmtpstring  NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sKsfstring   NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sPevstring   NVARCHAR(255)
  DECLARE @sTablename   NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sSQL         NVARCHAR(500)
  DECLARE @nReturn      INTEGER  

  DECLARE @sPk          NVARCHAR(200)
  DECLARE @sPk2         NVARCHAR(200)
  DECLARE @sValue       NVARCHAR(2000)
  DECLARE @sColumn      NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sObj         NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sObjorg      NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @nSeq         NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sPart        NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sPartorg     NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sType        NVARCHAR(4)
  DECLARE @sAddLang	    NVARCHAR(2)
  DECLARE @nLine        NVARCHAR(30)

  SET @sChk = '0'
  IF @sSessionid IS NULL OR @sEvent IS NULL or @sLang IS NULL 
    /* All parameters are required. */
    RETURN

  /* Initialize some strings. */
  SET @sInsstring  = dbo.o7getactionlabel( N'+', N'-', N'-', @sLang, N'BSAUDP' )
  SET @sUpdstring  = dbo.o7getactionlabel( N'-', N'+', N'-', @sLang, N'BSAUDP' )
  SET @sDelstring  = dbo.o7getactionlabel( N'-', N'-', N'+', @sLang, N'BSAUDP' )  
  SET @sHdrstring  = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSJOBS', @sLang, N'HDR' )
  SET @sActstring  = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSJOBS', @sLang, N'ACT' )
  SET @sEpostring  = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSJOBS', @sLang, N'EPO' )
  SET @sEtpstring  = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSJOBS', @sLang, N'ETP' )
  SET @sEststring  = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSJOBS', @sLang, N'ETP_SELECTSTANDARDS' )
  SET @sDocstring  = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSJOBS', @sLang, N'DOC' )
  SET @sDocpstring = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSJOBS', @sLang, N'DOCP' )
  SET @sDocsstring = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSJOBS', @sLang, N'DOCS' )
  SET @sPasstring  = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSJOBS', @sLang, N'PAS' )
  SET @sCmtstring  = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSJOBS', @sLang, N'CMT' )  
  SET @sCmtpstring = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSJOBS', @sLang, N'CMTP' )  
  SET @sCmtsstring = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSJOBS', @sLang, N'CMTS' )  
  SET @sKsfstring  = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSJOBS', @sLang, N'KSF' )
  SET @sPevstring  = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSJOBS', @sLang, N'PEV' )

  SET @sElacols  = dbo.o7eadiff_getcolumns( N'ELA', 0, 271 )
  SET @sElacols2 = dbo.o7eadiff_getcolumns( N'ELA', 272, 999 )
  SET @sEvtcols  = dbo.o7eadiff_getcolumns( N'EVNT', 0, 271 )
  SET @sEvtcols2 = dbo.o7eadiff_getcolumns( N'EVNT', 272, 999 )
  SET @sActcols  = dbo.o7eadiff_getcolumns( N'ACT', 0, 999 )
  SET @sInrhcols = dbo.o7eadiff_getcolumns( N'INRH', 0, 999 )
  SET @sPromcols = dbo.o7eadiff_getcolumns( N'PROM', 0, 999 )
  SET @sEtpcols  = dbo.o7eadiff_getcolumns( N'ETP', 0, 999 )
  SET @sEstcols  = dbo.o7eadiff_getcolumns( N'EST', 0, 999 )
  SET @sDocucols = dbo.o7eadiff_getcolumns( N'DOCU', 0, 999 )
  SET @sPartcols = dbo.o7eadiff_getcolumns( N'PART', 0, 999 )
  SET @sAddcols  = dbo.o7eadiff_getcolumns( N'ADD', 0, 999 )
  SET @sKsfcols  = dbo.o7eadiff_getcolumns( N'SFWO', 0, 999 )
  SET @sPevcols  = dbo.o7eadiff_getcolumns( N'PRME', 0, 999 )
 
  /* Delete data of current session and all data older than 2 days. */
  DELETE FROM r5eadiff
  WHERE  ead_sessionid = @sSessionid
  OR     ead_date <= getdate() - 2
  
  /* Drop all global temp tables to be used, normally this should not be necessary. */ 
  EXECUTE @nReturn = o7eadiff_droptemptables @sSessionid
  
  /* Create temp tables for the archive table and the events table. */
  EXEC( 'SELECT * INTO r5ela_global_temp_' + @sSessionid + ' FROM r5elecarchive WHERE 1=2'  )
  EXEC( 'SELECT * INTO r5evt_global_temp_' + @sSessionid + ' FROM r5events WHERE 1=2'  )

  /* Polulate the temp table with the archived @sEvent data. */
  EXECUTE @nReturn = o7eadiff_insela @sSessionid, @sEvent, N'EVNT', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @sElacols, @sElacols2 
  
  /* Retrieve the pk of the @sEvent archive record, if not present there is nothing to compare, so exit. */
  SET @sSQL = 'SELECT @sOutput = ela_code FROM r5ela_global_temp_' + @sSessionid 
  EXEC sp_executeSql @sSQL, N'@sOutput NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT', @sElaparent OUTPUT
  IF @sElaparent IS NULL
    BEGIN
      EXEC( 'DROP TABLE r5ela_global_temp_' + @sSessionid )
      EXEC( 'DROP TABLE r5evt_global_temp_' + @sSessionid )
      SET @sChk = '1'
      RETURN
    END  

  /* * * *   E V E N T S   * * * */
  SET @sTablename = 'r5evt_global_temp_' + @sSessionid
  EXEC( 'INSERT INTO ' + @sTablename + ' ( ' + @sEvtcols + @sEvtcols2 + ' ) SELECT ' + @sEvtcols + @sEvtcols2 +
        ' FROM r5events WHERE evt_code = ''' + @sEvent + '''' )
  EXECUTE @nReturn = o7eadiff_loopela @sSessionid, @sEvent, @sLang, N'EVNT', @sHdrstring, @sTablename, @sEvent,
                     N'#31#32#33#34#35#36#50#51#65#66#67#94#95#96#131#132#133#155#', NULL, NULL, @sInsstring, @sUpdstring 
  EXEC ( 'DELETE FROM r5ela_global_temp_' + @sSessionid )

   
  /* * * *   C U S T O M   F I E L D S   * * * */
  SET @sTablename = 'r5prv_global_temp_' + @sSessionid
  EXEC( 'SELECT * INTO ' + @sTablename + ' FROM r5propertyvalues WHERE 1=2'  )

  /* Retrieve custom fields of the current work order. */
  DECLARE c_prv CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
    SELECT prv_property, COALESCE( prv_value, CAST( prv_nvalue AS CHAR), dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( prv_dvalue, N'DD-MON-YYYY' ) ),
           CASE prv_value WHEN NULL THEN CASE prv_nvalue WHEN NULL THEN N'PRV_DVALUE' ELSE N'PRV_NVALUE' END ELSE N'PRV_VALUE' END
    FROM   r5propertyvalues
    WHERE  prv_code = @sEvent
    AND    prv_rentity = N'EVNT'
    ORDER BY prv_property
  OPEN c_prv
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_prv INTO @sPk, @sValue, @sColumn
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN  
      EXEC( 'INSERT INTO ' + @sTablename + ' ( ' + @sPromcols + ' ) SELECT ' + @sPromcols + 
            ' FROM r5propertyvalues WHERE prv_code = ''' + @sEvent + 
            ''' AND prv_property = ''' + @sPk + ''' AND prv_rentity = ''EVNT'' ' )
      EXECUTE @nReturn = o7eadiff_insela @sSessionid, @sEvent, N'PROM', @sElaparent, @sPk, NULL, NULL, @sElacols, @sElacols2 
      EXECUTE @nReturn = o7eadiff_loopela @sSessionid, @sEvent, @sLang, N'PROM', @sHdrstring, @sTablename, @sPk,
                     N'#8#11#12#', @sColumn, @sValue, @sInsstring, @sUpdstring 
      /* Delete from used temp tables. */
      EXEC ( 'DELETE FROM ' + @sTablename )
      EXEC ( 'DELETE FROM r5ela_global_temp_' + @sSessionid )
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_prv INTO @sPk, @sValue, @sColumn
    END
  CLOSE c_prv
  DEALLOCATE c_prv   

  /* Retrieve custom fields that have been deleted. */  
  DECLARE c_ela_prv CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
    SELECT ela_fld1, COALESCE( ela_fld6, ela_fld7, ela_fld8 ),

  SET @cmtlstring  = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSPMTW', @lang, N'CMTL' )  
  SET @cmtsstring  = dbo.o7getfieldlabel( N'WSPMTW', @lang, N'CMTS' )  

  SET @elacols  = dbo.o7eadiffptw_getcolumns( N'ELA' )
  SET @ptwcols  = dbo.o7eadiffptw_getcolumns( N'PTW' )
  SET @ksfcols  = dbo.o7eadiffptw_getcolumns( N'SFWO' )
  SET @pwlcols  = dbo.o7eadiffptw_getcolumns( N'LTPW' )
  SET @Promcols = dbo.o7eadiffptw_getcolumns( N'PROM' )
  SET @ackcols  = dbo.o7eadiffptw_getcolumns( N'CHKL' )
  SET @pwccols  = dbo.o7eadiffptw_getcolumns( N'CNFL' )
  SET @Docucols = dbo.o7eadiffptw_getcolumns( N'DOCU' )
  SET @Partcols = dbo.o7eadiffptw_getcolumns( N'PART' )
  SET @Addcols  = dbo.o7eadiffptw_getcolumns( N'ADD' )
 
  /* Delete data of current session and all data older than 2 days. */
  DELETE FROM r5eadiff
  WHERE  ead_sessionid = @sessionid
  OR     ead_date <= getdate() - 2
  
  /* Drop all global temp tables to be used, normally this should not be necessary. */ 
  EXECUTE @return = o7eadiffptw_droptemptables @sessionid
  
  /* Create temp tables for the archive table and the events table. */
  EXEC( 'SELECT * INTO r5ela_global_temp_' + @sessionid + ' FROM r5elecarchive WHERE 1=2'  )
  EXEC( 'SELECT * INTO r5ptw_global_temp_' + @sessionid + ' FROM r5permittowork WHERE 1=2'  )

  /* Polulate the temp table with the archived @ptw data. */
  EXECUTE @return = o7eadiffptw_insela @sessionid, @ptw, N'PTW', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @elacols 
  
  /* Retrieve the pk of the @ptw archive record, if not present there is nothing to compare, so exit. */
  SET @sql = 'SELECT @sOutput = ela_code FROM r5ela_global_temp_' + @sessionid 
  EXEC sp_executeSql @sql, N'@sOutput NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT', @elaparent OUTPUT
  IF @elaparent IS NULL
    BEGIN
      EXEC( 'DROP TABLE r5ela_global_temp_' + @sessionid )
      EXEC( 'DROP TABLE r5ptw_global_temp_' + @sessionid )
      SET @chk = '1'
      RETURN
    END  


  /* * * *   P T W   * * * */
  SET @tablename = 'r5ptw_global_temp_' + @sessionid
  EXEC( 'INSERT INTO ' + @tablename + ' ( ' + @ptwcols + ' ) SELECT ' + @ptwcols + 
        ' FROM r5permittowork WHERE ptw_code = ''' + @ptw + '''' )
  EXECUTE @return = o7eadiffptw_loopela @sessionid, @ptw, @lang, N'PTW', @hdrstring, @tablename, @ptw,
                     N'##', NULL, NULL, @insstring, @updstring 
  EXEC ( 'DELETE FROM r5ela_global_temp_' + @sessionid )

   
  /* * * *   C U S T O M   F I E L D S   * * * */
  SET @tablename = 'r5prv_global_temp_' + @sessionid
  EXEC( 'SELECT * INTO ' + @tablename + ' FROM r5propertyvalues WHERE 1=2'  )

  /* Retrieve custom fields of the current PTW. */
  DECLARE c_prv CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
    SELECT prv_property, COALESCE( prv_value, CAST( prv_nvalue AS CHAR), dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( prv_dvalue, N'DD-MON-YYYY' ) ),
           CASE prv_value WHEN NULL THEN CASE prv_nvalue WHEN NULL THEN N'PRV_DVALUE' ELSE N'PRV_NVALUE' END ELSE N'PRV_VALUE' END
    FROM   r5propertyvalues
    WHERE  prv_code = @ptw
    AND    prv_rentity = N'PTW'
    ORDER BY prv_property
  OPEN c_prv
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_prv INTO @pk, @value, @column
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN  
      EXEC( 'INSERT INTO ' + @tablename + ' ( ' + @promcols + ' ) SELECT ' + @promcols + 
            ' FROM r5propertyvalues WHERE prv_code = ''' + @ptw + 
            ''' AND prv_property = ''' + @pk + ''' AND prv_rentity = ''PTW'' ' )
      EXECUTE @return = o7eadiffptw_insela @sessionid, @ptw, N'PROM', @elaparent, @pk, NULL, NULL, @elacols 
      EXECUTE @return = o7eadiffptw_loopela @sessionid, @ptw, @lang, N'PROM', @hdrstring, @tablename, @pk,
                     N'#8#11#12#', @column, @value, @insstring, @updstring 
      /* Delete from used temp tables. */
      EXEC ( 'DELETE FROM ' + @tablename )
      EXEC ( 'DELETE FROM r5ela_global_temp_' + @sessionid )
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_prv INTO @pk, @value, @column
    END
  CLOSE c_prv
  DEALLOCATE c_prv   

  /* Retrieve custom fields that have been deleted. */  
  DECLARE c_ela_prv CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
    SELECT ela_fld1, COALESCE( ela_fld6, ela_fld7, ela_fld8 ),
           CASE ela_fld6 WHEN NULL THEN CASE ela_fld7 WHEN NULL THEN N'PRV_DVALUE' ELSE N'PRV_NVALUE' END ELSE N'PRV_VALUE' END
    FROM   r5elecarchive
    WHERE  ela_entity = N'PROM'
    AND    ela_parent = @elaparent
    AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x' 
                    FROM   r5propertyvalues
                    WHERE  prv_code     = @ptw
                    AND    prv_rentity  = N'PTW'
                    AND    prv_property = ela_fld1 )
  OPEN c_ela_prv
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_ela_prv INTO @pk, @value, @column
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN  
      /* Create a differences record if only an archive record exist. */
      EXECUTE @return = o7eadiffptw_insrecord @sessionid, @ptw, @lang, N'PROM', @hdrstring, 
                         N'U', @updstring, @pk, @column, NULL, @value, NULL        
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_ela_prv INTO @pk, @value, @column
    END
  CLOSE c_ela_prv
  DEALLOCATE c_ela_prv   
      
      
  /* * * *   D O C U M

CREATE FUNCTION o7eadiffptw_getcolumns(
  @ent NVARCHAR( 30 ) )
  RETURNS NVARCHAR( 4000 ) AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @cols    NVARCHAR( 4000 )
  DECLARE @elmcode NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @basecol NVARCHAR( 30 )

  DECLARE c_elm CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT elm_code, CASE @ent WHEN N'ELA' THEN REPLACE( elm_archcol, N'ELM_', N'ELA_' ) ELSE elm_basecol END
    FROM   r5elecmapping
    WHERE  elm_entity = CASE @ent WHEN N'ELA' THEN N'PTW' ELSE @ent END
    ORDER BY elm_code

  SET @cols = ''
  OPEN c_elm
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_elm INTO @elmcode, @basecol
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN 
      IF @elmcode <> '1'
        SET @cols = @cols + ','
      SET @cols = @cols + @basecol
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_elm INTO @elmcode, @basecol
    END
  CLOSE c_elm
  DEALLOCATE c_elm
  RETURN @cols
END

CREATE PROCEDURE o7eadiffptw_insela
  @sessionid NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @ptw       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @ent       NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @parent    NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @code      NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @code2     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @code3     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @cols      NVARCHAR( 4000 )
AS
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  DECLARE @wstring NVARCHAR( 500 )
  IF @ent = N'PTW' 
    SET @wstring = 'WHERE  ela_code = ( SELECT CAST( MAX( CAST( ela_code AS NUMERIC ) ) AS CHAR )
                FROM   r5elecarchive
                WHERE  ela_entity  = ''' + @ent + ''' AND ela_entcode = ''' + @ptw + ''' )'
  ELSE IF @ent = N'SFWO' 
    SET @wstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @parent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @ent + 
               ''' AND ela_fld1 = ''' + @code + ''''
  ELSE IF @ent = N'PROM' 
    SET @wstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @parent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @ent + 
               ''' AND ela_fld1 = ''' + @code + ''''
  ELSE IF @ent = N'LTPW' 
    SET @wstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @parent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @ent + 
               ''' AND ela_fld1 = ''' + @code + ''''
  ELSE IF @ent = N'CHKL' 
    SET @wstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @parent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @ent + 
               ''' AND ela_fld1 = ''' + @code + ''''
  ELSE IF @ent = N'CNFL' 
    SET @wstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @parent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @ent + 
               ''' AND ela_fld1 = ''' + @code + ''' AND ela_fld2 = ''' + @code2 + ''''
  ELSE IF @ent IN ( N'DOCU', N'DOCL', N'DOCS' ) 
    SET @wstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @parent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @ent + 
               ''' AND ela_fld1 = ''' + @code + ''''
  ELSE IF @ent = N'PART' 
    SET @wstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @parent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @ent + 
               ''' AND ela_fld1 = ''' + @code + ''' AND ela_fld10 = ''' + @code2 + ''''
  ELSE IF @ent IN ( N'ADD', N'ADDL', N'ADDS' ) 
    SET @wstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @parent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @ent + 
                 ''' AND ela_fld3 = ''' + @code + ''' AND ela_fld6 = ''' + @code2 + ''' AND ela_fld7 = ' + @code3
  EXEC( 'INSERT INTO r5ela_global_temp_' + @sessionid + ' ( ela_code, ' + @cols + ' ) SELECT ela_code, ' + @cols + 
        ' FROM r5elecarchive ' + @wstring )

CREATE PROCEDURE o7eadiffptw_insrecord
  @sessionid    NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @ptw          NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @lang         NVARCHAR( 2 ),
  @curtype      NVARCHAR( 4 ), 
  @typestring   NVARCHAR( 40 ),
  @action       NVARCHAR( 1 ), 
  @actionstring NVARCHAR( 40 ), 
  @pk           NVARCHAR( 200 ), 
  @col          NVARCHAR( 100 ),
  @arccol       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @signedvalue  NVARCHAR( 2000 ), 
  @currentvalue NVARCHAR( 2000 )
AS  
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  DECLARE @field NVARCHAR( 255 )
  IF @curtype = N'PROM' 
    /* Retrieve property name. */
    SET @field = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang, N'PROM', @pk, NULL, NULL )
  ELSE IF @action = N'U' 
    BEGIN
      /* Retrieve boiler text. */
      SELECT @field = bot_text
      FROM   r5boilertexts
      WHERE  bot_function = CASE @curtype WHEN N'PTW'  THEN N'BZPMTW' 
                                          WHEN N'SFWO' THEN N'BZSFWO'
                                          WHEN N'LTPW' THEN N'BZLTPW'
                                          WHEN N'CHKL' THEN N'BZACKD'
                                          WHEN N'CNFL' THEN N'BZPWCD'
                                          WHEN N'DOCU' THEN N'BZDAED'
                                          WHEN N'DOCS' THEN N'BZDAED'
                                          WHEN N'DOCL' THEN N'BZDAED'
                                          WHEN N'PART' THEN N'BZEPAD'
                                          WHEN N'ADD'  THEN N'BZADDD'
                                          WHEN N'ADDS' THEN N'BZADDD'
                                          WHEN N'ADDL' THEN N'BZADDD' END
      AND    bot_fld1     = CASE @curtype WHEN N'ADDS' THEN N'ADD'
                                          WHEN N'ADDL' THEN N'ADD' 
                                          WHEN N'DOCS' THEN N'DOCU' 
                                          WHEN N'DOCL' THEN N'DOCU' 
                                          ELSE @curtype END + '.'+@arccol
      AND    bot_lang     = @lang
    END
  INSERT INTO r5eadiff( ead_sessionid, ead_date, ead_type, ead_action, ead_pk, 
                        ead_field, ead_column, ead_signedvalue, ead_currentvalue )
  VALUES( @sessionid, getdate(), @typestring, @actionstring, 
          CASE @curtype WHEN N'PROM' THEN @ptw ELSE @pk END, @field, @col, @signedvalue, @currentvalue )

CREATE PROCEDURE o7eadiffptw_loopela
  @sessionid       NVARCHAR(30),
  @ptw             NVARCHAR(30),
  @lang            NVARCHAR(2),
  @ent             NVARCHAR(4),
  @entstring       NVARCHAR(100),
  @tablename       NVARCHAR(30),
  @pk              NVARCHAR(200),
  @datecols        NVARCHAR(200), -- Holds numbers representing date columns ( without time ), separated by #s.
  @promcol         NVARCHAR(30),
  @promvalue       NVARCHAR(100),
  @insstring       NVARCHAR(40),
  @updstring       NVARCHAR(40) 
AS
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  DECLARE @code    NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @code2   NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @elmcode NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @basecol NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @archcol NVARCHAR(50)
  DECLARE @coltype NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sql     NVARCHAR(200)
  DECLARE @return  INTEGER

  DECLARE c_elm CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT elm_code, elm_basecol, elm_archcol, elm_coltype
    FROM   r5elecmapping
    WHERE  elm_entity = CASE WHEN @ent IN ( N'DOCL', N'DOCS' ) THEN N'DOCU'
                             WHEN @ent IN ( N'ADDL', N'ADDS' ) THEN N'ADD' ELSE @ent END
    AND ( ( elm_entity = N'PROM' AND elm_code IN ( 6, 7, 8 ) ) OR
          ( elm_entity = N'ADD'  AND elm_code <> 9 ) OR
            elm_entity NOT IN ( N'PROM', N'ADD' ) )
    ORDER BY elm_code

  OPEN c_elm
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_elm INTO @elmcode, @basecol, @archcol, @coltype
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN 
      SET @code  = NULL
      SET @code2 = NULL
      /* Retrieve the archived value of the current column. */
      SET @sql = 'SELECT @sOutput = ' + REPLACE( @archcol, 'ELM_', 'ELA_' ) + 
                  ' FROM r5ela_global_temp_' + @sessionid 
      EXEC sp_executeSql @sql, N'@sOutput NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT', @code2 OUTPUT
      IF @elmcode = N'1' AND @code2 IS NULL
        BEGIN
          /* No elec archive record found, so must be insert. */
          IF @ent = N'PROM' 
            EXECUTE @return = o7eadiffptw_insrecord @sessionid, @ptw, @lang, @ent, @entstring, 
                               N'U', @updstring, @pk, @promcol, NULL, NULL, @promvalue
          ELSE
            EXECUTE @return = o7eadiffptw_insrecord @sessionid, @ptw, @lang, @ent, @entstring, 
                               N'I', @insstring, @pk, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
          BREAK
        END
        
      /* Retrieve the current/actual value of the current column.  Use date format for Date columns. */
      IF CHARINDEX( '#'+@elmcode+'#', @datecols ) > 0 
        BEGIN
          /* Date columns, without time */
          SET @sql = 'SELECT @sOutput = dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( ' + @basecol + ', N''DD-MON-YYYY'' ) FROM ' + @tablename
          EXEC sp_executeSql @sql, N'@sOutput NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT', @code OUTPUT
        END
      ELSE IF @coltype = N'datetime' 
        BEGIN
          /* Date columns, with time. */   
          SET @sql = 'SELECT @sOutput = dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( ' + @basecol + ', N''DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'' ) FROM ' + @tablename
          EXEC sp_executeSql @sql, N'@sOutput NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT', @code OUTPUT
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN 
          /* None date columns. */
          SET @sql = 'SELECT @sOutput = ' + @basecol + ' FROM ' + @tablename
          EXEC sp_executeSql @sql, N'@sOutput NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT', @code OUTPUT
        END   
      IF COALESCE( @code, N'!$#@' ) <> COALESCE( @code2, N'!$#@' )  
        /* If the values are different, insert a record into the differences table. */
        EXECUTE @return = o7eadiffptw_insrecord @sessionid, @ptw, @lang, @ent, @entstring, 
                           N'U', @updstring, @pk, @basecol, @archcol, @code2, @code

      FETCH NEXT FROM c_elm INTO @elmcode, @basecol, @archcol, @coltype
    END
  CLOSE c_elm
  DEALLOCATE c_elm

CREATE FUNCTION o7eadiff_getcolumns(
  @sEnt NVARCHAR(30),
  @nMin NUMERIC,
  @nMAx NUMERIC )
  RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000) AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @sCols    NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sElmcode NVARCHAR(20)
  DECLARE @sBasecol NVARCHAR(30)

  DECLARE c_elm CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT elm_code, CASE @sEnt WHEN N'ELA' THEN REPLACE( elm_archcol, 'ELM_', 'ELA_' ) ELSE elm_basecol END
    FROM   r5elecmapping
    WHERE  elm_entity = CASE @sEnt WHEN N'ELA' THEN N'EVNT' ELSE @sEnt END
    AND    elm_code BETWEEN @nMin AND @nMax
    ORDER BY elm_code

  SET @sCols = ''
  OPEN c_elm
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_elm INTO @sElmcode, @sBasecol
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN 
      IF @sElmcode <> '1'
        SET @sCols = @sCols + ','
      SET @sCols = @sCols + @sBasecol
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_elm INTO @sElmcode, @sBasecol
    END
  CLOSE c_elm
  DEALLOCATE c_elm
  RETURN @sCols
END

CREATE PROCEDURE o7eadiff_insela
  @sSessionid NVARCHAR(30),
  @sEvent     NVARCHAR(30),
  @sEnt       NVARCHAR(4),
  @sParent    NVARCHAR(30),
  @sCode      NVARCHAR(30),
  @sCode2     NVARCHAR(30),
  @sCode3     NVARCHAR(30),
  @sCols      NVARCHAR(4000),
  @sCols2     NVARCHAR(4000)
AS
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  DECLARE @sWstring NVARCHAR(500)
  IF @sEnt = N'EVNT' 
    SET @sWstring = 'WHERE  ela_code = ( SELECT CAST( MAX( CAST( ela_code AS NUMERIC ) ) AS CHAR )
                FROM   r5elecarchive
                WHERE  ela_entity  = ''' + @sEnt + ''' AND ela_entcode = ''' + @sEvent + ''' )'
  ELSE IF @sEnt = N'ACT' 
    SET @sWstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @sParent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @sEnt + 
               ''' AND ela_fld2 = ''' + @sCode + ''''
  ELSE IF @sEnt = N'PROM' 
    SET @sWstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @sParent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @sEnt + 
               ''' AND ela_fld1 = ''' + @sCode + ''''
  ELSE IF @sEnt = N'INRH' 
    SET @sWstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @sParent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @sEnt + 
               ''' AND ela_fld40 = ''' + @sCode + ''''
  ELSE IF @sEnt = N'ETP' 
    SET @sWstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @sParent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @sEnt + 
               ''' AND ela_fld2 = ''' + @sCode + ''' AND ela_fld3 = ''' + @sCode2 + ''' AND ela_fld4 = ''' + @sCode3 + ''''
  ELSE IF @sEnt = N'EST' 
    SET @sWstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @sParent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @sEnt + 
               ''' AND ela_fld1 = ''' + @sCode + ''''
  ELSE IF @sEnt IN ( N'DOCU', N'DOCS', N'DOCP' )
    SET @sWstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @sParent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @sEnt + 
               ''' AND ela_fld1 = ''' + @sCode + ''''
  ELSE IF @sEnt = N'PART' 
    SET @sWstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @sParent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @sEnt + 
               ''' AND ela_fld1 = ''' + @sCode + ''' AND ela_fld10 = ''' + @sCode2 + ''''
  ELSE IF @sEnt IN ( N'ADD', N'ADDS', N'ADDP' ) 
    SET @sWstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @sParent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @sEnt + 
                 ''' AND ela_fld3 = ''' + @sCode + ''' AND ela_fld6 = ''' + @sCode2 + ''' AND ela_fld7 = ' + @sCode3
  ELSE IF @sEnt = N'SFWO'
    SET @sWstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @sParent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @sEnt + 
                 ''' AND ela_fld1 = ''' + @sCode + ''''
  ELSE IF @sEnt = N'PRME'
    SET @sWstring = 'WHERE ela_parent  = ''' + @sParent + ''' AND ela_entity  = ''' + @sEnt + 
                 ''' AND ela_fld1 = ''' + @sCode + ''''

  EXEC( 'INSERT INTO r5ela_global_temp_' + @sSessionid + ' ( ela_code, ' + @sCols + @sCols2 + ' ) SELECT ela_code, ' + @sCols + @sCols2 + 
        ' FROM r5elecarchive ' + @sWstring )

CREATE PROCEDURE o7eadiff_insrecord
  @sSessionid    NVARCHAR(30),
  @sEvent        NVARCHAR(30),
  @sLang         NVARCHAR(2),
  @sCurtype      NVARCHAR(4), 
  @sTypestring   NVARCHAR(40),
  @sAction       NVARCHAR(1), 
  @sActionstring NVARCHAR(40), 
  @sPk           NVARCHAR(200), 
  @sCol          NVARCHAR(100),
  @sArccol       NVARCHAR(30),
  @sSignedvalue  NVARCHAR(2000), 
  @sCurrentvalue NVARCHAR(2000)
AS  
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  DECLARE @sField NVARCHAR(255)
  IF @sCurtype = N'PROM' 
    /* Retrieve property name. */
    SET @sField = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'PROM', @sPk, NULL, NULL )
  ELSE IF @sAction = N'U' 
    BEGIN
      /* Retrieve boiler text. */
      SELECT @sField = bot_text
      FROM   r5boilertexts
      WHERE  bot_function = CASE @sCurtype WHEN N'EVNT' THEN N'BZEVTD' 
                                           WHEN N'ACT'  THEN N'BZACTD'
                                           WHEN N'INRH' THEN N'BZEPOD'
                                           WHEN N'ETP'  THEN N'BZETPD'
                                           WHEN N'EST'  THEN N'BZESTD'
                                           WHEN N'DOCU' THEN N'BZDAED'
                                           WHEN N'DOCS' THEN N'BZDAED'
                                           WHEN N'DOCP' THEN N'BZDAED'
                                           WHEN N'PART' THEN N'BZEPAD'
                                           WHEN N'ADD'  THEN N'BZADDD' 
                                           WHEN N'ADDS' THEN N'BZADDD' 
                                           WHEN N'ADDP' THEN N'BZADDD' 
                                           WHEN N'SFTY' THEN N'BZKSFD'
                                           WHEN N'PRME' THEN N'BZPEVD' END
      AND    bot_fld1     = CASE @sCurtype WHEN N'ADDS' THEN N'ADD' 
                                           WHEN N'ADDP' THEN N'ADD' 
                                           WHEN N'DOCS' THEN N'DOCU' 
                                           WHEN N'DOCP' THEN N'DOCU' 
                                           ELSE @sCurtype END +'.'+@sArccol
      AND    bot_lang     = @sLang
    END

                        ead_field, ead_column, ead_signedvalue, ead_currentvalue )
  VALUES( @sSessionid, getdate(), @sTypestring, @sActionstring, 
          CASE @sCurtype WHEN N'PROM' THEN @sEvent ELSE @sPk END, @sField, @sCol, @sSignedvalue, @sCurrentvalue )

CREATE PROCEDURE o7eadiff_loopela
  @sSessionid       NVARCHAR(30),
  @sEvent           NVARCHAR(30),
  @sLang            NVARCHAR(2),
  @sEnt             NVARCHAR(4),
  @sEntstring       NVARCHAR(100),
  @sTablename       NVARCHAR(30),
  @sPk              NVARCHAR(200),
  @sDatecols        NVARCHAR(200), -- Holds numbers representing date columns ( without time ), separated by #s.
  @sPromcol         NVARCHAR(30),
  @sPromvalue       NVARCHAR(100),
  @sInsstring       NVARCHAR(40),
  @sUpdstring       NVARCHAR(40) 
AS
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  DECLARE @sCode    NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sCode2   NVARCHAR(4000)
  DECLARE @sElmcode NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sBasecol NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sArchcol NVARCHAR(50)
  DECLARE @sColtype NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sSQL     NVARCHAR(200)
  DECLARE @nReturn  INTEGER
  DECLARE @sNval    NVARCHAR(4)
 
  DECLARE c_elm CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT elm_code, elm_basecol, elm_archcol, elm_coltype
    FROM   r5elecmapping
    WHERE  elm_entity = CASE @sEnt WHEN N'DOCP' THEN N'DOCU'
                                   WHEN N'DOCS' THEN N'DOCU'
                                   WHEN N'ADDP' THEN N'ADD'
                                   WHEN N'ADDS' THEN N'ADD' ELSE @sEnt END
    AND ( ( elm_entity = N'PROM' AND elm_code IN ( 6, 7, 8 ) ) OR
          ( elm_entity = N'ADD'  AND elm_code <> 9 ) OR
            elm_entity NOT IN ( N'PROM', N'ADD' ) )
    ORDER BY elm_code

  OPEN c_elm
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_elm INTO @sElmcode, @sBasecol, @sArchcol, @sColtype
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN 
      SET @sCode  = NULL
      SET @sCode2 = NULL
      /* Retrieve the archived value of the current column. */
      SET @sSQL = 'SELECT @sOutput = ' + REPLACE( @sArchcol, 'ELM_', 'ELA_' ) + 
                  ' FROM r5ela_global_temp_' + @sSessionid 
      EXEC sp_executeSql @sSQL, N'@sOutput NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT', @sCode2 OUTPUT
      IF @sElmcode = N'1' AND @sCode2 IS NULL
        BEGIN
          /* No elec archive record found, so must be insert. */
          IF @sEnt = N'PROM' 
            EXECUTE @nReturn = o7eadiff_insrecord @sSessionid, @sEvent, @sLang, @sEnt, @sEntstring, 
                               N'U', @sUpdstring, @sPk, @sPromcol, NULL, NULL, @sPromvalue
          ELSE
            EXECUTE @nReturn = o7eadiff_insrecord @sSessionid, @sEvent, @sLang, @sEnt, @sEntstring, 
                               N'I', @sInsstring, @sPk, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
          BREAK
        END
        
      /* Retrieve the current/actual value of the current column.  Use date format for Date columns. */
      IF CHARINDEX( '#'+@sElmcode+'#', @sDatecols ) > 0 
        BEGIN
          /* Date columns, without time */
          SET @sSQL = 'SELECT @sOutput = dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( ' + @sBasecol + ', N''DD-MON-YYYY'' ) FROM ' + @sTablename
          EXEC sp_executeSql @sSQL, N'@sOutput NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT', @sCode OUTPUT
        END
      ELSE IF @sColtype = N'datetime' 
        BEGIN
          /* Date columns, with time. */   
          SET @sSQL = 'SELECT @sOutput = dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( ' + @sBasecol + ', N''DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'' ) FROM ' + @sTablename
          EXEC sp_executeSql @sSQL, N'@sOutput NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT', @sCode OUTPUT
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN 
          /* None date columns. */
          SET @sSQL = 'SELECT @sOutput = ' + @sBasecol + ' FROM ' + @sTablename
          EXEC sp_executeSql @sSQL, N'@sOutput NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT', @sCode OUTPUT
        END   

      IF @sEnt = N'EVNT' AND CAST( SUBSTRING( @sArchcol, 8, 100 ) AS NUMERIC ) IN ( 12, 29, 41, 64, 78, 80, 85, 97, 105, 106, 118, 
        123, 149, 212, 213, 214, 215, 216, 244, 251, 252, 253, 254, 255, 256, 257, 258, 259, 260, 261, 262, 263,
        264, 265, 266, 267, 274, 275, 276, 277, 278, 279, 293, 297 ) 
        /* For WO checkboxes set NVL (nval) to '-'. */
        SET @sNval = N'-'
      ELSE
        SET @sNval = N'!$#@'

      IF COALESCE( @sCode, N'!$#@' ) <> COALESCE( @sCode2, @sNval )  
        /* If the values are different, insert a record into the differences table. */
        EXECUTE @nReturn = o7eadiff_insrecord @sSessionid, @sEvent, @sLang, @sEnt, @sEntstring, 
                           N'U', @sUpdstring, @sPk, @sBasecol, @sArchcol, @sCode2, @sCode

      FETCH NEXT FROM c_elm INTO @sElmcode, @sBasecol, @sArchcol, @sColtype
    END
  CLOSE c_elm
  DEALLOCATE c_elm

CREATE PROCEDURE O7EASEPO 
   @sEvent          nvarchar(30),
   @sRoute          nvarchar(20),
   @sTemplate       nvarchar(1),
   @sObject         nvarchar(30),
   @sObjectorg      nvarchar(15),
   @sAspect         nvarchar(1),
   @sDeleas         nvarchar(1),
   @sInseas         nvarchar(1),
   @sDelepo         nvarchar(1),
   @sInsepo         nvarchar(1),
   @sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
   
AS SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit					int
	declare @sDeforg					nvarchar(15) --r5aspectpoints.apo_object_org%TYPE 
	declare @sChk1						nvarchar(3) 
	declare @nReturn					int
	declare @sApmColumn					nvarchar(35)
	declare @sApmDefault 				nvarchar(25)
	declare @sProType					nvarchar(4)
	declare @sUpdateClause				nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sUpdateClause1				nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sWhereClause				nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sAspectPts					nvarchar(30)
   
BEGIN
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk1 OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @sChk = N'0'
	IF @sEvent     IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end
	IF @sDeleas = N'Y' 
		DELETE FROM R5EVENTASPECTS
		WHERE  EAS_EVENT = @sEvent


	IF @sInseas = N'Y' 
		INSERT INTO R5EVENTASPECTS
			( EAS_ASPECT
			, EAS_EVENT      )
		SELECT A.APO_ASPECT , @sEvent
			FROM   R5ASPECTPOINTS A
			, R5OBJECTS O
			, R5ROUTEPOINTS R
			WHERE R.ROP_OBJECT     = A.APO_OBJECT
			AND   R.ROP_OBJECT_ORG = A.APO_OBJECT_ORG
			AND   R.ROP_POINTTYPE  = A.APO_POINTTYPE
			AND   R.ROP_POINT      = A.APO_POINT
			AND   R.ROP_OBJECT     = O.OBJ_CODE
			AND   R.ROP_OBJECT_ORG = O.OBJ_ORG
			AND   O.OBJ_RSTATUS    IN ( N'I', N'B', N'C' )
			AND   R.ROP_ROUTE      = @sRoute
			AND NOT EXISTS
				( SELECT NULL
				FROM   R5EVENTASPECTS T
				WHERE  T.EAS_EVENT  = @sEvent
				AND    T.EAS_ASPECT = A.APO_ASPECT )
		UNION
		SELECT P.APO_ASPECT , @sEvent
			FROM R5ASPECTPOINTS P
			, R5OBJECTS S
			, R5ROUTEPOINTS R
			WHERE S.OBJ_CATEGORY   = P.APO_OBJECT
			AND   @sDeforg          = P.APO_OBJECT_ORG
			AND   R.ROP_OBJECT     = S.OBJ_CODE
			AND   R.ROP_OBJECT_ORG = S.OBJ_ORG
			AND   R.ROP_POINTTYPE  = P.APO_POINTTYPE
			AND   R.ROP_POINT      = P.APO_POINT
			AND   S.OBJ_RSTATUS    IN ( N'I', N'B', N'C' )
			AND   R.ROP_ROUTE      = @sRoute
			AND NOT EXISTS
				( SELECT NULL
				FROM   R5EVENTASPECTS C
				WHERE  C.EAS_EVENT  = @sEvent
				AND    C.EAS_ASPECT = P.APO_ASPECT )


	IF @sDelepo = N'Y' 
		DELETE FROM R5EVENTPOINTS
		WHERE  EPO_EVENT = @sEvent
		AND    EPO_ASPECT LIKE @sAspect


	IF @sInsepo = N'Y' 
		begin
			IF @sTemplate = N'+' 
				begin
						INSERT INTO R5EVENTPOINTS
						( EPO_EVENT
						, EPO_ASPECT
						, EPO_LINE
						, EPO_OBJECT
						, EPO_OBJECT_ORG
						, EPO_OBTYPE
						, EPO_OBRTYPE
						, EPO_POINTTYPE
						, EPO_POINT
						, EPO_UOM
						, EPO_RISK
						, EPO_CONFRATING
						, EPO_METHOD
						, EPO_MIN
						, EPO_MINTOL
						, EPO_MAX
						, EPO_MAXTOL
						, EPO_MINPPM
						, EPO_MAXPPM
						, EPO_MINSTWO
						, EPO_MAXSTWO
						, EPO_TYPE
						)
						SELECT
						 @sEvent
						 ,  E.EAS_ASPECT	   
						 , R.ROP_LINE		   
						 , S.OBJ_CODE		   
						 , S.OBJ_ORG           
						 , S.OBJ_OBTYPE	   
						 , S.OBJ_OBRTYPE	
						 , R.ROP_POINTTYPE	
						 , R.ROP_POINT	   
						 , A.APO_UOM	
						 , A.APO_RISK      
						 , A.APO_CONFRATING    
						 , A.APO_METHOD	   
						 , A.APO_MIN		
						 , A.APO_MINTOL	   
						 , A.APO_MAX		
						 , A.APO_MAXTOL	   
						 , A.APO_MINPPM	   
						 , A.APO_MAXPPM	   
						 , A.APO_MINSTWO   
						 , A.APO_MAXSTWO
						 , N'C'
					FROM R5ASPECTPOINTS A
					, R5EVENTASPECTS E
					, R5OBJECTS S
					, R5ROUTEPOINTS R
					WHERE R.ROP_ROUTE      = @sRoute
					AND   E.EAS_EVENT      = @sEvent
					AND   A.APO_ASPECT     = E.EAS_ASPECT
					AND   E.EAS_ASPECT LIKE @sAspect
					AND   R.ROP_POINTTYPE  = A.APO_POINTTYPE
					AND   R.ROP_POINT      = A.APO_POINT
					AND   R.ROP_OBJECT     = A.APO_OBJECT
					AND   R.ROP_OBJECT_ORG = A.APO_OBJECT_ORG
					AND   S.OBJ_CATEGORY   = R.ROP_OBJECT       -- Step 1 - moved out
					-- Step 2 - got rid of a SELECT; Step 3 - broke the IN
					AND  (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.O7EASEPO_GET_HIERARCHY_1 (@sObject,@sObjectorg)
						          WHERE  Level = coalesce(R.ROP_LEVEL -1, Level)
						          AND CHILD = S.OBJ_CODE AND CHILD_ORG = S.OBJ_ORG)
					      OR (coalesce(R.ROP_LEVEL, 1 ) = 1 AND S.OBJ_CODE = @sObject AND S.OBJ_ORG = @sObjectorg)
						 )
   					AND NOT EXISTS
					 ( SELECT NULL
					   FROM   R5EVENTPOINTS
					   WHERE  EPO_EVENT      = @sEvent
					   AND    EPO_ASPECT     = E.EAS_ASPECT
					   AND    EPO_OBJECT     = S.OBJ_CODE
					   AND    EPO_OBJECT_ORG = S.OBJ_ORG
					   AND    EPO_POINTTYPE  = R.ROP_POINTTYPE
					   AND    EPO_POINT      = R.ROP_POINT )
							
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					INSERT INTO R5EVENTPOINTS
					( EPO_EVENT
					, EPO_ASPECT
					, EPO_LINE
					, EPO_OBJECT
					, EPO_OBJECT_ORG
					, EPO_OBTYPE
					, EPO_OBRTYPE
					, EPO_POINTTYPE
					, EPO_POINT
					, EPO_UOM
					, EPO_RISK
					, EPO_CONFRATING
					, EPO_METHOD
					, EPO_MIN
					, EPO_MINTOL
					, EPO_MAX
					, EPO_MAXTOL
					, EPO_MINPPM
					, EPO_MAXPPM
					, EPO_MINSTWO
					, EPO_MAXSTWO
					, EPO_TYPE
					)
					SELECT @sEvent
						 , E.EAS_ASPECT          
						 , R.ROP_LINE            
						 , R.ROP_OBJECT          
						 , R.ROP_OBJECT_ORG      
						 , R.ROP_OBTYPE          
						 , R.ROP_OBRTYPE         
						 , R.ROP_POINTTYPE       
						 , R.ROP_POINT           
						 , A.APO_UOM             
						 , A.APO_RISK            
						 , A.APO_CONFRATING      
						 , A.APO_METHOD          
						 , A.APO_MIN             
						 , A.APO_MINTOL          
						 , A.APO_MAX             
						 , A.APO_MAXTOL          
						 , A.APO_MINPPM          
						 , A.APO_MAXPPM          
						 , A.APO_MINSTWO         
						 , A.APO_MAXSTWO         
						 , R.ROP_OBTYPE          
					FROM  R5ASPECTPOINTS A
					 , R5EVENTASPECTS E
					 , R5ROUTEPOINTS R
					WHERE R.ROP_OBJECT     = A.APO_OBJECT
					AND   R.ROP_OBJECT_ORG = A.APO_OBJECT_ORG
					AND   R.ROP_POINTTYPE  = A.APO_POINTTYPE
					AND   R.ROP_POINT      = A.APO_POINT
					AND   R.ROP_ROUTE      = @sRoute
					AND   E.EAS_EVENT      = @sEvent
					AND   A.APO_ASPECT     = E.EAS_ASPECT
					AND   E.EAS_ASPECT LIKE @sAspect
					AND NOT EXISTS
					( SELECT NULL
					  FROM   R5EVENTPOINTS E2
					  WHERE  E2.EPO_EVENT      = @sEvent
					  AND    E2.EPO_ASPECT     = E.EAS_ASPECT
					  AND    E2.EPO_OBJECT     = R.ROP_OBJECT
					  AND    E2.EPO_OBJECT_ORG = R.ROP_OBJECT_ORG
					  AND    E2.EPO_POINTTYPE  = R.ROP_POINTTYPE
					  AND    E2.EPO_POINT      = R.ROP_POINT )


					INSERT INTO R5EVENTPOINTS
					( EPO_EVENT

					, EPO_OBJECT

					, EPO_OBTYPE

create function O7EASEPO_GET_HIERARCHY_1 (	@sCode	nvarchar(30),
											@sOrg	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						Level		int )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sCurrentType	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCurrentRtype	nvarchar(4)
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_child		nvarchar(30), 
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15), 
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_child, 
				stc_child_org, 
				1 
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and 
				stc_parent_org	= @sOrg		

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= stc_child,
							@sOrg	= stc_child_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @sOrg, @nLevel )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_child, 
												stc_child_org, 
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and 
												stc_parent_org	= @sOrg		
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end
