CREATE PROCEDURE O7ECAPDRV
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @session         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @newobject       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @newobject_org   NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @chk             NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @return          INT

  /* Check whether a session should be marked as processed. */
  UPDATE r5equipconfigsessions
  SET    egs_active           = N'-',
         egs_processed        = N'+',
         egs_awaitingpurchase = N'-'
  WHERE  egs_active           = N'+'
  AND    egs_processed        = N'-'
  AND    egs_awaitingpurchase = N'+'
  AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                   FROM   r5ecsessionequipment
                   WHERE  cse_session        = egs_code
                   AND    cse_generatedtrans = N'-' )

  DECLARE cse CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT cse_session, cse_newobject, cse_newobject_org
    FROM   r5objects, r5equipconfigsessions, r5ecsessiondetails, r5ecsessionequipment
    WHERE  csd_pk             = cse_detailpk
    AND    egs_code           = cse_session
    AND    obj_code           = cse_newobject
    AND    obj_org            = cse_newobject_org
    AND    obj_rstatus       <> N'A'
    AND    csd_level          = 1
    AND    cse_generatedtrans = N'-'
    AND    egs_active         = N'+'
    AND    egs_processed      = N'-'
  OPEN cse
  FETCH NEXT FROM cse INTO @session, @newobject, @newobject_org
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Do transactional data for current ( parent ) equipment. */
      EXECUTE @return = o7generateequipment @session, N'T', @newobject, @newobject_org, N'T', @chk
      FETCH NEXT FROM cse INTO @session, @newobject, @newobject_org
    END
  CLOSE cse
  DEALLOCATE cse
  
  /* Check again whether a session should be marked as processed. */
  UPDATE r5equipconfigsessions
  SET    egs_active           = N'-',
         egs_processed        = N'+',
         egs_awaitingpurchase = N'-'
  WHERE  egs_active           = N'+'
  AND    egs_processed        = N'-'
  AND    egs_awaitingpurchase = N'+'
  AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                   FROM   r5ecsessionequipment
                   WHERE  cse_session        = egs_code
                   AND    cse_generatedtrans = N'-' )
  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ECDRV
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @egscode NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @cnt     NUMERIC
  DECLARE @chk     NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @return  INT

  /* First reset processrunning flag, if nothing happened for the last hour. */
  UPDATE r5equipconfigsessions
  SET    egs_processrunning = N'-'
  WHERE  egs_processrunning = N'+'
  AND    dbo.o7gttime2( egs_org ) - 1/24 > egs_processlastupdated
    
  /* Retrieve the first session to process. */
  SELECT @egscode = MIN( egs_code )
  FROM   r5equipconfigsessions
  WHERE  egs_active         = N'+'
  AND    egs_processed      = N'-'
  AND    egs_processrunning = N'-'
  AND    egs_processerror   = N'-'
  AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
              FROM   r5ecsessionequipment
              WHERE  cse_session   = egs_code
              AND    cse_generated = N'-' )

  IF @egscode IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* First check for errors. */
      EXECUTE @return = o7generateequipment @egscode, N'P', NULL, NULL, N'+', @chk 
      SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
      FROM   r5ecsessionwarnings
      WHERE  csw_session = @egscode
      AND    csw_type    = N'E'
      IF @cnt > 0 
        /* Errors exist. flag record as such. */
        UPDATE r5equipconfigsessions
        SET    egs_processerror       = N'+',
               egs_processlastupdated = NULL
        WHERE  egs_code = @egscode
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          /* No errors, so start actual equipment creation process. */
          UPDATE r5equipconfigsessions
          SET    egs_processerror       = N'-',
                 egs_processrunning     = N'+',
                 egs_processlastupdated = dbo.o7gttime2( egs_org )
          WHERE  egs_code = @egscode
          EXECUTE @return = o7generateequipment @egscode, N'E', NULL, NULL, N'+', @chk
        END 
    END
END

create procedure O7EDPREP_O7EDPREP02
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

	declare @sDeflang		nvarchar(400)
	SELECT @sDeflang = ins_desc
	FROM   r5install
	WHERE  ins_code = 'DEFLANG'

    INSERT INTO r5ucodes ( uco_entity,
                           uco_rentity,
                           uco_code,
                           uco_rcode,
                           uco_system,
                           uco_desc )
	SELECT                 ent_entity,
	                       SUBSTRING(bot_fld1, 1, 4),
	                       bot_fld2,
	                       SUBSTRING(bot_fld1, 6, LEN(bot_fld1)-5),
	                       CASE bot_fld2 WHEN SUBSTRING(bot_fld1, 6, LEN(bot_fld1)-5) THEN '+' ELSE '-' END,
	                       bot_text
	FROM  r5boilertexts,
	      r5entities
	WHERE bot_function = 'UCODES'
	AND   bot_lang     = @sDeflang
	AND   SUBSTRING(bot_fld1, 1, 4) = ent_rentity
	AND   (bot_fld1 + bot_fld2) NOT IN ('EVST_RR', 'OCTP_XX')

	UPDATE r5ucodes
	SET    uco_desc = ( SELECT bot_text
	                    FROM   r5boilertexts
	                    WHERE  bot_function = 'UCODES'
	                    AND    bot_lang     = @sDeflang
	                    AND    bot_fld1 + bot_fld2 = 'EVST_RR' )
	WHERE  uco_rentity = 'EVST'
	AND    uco_rcode   = 'R'
	AND    uco_code    = ( SELECT edu_code
	                       FROM   r5editionucodes
                           WHERE  edu_rentity  = 'EVST'
                           AND    edu_rcode    = 'R'
                           AND    edu_lang     = @sDeflang
                           AND    edu_textcode = '13055' )

	UPDATE r5ucodes
	SET    uco_desc = ( SELECT bot_text
	                    FROM   r5boilertexts
	                    WHERE  bot_function = 'UCODES'
	                    AND    bot_lang     = @sDeflang
	                    AND    bot_fld1 + bot_fld2 = 'OCTP_XX' )
	WHERE  uco_rentity = 'OCTP'
	AND    uco_rcode   = 'X'
	AND    uco_code    = ( SELECT edu_code
	                       FROM   r5editionucodes
                           WHERE  edu_rentity  = 'OCTP'
                           AND    edu_rcode    = 'X'
                           AND    edu_lang     = @sDeflang
                           AND    edu_textcode = '13105' )

	UPDATE r5ucodes
	SET    uco_system  = '+'
	WHERE  uco_rentity = 'OBCR'
	AND    uco_rcode   = '*'
	AND    uco_code    = '3'

	UPDATE r5ucodes
	SET    uco_system  = '+'
	WHERE  uco_rentity = 'JBPR'
	AND    uco_rcode   = '*'
	AND    uco_code    = '3'

	-- Insert r5descriptions
	INSERT INTO r5descriptions
	( des_rentity,
	  des_entity,
	  des_rtype,
	  des_type,
	  des_code,
	  des_lang,
	  des_text,
	  des_trans,
	  des_org )
	SELECT
	   'UCOD',
	   e.ent_entity,
	   u.uco_rentity,
	   u.uco_entity,
	   u.uco_code,
	   l.lin_code,
	   b.bot_text,
	   CASE l.lin_code WHEN @sDeflang THEN '+' ELSE '-' END,
	   '*'
	FROM r5ucodes   u,
		 r5entities e,
		 r5langinst l,
		 r5boilertexts b
	WHERE e.ent_rentity = 'UCOD'
	AND   b.bot_function = 'UCODES'
	AND   b.bot_lang     = l.lin_code
	AND   SUBSTRING(b.bot_fld1, 1, 4) = u.uco_rentity
	AND   b.bot_fld2 = u.uco_code
	AND   SUBSTRING(b.bot_fld1, 6, LEN(bot_fld1)-5) = u.uco_rcode
	AND   u.uco_rentity IN ('EVST', 'JBTP', 'JBPR', 'OCTP', 'RQST', 'OBCR', 'DOST')
	AND   (b.bot_fld1 + b.bot_fld2) NOT IN ('EVST_RR', 'OCTP_XX')

	UPDATE r5descriptions
	SET    des_text = ( SELECT bot_text
	                    FROM   r5boilertexts
	                    WHERE  bot_function = 'UCODES'
	                    AND    bot_lang     = des_lang
	                    AND    bot_fld1 + bot_fld2 = 'EVST_RR' )
	WHERE  des_rentity = 'UCOD'
    AND    des_rtype   = 'EVST'
    AND    des_lang    IN ( SELECT lin_code FROM r5langinst )
    AND    des_code    = ( SELECT edu_code
                           FROM   r5editionucodes
                           WHERE  edu_rentity  = 'EVST'
                           AND    edu_rcode    = 'R'
                           AND    edu_lang     = des_lang
                           AND    edu_textcode = '13055' )

	UPDATE r5descriptions
	SET    des_text = ( SELECT bot_text
	                    FROM   r5boilertexts
	                    WHERE  bot_function = 'UCODES'
	                    AND    bot_lang     = des_lang
	                    AND    bot_fld1 + bot_fld2 = 'OCTP_XX' )
	WHERE  des_rentity = 'UCOD'
    AND    des_rtype   = 'OCTP'
    AND    des_lang    IN ( SELECT lin_code FROM r5langinst )
    AND    des_code    = ( SELECT edu_code
	                       FROM   r5editionucodes
                           WHERE  edu_rentity  = 'OCTP'
                           AND    edu_rcode    = 'X'
                           AND    edu_lang     = des_lang
                           AND    edu_textcode = '13105' )

	if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
		COMMIT

create procedure O7EDPREP_O7EDPREP03
as
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

  declare @sDeflang		nvarchar(400)
  SELECT @sDeflang = ins_desc
  FROM   r5install
  WHERE  ins_code = 'DEFLANG'

  -- Add new custom field 'HOLD'.
  INSERT INTO r5properties ( pro_code,
                             pro_type,
                             pro_text )
  SELECT                     'HOLD',
                             'CHAR',
                             bot_text
  FROM  r5boilertexts
  WHERE bot_function = 'CUSTOM'
  AND   bot_fld1     = 'HOLD'
  AND   bot_lang     = @sDeflang

  -- Add new custom field 'PRIORITY'.
  INSERT INTO r5properties ( pro_code,
                             pro_type,
                             pro_text )
  SELECT                     'PRIORITY',
                             'CHAR',
                             bot_text
  FROM  r5boilertexts
  WHERE bot_function = 'CUSTOM'
  AND   bot_fld1     = 'PRIORITY'
  AND   bot_lang     = @sDeflang

  -- Add LOVs for custom fields 'HOLD' and 'PRIORITY'.
  INSERT INTO r5propertyvalues ( prv_property,
                                 prv_rentity,
                                 prv_class,
                                 prv_seqno,
                                 prv_value,
                                 prv_class_org )
  SELECT 'HOLD',
         'EVNT',
         '*',
         bot_fld2,
         bot_text,
         '*'
  FROM   r5boilertexts
  WHERE  bot_function = 'CUSTOM'
  AND    bot_fld1     = 'HOLDVALUES'
  AND    bot_lang     = @sDeflang

  INSERT INTO r5propertyvalues ( prv_property,
                                 prv_rentity,
                                 prv_class,
                                 prv_seqno,
                                 prv_value,
                                 prv_class_org )
  SELECT 'PRIORITY',
         'PORD',
         '*',
         bot_fld2,
         bot_text,
         '*'
  FROM   r5boilertexts
  WHERE  bot_function = 'CUSTOM'
  AND    bot_fld1     = 'PRIORITYVALUES'
  AND    bot_lang     = @sDeflang

  -- Associate classes to entities
  INSERT INTO r5classes ( cls_entity,
                          cls_rentity,
                          cls_code,
                          cls_desc,
                          cls_org,
                          cls_notused )
  SELECT ent_entity,
         'EVNT',
         '*',
         bot_text,
         '*',
         '-'
  FROM   r5entities, r5boilertexts
  WHERE  bot_function = 'CUSTOM'
  AND    bot_fld1     = 'ALLCLASSES'
  AND    bot_lang     = @sDeflang
  AND    ent_rentity  = 'EVNT'
  AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                      FROM   r5classes
                      WHERE  cls_rentity = 'EVNT'
                      AND    cls_code    = '*'
                      AND    cls_org     = '*' )

  INSERT INTO r5classes ( cls_entity,
                          cls_rentity,
                          cls_code,
                          cls_desc,
                          cls_org,
                          cls_notused )
  SELECT ent_entity,
         'PORD',
         '*',
         bot_text,
         '*',
         '-'
  FROM   r5entities, r5boilertexts
  WHERE  bot_function = 'CUSTOM'
  AND    bot_fld1     = 'ALLCLASSES'
  AND    bot_lang     = @sDeflang
  AND    ent_rentity  = 'PORD'
  AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                      FROM   r5classes
                      WHERE  cls_rentity = 'PORD'
                      AND    cls_code    = '*'
                      AND    cls_org     = '*' )


  -- Associate custom fields to entities
  INSERT INTO r5addproperties ( apr_property,
                                apr_rentity,
                                apr_class,
                                apr_line,
                                apr_list,
                                apr_listvalid,
                                apr_required,
                                apr_nonupdcat,
                                apr_class_org,
                                apr_wodisp )
  VALUES ( 'HOLD', 'EVNT', '*', 1, 'E', '+', '-', '-', '*', '-' )

  INSERT INTO r5addproperties ( apr_property,
                                apr_rentity,
                                apr_class,
                                apr_line,
                                apr_list,
                                apr_listvalid,
                                apr_required,
                                apr_nonupdcat,
                                apr_class_org,
                                apr_wodisp )
  VALUES ( 'PRIORITY', 'PORD', '*', 1, 'E', '+', '-', '-', '*', '-' )

  if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
	COMMIT

create procedure O7EDPREP_O7EDPREP09
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

  -- Set the Databridge triggers to active
  UPDATE r5flexsql
  SET    flx_active = '+'
  WHERE  flx_table IN ( 'R5REQUISITIONS', 'R5REQUISLINES' )

  -- Shotgun #27011
  UPDATE r5partnersubscriptions
  SET    psb_enabled = '+'
  WHERE  psb_partner = '2'
  AND    psb_event = 'ADDREQUISTN'
  AND    psb_documenttype = 'ADD_REQUISITN_004'

  UPDATE r5partnersubscriptions
  SET    psb_enabled = '+'
  WHERE  psb_partner = '2'
  AND    psb_event = 'CANCELREQHEADER'
  AND    psb_documenttype = 'CANCEL_REQUISITN_005'

  UPDATE r5partnersubscriptions
  SET    psb_enabled = '+'
  WHERE  psb_partner = '2'
  AND    psb_event = 'CANCELREQLINE'

create PROCEDURE O7EDPREP_O7EDPREP10
as
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

  -- Delete page layout for requestor group
  DELETE FROM r5pagelayout
    WHERE plo_usergroup = 'R5REQ'
    AND   SUBSTRING(plo_pagename,1,6) IN (SELECT fun_code FROM r5functions WHERE fun_rs = '+')

    plo_attribute, plo_fieldcontainer, plo_fieldgroup, plo_positioningroup,
    plo_fieldconttype, plo_tabindex, plo_systemattribute, plo_changed,
    plo_mekey, plo_meflag)
  SELECT 'R5REQ', plo_pagename, plo_elementid, plo_elementtype, plo_presentinjsp,
    plo_attribute, plo_fieldcontainer, plo_fieldgroup, plo_positioningroup,
    plo_fieldconttype, plo_tabindex, plo_systemattribute, plo_changed,
    plo_mekey, NULL
    FROM r5pagelayout
    WHERE plo_usergroup = 'R5'
    AND   plo_meflag = 'B'
    AND   SUBSTRING(plo_pagename,1,6) IN (SELECT fun_code FROM r5functions WHERE fun_rs = '+')

  if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
    COMMIT

create procedure O7ELARCHIVE  @sEntity nvarchar(4),
                              @sCode nvarchar(45),
                              @sOrg nvarchar(15),
                              @sParent nvarchar(30),
                              @sESigner nvarchar(255),
                              @sSigntype nvarchar(8),
                              @sCertifynum nvarchar(20),
                              @sCertifytype nvarchar(8)
                                                        
as
        SET NOCOUNT ON 
        declare @sCseqno        nvarchar(30)
        declare @sChk           nvarchar(6)
        declare @sDcode         nvarchar(50)
        declare @sDorg          nvarchar(18)
        declare @sCodeorg       nvarchar(65)
        declare @sDocorg        nvarchar(15) --r5documents.doc_org%type
        declare @sDAEDocument   nvarchar(30) 
        declare @sDAEEntity     nvarchar(4) 
        declare @sDAERentity    nvarchar(4) 
        declare @sDAEType       nvarchar(4) 
        declare @sDAERtype      nvarchar(4) 
        declare @sDAECode       nvarchar(50) 
        declare @sDAECopytowo   nvarchar(1) 
        declare @sDAEPrintonwo  nvarchar(1) 
        declare @sDAECopytopo   nvarchar(1) 
        declare @sDAEPrintonpo  nvarchar(1) 
        declare @nDAEUpdatecount numeric(38)
        declare @sDAECreatecopytowo nvarchar(1) 
        declare @dDAELastsaved  datetime
        declare @sPREPermit     nvarchar (12) 
        declare @sPREEntity     nvarchar (4) 
        declare @sPRERentity    nvarchar (4) 
        declare @sPREType       nvarchar (4) 
        declare @sPRERtype      nvarchar (4) 
        declare @sPRECode       nvarchar (50) 
        declare @sPREMand       nvarchar (1)
        declare @nPREUpdatecount numeric(38)
        declare @sPREPermitorg  nvarchar(15)
        declare @sPRVProperty   nvarchar (8)
        declare @sPRVRentity    nvarchar (4) 
        declare @sPRVClass      nvarchar (8) 
        declare @sPRVCode       nvarchar (100) 
        declare @nPRVSeqno      numeric (4)
        declare @sPRVValue      nvarchar (40) 
        declare @nPRVNValue     int 
        declare @dPRVDValue     datetime 
        declare @sPRVClassorg   nvarchar (15)
        declare @sEPAPart       nvarchar(30) 
        declare @sEPAEntity     nvarchar(4) 
        declare @sEPARentity    nvarchar(4)
        declare @sEPAType       nvarchar(4)
        declare @sEPARtype      nvarchar(4)
        declare @sEPACode       nvarchar(50)
        declare @sEPAQty        numeric(24,6)
        declare @sEPAUom        nvarchar(30)
        declare @sEPAComment    nvarchar(240)
        declare @sEPAPartorg    nvarchar(15)
        declare @nEPAUpdatecount numeric(38)
        declare @sEPAPk         nvarchar(30)
        declare @sEPAPartlocation nvarchar(80)
        declare @sEPASyslevel   nvarchar(30)
        declare @sEPAAsmlevel   nvarchar(30)
        declare @sEPAComplevel  nvarchar(30)
        declare @dEPALastsaved  datetime
        declare @nReturn        int
        declare @nErecord       int
        declare @dGtTime        datetime
        declare @sAdd_entity    nvarchar(4)
        declare @sAdd_rentity   nvarchar(4) 
        declare @sAdd_type      nvarchar(4)
        declare @sAdd_rtype     nvarchar(4)
        declare @sAdd_code      nvarchar(100)
        declare @sAdd_lang      nvarchar(2)
        declare @nAdd_line      numeric(12,0)
        declare @sAdd_print     nvarchar(1)
        declare @tAdd_text      nvarchar(4000)
        declare @dAdd_created   datetime
        declare @sAdd_user      nvarchar(255)
        declare @dAdd_updated   datetime
        declare @sAdd_upduser   nvarchar(255)
        declare @nAdd_updatecount numeric(38,0)
        declare @dAddLastsaved  datetime
        declare @ptrval         varbinary(16)
        declare @nValidptr      int
        declare @nLength        int
        declare @nPRVUpdatecount numeric(38)
        declare @dPRVCreated    datetime 
        declare @dPRVUpdated    datetime
        declare @sPRVNotused    nvarchar(1)
        declare @dPRVLastsaved  datetime

        IF @sEntity IN ( N'PORD', N'OBJ', N'INV' ) 
                SET @sCodeorg = @sCode + N'#' + @sOrg
        ELSE
                SET @sCodeorg = @sCode

        declare c_docs cursor local for SELECT  DAE_DOCUMENT, DAE_ENTITY, DAE_RENTITY, DAE_TYPE,
                                                DAE_RTYPE, DAE_CODE, DAE_COPYTOWO, DAE_PRINTONWO,
                                                DAE_COPYTOPO, DAE_PRINTONPO, DAE_UPDATECOUNT, DAE_CREATECOPYTOWO,
                                                DAE_LASTSAVED
                                        FROM    r5docentities
                                        WHERE   dae_rentity = @sEntity
                                        AND     dae_code = @sCodeorg

        open c_docs
        fetch next from c_docs into     @sDAEDocument, @sDAEEntity, @sDAERentity, @sDAEType, 
                                        @sDAERtype, @sDAECode, @sDAECopytowo, @sDAEPrintonwo, @sDAECopytopo, 
                                        @sDAEPrintonpo, @nDAEUpdatecount, @sDAECreatecopytowo, @dDAELastsaved
        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                begin
                        SELECT @sDocorg = doc_org
                        FROM r5documents
                        WHERE doc_code = @sDAEDocument

                        execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sCseqno OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
                        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                begin
                                        close c_docs
                                        deallocate c_docs
                                        return -1
                                end

                        execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sOrg 
                        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                begin
                                        close c_docs
                                        deallocate c_docs
                                        return -1
                                end
                        
                        INSERT INTO r5elecarchive (     ELA_CODE, ELA_USER, ELA_DATE, ELA_SIGNTYPE, ELA_CERTIFYNUM,  ELA_CERTIFYTYPE,
                                                        ELA_SCODE, ELA_ENTITY, ELA_ENTCODE, ELA_ENTORG, ELA_STATUS, ELA_PARENT,
                                                        ELA_FLD1,  ELA_FLD2,  ELA_FLD3,  ELA_FLD4,  ELA_FLD5,
                                                        ELA_FLD6,  ELA_FLD7,  ELA_FLD8,  ELA_FLD9,  ELA_FLD10,
                                                        ELA_FLD11, ELA_FLD12, ELA_FLD13 )
                        VALUES    (                     @sCseqno, @sESigner, @dGtTime, @sSigntype, @sCertifynum, @sCertifytype,  
                                                        null, N'DOCU', @sDAEDocument, @sDocorg, null, @sParent,
                                                        @sDAEDocument, @sDAEEntity, @sDAERentity, @sDAEType, @sDAERtype,
                                                        @sDAECode, @sDAECopytowo, @sDAEPrintonwo, @sDAECopytopo, @sDAEPrintonpo,
                                                        @nDAEUpdatecount, @sDAECreatecopytowo, dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(@dDAELastsaved, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS' ) )        

                        fetch next from c_docs into     @sDAEDocument, @sDAEEntity, @sDAERentity, @sDAEType, 
                                                        @sDAERtype, @sDAECode, @sDAECopytowo, @sDAEPrintonwo, @sDAECopytopo, 
                                                        @sDAEPrintonpo, @nDAEUpdatecount, @sDAECreatecopytowo, @dDAELastsaved

                end
        close c_docs
        deallocate c_docs


        declare c_parts cursor local for SELECT EPA_PART, EPA_ENTITY, EPA_RENTIT

name: O7ENERGYSTAR
body:
CREATE PROCEDURE O7ENERGYSTAR
AS 
  SET NOCOUNT ON

  DECLARE @sChk         NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @nEsmonths    NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nConv        NUMERIC( 24, 12 )
  DECLARE @dLastreading DATETIME
  DECLARE @nCons        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @dSdate       DATETIME
  DECLARE @dEdate       DATETIME
  DECLARE @dEmdate      DATETIME
  DECLARE @nReturn      INTEGER
  DECLARE @sCustomerid  NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @sMeterid     NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @sMeterunit   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sObject      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sOrg         NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sUom         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @dDate        DATETIME
  DECLARE @nDiff        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  
  /* Determine dates. */
  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @nEsmonths OUTPUT, N'ESMONTHS', @sChk OUTPUT
  IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
    RETURN -1
  SET @dSdate = DATEADD( mm, -@nEsmonths, CONVERT( VARCHAR( 25 ), DATEADD( dd,-( DAY( getdate() ) -1 ),getdate() ),101 ) )
  SET @dEdate = CONVERT( VARCHAR( 25 ), DATEADD( dd, -( DAY( getdate() ) ), getdate() ), 101 )

  /* Delete all old data. */
  DELETE FROM r5energystarreadings
  WHERE  esr_date >= @dSdate

  /* Retrieve consumption data. */
  DECLARE c_cee CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT ess_customerid, ess_meterunit,ess_meterid, cee_object, cee_object_org, cmd_uom, 
           CONVERT( VARCHAR(25), dbo.F_LAST_DAY( cee_date ), 101),
           SUM( cee_actualconsumption )
    FROM   r5energystarsetup, r5commodities, r5commodityenergyeff
    WHERE  cee_object     = ess_object
    AND    cee_object_org = ess_object_org
    AND    cmd_uom        = ess_uom
    AND    cee_commodity  = cmd_code            
    AND    cee_date BETWEEN @dSdate AND @dEdate
    GROUP BY ess_customerid, ess_meterunit,ess_meterid, cee_object, cee_object_org, cmd_uom, 
             CONVERT( VARCHAR(25), dbo.F_LAST_DAY( cee_date ), 101)

  OPEN c_cee
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_cee INTO @sCustomerid, @sMeterunit, @sMeterid ,@sObject, @sOrg, @sUom, @dDate, @nCons
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      IF @sMeterunit <> @sUom
        BEGIN
          SELECT @nConv = uoc_confact
          FROM   r5uomconversion
          WHERE  uoc_siteuom = @sUom
          AND    uoc_baseuom = @sMeterunit
          SET @nConv = COALESCE( @nConv, 1 )
        END
      ELSE
        SET @nConv = 1
      /* Insert consumption data coming from utility bills. */
      INSERT INTO r5energystarreadings( esr_customerid, esr_object, esr_object_org, esr_meterid,esr_uom, esr_date, esr_consumption )
      VALUES( @sCustomerid, @sObject, @sOrg,@sMeterid ,@sUom, @dDate, @nCons * @nConv )
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_cee INTO @sCustomerid, @sMeterunit, @sMeterid ,@sObject, @sOrg, @sUom, @dDate, @nCons
    END
  CLOSE c_cee
  DEALLOCATE c_cee

  /* Per month, check whether there is 'metered' equipment, without utility bills. */
  WHILE @dSdate < @dEdate
    BEGIN
      /* Set the end date of the current month */
      SET @dEmdate = DATEADD( mm, 1, @dSdate )
      /* Loop through all equipment. */
      DECLARE c_ess CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT DISTINCT ess_customerid, ess_object, ess_object_org, ess_meterid,ess_uom, ess_meterunit
        FROM   r5energystarsetup
        WHERE  ess_object IS NOT NULL
        AND    ess_uom IS NOT NULL
        AND    ess_confirmed = N'+'
        AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                    FROM   r5readings
                    WHERE  rea_object     = ess_object
                    AND    rea_object_org = ess_object_org
                    AND    rea_calcuom    = ess_uom
                    AND    rea_date      >= @dSdate )
        AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                        FROM   r5commodities, r5commodityenergyeff
                        WHERE  cee_object     = ess_object
                        AND    cee_object_org = ess_object_org
                        AND    cmd_uom        = ess_uom
                        AND    cee_commodity  = cmd_code            
                        AND    cee_date BETWEEN @dSdate AND DATEADD( dd, -1, @dEmdate ) )
      OPEN c_ess
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_ess INTO @sCustomerid, @sObject, @sOrg,@sMeterid , @sUom, @sMeterunit
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          SET @dLastreading = NULL
          SET @nCons = 0
          /* Get date of last reading before current month. */
          SELECT @dLastreading = rea_date
          FROM   r5readings
          WHERE  rea_object     = @sObject
          AND    rea_object_org = @sOrg
          AND    rea_calcuom    = @sUom
          AND    rea_date       < @dSdate
          ORDER BY rea_date
          /* Loop through all readings, and add consumption. */
          DECLARE c_rea CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
            SELECT rea_diff, rea_date
            FROM   r5readings
            WHERE  rea_object     = @sObject
            AND    rea_object_org = @sOrg
            AND    rea_calcuom    = @sUom
            AND    rea_date      >= @dSdate
            ORDER BY rea_date
          OPEN c_rea
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_rea INTO @nDiff, @dDate
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              IF @dLastreading IS NULL
                BEGIN
                  IF @dDate < @dEmdate
                    SET @nCons = @nDiff
                END
              ELSE
                SET @nCons = @nCons + 
                             ( ( CAST( DATEDIFF( DAY, dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( @dLastreading, @dSdate ),
                                                      dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( @dDate, @dEmdate ) ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) /
                                 CAST( DATEDIFF( DAY, @dLastreading, @dDate ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) * @nDiff )
              IF @dDate > @dEmdate
                BREAK
              SET @dLastreading = @dDate
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_rea INTO @nDiff, @dDate
            END
          CLOSE c_rea
          DEALLOCATE c_rea 
          IF @sMeterunit <> @sUom
            BEGIN
              SELECT @nConv = uoc_confact
              FROM   r5uomconversion
              WHERE  uoc_siteuom = @sUom
              AND    uoc_baseuom = @sMeterunit
              SET @nConv = COALESCE( @nConv, 1 )
            END
          ELSE
            SET @nConv = 1
          INSERT INTO r5energystarreadings( esr_customerid, esr_object, esr_object_org, esr_meterid,esr_uom, esr_date, esr_consumption )
          VALUES( @sCustomerid, @sObject, @sOrg,@sMeterid ,@sUom, dbo.F_LAST_DAY( @dSdate ), @nCons * @nConv )
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_ess INTO @sCustomerid, @sObject, @sOrg, @sMeterid, @sUom, @sMeterunit
        END
      CLOSE c_ess
      DEALLOCATE c_ess
      SET @dSdate = DATEADD( mm, 1, @dSdate )
    END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.o7energystartimelapse( 
  @dStartdate DATETIME, 
  @dEnddate   DATETIME ) 
  RETURNS     NVARCHAR( 50 ) AS 
BEGIN 
  DECLARE @sMinutes    NVARCHAR( 50 )
  DECLARE @sHours      NVARCHAR( 50 ) 
  DECLARE @dFinaldate  DATETIME 
  IF @dStartdate IS NULL OR @dEnddate < @dStartdate
    /* Return if no start date, or end date before start date. */
    RETURN NULL
  /* Set end date to today, if no value provided.  */
  SET @dFinaldate = COALESCE( @dEnddate, getdate() )
  /* Calculate hours and minutes. */
  SET @sMinutes = DATEDIFF( MI, @dStartdate, @dFinalDate )
  IF @sMinutes = 0 
    RETURN '00:00'
  SET @sHours = @sMinutes / 60
  SET @sMinutes = @sMinutes - ( @sHours * 60 )
  /* Return the concatenated values for hours and minutes. */
  RETURN dbo.F_LPAD( @sHours, 2, N'0' ) + N':' + dbo.F_LPAD( @sMinutes, 2, N'0' )
END

create function O7ENRHAS(	 @sUserID nvarchar(255) , @sPassword nvarchar(30) )
returns nvarchar(200)
as
begin
    declare @sEncryption    nvarchar(60)
    declare @nOffset        int
    declare @nASCII         int
    declare @nEncr			int
    declare @sGTranspose    nchar(162) 
    declare @nHash			int
	declare @nCounter		int
	

	set @nOffset = 0
	set @sGTranspose    = 'ya5>fbR(E8JXnAOuijm=HZeUIw7/Br9sq.gKpWd$1,PoFc%zt4<Qv#+2\:6LkSY_;CNM[]l0T3GhV-D)xya5>fbR(E8JXnAOuijm=HZeUIw7/Br9sq.gKpWd$1,PoFc%zt4<Qv#+2\:6LkSY_;CNM[]l0T3GhV-D)x'
	set @nHash = 0

  -- hashing function to generate offset pointer  
	SELECT @nCounter = 1
	WHILE (@nCounter <= LEN(@sUserID) )
		begin
			SET @nASCII = ASCII(SUBSTRING(@sUserID, @nCounter, 1))
			IF @nASCII < 40 or @nASCII > 122 
				set @nASCII = 40
			set @nHash = @nHash + @nASCII;
			SELECT @nCounter = @nCounter +1
		end
	set @nHash = (@nHash * 11) % 41
	

	set @nOffset = @nHash

    IF @nOffset = -1  
		RETURN ( 'Invalid User ID')


    set @nEncr = @nOffset + 32 
    if @nEncr < 40 or @nEncr > 122
		set @nEncr = 40

	set	@sEncryption = cast(@nEncr as nvarchar(60))

	SELECT @nCounter = 1
	WHILE (@nCounter <= LEN(@sPassword) )
		begin
			set @nASCII = ASCII(SUBSTRING(@sPassword, @nCounter, 1))
			IF @nASCII < 40 or @nASCII > 122 
				set @nASCII = 40
			SELECT @nCounter = @nCounter +1
			set @sEncryption = @sEncryption + SUBSTRing(@sGTranspose, @nASCII - 40 + @nOffset + @nCounter, 1)
		end

    RETURN (@sEncryption)

end

create function O7ENRPAS( @sUserid nvarchar(255), @sPassword nvarchar(12) )
returns nvarchar(60)
as
begin
	declare @sEncryption	nvarchar(60)
	declare @nOffset		int
	declare @nAscii		int
	declare @nEncr			int
	declare @sTranspose		nchar(162)

	declare @nX				int
	declare @nLen			int
	declare @nTemp			int

	declare @nHash			int

	set @sTranspose = N'ya5>fbR(E8JXnAOuijm=HZeUIw7/Br9sq.gKpWd$1,PoFc%zt4<Qv#+2\:6LkSY_;CNM[]l0T3GhV-D)xya5>fbR(E8JXnAOuijm=HZeUIw7/Br9sq.gKpWd$1,PoFc%zt4<Qv#+2\:6LkSY_;CNM[]l0T3GhV-D)x'
	set @nOffset = 0

	--begin embedded function "hashing" here
	set @nX = 0
	set @nLen = len( @sUserid )
	set @nHash = 0
	while @nX < @nLen
		begin
			set @nAscii = ascii( substring( UPPER(@sUserid), @nX, 1))
			if @nAscii < 40 or @nAscii > 122
				begin
					set @nHash = -1
					break
				end

			set @nHash = @nHash + @nAscii

			set @nX = @nX + 1
		end
	
	if @nHash > 0
		set @nHash = (@nHash*11) % 41
	--end function

	set @nOffset = @nHash
	if @nOffset = -1
		return N'Invalid User ID'

	set @nEncr = @nOffset + 32
	if @nEncr < 40 or @nEncr > 122
		set @nEncr = 40

	set @sEncryption = CHAR(@nEncr)

	set @nX = 0
	set @nLen = len( @sPassword )
	while @nX < @nLen
		begin
			set @nAscii = ascii( substring( @sPassword, @nX, 1))
			if @nAscii < 40 or @nAscii > 122
				return N'Invalid Password'

			set @nTemp = @nAscii - 40 + @nOffset + @nX
			set @sEncryption = @sEncryption + substring( @sTranspose, @nTemp, 1 )

			set @nX = @nX + 1
		end
	
	return ( @sEncryption )
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ENTQRY_CLEARPROMPTVAL
          @sFormid    nvarchar(45) 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @bFound_prompt bit
	declare @nN_promptvals int
	declare @sN_promptvals nvarchar(50)
	declare @nN_typevals int
	declare @sN_typevals nvarchar(50)

	declare @sTypeFromTempTable  nvarchar(45)
	declare @sNewnTypeFromTempTable nvarchar(45)
	declare @sWhereFromTempTable  nvarchar(45)

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7ENTQRY_PACKAGE_INIT

		return -1
	set @nNew_n = 0

		return -1

		set @nCounter = 1

    	begin
			execute  @nReturn = O7ENTQRY_GET_PROMPT @nCounter, @sPromptFromTempTable OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
        	IF @sPromptFromTempTable NOT LIKE @sFormid + N'%'
			begin
				set @nNew_n = @nNew_n + 1
				execute  @nReturn = O7ENTQRY_GET_VALUE @nCounter, @sValueFromTempTable OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
				set @sNewnValueFromTempTable = @sValueFromTempTable
				execute  @nReturn = O7ENTQRY_SET_VALUE @nNew_n, @sNewnValueFromTempTable
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
				execute  @nReturn = O7ENTQRY_GET_PROMPT @nCounter, @sPromptFromTempTable OUTPUT

				set @sNewnPromptFromTempTable = @sPromptFromTempTable

				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
			end
			set @nCounter = @nCounter + 1
		end --end of while
		set @nN_promptvals = @nNew_n
		set @sN_promptvals = cast(@nN_promptvals as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ENTQRY', N'N_PROMPTVALS', @sN_promptvals
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
  	end
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ENTQRY', N'N_TYPEVALS', @sN_typevals
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @nN_typevals = cast(@sN_typevals as int)
    If @nN_typevals > 0
	begin
	    set @nNew_n = 0
		set @nCounter = 1
    	WHILE @nCounter <= @nN_typevals
    	begin
			execute  @nReturn = O7ENTQRY_GET_TYPE @nCounter, @sTypeFromTempTable OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
        	IF @sTypeFromTempTable NOT LIKE @sFormid + N'%'
			begin
				set @nNew_n = @nNew_n + 1
				execute  @nReturn = O7ENTQRY_GET_TYPE @nCounter, @sTypeFromTempTable OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
				set @sNewnTypeFromTempTable = @sTypeFromTempTable
				execute  @nReturn = O7ENTQRY_SET_TYPE @nNew_n, @sNewnTypeFromTempTable
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
				execute  @nReturn = O7ENTQRY_GET_WHERE @nCounter, @sWhereFromTempTable OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
				set @sNewnWhereFromTempTable = @sWhereFromTempTable
				execute  @nReturn = O7ENTQRY_SET_WHERE @nNew_n, @sNewnWhereFromTempTable
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1 
			end
			set @nCounter = @nCounter + 1
		end --end of while
		set @nN_typevals = @nNew_n
		set @sN_typevals = cast(@nN_typevals as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ENTQRY', N'N_TYPEVALS', @sN_typevals
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    end

create procedure O7ENTQRY_PACKAGE_INIT
as
	--This procedure will be called from all procs and funcs within
	--this package.  This is to simulate package initialization scripts in Oracle
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sInitHasRun	nvarchar(8)
	declare @nReturn		int

begin
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'InitHasRun', @sInitHasRun OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sInitHasRun = N'false'
		begin
			execute @nReturn = CREATE_O7ENTQRY_TMP_TABLE
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ENTQRY', N'N_PROMPTVALS', N'0'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ENTQRY', N'N_TYPEVALS', N'0'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
						
			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'InitHasRun', N'true'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7EOBPOINTS
  @event NVARCHAR( 30 ) AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @frompoint     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @topoint       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @object        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @org           NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @uom           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @offset        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @totalweight   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @level         INT
  DECLARE @eobobject     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @eobobjectorg  NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @objuom        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objweight     NUMERIC
  DECLARE @sqlidentity   INT
  DECLARE @direction     NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @objlength     NUMERIC( 24,6 )
  DECLARE @objlengthuom  NVARCHAR( 10 )
  DECLARE @objdirection  NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @len           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @lenuom        NVARCHAR( 8 )

  SELECT @frompoint = evt_frompoint, 
         @topoint   = evt_topoint,
         @object    = evt_object, 
         @org       = evt_object_org, 
         @uom       = obj_linearrefuom,
         @direction = obj_direction,
         @len       = obj_length,
         @lenuom    = obj_lengthuom
  FROM   r5objects, r5events
  WHERE  obj_code = evt_object
  AND    obj_org  = evt_object_org
  AND    evt_code = @event
  IF @frompoint IS NOT NULL AND @topoint IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      DECLARE eob CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT eob_sqlidentity, eob_level, eob_object, eob_object_org, obj_linearrefuom, obj_linearcostweight, obj_length, obj_lengthuom, obj_direction
        FROM   r5objects, r5eventobjects 
        WHERE  obj_code  = eob_object
        AND    obj_org   = eob_object_org
        AND    eob_event = @event
        AND    obj_linearrefuom IS NOT NULL
      OPEN eob
      FETCH NEXT FROM eob INTO @sqlidentity, @level, @eobobject, @eobobjectorg, @objuom, @objweight, @objlength, @objlengthuom, @objdirection
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          SET @offset = dbo.o7getpointoffset( @eobobject, @eobobjectorg, @object, @org, @uom, N'+' ) * dbo.o7pointuomconv( @uom, @objuom )
          SET @totalweight = NULL    
          IF @objweight IS NOT NULL
            /* Get total weight. */
            SELECT @totalweight = SUM( obj_linearcostweight )
            FROM   r5objects, r5eventobjects
            WHERE  obj_code  = eob_object
            AND    obj_org   = eob_object_org
            AND    eob_event = @event
            AND    eob_level = @level
          IF COALESCE( @objdirection, @direction, 'x' ) = COALESCE( @direction, @objdirection, 'x' ) 
            UPDATE r5eventobjects
            SET    eob_frompoint        = ( @frompoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( @uom, @objuom ) ) + @offset,
                   eob_topoint          = ( @topoint   * dbo.o7pointuomconv( @uom, @objuom ) ) + @offset,
                   eob_weightpercentage = ROUND( @objweight / @totalweight * 100, 2 )
            WHERE  eob_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          ELSE
            /* Adjust for direction being different. */
            UPDATE r5eventobjects
            SET    eob_frompoint        = ( @len * dbo.o7pointuomconv( @lenuom, @objuom ) ) - ( @topoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( @uom, @objuom ) ) + @offset,
                   eob_topoint          = ( @len * dbo.o7pointuomconv( @lenuom, @objuom ) ) - ( @frompoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( @uom, @objuom ) ) + @offset,
                   eob_weightpercentage = ROUND( @objweight / @totalweight * 100, 2 )
            WHERE  eob_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM eob INTO @sqlidentity, @level, @eobobject, @eobobjectorg, @objuom, @objweight, @objlength, @objlengthuom, @objdirection
        END
      CLOSE eob
      DEALLOCATE eob
    END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7EPOVAL
	@sAspect nvarchar(30),
	@sObject nvarchar(30),
	@sObjorg nvarchar(15),
	@sItem   nvarchar(35),
	@sValue  nvarchar(200),
	@sResult nvarchar(1) OUTPUT
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sSQL  nvarchar(2000) /*r5minmaxparameters.mmp_statement%TYPE*/
	declare @sCol  nvarchar(2000) /*      r5minmaxparameters.mmp_statement%TYPE*/
	declare @sProtype	nvarchar(4) /*	   r5properties.pro_type%TYPE*/
	declare @sStatement1 nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sStatement2 nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sStatement3 nvarchar(2000)
	declare @nResult float
	declare	@sResult1 nvarchar(45) 

BEGIN

	set @sResult = null

	SELECT @sSQL = mmp_statement,
		 @sProtype = pro_type
	FROM   r5minmaxformulas,
		 r5minmaxparameters,
		 r5properties,
		 r5aspectprompts
	WHERE  apm_rule   = mmf_code
	AND    apm_prompt = pro_code
	AND    mmp_code   = SUBSTRING( mmf_formula, 2, len(mmf_formula) - 1 )
	AND    apm_aspect = @sAspect
	AND    apm_column = @sItem

	IF @sSQL IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			set @sSQL = REPLACE( @sSQL, N':ASPECT',    @sAspect )
			set @sSQL = REPLACE( @sSQL, N':OBJECTORG', @sObjorg )
			set @sSQL = REPLACE( @sSQL, N':OBJECT',    @sObject )
			set @sCol = SUBSTRING( @sSQL, 8, charindex( N'FROM' , @sSQL ) - 9 )
			IF charindex( N'''', @sCol  ) = 0 
				begin
					IF charindex( N'WHERE' , @sSQL ) > 0 
						set @sSQL = @sSQL +  N' AND ' + @sCol + N' = ''' + @sValue + N''''
					ELSE
						set @sSQL = @sSQL + N' WHERE ' + @sCol + N' = ''' + @sValue + N''''
				end
			ELSE
				set @sSQL = REPLACE( @sSQL, N':VALUE',    @sValue )

		  	set @sStatement1 = SUBSTRING(@sSQL, 1, 7)
		  	set @sStatement2 = SUBSTRING(@sSQL, 8, len(@sSQL)-7)
		  	set @sStatement3 = @sStatement1 + ' @sResult1 = ' + @sStatement2

				execute sp_executesql @sStatement3, N'@sResult1 nvarchar(45) OUTPUT', @sResult1 OUTPUT

			if @@Error = 0 
				begin
					if @sResult1 IS NULL
						set @sResult = '0'
					else
						set @sResult = '1'
				end
			else
				set @sResult = NULL
		end
	ELSE
		set @sResult = N'2'

END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7EQUIPSTRUCTURE
  @session             NUMERIC,
  @lang                NVARCHAR( 2 ),
  @parent              NVARCHAR( 200 ),
  @parentorg           NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @parenttype          NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @createtopparent     NVARCHAR( 1 ) = N'-',
  @loginuser           NVARCHAR( 255 ) 
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @chk              NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @equipstr         NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @mosobj           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @mospart          NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @mosworkspace     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @return           INT
  DECLARE @parentstring     NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @childstring      NVARCHAR( 200 )

  DECLARE @ecschild         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ecschildorg      NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @ecssyslevel      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ecsasmlevel      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ecscomplevel     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ecscomplocation  NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @ecsrollup        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @type             NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @kit              NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @qty              NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  DECLARE @epapart          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @epapartorg       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @epaqty           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  
  DECLARE @kttpart          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @kttpartorg       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @kttqty           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @parentobjrtype   NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @parentobjtype    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @parentmrc        NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @objrtype         NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @objtype          NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @department       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @icon             NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @iconpath         NVARCHAR( 1000 )
  DECLARE @rentity          NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @workspace        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sequence         NUMERIC( 10 )
  
  SET @equipstr      = dbo.o7dflt2( N'EQUIPSTR' )
  SET @mosobj        = dbo.o7getmos( N'OBJ' )
  SET @mospart       = dbo.o7getmos( N'PART' )
  SET @mosworkspace  = dbo.o7getmos( N'WKSP' )
  
  DECLARE @structprefuser        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @userstructpref        NVARCHAR( 1 ) = N'-'
  DECLARE @showparts             NVARCHAR( 1 ) = N'-'
  DECLARE @showvmrs              NVARCHAR( 1 ) = N'-'
  
  /* Delete data older than 1 day. */
  DELETE FROM r5equipmentstructuredetail
  WHERE  std_date < getdate() - 1 
      
  DECLARE cur_check_usp CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT ust_usercode, ust_show_part, ust_show_vmrs
    FROM r5userstructurepreferences
    WHERE ust_usercode = @loginuser
  
  OPEN cur_check_usp
        FETCH NEXT FROM cur_check_usp INTO @structprefuser, @showparts, @showvmrs
        IF @structprefuser IS NOT NULL
            SET @userstructpref = N'+'
      CLOSE cur_check_usp
  DEALLOCATE cur_check_usp
  
  IF @createtopparent = N'+'
    BEGIN
        DECLARE topobjrtype CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
        SELECT obj_obrtype,obj_obtype,obj_mrc
        FROM   r5objects
        WHERE  obj_code    = @parent
        AND    obj_org     = @parentorg
        
        OPEN topobjrtype
        FETCH NEXT FROM topobjrtype INTO @parentobjrtype,@parentobjtype,@parentmrc 
        CLOSE topobjrtype;
        /* insert top @parent. */
        EXECUTE @return = o7getclassicon 'OBJ', @parent,@parentorg,@icon OUTPUT, @iconpath OUTPUT
        EXECUTE @return = o7equipstructure_insstd @session, @lang, @session, N'*', N'*', @parent, @parentorg, @parenttype, 
                        @parentobjrtype,N'+', NULL, @equipstr, @mosobj, @mospart, @mosworkspace, @parentmrc, @parentobjtype,@icon,@iconpath,NULL, NULL, @loginuser, @userstructpref
    END 

  /* Loop through all equip config structure records. */
  DECLARE obj CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT obj_code, obj_org,obj_obrtype,obj_syslevel, obj_asmlevel, obj_complevel, obj_complocation, stc_rollup, N'E', NULL, NULL, obj_mrc, obj_obtype,NULL, stc_sequence
    FROM    r5objects, r5structures
    WHERE   stc_child          = obj_code 
    AND     stc_child_org      = obj_org 
    AND     stc_parent         = @parent 
    AND     stc_parent_org     = @parentorg
    AND     'E' = @parenttype
    UNION
    SELECT  obj_code, obj_org,obj_obrtype,NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, N'+',       N'E', NULL, NULL, obj_mrc, obj_obtype, NULL, NULL
    FROM    r5objects
    WHERE   obj_workspace     = @parent
    AND     'W' = @parenttype
    UNION
    SELECT  wks_pk, wks_org,NULL,NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, N'+', N'W', NULL, NULL, wks_mrc, NULL,wks_code, NULL
    FROM    r5workspaces
    WHERE   wks_objparent         = @parent 
    AND     wks_objparent_org     = @parentorg
    AND     'E' = @parenttype
    UNION
    SELECT  epa_part, epa_part_org, NULL,epa_syslevel, epa_asmlevel, epa_complevel, epa_partlocation, N'+', N'P', par_kit, epa_qty, NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL
    FROM    r5parts, r5entityparts o
    WHERE   par_code    = epa_part
    AND     par_org     = epa_part_org
    AND     epa_rentity = 'WKSP'
    AND     epa_code = @parent
    AND     'W' = @parenttype
    UNION
    SELECT epa_part, epa_part_org, NULL,epa_syslevel, epa_asmlevel, epa_complevel, epa_partlocation, N'+', N'P', par_kit, epa_qty,NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL
    FROM   r5parts, r5entityparts o
    WHERE  par_code    = epa_part
    AND    par_org     = epa_part_org
    AND    epa_rentity IN( N'OBJ',N'LOC')
    AND    (epa_code   = @parent + '#' + @parentorg)
    AND     'E' = @parenttype
    UNION
    SELECT epa_part, epa_part_org, NULL,epa_syslevel, epa_asmlevel, epa_complevel, epa_partlocation, N'+', N'P', par_kit, epa_qty,NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL
    FROM   r5parts, r5entityparts o
    WHERE  par_code    = epa_part
    AND    par_org     = epa_part_org
    AND    (epa_rentity = N'OBJ'  OR epa_rentity = N'LOC')
    AND     'E' = @parenttype
    AND    (epa_code    =  @parent + '#' + @parentorg OR(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM R5OBJECTS 
                                                                WHERE  obj_code = @parent
                                                                AND    obj_org  = @parentorg
                                                                AND    obj_category = o.epa_code)
                                                        AND    NOT EXISTS (SELECT  1 from R5ENTITYPARTS a WHERE a.epa_part= o.epa_part 
                                                        AND    a.epa_part_org=o.epa_part_org 
                                                        AND    a.epa_code= @parent + '#' + @parentorg  
                                                        AND    (a.epa_rentity='OBJ' OR a.epa_rentity = N'LOC'))))
  OPEN obj
  FETCH NEXT FROM obj INTO @ecschild, @ecschildorg, @objrtype, @ecssyslevel, @ecsasmlevel, @ecscomplevel, @ecscomplocation, @ecsrollup, @type, @kit, @qty, @department, @objtype, @workspace, @sequence
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @rentity = CASE @type WHEN 'P' THEN 'PART' WHEN 'W' THEN 'WKSP' ELSE 'OBJ' END
      IF (@ecssyslevel IS NULL OR (@userstructpref = '+' AND @showvmrs = '-')) AND @ecscomplocation IS NULL
        BEGIN
            /* If there is no inner structures, insert actual structure. */
            EXECUTE @return = o7getclassicon @rentity, @ecschild,@ecschildorg,@icon OUTPUT, @iconpath OUTPUT
            EXECUTE @return = o7equipstructure_insstd @session, @lang, @parent, @parentorg, @parenttype, @ecschild, @ecschildorg, @type, 
                              @objrtype, @ecsrollup, @qty, @equipstr, @mosobj, @mospart, @mosworkspace, @department, @objtype,@icon,@iconpath,@workspace, @sequence, @loginuser, @userstructpref
        END
      ELSE IF (@ecssyslevel IS NULL OR (@userstructpref = '+' AND @showvmrs = '-')) AND @ecscomplocation IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
          /* If there is only a coomp location, use that as child of the actual @parent. */
          SET @childstring = @parent+ N'#'+@ecscomplocation
          EXECUTE @return = o7equipstructure_insstd @session, @lang, @parent, @pare

CREATE PROCEDURE O7EQUIPSTRUCTURE_INSERTPARTCHILD
  @session         NUMERIC,
  @lang            NVARCHAR( 2 ),
  @par             NVARCHAR( 200 ),
  @parorg          NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @equipstr        NVARCHAR( 200 ),
  @mosobj          NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @mospart         NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @mosworkspace    NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @loginuser       NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @userstructpref  NVARCHAR( 1 )
AS
    DECLARE    @childpart      NVARCHAR( 30 )
    DECLARE    @childpartorg   NVARCHAR( 15 )
    DECLARE    @qty            NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
    DECLARE    @countit        INT 
    DECLARE    @return         INT
    DECLARE    @icon           NVARCHAR( 30 )
    DECLARE    @iconpath       NVARCHAR( 1000 )
BEGIN
        SET @countit = 0;
        DECLARE childparts CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
        SELECT epa_part, epa_part_org, epa_qty
        FROM   r5entityparts
        WHERE  epa_rentity = 'PART'
        AND    epa_code    = @par + '#' + @parorg

        OPEN childparts
        FETCH NEXT FROM childparts INTO @childpart,@childpartorg,@qty
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            DECLARE structure CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
            SELECT 1
            FROM  r5equipmentstructuredetail
            WHERE std_session = @session
            AND   std_parent =   @par 
            AND   std_parent_org = @parorg
            AND   std_child = @childpart
            AND   std_child_org = @childpartorg
            AND   std_parenttype = 'P'
            AND   std_childtype ='P'
            
            OPEN structure
            FETCH NEXT FROM structure INTO @countit
            CLOSE structure
            DEALLOCATE structure
            IF @countit = 1  
            BEGIN
                FETCH NEXT FROM childparts INTO @childpart,@childpartorg,@qty 
                continue
            END
            EXECUTE @return = o7getclassicon 'PART',@childpart, @childpartorg, @icon OUTPUT, @iconpath OUTPUT
            EXECUTE @return = o7equipstructure_insstd @session, @lang, @par, @parorg, 'P', @childpart, @childpartorg, 'P', NULL,'+', @qty, @equipstr, @mosobj, @mospart,@mosworkspace, NULL,NULL,@icon,@iconpath, NULL, NULL,@loginuser,@userstructpref
            
            EXECUTE @return = o7equipstructure_insertpartchild @session, @lang, @childpart,@childpartorg,@equipstr, @mosobj, @mospart, @mosworkspace, @loginuser, @userstructpref
            
            FETCH NEXT FROM childparts INTO @childpart,@childpartorg,@qty 
        END
        CLOSE childparts
        DEALLOCATE childparts
    END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7EQUIPSTRUCTURE_INSSTD
  @session      NUMERIC,
  @lang         NVARCHAR( 2 ),
  @par          NVARCHAR( 200 ),
  @parorg       NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @partype      NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @child        NVARCHAR( 200 ),
  @childorg     NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @childtype    NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @objrtype     NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @rollup       NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @qty          NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @equipstr     NVARCHAR( 200 ),
  @mosobj       NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @mospart      NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @mosworkspace NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @department   NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @objtype       NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @icon         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @iconpath     NVARCHAR( 1000 ),
  @workspace    NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sequence     NUMERIC( 10 ),
  @loginuser        NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @userstructpref   NVARCHAR( 1 )
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @configcode           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @configrev            NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @kit                  NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @uom                  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @descrleft            NVARCHAR( 300 )
  DECLARE @descrright           NVARCHAR( 300 )
  DECLARE @childdescr           NVARCHAR( 300 )
  DECLARE @childcode            NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @string               NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @risklevelicon        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @riskleveliconpath    NVARCHAR( 1000 )
  DECLARE @pos                  NUMERIC
  DECLARE @postot               NUMERIC

  DECLARE @showparts             NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @showvmrs              NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @showworkspaces        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @sortoption            NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @equipcodeseq          NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @equipdescseq          NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @equiporgseq           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @equiptypeseq          NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @equiptypedescseq      NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @fieldValue            NVARCHAR( 300 )
  DECLARE @fieldSeq              NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @equipfieldcode        NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @equipfielddesc        NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @equipfieldorg         NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @equipfieldtype        NVARCHAR( 200 )
  DECLARE @equipfieldtypedesc    NVARCHAR( 200 )
  
  IF  @userstructpref = N'+'
    BEGIN
      DECLARE cur_usp CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT ust_equipcode, ust_equipdesc, ust_equiporg, ust_equiptypecode, ust_equiptypedesc, ust_sortoption, ust_show_vmrs, ust_show_part, ust_show_workspace
        FROM r5userstructurepreferences
        WHERE ust_usercode = @loginuser 
        
      OPEN cur_usp
        FETCH NEXT FROM cur_usp INTO @equipcodeseq, @equipdescseq, @equiporgseq, @equiptypeseq, @equiptypedescseq, @sortoption, @showvmrs, @showparts, @showworkspaces
      CLOSE cur_usp
      DEALLOCATE cur_usp
    END
  
  SET @descrleft  =''
  SET @descrright =''
  SET @risklevelicon  = null
  SET @riskleveliconpath  = null
  SET @childcode = SUBSTRING( @child, CHARINDEX( N'#', @child) + 1, 200 )
  IF @childtype = N'P'
    /* Get part data. */
    SELECT @kit = par_kit, 
           @uom = par_uom
    FROM   r5parts
    WHERE  par_code = @child
    AND    par_org  = @childorg
    
  /* Set description. */
  IF @childtype IN ( N'E', N'P', N'W' )
    BEGIN
    IF @userstructpref = N'-' OR (@userstructpref = N'+' AND @childtype <> N'E')
     BEGIN
      IF @equipstr = N'D'
         SET @descrleft = N''
      ELSE
        SET @descrleft = coalesce(@workspace,@child)
        
      /* Get description. */
      IF @childtype = N'E'
        begin
            SET @childdescr = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang, N'OBJ', @child+N'#'+@childorg, NULL, NULL )
            SELECT @risklevelicon = rms_icon, @riskleveliconpath = rms_iconpath 
            FROM   r5riskmatrixsetup, r5objects 
            WHERE  rms_code = obj_risklevel
            AND    obj_code = @child
            AND    obj_org =  @childorg
        end
      ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF @childtype = N'P'
                SET @childdescr = SUBSTRING(dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang, N'PART', @child+N'#'+@childorg, NULL, NULL ), 1, 80)
            ELSE
                SET @childdescr = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang, N'WKSP', @child+N'#'+@childorg, NULL, NULL )
        END

      IF @equipstr IN ( N'B', N'D' )
        BEGIN
            /* Get description. */
            IF @equipstr = 'B'
                SET @descrleft = @descrleft + N'-'
            SET @descrleft = @descrleft + @childdescr
        END
      IF @childtype = N'P'
        BEGIN
            SET @descrleft  = @descrleft + N'(' 
            SET @descrright = N' ' + @uom + N')' 
        END

      IF ( @childtype = N'E' AND @mosobj = N'+' ) OR ( @childtype = N'P' AND @mospart = N'+' ) OR ( @childtype = N'W' AND @mosworkspace = N'+' )
        BEGIN
          SET @descrright = @descrright + N'(' + @childorg  + N')'
        END
     END
     ELSE IF @userstructpref = N'+' AND  @childtype  = N'E'
       BEGIN
         SET @equipfieldcode = coalesce(@workspace,@child)
         SET @equipfieldorg = @childorg
         SET @childdescr = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang, N'OBJ', @child+N'#'+@childorg, NULL, NULL )
         SET @equipfielddesc = @childdescr
         SET @equipfieldtypedesc = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang, N'UCOD', @objtype, 'OBTP', NULL )
         SET @equipfieldtype = @objtype
            
         SELECT @risklevelicon = rms_icon, @riskleveliconpath = rms_iconpath 
         FROM   r5riskmatrixsetup, r5objects 
         WHERE  rms_code = obj_risklevel
         AND    obj_code = @child
         AND    obj_org =  @childorg
         
         IF (@mosobj = N'+' )
             SET @equipfieldorg =  N'(' + @childorg  + N')'

        DECLARE cur_strcut_order CURSOR  LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT CASE 
           WHEN fieldname = 'EQUIPCODE' THEN @equipfieldcode
           WHEN fieldname = 'EQUIPDESC' THEN @equipfielddesc
           WHEN fieldname = 'EQUIPORG' THEN @equipfieldorg
           WHEN fieldname = 'EQUIPTYPECODE' THEN @equipfieldtype
           WHEN fieldname = 'EQUIPTYPEDESC' THEN @equipfieldtypedesc
           END equipfieldvalue, structorder 
           FROM (SELECT 
               ust_equipcode AS EQUIPCODE, 
               ust_equipdesc     AS EQUIPDESC,
               ust_equiporg      AS EQUIPORG,
               ust_equiptypecode AS EQUIPTYPECODE,
               ust_equiptypedesc AS EQUIPTYPEDESC
               FROM r5userstructurepreferences
               WHERE ust_usercode = @loginuser) stu
               UNPIVOT(structorder FOR fieldname IN(EQUIPCODE,EQUIPDESC,EQUIPORG,EQUIPTYPECODE,EQUIPTYPEDESC)) AS DispOrder
           WHERE structorder IS NOT NULL
           ORDER BY structorder
               
        OPEN cur_strcut_order
        FETCH NEXT FROM cur_strcut_order INTO @fieldValue, @fieldSeq
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
         BEGIN
            IF @fieldSeq < 4
                SET @descrleft  = @descrleft + @fieldValue + '-'
            ELSE
                SET @descrright = @descrright + @fieldValue + '-'
         FETCH NEXT FROM cur_strcut_order INTO  @fieldValue, @fieldSeq
         END

         CLOSE cur_strcut_order
         DEALLOCATE cur_strcut_order
             
         IF LEN(@descrleft) > 0  AND LEN(@descrright) > 0
           SET @descrright = SUBSTRING(@descrright, 1, LEN(@descrright)-1)
         ELSE IF LEN(@descrleft) > 0 
           SET @descrleft = SUBSTRING(@descrleft, 1, LEN(@descrleft)-1)
         ELSE IF LEN(@descrright) > 0 
           SET @descrright = SUBSTRING(@descrright, 1, LEN(@descrright)-1)
      END
    END

  ELSE IF @childtype IN ( N'S', N'A', N'C' )
    BEGIN
        /* get code structure description. */
        SELECT @descrleft = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang, N'CLVL', csr_code, NULL, NULL )
        FROM   r5codestructure
        WHERE  csr_rentity   = 'ACT'
        AND    csr_structure = @childcode
        
        SET @childdescr = @descrleft
    END

  ELSE IF @ch

name: O7ERCEWS

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ERCEWS
	@nChk		int OUTPUT,
    @sType      nvarchar(6),
    @sRentity   nvarchar(4),
    @sOldstatus nvarchar(4),
    @sNewstatus nvarchar(4) ,
    @sOrg       nvarchar(15),
    @sCuser     nvarchar(255),
    @sCrole     nvarchar(30) = '*'
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sOrgT         nvarchar(15)
    declare @nSign         int
    declare @nReturn       int
    declare @nStatus       int
    declare @sUser_group   nvarchar(12)
    declare @sVAuthRentity nvarchar(8)
    declare @nResult       int

	set @sVAuthRentity = null
    set @nChk = 0
	execute @nReturn = O7ERECORD @nSign OUTPUT, @sType, @sRentity, @sOldstatus, @sNewstatus 
	if @@error <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	IF @nSign = 2 
		begin
			/*if user is not specified then  return 1 to indicate esign required*/
			IF @sCuser is NULL or @sCuser = N''
				begin
					set @nChk = 1
					RETURN
				end
			/* if user then check for authorization to change signatures  return 2 if no perimssion */
			set @sOrgT = @sOrg
			IF @sOrgT IS NULL or @sOrgT = N''
	  			set @sOrgT = N'*'
			
			/* CURSOR to get the user group for checking the status change by thew user */
			SELECT @sUser_group = uog_group
			FROM   r5userorganization
			WHERE  uog_user = @sCuser
			AND    uog_role = @sCrole
			AND    uog_org  = @sOrgT

			IF @sRentity IN (N'RECV',N'RETN',N'STST',N'STOS')
				set @sVAuthRentity = N'TRAN'
			ELSE
	    		set @sVAuthRentity = @sRentity

    		SELECT @nResult = count(*) FROM r5auth
    		WHERE ( aut_user    = @sCuser
      		OR ( aut_group   = @sUser_group
      		AND  aut_user    = N'*' ) )
   			AND     aut_rentity = @sVAuthRentity
   			AND     (aut_status = '*' or aut_status  = @sOldstatus)
   			AND     aut_statnew = @sNewstatus
   			AND     aut_type    = N'+'
   			AND NOT EXISTS (
      			SELECT *
      			FROM   r5auth x
      			WHERE  x.aut_group    = @sUser_group
      			AND    x.aut_user     = @sCuser
      			AND    ( x.aut_status = N'*'
        		OR   x.aut_status   = @sOldstatus )
      			AND    x.aut_rentity  = @sVAuthRentity
      			AND    x.aut_type     = N'-' )

			if @nResult = 0
				set @nChk = 2
		end

name: O7ERECORD
body:
create procedure O7ERECORD @nChk int OUTPUT, @sType nvarchar(6), @sRentity nvarchar(4), @sOldstatus nvarchar(4), @sNewstatus nvarchar(4)
as


	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sSign nvarchar(1)-- r5elecrec.elr_signature%@sType
	declare @nCount int
	declare @nRetValue int

	execute @nRetValue = o7esign_set_Rentity @sRentity
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nRetValue <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nRetValue = o7esign_set_Oldstatus @sOldstatus
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nRetValue <> 0
		return - 1
	
	execute @nRetValue = o7esign_set_Newstatus @sNewstatus
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nRetValue <> 0
		return -1
		
	IF @sType = N'UPD' 
		BEGIN	
			IF @sOldstatus = @sNewstatus 
				BEGIN
					SET @nChk  = 0
					RETURN 
				END

			SELECT @nCount = count(*)
			FROM r5elecrec
			WHERE elr_Rentity = @sRentity
			AND   elr_status = @sOldstatus
			AND   elr_Newstatus = @sNewstatus

			if @nCount > 0
				BEGIN
					SELECT @sSign = Coalesce(elr_signature, N'-')
					FROM r5elecrec
					WHERE elr_Rentity = @sRentity
					AND   elr_status = @sOldstatus
					AND   elr_Newstatus = @sNewstatus

					IF @sSign = N'-' 
						BEGIN  
							SELECT @nCount = count(*)
							FROM r5elecrec
							WHERE elr_Rentity = @sRentity
							AND   elr_status = N'*'
							AND   elr_Newstatus = @sNewstatus
							
							if @nCount = 0
								BEGIN
									SET @nChk  = 1
									RETURN
								END
							else
								BEGIN
									SELECT @sSign = Coalesce(elr_signature, N'-')
									FROM r5elecrec
									WHERE elr_Rentity = @sRentity
									AND   elr_status = N'*'
									AND   elr_Newstatus = @sNewstatus

									IF @sSign = N'-' 
										BEGIN
											SET @nChk = 1
											RETURN
										END
									ELSE
										BEGIN
											SET @nChk  = 2
											RETURN
										END
								END
						END			
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @nChk  = 2
							RETURN
						END 
				END
			else
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCount = count(*)
					FROM r5elecrec
					WHERE elr_Rentity = @sRentity
					AND   elr_status = N'*'
					AND   elr_Newstatus = @sNewstatus
					
					if @nCount = 0
						BEGIN
							SET @nChk  = 0
							RETURN
						END
					else
						BEGIN
							SELECT @sSign = Coalesce(elr_signature, N'-')
							FROM r5elecrec
							WHERE elr_Rentity = @sRentity
							AND   elr_status = N'*'
							AND   elr_Newstatus = @sNewstatus

							IF @sSign = N'-' 
								BEGIN
									SET @nChk = 1
									RETURN
								END
							ELSE
								BEGIN
									SET @nChk = 2
									RETURN
								END
						END 
				END
		END  
	IF @sType = N'NEW' 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCount = count(*)
			FROM r5elecrec
			WHERE elr_Rentity = @sRentity
			AND   ( elr_status = N'-' OR ( @sRentity = N'INRH' AND elr_status = @sOldstatus ) )
			AND   elr_Newstatus = @sNewstatus


			if @nCount = 0
				BEGIN
					SET @nChk  = 0
					RETURN
				END
			else
				BEGIN
					IF @sRentity = N'INRH' AND @sOldstatus = N'#' 
						SELECT @sSign = Coalesce(elr_signature, N'-')
						FROM r5elecrec
						WHERE elr_Rentity = @sRentity
						AND   elr_status = @sOldstatus
						AND   elr_Newstatus = @sNewstatus
					ELSE
						SELECT @sSign = Coalesce(elr_signature, N'-')
						FROM r5elecrec
						WHERE elr_Rentity = @sRentity
						AND   elr_status = N'-'
						AND   elr_Newstatus = @sNewstatus

					IF @sSign = N'-' 
						BEGIN
							SET @nChk = 1
							RETURN
						END
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @nChk  = 2
							RETURN
						END
				END
		END
	IF @sType = N'DEL' 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCount = count(*)
			FROM r5elecrec
			WHERE elr_Rentity = @sRentity
			AND   elr_status = @sOldstatus
			AND   elr_Newstatus = N'-'


			if @nCount = 0
				BEGIN
					SET @nChk  = 0
					RETURN
				END
			else
				BEGIN
					SELECT @sSign = Coalesce(elr_signature, N'-')
					FROM r5elecrec
					WHERE elr_Rentity = @sRentity
					AND   elr_status = @sOldstatus
					AND   elr_Newstatus = N'-'

					IF @sSign = N'-' 
						BEGIN
							SET @nChk = 1
							RETURN
						END
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @nChk  = 2
							RETURN
						END
				END
		END
	ELSE
		SET @nChk  = 0
		RETURN

create procedure O7ERR_ERASE_ERROR
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sUlang		nvarchar(2)
	declare @sErrMess	nvarchar(2000)
	declare @nCount		int
	declare @nReturn	int

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7ERR_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'R5SOURCE', null
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'R5SRCTYPE', null
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'R5ERRNUM', null
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'ULANG', @sUlang OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	select	@nCount = count(*)
	  FROM  r5errtexts
	 WHERE  ert_code   = N'0'
	 AND    ert_lang   = @sUlang

	if @nCount = 0
		SET @sErrMess = N'No errors encountered recently'
	else
		select @sErrMess = ert_text
		  FROM  r5errtexts
		 WHERE  ert_code   = N'0'
		 AND    ert_lang   = @sUlang

	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'R5ERRMESS', @sErrMess
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

name: O7ERR_PACKAGE_INIT
body:
create procedure O7ERR_PACKAGE_INIT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--This procedure will be called from all procs and funcs within
	--this package.  This is to simulate package initialization scripts in Oracle

	declare @sInitHasRun	nvarchar(8)
	declare @sUlang			nvarchar(2)
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @nReturn		int

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'InitHasRun', @sInitHasRun OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sInitHasRun = N'false'
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7SESS_USER_LANGUAGE @sUlang OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sUlang is null
				begin
					select @nCount = count(*)
					  From r5install
					 Where ins_code = N'DEFLANG'

					if @nCount = 1
						select @sUlang = Substring(ins_desc, 1, 2)
						  From r5install
						 Where ins_code = N'DEFLANG'
					else
						SET @sUlang = N'EN'

					execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'ULANG', @sUlang
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1
				end
			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'InitHasRun', N'true'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end

create procedure O7ERR_R5ERROR	@sError	nvarchar(512)	OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sDebugMode	nvarchar(3)
	declare @sSrcType	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sSource	nvarchar(32)
	declare	@sErrNum	nvarchar(32)
	declare @sErrMess	nvarchar(255)
	declare @nReturn	int

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7ERR_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'DEBUGMODE', @sDebugMode OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sDebugMode = N'OFF'
		begin
			execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'R5ERRMESS', @sError OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end
	else
		begin
			execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'R5SRCTYPE', @sSrcType OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'R5SOURCE', @sSource OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'R5ERRNUM', @sErrNum OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'R5ERRMESS', @sErrMess OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			
			SET @sError = @sSrcType + N'-' + @sSource + N'-' + @sErrNum + N' : ' + @sErrMess
		end

name: O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR

create procedure O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR	@sSource	nvarchar(32), 
									@sSrctype	nvarchar(4), 
									@nR5code	int
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sProdname	nvarchar(200) --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare	@sChk		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCount		int
	declare @sUlang		nvarchar(2)
	declare @sErrMess	nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sR5Code	nvarchar(32)
	declare @nReturn	int

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7ERR_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sProdname OUTPUT, N'PRODNAME', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'R5SOURCE', @sSource
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'R5SRCTYPE', @sSrctype
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @sR5Code = convert( nvarchar, @nR5code )
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'R5ERRNUM', @sR5Code
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'ULANG', @sUlang OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	select	@nCount = count(*)
	  FROM	r5errsource e,
			r5errtexts t
	 WHERE  e.ers_source = @sSource
	 AND    e.ers_type   = @sSrctype
	 AND    e.ers_number = @nR5code
	 AND    t.ert_code   = e.ers_code
	 AND    t.ert_lang   = @sUlang

	if @nCount = 0
		SET @sErrMess = @sProdname + N'-0001 : Error in ' + @sSrctype + N' ' + @sSource + N' (' + convert( nvarchar, @nR5code ) + N')'
	else
		select @sErrMess = @sProdname + N'-' + ert_code + N' : ' + char(10) + coalesce( t.ert_text, e.ers_desc)
		  FROM	r5errsource e,
				r5errtexts t
		 WHERE  e.ers_source = @sSource
		 AND    e.ers_type   = @sSrctype
		 AND    e.ers_number = @nR5code
		 AND    t.ert_code   = e.ers_code
		 AND    t.ert_lang   = @sUlang
	
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'R5ERRMESS', @sErrMess
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	RAISERROR(@sErrMess, 16, 1 )

create procedure O7ERR_SET_DEBUG	@sOnoff	nvarchar(3)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn	int

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7ERR_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sOnoff = N'ON'
		begin
			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'DEBUGMODE', N'ON'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end
	else
		begin
			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7ERR', N'DEBUGMODE', N'OFF'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end
