create procedure O7ESTDMA  @sSource    nvarchar(8),
                           @sCode      nvarchar(30),
                           @sClass     nvarchar(80),
                           @dDatefrom  datetime,
                           @dDateto    datetime,
                           @nCost      numeric(30,6)   OUTPUT,
                           @sStatement nvarchar(4000)  OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nCursor1     int
    declare @nIgnore      int
	declare @sSQL		  nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sExtracol    nvarchar( 2000 )            /* extra columns in select clause.       */
    declare @sFromstat    nvarchar( 1000 )            /* from statement                        */
    declare @sSelclause   nvarchar( 3000 )            /* select statement it self              */
    declare @sEvtclause   nvarchar( 3000 )            /* and clause for events                 */
    declare @sPrjclause   nvarchar( 3000 )            /* and clause for projects               */
    declare @sBudclause   nvarchar( 3000 )            /* and clause for budgets                */
    declare @sAndclause   nvarchar( 3000 )            /* and clause to use ( evt, pro or bud ) */
    declare @sGroupby     nvarchar( 2000 )            /* group by statement                    */
    declare @sCharfrom    nvarchar(   10 )            /* date from in character                */
    declare @sCharto      nvarchar(   10 )            /* date to in character                  */
	declare @sPriceLevel  nvarchar(200)			  /* Price level ( Part or Stock )         */
	declare @nRate		  numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRecid		  nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct		  numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent		  nvarchar(30)
    declare @sRouteParent nvarchar(30)
	declare @nQty		  numeric(24,6)   			 
    declare @nTempCost    numeric(30,6)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''
    /* This procedure retrieves the estimated direct material costs */
    /* Get price level */
	SELECT @sPriceLevel = ISNULL(ins_desc, N'P')
	FROM r5install
	WHERE ins_code = N'PRICELEV'

	if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
		set @sPriceLevel = N'P'
	
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

	/* NOTE: BAN is a special case and its functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'select round( isnull( sum( isnull(dbo.O7GETPRC( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part,
										m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org, N''B'', N''' + @sPriceLevel + N''', null ), 0 ) *
										isnull( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) ), 0), 2) costs,
										isnull( dbo.O7GETPRC( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org,
													  e.evt_org, N''B'', N''' + @sPriceLevel + N''', null ), 0 ) rate,
										isnull( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) qty,
										a.act_event,
										a.act_act,
										cast(p.par_sqlidentity as nvarchar(38)) recid 
								from   r5parts      p,
									   r5matlparts  m,
									   r5activities a,
									   r5ububat     u,
									   r5mrcs       c RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5events e ON e.evt_mrc = c.mrc_code
                                                      LEFT OUTER JOIN  r5objects o ON o.obj_code = e.evt_object 
									                    				   and o.obj_org = e.evt_object_org 
								where  a.act_event         = e.evt_code 
								and    p.par_code          = m.mlp_part 
								and    p.par_org           = m.mlp_part_org 
								and    m.mlp_direct        = N''+'' 
								and    a.act_matlist       = m.mlp_matlist 
								and    a.act_matlrev       = m.mlp_matlrev 
								and    dbo.o7checkmatch( m.mlp_equipfilter, o.obj_checklistfilter ) = N''+'' 
								and    CASE WHEN m.mlp_code is null THEN isnull( m.mlp_obrtype,'' '') 
											   WHEN m.mlp_code = o.obj_category THEN N''C'' 
											   WHEN m.mlp_code = e.evt_object THEN e.evt_obrtype END = 
											   isnull( m.mlp_obrtype,'' '') 
								and   u.bub_event = e.evt_code
								and   u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N''' 
								and   u.bub_rstatus <> N''B''
								and   a.act_start >= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101)
								and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) 
								group by c.mrc_store,
                                         m.mlp_part,
										 m.mlp_part_org,
										 e.evt_org,
										 m.mlp_qty,
										 a.act_event,
										 a.act_act,
										 p.par_sqlidentity '
			return
		end
	else
		begin
		   /* Set from statement */
			IF @sSource = N'BUD'
				set @sFromstat = N' r5parts      p,
							   r5matlparts  m,
							   r5activities a,
							   r5ububat     u, 
							   r5mrcs       c RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5events e ON e.evt_mrc = c.mrc_code
                                              LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects o ON o.obj_code = e.evt_object 
                    		                                        and o.obj_org = e.evt_object_org '
			ELSE
				set @sFromstat = N'r5parts      p,
							r5matlparts  m,
							r5activities a,
						    r5mrcs       c RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5events e ON e.evt_mrc = c.mrc_code
                                           LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects o ON o.obj_code = e.evt_object 
                    		                                          and o.obj_org = e.evt_object_org '
			/* Set select statement it self */
			set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = round( isnull( sum( isnull(dbo.O7GETPRC( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part,
														m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org, N''B'', @sPriceLevel, null ), 0 ) *
														isnull( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) ), 0), 2)
								 from   ' + @sFromstat +
							   N' where  a.act_event         = e.evt_code 
								and    p.par_code          = m.mlp_part 
								and    p.par_org           = m.mlp_part_org 
								and    m.mlp_direct        = N''+'' 
								and    a.act_matlist       = m.mlp_matlist 
								and    a.act_matlrev       = m.mlp_matlrev 
								and    dbo.o7checkmatch( m.mlp_equipfilter, o.obj_checklistfilter ) = N''+'' 
								and    CASE WHEN m.mlp_code is null THEN isnull( m.mlp_obrtype,'' '') 
											   WHEN m.mlp_code = o.obj_category THEN N''C'' 
											   WHEN m.mlp_code = e.evt_object THEN e.evt_obrtype END = 
											   isnull( m.mlp_obrtype,'' '') '

			set @sEvtclause = N' and   a.act_event = @sEvent and evt_routeparent IS NULL '

			set @sPrjclause = N' and   a.act_project in
							 ( select prj_code from dbo.O7ESTXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'

			set @sBudclause = N' and   u.bub_event = e.evt_code
						  and   u.bub_code  = @sCode
						  and   u.bub_rstatus <> N''B''
						  and   a.act_start >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101)
						  and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101) '
			   /* Set actual and clause, depending on variable  source  */
			if @sSource = N'EVT' 
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			else
				begin
					if  @sSource = N'PRJ' 
						set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
					else
						begin
								if  @sSource = N'BUD' 
									set @sAndclause = @sBudclause
								else
									set @sAndclause = N''
						end
				end

			set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause

            if @sSource in ( N'EVT', N'EVT2')
                begin
                    set @nCost = 0
                    declare c_estdma_evt cursor local for select evt_code, evt_routeparent from dbo.O7ESTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) where ( evt_routeparent IS NULL OR evt_code = @sCode )
                    open c_estdma_evt
                    fetch next from c_estdma_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ESTFIX   @sSource		nvarchar(8),
							@sCode			nvarchar(30),
							@sClass			nvarchar(80),
							@dDatefrom		datetime,
							@dDateto		datetime,
							@nCost			numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
							@sStatement		nvarchar(4000)		OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)		
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(200)		
	declare @sSelclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sBudclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(200)			
	declare @sExtra			nvarchar(800)	
	declare @sExtracol		nvarchar(800)			
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sPriceLevel    nvarchar(200)
	declare @nRate			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRecid			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRouteParent   nvarchar(30)
    declare @nTempCost      numeric(30,6)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''
    set @sExtra = N''
    /* This procedure retrieves the estimated labour costs */
    /* Set dates in character format. */
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )
    
	/* NOTE: BAN is a special case and its functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN' 
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'select round( sum( CASE WHEN (a.act_order IS NULL AND a.act_req IS NULL) THEN COALESCE( a.act_est, 0 ) ELSE 1 END  *
											coalesce( a.act_ntrate, 1 ) * ( ( DATEDIFF(day, dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( a.act_start, CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101) ),
												dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( a.act_start + a.act_duration - 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) ) ) + 1 ) / a.act_duration ) ), 2 )  costs, 
											coalesce( a.act_ntrate, 0 ) rate,
											round( sum( CASE WHEN (a.act_order IS NULL AND a.act_req IS NULL) THEN coalesce( a.act_est, 0 ) ELSE 1 END
											* ( ( DATEDIFF(day, dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( a.act_start, CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101) ),
												dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( a.act_start + a.act_duration - 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) ) ) + 1 ) / a.act_duration ) ), 2 ) qty,
											a.act_event,
											a.act_act,
											a.act_sqlidentity recid
	 							 from r5events e, r5activities a, r5ububat u 
								where a.act_hire  = N''+''
									and   a.act_event = e.evt_code
									and   coalesce( a.act_ordrtype, N''ST'' ) = N''SF'' 
									and   u.bub_event = a.act_event
									and   u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N''' 
									and   a.act_start + a.act_duration >= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101)
									and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) 
								group by a.act_ntrate, a.act_event, a.act_act, a.act_sqlidentity '
			return
		end
	else
		begin
			IF @sSource = N'BUD'
				begin
					set @sFromstat = ' r5events e, r5activities a, r5ububat u '
					set @sExtra = N' * ( ( DATEDIFF(day, dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( a.act_start, CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101) ), 
						dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( a.act_start + a.act_duration - 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101) ) ) + 1 ) / a.act_duration ) '	
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					set @sFromstat = N' r5events e, r5activities a '
					set @sExtra    = N''
				end

			/* Set select statement it self */
			set @sSelclause = N' select @nCost = round( sum( CASE WHEN (a.act_order IS NULL AND a.act_req IS NULL) THEN COALESCE( a.act_est, 0 ) ELSE 1 END  *
											coalesce( a.act_ntrate, 1 ) '
											+ @sExtra + ' ), 2 ) 
							 from  ' + @sFromstat +
							 N' where a.act_hire  = N''+''
								 and   a.act_event = e.evt_code
								 and   coalesce( a.act_ordrtype, N''ST'' ) = N''SF'' '


			/* Set additional and clause for events */
			set @sEvtclause =  N'and a.act_event = @sEvent and evt_routeparent IS NULL '

			/* Set additional and clause for projects */
			set @sPrjclause = ' and a.act_project in
						   ( select prj_code from dbo.O7ESTXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) )'
			/* Set additional and clause for budgets */
			set @sBudclause = ' and   u.bub_event = a.act_event
						  and   u.bub_code  = @sCode
						  and   a.act_start + a.act_duration >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101)
						  and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101) '
			/* Set actual and clause, depending on variable  source  */
			IF @sSource = N'EVT'
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			ELSE IF @sSource = N'PRJ'
				set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
			ELSE IF @sSource = N'BUD'
			   set @sAndclause = @sBudclause
			ELSE
				set @sAndclause = N''

			set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause

            if @sSource in ( N'EVT', N'EVT2')
                begin
                    set @nCost = 0
                    declare c_estfix_evt cursor local for select evt_code, evt_routeparent from dbo.O7ESTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) where ( evt_routeparent IS NULL OR evt_code = @sCode )
                    open c_estfix_evt
                    fetch next from c_estfix_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            if @sRouteParent is not null
                                set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( dbo.o7sesfix( @sRouteParent, @sEvent ), 0 )

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ESTHIR   @sSource		nvarchar(8),
							@sCode			nvarchar(30),

							@dDatefrom		datetime,
							@dDateto		datetime,
							@nCost			numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,

AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)		
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(200)		
	declare @sSelclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sBudclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(200)

	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sPriceLevel    nvarchar(200)
	declare @nRate			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRecid			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRouteParent   nvarchar(30)
    declare @nTempCost      numeric(30,6)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''
    set @sExtra = N''

    /* This procedure retrieves the estimated labour costs */
    /* Set dates in character format. */
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )
  
	/* NOTE: BAN is a special case and its functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'select round( sum( coalesce( a.act_est, 0 ) *
												  coalesce( a.act_ntrate, 0 ) * ( ( DATEDIFF(day, dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( a.act_start, CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101) ),
												dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( a.act_start + a.act_duration - 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) ) ) + 1 ) / a.act_duration ) ), 2 )  costs,
										coalesce( a.act_ntrate, 0 ) rate,
										round( sum( coalesce( a.act_est, 0 )   * ( ( DATEDIFF(day, dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( a.act_start, CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101) ),
												dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( a.act_start + a.act_duration - 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) ) ) + 1 ) / a.act_duration )  ), 2 ) qty,
										a.act_event,
										a.act_act,
										cast(a.act_sqlidentity as nvarchar(38)) recid 
								from  r5events e, r5activities a, r5ububat u
							    where  a.act_hire  = N''+''
                                  and  a.act_event = e.evt_code
								  and   coalesce( a.act_ordrtype, N''ST'' ) = N''ST''
								  and   u.bub_event = a.act_event
								  and   u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N'''
								  and   a.act_start + a.act_duration >= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101)
								  and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) 
								group by a.act_ntrate, a.act_event, a.act_act, a.act_sqlidentity '
			return
		end
	else
		begin
			IF @sSource = N'BUD'
				begin
					set @sFromstat = N'r5events e, r5activities a, r5ububat u'
					set @sExtra = N' * ( ( DATEDIFF(day, dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( a.act_start, CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101) ), 
						dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( a.act_start + a.act_duration - 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101) ) ) + 1 ) / a.act_duration ) '	
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					set @sFromstat = N'r5events e, r5activities a '
					set @sExtra    = N''
				end
			/* Set select statement it self */
			set @sSelclause = N' select @nCost = round( sum( coalesce( a.act_est, 0 ) *
												  coalesce( a.act_ntrate, 0 ) '
												  + @sExtra + ' ), 2 ) 
							 from  ' + @sFromstat +
						   N' where  a.act_hire  = N''+''
                             and  a.act_event = e.evt_code
							 and    coalesce( a.act_ordrtype, N''ST'' ) = N''ST'' '
			/* Set additional and clause for events */
			set @sEvtclause = N' and a.act_event = @sEvent and evt_routeparent IS NULL '
			/* Set additional and clause for projects */
			set @sPrjclause = N' and a.act_project in
						   ( select prj_code from dbo.O7ESTXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'
			/* Set additional and clause for budgets */
			set @sBudclause = N' and   u.bub_event = a.act_event
								  and   u.bub_code  = @sCode
								  and   a.act_start + a.act_duration >=	CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101)
								  and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101) '
			/* Set actual and clause, depending on variable  source  */
   			IF @sSource = N'EVT'
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			ELSE IF @sSource = N'PRJ'
				set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
			ELSE IF @sSource = N'BUD'
			   set @sAndclause = @sBudclause
			ELSE
				set @sAndclause = N''
    
			set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause

            if @sSource in ( N'EVT', N'EVT2')
                begin
                    set @nCost = 0
                    declare c_esthir_evt cursor local for select evt_code, evt_routeparent from dbo.O7ESTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) where ( evt_routeparent IS NULL OR evt_code = @sCode )
                    open c_esthir_evt
                    fetch next from c_esthir_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            if @sRouteParent is not null
                                set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( dbo.o7seshir( @sRouteParent, @sEvent ), 0 )
                            
			                EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											                @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			                if @@ERROR <> 0 
                                begin 
                                    close c_esthir_evt
                                    deallocate c_esthir_evt
				                    return -1
                                end

                            set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

                            fetch next from c_esthir_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                        end
                    close c_esthir_evt
                    deallocate c_esthir_evt
                end
            else
                begin
			        EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											        @nCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent

                end
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ESTLABPPM 
				@sSource    nvarchar(8),
				@sCode      nvarchar(30),
				@sHired     nvarchar(1),
				@dDatefrom  datetime,
				@dDateto    datetime,
				@nCost      numeric(30,6) OUTPUT,
				@sStatement nvarchar(4000)  OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sExtracol  nvarchar(800)  
	declare @sSelclause nvarchar(3000) 
	declare @sCharfrom  nvarchar(10)  
	declare @sCharto    nvarchar(10)  
	declare @sGroupby   nvarchar(200) 
	declare @nRate		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRecid		nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct		numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent		nvarchar(30)
	declare @nQty		numeric(24,6)
	 
	set @sExtracol = N''

	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

	/* NOTE: BAN is a special case and its functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/

	if @sSource = N'BAN' 
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'SELECT ROUND( SUM( coalesce( p.ppa_est, 0 ) * coalesce( dbo.o7gettraderate( act_mrc, act_trade, fut_date, evt_org ), 0 ) *
												( Datediff(day, dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( f.fut_date + p.ppa_start + p.ppa_duration - 2,CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101)) , 
												dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( f.fut_date + p.ppa_start - 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101)) + 1 ) / p.ppa_duration ) ), 2 ) costs, 
										coalesce( dbo.o7gettraderate( act_mrc, act_trade, fut_date, evt_org ), 0 ) rate,
										ROUND( SUM( coalesce( p.ppa_est, 0 ) * 
												( datediff(day, dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( f.fut_date + p.ppa_start + p.ppa_duration - 2,CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101)) ,
												dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( f.fut_date + p.ppa_start - 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101) ) + 1 ) / p.ppa_duration ) ), 2 ) qty,
										f.fut_event act_event,
										p.ppa_act act_act,
										N''PPM''+ CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), f.fut_date ,101) recid
								 FROM   r5futureevents f,
										r5ppms s,
										r5events e,
										r5ppmacts p,
										r5activities a,
										r5ububat u
								WHERE  f.fut_event = a.act_event
								AND    e.evt_code  = a.act_event
								AND    a.act_act   = p.ppa_act
								AND    p.ppa_hire  = N''' + @sHired + N''' 
								AND    f.fut_seqno > 1
								AND    u.bub_event = f.fut_event
								AND    u.bub_rstatus NOT IN ( N''B'', N''C'' )
								AND    u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N''' 
								AND    u.bub_ppm   = s.ppm_code
								AND    s.ppm_revrstatus = N''A''
								AND    s.ppm_code = p.ppa_ppm
								AND    s.ppm_revision = p.ppa_revision
								AND    f.fut_date + p.ppa_start + p.ppa_duration - 2 >=
											CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101) 
								AND    f.fut_date + p.ppa_start - 1 <=
											CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101)  
							group by dbo.o7gettraderate( act_mrc, act_trade, fut_date, evt_org ),
										f.fut_event,
										p.ppa_act,
										N''PPM'' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), f.fut_date ,101) '
			return
		end
	else
		SELECT @nCost = ROUND( SUM( coalesce( p.ppa_est, 0 ) * coalesce( dbo.o7gettraderate( act_mrc, act_trade, fut_date, evt_org ), 0 ) *
								( Datediff(day, dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( f.fut_date + p.ppa_start + p.ppa_duration - 2,CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101)) , 
								dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( f.fut_date + p.ppa_start - 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101)) + 1 ) / p.ppa_duration ) ), 2 ) 
		FROM   r5futureevents f,
               r5events e,
               r5ppms s,
               r5ppmacts p,
               r5activities a,
               r5ububat u
		WHERE  f.fut_event = a.act_event
		AND    e.evt_code  = a.act_event
		AND    a.act_act   = p.ppa_act
		AND    p.ppa_hire  = @sHired
		AND    f.fut_seqno > 1
		AND    u.bub_event = f.fut_event
		AND    u.bub_rstatus NOT IN ( N'B', N'C' )
		AND    u.bub_code  = @sCode
        AND    u.bub_ppm   = s.ppm_code
        AND    s.ppm_revrstatus = N'A'
        AND    s.ppm_code = p.ppa_ppm
        AND    s.ppm_revision = p.ppa_revision
		AND    f.fut_date + p.ppa_start + p.ppa_duration - 2 >=	CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101) 
		AND    f.fut_date + p.ppa_start - 1 <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101)

	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''
	SET @sPriceLevel = N'P'

	SELECT @sPriceLevel = ISNULL(ins_desc, N'P')
	FROM r5install
	WHERE ins_code = N'PRICELEV'
	
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

	/* NOTE: BAN is a special case and its functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'select round( isnull( sum( isnull( dbo.O7GETPRC( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part,
													m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org, N''B'', N''' + @sPriceLevel + ''', null ), 0 ) *
																	 isnull( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) ), 0), 2) costs, 
										isnull( dbo.O7GETPRC( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org,
															e.evt_org, N''B'', N''' + @sPriceLevel + ''', null ), 0 ) rate,
										isnull( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) qty,
										a.act_event,
										a.act_act,
										cast(p.par_sqlidentity as nvarchar(38)) recid									 
								from   r5parts p,
                    				   r5matlparts m,
                    				   r5activities a,
                    				   r5ububat u, 
									   r5mrcs       c RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5events e ON e.evt_mrc = c.mrc_code
									                  LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects o ON o.obj_code = e.evt_object 
									                    				   and o.obj_org = e.evt_object_org 
								where  a.act_event       = e.evt_code 
								and    p.par_code          = m.mlp_part 
								and    p.par_org           = m.mlp_part_org 
								and    m.mlp_direct        = N''-'' 
								and    a.act_matlist       = m.mlp_matlist 
								and    a.act_matlrev       = m.mlp_matlrev 
								and    p.par_tool is null 
								and    dbo.o7checkmatch( m.mlp_equipfilter, o.obj_checklistfilter ) = N''+'' 
								and    CASE when m.mlp_code is null THEN isnull( m.mlp_obrtype, N'' '')
													when m.mlp_code = o.obj_category THEN N''C''
													when m.mlp_code = e.evt_object THEN e.evt_obrtype END = isnull( m.mlp_obrtype, N'' '')
								and   u.bub_event = e.evt_code
								and   u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N''' 
								and   u.bub_rstatus <> N''B''
								and   a.act_start >= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101)
								and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101)
								group by c.mrc_store,
										m.mlp_part,
										m.mlp_part_org,
										e.evt_org,
										m.mlp_qty,
										a.act_event,
										a.act_act,
										p.par_sqlidentity '
			return
		end
	else
		begin
			/* Set dates in character format. */
    		/* Set from statement */
   			IF    @sSource = N'BUD'
        		set @sFromstat = N' r5parts p,
                    			   r5matlparts m,
                    			   r5activities a,
                    			   r5ububat u, 
								   r5mrcs       c RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5events e ON e.evt_mrc = c.mrc_code
								                  LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects o ON o.obj_code = e.evt_object 
                    			                                        and o.obj_org = e.evt_object_org '
   			ELSE
      			set @sFromstat = N' r5parts p,
						r5matlparts  m,
						r5activities a,
					    r5mrcs       c RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5events e ON e.evt_mrc = c.mrc_code
						               LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects o ON o.obj_code = e.evt_object 
						                                     and o.obj_org = e.evt_object_org '

   			/* Set select statement it self */
   			set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = round( isnull( sum( isnull( dbo.O7GETPRC( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part,
							m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org, N''B'', @sPriceLevel, null ), 0 ) *
											 isnull( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) ), 0), 2) 
							' + @sExtracol + N'
					 from   ' + @sFromstat +
				   N' where  a.act_event       = e.evt_code 
					and    p.par_code          = m.mlp_part 
					and    p.par_org           = m.mlp_part_org 
					and    m.mlp_direct        = N''-'' 
					and    a.act_matlist       = m.mlp_matlist 
					and    a.act_matlrev       = m.mlp_matlrev 
					and    p.par_tool is null 
					and    dbo.o7checkmatch( m.mlp_equipfilter, o.obj_checklistfilter ) = N''+'' 
					and    CASE when m.mlp_code is null THEN isnull( m.mlp_obrtype, N'' '')
										when m.mlp_code = o.obj_category THEN N''C''
										when m.mlp_code = e.evt_object THEN e.evt_obrtype END = isnull( m.mlp_obrtype, N'' '') '
			/* Set additional and clause for events */
			set @sEvtclause = N' and   a.act_event = @sEvent and evt_routeparent IS NULL '

			/* Set additional and clause for projects */
			set @sPrjclause = N' and  a.act_project in
							 ( select prj_code from dbo.O7ESTXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'
			/* Set additional and clause for budgets */
			set @sBudclause = N' and   u.bub_event = e.evt_code
						  and   u.bub_code  = @sCode
						  and   u.bub_rstatus <> N''B''
						  and   a.act_start >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101)
						  and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101) '

			/* Set actual and clause, depending on variable  @sSource  */
			if @sSource = N'EVT' 
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			else
				begin
					if  @sSource = N'PRJ' 
						set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
					else
						begin
								if  @sSource = N'BUD' 
									set @sAndclause = @sBudclause
								else
									set @sAndclause = N''
						end
				end
    
			set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause

            if @sSource in ( N'EVT', N'EVT2')
                begin
                    set @nCost = 0
                    declare c_estmat_evt cursor local for select evt_code, evt_routeparent from dbo.O7ESTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) where ( evt_routeparent IS NULL OR evt_code = @sCode )
                    open c_estmat_evt
                    fetch next from c_estmat_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            if @sRouteParent is not null
                                set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( dbo.o7sesmat( @sRouteParent, @sEvent, @sPriceLevel ), 0 )
                            
			                EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sPriceLevel nvarchar(200), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											                @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sPriceLevel, @sEvent
			                if @@ERROR <> 0 
                                begin 
                                    close c_estmat_evt
                                    deallocate c_estmat_evt
				                    return -1
                                end

                            set @nCost = @

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ESTMATPPM	
	@sSource		nvarchar(8),
	@sCode			nvarchar(30),
	@sClass			nvarchar(80),
	@dDatefrom		datetime,
	@dDateto		datetime,
	@nCost			numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
	@sStatement		nvarchar(4000)		OUTPUT 
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)		
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(200)		
	declare @sSelclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sBudclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(200)		
	declare @nOrddma		numeric(30,6)		
	declare @sExtracol		nvarchar(800)			
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sPriceLevel    nvarchar(200)
	declare @nRate			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRecid			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''
	SET @sPriceLevel = N'P'

	SELECT @sPriceLevel = ISNULL(ins_desc, N'P')
	FROM r5install
	WHERE ins_code = N'PRICELEV'
	
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

	/* NOTE: BAN is a special case and its functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
		    set @sStatement = N'SELECT ROUND( isnull( SUM( isnull( dbo.o7getprc( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part,
											    m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org, N''B'', N''' + @sPriceLevel + N''', null ), 0 ) *
											    isnull( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) ), 0 ), 2) costs,
									    isnull( dbo.o7getprc( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org, 
													    e.evt_org, N''B'', N''' + @sPriceLevel + N''', null ), 0 ) rate,
									    ROUND( SUM( isnull( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) ), 2) qty, 
									    f.fut_event act_event, 
									    a.ppa_act act_act, 
									    cast(p.par_sqlidentity as nvarchar(38)) + N''#'' + convert( nvarchar(10), f.fut_date, 101 ) recid
						       FROM   r5parts p,
								      r5matlparts m,
								      r5ppmacts a,
                                      r5ppms s,
								      r5matlists l,
								      r5futureevents f,
								      r5ububat u,
								      r5events e LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects o ON ( o.obj_code      = e.evt_object
																	       AND    o.obj_org       = e.evt_object_org )
                                                 LEFT OUTER JOIN r5mrcs c ON e.evt_mrc = c.mrc_code
						       WHERE  a.ppa_ppm           = e.evt_ppm
						       AND    p.par_code          = m.mlp_part
						       AND    p.par_org           = m.mlp_part_org
						       AND    m.mlp_direct        = N''' + @sClass + N''' 
						       AND    a.ppa_matlist       = m.mlp_matlist
						       AND    l.mtl_code          = m.mlp_matlist
						       AND    l.mtl_revision      = m.mlp_matlrev
						       AND    l.mtl_revrstatus    = N''A''
						       AND    u.bub_event         = f.fut_event
						       AND    u.bub_code          = N''' + @sCode + N'''
                               AND    u.bub_ppm           = s.ppm_code
                               AND    s.ppm_revrstatus    = N''A''
                               AND    s.ppm_code          = a.ppa_ppm
                               AND    s.ppm_revision      = a.ppa_revision
						       AND    u.bub_event         = e.evt_code
						       AND    f.fut_seqno         > 1
						       AND    p.par_tool is null
						       AND    f.fut_date + a.ppa_start - 1 >= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101)
						       AND    f.fut_date + a.ppa_start - 1 <= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101)
						       AND    CASE WHEN m.mlp_code is null THEN isnull( m.mlp_obrtype,'' '')
										    WHEN m.mlp_code = o.obj_category THEN N''C''
										      WHEN m.mlp_code = e.evt_object THEN e.evt_obrtype END =
										      isnull( m.mlp_obrtype,'' '')
						       AND    u.bub_event = e.evt_code
						    group by c.mrc_store,
								     m.mlp_part,
								     m.mlp_part_org, 
								     e.evt_org, 
								     f.fut_event, 
								     a.ppa_act, 
								     cast(p.par_sqlidentity as nvarchar(38)) + N''#'' + convert( nvarchar(10), f.fut_date, 101 ) '
			return
		end
	else
		SELECT @nCost = ROUND( isnull( SUM( isnull( dbo.o7getprc( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part,
							m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org, N'B', @sPriceLevel, null ), 0 ) *
							isnull( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) ), 0 ), 2) 
		   FROM   r5parts p,
				  r5matlparts m,
				  r5ppmacts a,
                  r5ppms s,
				  r5matlists l,
				  r5futureevents f,
				  r5ububat u,
				  r5events e LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects o ON ( o.obj_code      = e.evt_object
													   AND    o.obj_org       = e.evt_object_org )
                             LEFT OUTER JOIN r5mrcs c ON e.evt_mrc = c.mrc_code
		   WHERE  a.ppa_ppm           = e.evt_ppm
		   AND    p.par_code          = m.mlp_part
		   AND    p.par_org           = m.mlp_part_org
		   AND    m.mlp_direct        = @sClass 
		   AND    a.ppa_matlist       = m.mlp_matlist
		   AND    l.mtl_code          = m.mlp_matlist
		   AND    l.mtl_revision      = m.mlp_matlrev
		   AND    l.mtl_revrstatus    = N'A'
		   AND    u.bub_event         = f.fut_event
		   AND    u.bub_code          = @sCode
           AND    u.bub_ppm           = s.ppm_code
           AND    s.ppm_revrstatus    = N'A'
           AND    s.ppm_code          = a.ppa_ppm
           AND    s.ppm_revision      = a.ppa_revision
		   AND    u.bub_event         = e.evt_code
		   AND    f.fut_seqno         > 1
		   AND    p.par_tool is null
		   AND    f.fut_date + a.ppa_start - 1 >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101)
		   AND    f.fut_date + a.ppa_start - 1 <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101)
		   AND    CASE WHEN m.mlp_code is null THEN isnull( m.mlp_obrtype,' ')
						WHEN m.mlp_code = o.obj_category THEN N'C'
						  WHEN m.mlp_code = e.evt_object THEN e.evt_obrtype END =
						  isnull( m.mlp_obrtype,' ')
		   AND    u.bub_event = e.evt_code

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ESTTOOL	
			@sSource		nvarchar(8),
			@sCode			nvarchar(30),
			@sClass			nvarchar(80),
			@dDatefrom		datetime,
			@dDateto		datetime,
			@nCost			numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
			@sStatement		nvarchar(4000)		OUTPUT 
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)		
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(200)		
	declare @sSelclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sBudclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(200)		
	declare @nOrddma		numeric(30,6)		
	declare @sExtracol		nvarchar(800)			
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @nRate			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRecid			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRouteParent   nvarchar(30)
    declare @nTempCost      numeric(30,6)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''
	
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

	/* NOTE: BAN is a special case and its functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'select round( sum( isnull( t.tor_qty, 0 ) *	
												isnull( t.tor_hours, 0 ) * m.mrt_tariff ) ,2) costs,
										isnull( m.mrt_tariff, 0 ) rate,
                        				ROUND( SUM( isnull( t.tor_hours, 0 ) * isnull( t.tor_qty, 0 ) ), 2 ) qty,
                        				a.act_event act_event,
                        				a.act_act act_act,
                       					cast(t.tor_sqlidentity as nvarchar(38)) recid                				  
								from   r5toolreq t, r5activities a, r5mrctools m, r5ububat u, r5events e 
								where  a.act_event = t.tor_event
								and    a.act_act = t.tor_act
								and    m.mrt_mrc = t.tor_mrc
								and    m.mrt_tool = t.tor_tool
								and    m.mrt_org  = e.evt_org
								and    a.act_event = e.evt_code 
								and    u.bub_event = a.act_event
								and    u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N'''
								and    u.bub_rstatus <> N''B''
								and    a.act_start + a.act_duration >= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101)
								and    a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) 
								group by m.mrt_tariff,
                                		 a.act_event,
                                		 a.act_act,
                                		 t.tor_sqlidentity '
			return
		end
	else
		begin
			if @sSource = N'BUD' or @sSource = N'BUD2'
				set @sFromstat = N'r5toolreq t, r5activities a, r5mrctools m, r5ububat u, r5events e '
			else
				set @sFromstat = N'r5toolreq t, r5activities a, r5mrctools m, r5events e '

			set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = round( sum( isnull( t.tor_qty, 0 ) *
											isnull( t.tor_hours, 0 ) *
							   m.mrt_tariff ) ,2) ' + @sExtracol +
               				  N' from  ' + @sFromstat +
							  N' where  a.act_event = t.tor_event
                 			  and    a.act_act = t.tor_act
                 			  and    m.mrt_mrc = t.tor_mrc
                 			  and    m.mrt_tool = t.tor_tool
                 			  and    m.mrt_org  = e.evt_org
                 			  and    a.act_event = e.evt_code '

			set @sEvtclause = N' and   a.act_event = @sEvent and evt_routeparent IS NULL '

			set @sPrjclause = N'and a.act_projbud like  isnull( @sClass, ''%'' )
								   and a.act_project in
								   ( select prj_code from dbo.O7ESTXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'

			set @sBudclause = N' and   u.bub_event = a.act_event
								and   u.bub_code  = @sCode 
								and   u.bub_rstatus <> ''B''
								and   t.tor_required >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101)
								and   t.tor_required <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101) '

			if @sSource = N'EVT' 
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			else
				begin
					if  @sSource = N'PRJ' 
						set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
					else
						begin
							if  @sSource = N'BUD' 
								set @sAndclause = @sBudclause
							else
								begin
									if @sSource = N'BUD2' 
										set @sAndclause = @sBudclause + N' and e.evt_rstatus <> N''C'' '
									else
										set @sAndclause = N''
								end
						end
				end

			set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause

            if @sSource in ( N'EVT', N'EVT2')
                begin
                    set @nCost = 0
                    declare c_esttool_evt cursor local for select evt_code, evt_routeparent from dbo.O7ESTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) where ( evt_routeparent IS NULL OR evt_code = @sCode )
                    open c_esttool_evt
                    fetch next from c_esttool_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            if @sRouteParent is not null
                                set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( dbo.o7sestl( @sRouteParent, @sEvent ), 0 )
                            
			                EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											                @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			                if @@ERROR <> 0 
                                begin 
                                    close c_esttool_evt
                                    deallocate c_esttool_evt
				                    return -1
                                end

                            set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

                            fetch next from c_esttool_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                        end
                    close c_esttool_evt
                    deallocate c_esttool_evt
                end
            else
                begin
			        EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											        @nCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			        if @@ERROR <> 0 
				        return -1
                end
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ESTTOOLPPM 
				@sSource    nvarchar(8),
				@sCode      nvarchar(30),
				@dDatefrom  datetime,
				@dDateto    datetime,
				@nCost      numeric(30,6) OUTPUT,
				@sStatement nvarchar(4000)  OUTPUT 
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sExtracol  nvarchar(800)  
	declare @sSelclause nvarchar(3000) 
	declare @sCharfrom  nvarchar(10)  
	declare @sCharto    nvarchar(10)  
	declare @sGroupby   nvarchar(200)  
	declare @nRate		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRecid		nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct		numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent		nvarchar(30)
	declare @nQty		numeric(24,6)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

	/* NOTE: BAN is a special case and its functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN' 
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'SELECT ROUND( SUM( coalesce( t.ppt_hours, 0 ) *	coalesce( t.ppt_qty, 0 ) *
													coalesce( m.mrt_tariff, 0 ) ), 2 ) costs,
										coalesce( m.mrt_tariff, 0 ) rate,
										ROUND( SUM( coalesce( t.ppt_hours, 0 ) * coalesce( t.ppt_qty, 0 ) ), 2 ) qty,
										f.fut_event act_event,
										p.ppa_act act_act,
										N''PPM''+ CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), f.fut_date ,101) recid								
								FROM   r5futureevents f,
										r5ppmacts p,
										r5activities a,
										r5ppms s,
										r5ppmtools t,
										r5mrctools m,
										r5events e,
										r5ububat u
								WHERE  f.fut_event      = a.act_event
									AND    a.act_act        = p.ppa_act
									AND    p.ppa_act        = t.ppt_act
									AND    m.mrt_tool       = t.ppt_tool
									AND    m.mrt_mrc        = a.act_mrc
									AND    m.mrt_org        = e.evt_org
									AND    a.act_event      = e.evt_code
									AND    f.fut_seqno      > 1
									AND    u.bub_event      = f.fut_event
									AND    u.bub_code       = N''' + @sCode + N''' 
									AND    u.bub_ppm        = p.ppa_ppm
									AND    u.bub_ppm        = t.ppt_ppm
									AND    s.ppm_revision   = t.ppt_revision
									AND    s.ppm_code       = u.bub_ppm
									AND    s.ppm_revrstatus = N''A''
									AND    s.ppm_revision   = p.ppa_revision
									AND    f.fut_date >= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101)
									AND    f.fut_date <= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101)
								group by m.mrt_tariff,
										f.fut_event,
										p.ppa_act,
										N''PPM''+ CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), f.fut_date ,101) '
			return
		end
	else
		SELECT @nCost = ROUND( SUM( coalesce( t.ppt_hours, 0 ) * coalesce( t.ppt_qty, 0 ) *
									coalesce( m.mrt_tariff, 0 ) ), 2 ) 
		FROM   r5futureevents f,
				r5ppmacts p,
				r5activities a,
				r5ppms s,
				r5ppmtools t,
				r5mrctools m,
				r5events e,
				r5ububat u
		WHERE  f.fut_event      = a.act_event
			AND    a.act_act        = p.ppa_act
			AND    p.ppa_act        = t.ppt_act
			AND    m.mrt_tool       = t.ppt_tool
			AND    m.mrt_mrc        = a.act_mrc
			AND    m.mrt_org        = e.evt_org
			AND    a.act_event      = e.evt_code
			AND    f.fut_seqno      > 1
			AND    u.bub_event      = f.fut_event
			AND    u.bub_code       = @sCode
			AND    u.bub_ppm        = p.ppa_ppm
			AND    u.bub_ppm        = t.ppt_ppm
			AND    s.ppm_revision   = t.ppt_revision
			AND    s.ppm_code       = u.bub_ppm
			AND    s.ppm_revrstatus = N'A'
			AND    s.ppm_revision   = p.ppa_revision
			AND    f.fut_date >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101)
			AND    f.fut_date <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101)

create function O7ESTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY (@sCode nvarchar(30))
returns @tReturn table( evt_code nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
                        evt_routeparent nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sParent    	nvarchar(30)
		
	declare @tStack table ( evt_code nvarchar(30), 
                            evt_routeparent nvarchar(30),
                            LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select evt_code, evt_routeparent, 1 from r5events where evt_code = @sCode
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = evt_code, @sParent = evt_routeparent from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode, @sParent )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND evt_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select evt_code, evt_routeparent, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5events
										 where evt_parent = @sCurrentCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create procedure O7EVTPRV
   @sEvent    nvarchar(30)


AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCount				int
	declare @sAgreement 		nvarchar(40)--R5propertyvalues.prv_value%TYPE;
	declare @sProperty 			nvarchar(8)--R5propertyvalues.prv_property%TYPE;
	declare @sClass 			nvarchar(8)--r5addproperties.apr_class%TYPE;
	declare @sClsorg 			nvarchar(8)--r5addproperties.apr_class_org%TYPE;
	declare @nDummy 			int
	declare @nLine 				int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(15)--r5organization.org_code%TYPE := o7dflt('DEFORG', @sChk);
	declare @nReturn			int


/* Initialize */
	set @sChk = NULL

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	/* Check mandatory parameter */
	if @sEvent IS NULL 
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7EVTPRV', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		end

	/* Check if customer attribute has been set up */
		select @nCount = count(*) 
		FROM   r5addproperties, r5events
		WHERE  evt_code      = @sEvent
		AND    apr_property  = N'_EC_AGR'
		AND    apr_rentity   = N'EVNT'
		AND    apr_class IN (N'*', evt_class)
		AND    apr_class_org = COALESCE(evt_class_org, @sDeforg);


		if @nCount = 1 
			SELECT @sProperty = apr_property, @sClass = apr_class, @sClsorg = apr_class_org, @nLine = apr_line
			FROM   r5addproperties, r5events
			WHERE  evt_code      = @sEvent
			AND    apr_property  = '_EC_AGR'
			AND    apr_rentity   = 'EVNT'
			AND    apr_class IN ('*', evt_class)
			AND    apr_class_org = COALESCE(evt_class_org, @sDeforg);
		else
			return   
   
	DELETE r5propertyvalues
	WHERE  prv_property = @sProperty
	AND    prv_rentity = 'EVNT'
	AND    prv_code = @sEvent;


	/* Get agreement */
	execute @nReturn = o7getagr @sEvent, @sAgreement OUTPUT, @nDummy OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	/* If found, insert as property value */
	IF @sAgreement IS NOT NULL 
		INSERT INTO r5propertyvalues (
			prv_property,
			prv_rentity   ,
			prv_class     ,
			prv_class_org ,
			prv_code      ,
			prv_seqno     ,
			prv_value   )
		VALUES (
			@sProperty,
			'EVNT',
			@sClass,
			@sClsorg,
			@sEvent,
			@nLine,
			@sAgreement)

CREATE PROCEDURE O7EXISTB 
   @sRentity			nvarchar(4),
   @sEnttype			nvarchar(4),
   @sEntcode			nvarchar(8),
   @sOrgcode			nvarchar(15),
   @sPar1				nvarchar(30),
   @sPar2				nvarchar(30),
   @sPar3				nvarchar(30),
   @sPar4				nvarchar(30),
   @sPar5				nvarchar(30),
   @nCountit			integer		OUTPUT,
   @sChk				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT  
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	set @sChk     = N'0'
	set @nCountit = -1

	IF @sRentity IS NULL
	OR @sEnttype IS NULL
	OR @sEntcode IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
	FROM   r5entities    e
	WHERE  e.ent_rentity = @sRentity
	IF @nCountit = 0 
		begin
			set @nCountit = -1
			set @sChk     = N'2'
			return
		end

	set @nCountit = -1
	IF @sRentity = N'ENT' 
		begin
			IF @sPar1 = N'UCOD' 
				SELECT @nCountit =COUNT( * )
				FROM   r5ucodes      u
				WHERE  u.uco_entity  = @sEnttype
				AND    u.uco_code    = @sEntcode
				AND    u.uco_rcode   = @sPar2
				AND    u.uco_system  = @sPar3
			else
				begin
					set @sChk     = N'3'
					set @nCountit = -1
					return
				end
		end
	else
		begin
			IF @sRentity = N'PROM' 
				begin
					SELECT @nCountit =COUNT( * )
					FROM   r5propertyvalues p
					WHERE  p.prv_property   = @sEntcode
					If @nCountit > 1
						set @nCountit = 1
					
				end
			else
				begin
					IF @sRentity = N'CLAS' 
						begin
							SELECT @nCountit =COUNT( * )
							FROM   r5addproperties
							WHERE  apr_class     = @sEntcode
							AND    apr_class_org = @sOrgcode
							AND    apr_rentity   = @sPar1
							If @nCountit > 1
								set @nCountit = 1
						end
					else
						begin
							IF @sRentity = N'EVNT' 
								begin
									SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
									FROM   r5install
									WHERE  ins_code = N'JTAUTH'
									AND    UPPER( ins_desc ) NOT IN ( N'YES', N'+' )
									IF @nCountit > 0 
										return

									SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
									FROM   r5jobtypeauth
									WHERE  jta_jobtype = @sEnttype
									AND  ( jta_group   = @sEntcode OR jta_group = N'*' )
									AND    jta_insert LIKE @sPar1
									AND    jta_update LIKE @sPar2
									AND    jta_delete LIKE @sPar3
								end
							else
								begin
								/* Unknown entity */
									set @sChk     = N'2'
									set @nCountit = -1
									return
								end
						end
				end
		end
end

create PROCEDURE O7EXISTC
   @sRentity        nvarchar(4),
   @sEnttype        nvarchar(1),
   @sEntcode        nvarchar(30),
   @sPar1           nvarchar(30),
   @sPar2           nvarchar(30),
   @sPar3           nvarchar(30),
   @sPar4           nvarchar(30),
   @sPar5           nvarchar(30),
   @sPar6           nvarchar(30),
   @nCountit        int OUTPUT,
   @sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
/* Initialize */
   set @sChk     = N'0'
   set @nCountit = -1

/* Check mandatory parameters */
	IF @sRentity IS NULL OR @sEnttype IS NULL OR @sEntcode IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

/* C03413  Not linked to contract     */
	IF @sRentity = N'CLAU' 
		begin
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5addetails   a
			WHERE  a.add_rentity = @sEnttype
			AND    a.add_code    = @sEntcode
			if @nCountit > 1 
				set @nCountit = 1
		end
	else
		begin
			IF @sRentity = N'CONT' 
				begin
					/* C13224 Contract rstatus = N'U' */
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
					FROM   r5contracts   c
					WHERE  c.con_code    = @sEntcode
					AND    c.con_rstatus = @sPar1
					
					if @nCountit > 1 
						set @nCountit = 1
				end
			else
				begin
					IF @sRentity = N'CPA' 
						begin
							IF @sEnttype = N'1' 
								begin
									SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
									FROM	r5contracts   c,
											r5contracts   c2,
											r5conparts    p
									WHERE  p.cpa_contract     = c.con_code
									AND    p.cpa_supplier     = @sPar2
									AND    p.cpa_supplier_org = @sPar5
									AND    p.cpa_part         = @sPar1
									AND    p.cpa_part_org     = @sPar4
									AND    p.cpa_contract    <> @sEntcode
									AND    c2.con_code        = @sEntcode
									AND    c2.con_org         = c.con_org
									AND    c.con_rstatus      = N'A'
									AND    ( c.con_start BETWEEN cast( @sPar3 as datetime ) AND cast( @sPar6 as datetime )
											OR cast( @sPar3 as datetime )  BETWEEN c.con_start AND c.con_end )

									if @nCountit > 1 
										set @nCountit = 1
								end
						end
					ELSE
						begin
							/* Unknown entity */
							set @sChk     = N'2'
							set @nCountit = -1
							RETURN
						end
				end
	   end

create PROCEDURE O7EXISTJ 
   @sRentity        nvarchar(4),
   @sEnttype        nvarchar(20),
   @sEntcode        nvarchar(20),
   @sPar1           nvarchar(20),
   @sPar2           nvarchar(20),
   @sPar3           nvarchar(20),
   @sPar4           nvarchar(20),
   @sPar5           nvarchar(20),
   @nCountit        int OUTPUT,
   @sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
declare @nReturn	int

BEGIN
	set @sChk     = N'0'
	set @nCountit = -1

	IF @sRentity IS NULL
	OR @sEnttype IS NULL
	OR @sEntcode IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
	FROM   r5entities r
	WHERE  r.ent_rentity = @sRentity

	IF @nCountit < 1 
		begin
			set @nCountit = -1
			set @sChk     = N'2'
			RETURN
		end


   set @nCountit = -1

	IF @sRentity = N'EVNT' 
		begin
			IF @sPar1 = N'PROJ' 
			begin
				SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
				FROM   r5events e
				WHERE  e.evt_project  = @sEntcode
				AND    e.evt_rstatus <> @sPar2

				If @nCountit > 1 
					set @nCountit = 1

				RETURN
			end
		end
	ELSE
		begin
			IF @sRentity = N'PROJ' 
				begin
					IF @sPar1 = N'PRST' 
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7EXISTJ2 @sRentity,@sEnttype,@sEntcode,@sPar1,@sPar2,@sPar3,@sPar4,@sPar5,@nCountit OUTPUT,@sChk OUTPUT 
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1
						end
					ELSE
						begin
							IF @sPar1 = N'POST' 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = O7EXISTJ2 @sRentity,@sEnttype,@sEntcode,@sPar1,@sPar2,@sPar3,@sPar4,@sPar5,@nCountit OUTPUT,@sChk OUTPUT 
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										return -1
								end
							ELSE
								begin
									IF  @sPar1 = N'ORDL' 
										begin
											SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
											FROM   r5orderlines  o
											WHERE  o.orl_project = @sEntcode
											AND    o.orl_active  = @sPar2
										
											If @nCountit > 1 
												set @nCountit = 1
										end
								end
						end
				
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					set @sChk     = N'2'
					set @nCountit = -1
					RETURN
				end

	end
end

create function O7EXISTJ2_GET_HIERARCHY_1 (	@sCode	nvarchar(20))
returns @tReturn table( prj_code	nvarchar(20)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						prj_rstatus	nvarchar(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sRStatus	nvarchar(4)
		
	declare @tStack table ( prj_code		nvarchar(20), 
							prj_rstatus		nvarchar(4), 
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	prj_code, 
				prj_rstatus,
				1 
		  from	r5projects
		 where	prj_parent		= @sCode	

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= prj_code,
							@sRStatus	= prj_rstatus
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @sRStatus )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND prj_code = @sCode 
					insert into @tStack	select	prj_code, 
												prj_rstatus,
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5projects
										 where	prj_parent		= @sCode	
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create procedure O7EXISTO	@sCrentity       nvarchar(4),
							@sCenttype       nvarchar(4),
							@sCentcode       nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar1          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar2          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar3          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar4          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar5          nvarchar(40),
							@nCountit        int OUTPUT,
							@sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

  
as

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nContinue int
	declare @sPar2  nvarchar(30) -- r5objects.obj_code%TYPE;
	declare @sOrg  nvarchar(15) -- r5organization.org_code%TYPE;

	/* Initialize */
	SET @sChk      =  N'0'
	SET @nCountit  =  -1
	SET @nContinue = 1

  /*init Cpar params in case they are empty strings*/
  if @sCpar1 = N'' set @sCpar1 = null
  if @sCpar2 = N'' set @sCpar2 = null
  if @sCpar3 = N'' set @sCpar3 = null
  if @sCpar4 = N'' set @sCpar4 = null
  if @sCpar5 = N'' set @sCpar5 = null

	/* Check mandatory parameters */
	IF @sCrentity IS NULL OR @sCenttype IS NULL OR @sCentcode IS NULL
		BEGIN
			SET @sChk  =  N'1'
			SET @nContinue = 0
			RETURN
		END


	SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
	FROM   r5entities    r
	WHERE  r.ent_rentity = @sCrentity

	If @nCountit < 1 
		BEGIN
			Set @nCountit = -1
			SET @sChk  =  N'2'
			SET @nContinue = 0
			RETURN
		END

	Set @nCountit = -1
	/* PERM tests ------------------------------------------------------ */
	/* A0321M Check if Object has any parents                            */
	/*        Check if the given parent-child exists                     */
	IF @sCrentity = N'STC' 
		begin
			IF @sCpar1 is NULL OR @sCpar2 is NULL 		
				begin
					SET @nCountit = -1
					SET @sChk  =  N'1'
					SET @nContinue = 0
					RETURN
				end 
			else
				begin 
					SET @sOrg  = SUBSTRING( @sCpar2, charindex( N'#', @sCpar2) +1 , len(@sCpar2))
					SET @sPar2 = SUBSTRING( @sCpar2, 1, charindex( N'#', @sCpar2) -1 )
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
					FROM   r5structures     s
					WHERE  s.stc_childtype  = @sCpar1
					AND    s.stc_child      = @sPar2
					AND    s.stc_child_org  = @sOrg
					AND    s.stc_parenttype = CASE WHEN @sCpar3 IS NULL THEN s.stc_parenttype ELSE @sCpar3 END
					AND    s.stc_parentrtype <> N'L'
					AND    s.stc_parent     = CASE WHEN @sCpar4 IS NULL THEN s.stc_parent ELSE @sCpar4 END
					AND    s.stc_parent_org = CASE WHEN @sCpar5 IS NULL THEN s.stc_parent_org ELSE @sCpar5 END

					SET @nContinue = 0
					If @nCountit > 1 
						Set @nCountit = 1
					RETURN
				end 
		end 

	IF @sCrentity = N'STWO' 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5objects     o
			WHERE  o.obj_obtype    = @sCpar1
			AND    o.obj_code      = @sCpar2
			AND    o.obj_org       = @sCpar3
			AND    o.obj_class     = @sCpar4
			AND    o.obj_class_org = @sCpar5
			SET @nContinue = 0
			RETURN
		END

	IF @sCrentity = N'OBJ' 
		BEGIN
			IF @sCpar1 = N'TYPE'
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
					FROM   r5objects o
					WHERE  o.obj_code               = @sCentcode
					AND    COALESCE( o.obj_obtype, N' ' ) = COALESCE( @sCenttype, N' ' )
					AND    o.obj_org                = @sCpar2
					SET @nContinue = 0
					RETURN
				END 
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
					FROM   r5objects     o
					WHERE  o.obj_obtype  = @sCpar2
					AND    o.obj_code    = @sCpar1
					AND    o.obj_org     = @sCpar4
					AND    o.obj_rstatus LIKE COALESCE( @sCpar3, N'%' )
					SET @nContinue = 0
					RETURN
				END
		END

	IF @sCrentity = N'PORD' 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5objects     o
			WHERE  o.obj_obtype  = @sCpar2
			AND    o.obj_code    = @sCpar1
			AND    o.obj_org     = @sCpar3
			AND EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
					  FROM   r5orderlines l
					  WHERE  l.orl_order     = o.obj_order
					  AND    l.orl_order_org = o.obj_order_org
					  AND    l.orl_ordline   = o.obj_orderline
					  AND    l.orl_rstatus NOT IN ( N'C', N'R' ) )

			SET @nContinue = 0
			RETURN
		END


	IF @nContinue = 1 
		BEGIN
			/* Unknown entity */
			SET @sChk      =  N'2'
			SET @nCountit  =  -1
		END

name: O7EXISTP
body:
create procedure O7EXISTP	@sCrentity       nvarchar(4),
							@sCenttype       nvarchar(4),
							@sCentcode       nvarchar(255),
							@sCpar1          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar2          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar3          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar4          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar5          nvarchar(40),
							@nCountit        int OUTPUT,
							@sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

  
as

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nContinue int
	/* Initialize */
	SET @sChk      =  N'0'
	SET @nCountit  =  -1
	SET @nContinue = 0
	/* Check mandatory parameters */
	IF @sCrentity IS NULL OR @sCenttype IS NULL 
		BEGIN
			SET @sChk  =  N'1'
			RETURN
		END


	IF  @sCrentity = N'ORD' AND @sCenttype = N'1' 

	/* P076281 existence of orderlines for an order */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5orderlines o
			WHERE  o.orl_order     = @sCentcode
			AND    o.orl_order_org = @sCpar1

			If @nCountit > 1 
				Set @nCountit = 1

			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN
		END
	IF @sCrentity = N'ORD' AND   @sCenttype = N'2' 
	/* P07627 order should not be partially received */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5orderlines o
			WHERE  o.orl_order     = @sCentcode
			AND    o.orl_order_org = @sCpar1
			AND  ( COALESCE( o.orl_recvqty, 0 )   > 0 OR
				COALESCE( o.orl_scrapqty, 0 )  > 0 OR
				COALESCE( o.orl_recvvalue, 0 ) > 0 )

			If @nCountit > 1 
				Set @nCountit = 1

			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN
		END



	IF @sCrentity = N'ORD' AND   @sCenttype = N'3' 
	/* P076282 non existence of order lines ref to project with rstatus <= N'C' */
		BEGIN
				SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
				FROM   r5orderlines o,
					r5projects   p
				WHERE  o.orl_order     = @sCentcode
				AND    o.orl_order_org = @sCpar2
				AND    p.prj_code      = o.orl_project
				AND    p.prj_rstatus  <= @sCpar1
				AND    o.orl_active    = N'+'


				If @nCountit > 1 
					Set @nCountit = 1

				SET @nContinue = 1
				RETURN
		END


	IF @sCrentity = N'ORD' AND   @sCenttype = N'4' 
		/* P076282 non existence of order lines ref to events with rstatus <= N'C' */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5orderlines o,
				r5events     e
			WHERE  o.orl_order     = @sCentcode
			AND    o.orl_order_org = @sCpar2
			AND    e.evt_code      = o.orl_event
			AND    o.orl_active    = N'+'
			AND    e.evt_rstatus  <= @sCpar1
			RETURN

			If @nCountit > 1 
				Set @nCountit = 1

			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN

		END


	IF @sCrentity = N'ORD' AND   @sCenttype = N'5' 
		/*  P0762B order should not be partially received */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5activities a
			WHERE  a.act_order     = @sCentcode
			AND    a.act_order_org = @sCpar1
			AND    COALESCE( a.act_nt, 0 ) > 0

			If @nCountit > 1 
				Set @nCountit = 1

			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN
		END


	IF @sCrentity = N'ORD' AND   @sCenttype = N'6' 
		/* P076282 non existence of order lines ref to events with rstatus <= N'C' if req is null*/
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5orderlines o,
				r5events     e
			WHERE  o.orl_order     = @sCentcode
			AND    o.orl_order_org = @sCpar2
			AND    e.evt_code      = o.orl_event
			AND    o.orl_req IS NULL
			AND    o.orl_active    = N'+'
			AND    e.evt_rstatus  <= @sCpar1

			If @nCountit > 1 
				Set @nCountit = 1

			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN
		END

	IF @sCrentity = N'ORL' AND   @sCenttype = N'1' 
		/* P09621 order status should be N'U' */
			BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5orders o
			WHERE  o.ord_code    = @sCentcode
			AND    o.ord_org     = @sCpar1
			AND    o.ord_rstatus = N'U'

			If @nCountit > 1 
				Set @nCountit = 1

			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN

		END
	IF @sCrentity = N'INV' AND   @sCenttype = N'1' 
		/* P03424 Discounts are calculated (r5orders, r5orderlines) */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5invoicelines i,
				r5orders       o
			WHERE  i.ivl_invoice     = @sCentcode
			AND    i.ivl_invoice_org = @sCpar1
			AND    o.ord_code        = i.ivl_order
			AND    o.ord_org         = i.ivl_order_org
			AND    COALESCE( o.ord_discount, 0 )= 0

			If @nCountit > 1 
				Set @nCountit = 1

			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN
		END

	IF @sCrentity = N'INV'  AND   @sCenttype = N'2' 
	/* P034275 non existence of debit/credit notes with with rstatus <> N'A' */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5invoices i
			WHERE  i.inv_parent = @sCentcode
			AND    i.inv_org    = @sCpar1
			AND    i.inv_rstatus <> N'A'

			If @nCountit > 1 
				Set @nCountit = 1

			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN
		END

	IF @sCrentity = N'INV' AND   @sCenttype = N'3' 
		/* P034276 non existence of parent invoice with rstatus = @sCpar1/@sCpar3 */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5invoices i
			WHERE  i.inv_code = @sCentcode
			AND    i.inv_org  = @sCpar2
			AND    i.inv_rstatus IN ( @sCpar1, @sCpar3 )

			If @nCountit > 1 
				Set @nCountit = 1

			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN
		END

	IF @sCrentity = N'INV' AND   @sCenttype = N'4'  
	/* P034282/P13222/P13321 non existence of Parent invoice with rstatus = @sCpar1 */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5invoices i
			WHERE  i.inv_code    = @sCentcode
			AND    i.inv_org     = @sCpar2
			AND    i.inv_rstatus = @sCpar1

			If @nCountit > 1 
				Set @nCountit = 1

			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN
		END

	IF @sCrentity = N'INV' AND   @sCenttype = N'5'  
		/*  Non existence of D/C invoices with rstatus N'C' */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5invoices i
			WHERE  i.inv_parent = @sCentcode
			AND    i.inv_org    = @sCpar1
			AND    i.inv_rstatus <> N'C'

			If @nCountit > 1 
				Set @nCountit = 1

			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN
		END

		IF @sCrentity = N'INV'  AND   @sCenttype = N'6'  
		/*  Non existence of invoicelines with rstatus N'C' */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5invoicelines i
			WHERE  i.ivl_invoice     = @sCentcode
			AND    i.ivl_invoice_org = @sCpar1
			If @nCountit > 1 
				Set @nCountit = 1

			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN
		END

	IF @sCrentity = N'INV'  AND   @sCenttype = N'7' 
		/* P034275 non existence of debit/credit notes with with rstatus N'A' or N'M' */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5invoices i
			WHERE  i.inv_parent = @sCentcode
			AND    i.inv_org    = @sCpar1
			AND    i.inv_rstatus IN ( N'A', N'M' )

			If @nCountit > 1 
				Set @nCountit = 1

			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN
		END
	IF @sCrentity = N'RCV' AND   @sCenttype = N'1' 
		/* P11122/P11221 receiced value >= total invoiced value */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   DUAL
			WHERE  COALESCE( cast( @sCpar1 as integer ),
					 0 ) >=
				( SELECT COALESCE( SUM( i.ivl_price ),
							  0 )
				  FROM   r5invoicelines i
				  WHERE  i.ivl_order     = @sCpar2
				  AND    i.ivl_order_org = @sCpar4
				  AND    i.ivl_ordline   = cast( @sCpar3 as integer ) )
			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN
		END
	IF (@sCrentity = N'IVL' AND @sCenttype = N'1') OR (@sCrentity = N'CAT') 
		/* P1325/P1335 existence of catalogue record for the invoice lines */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			 FROM   r5catalogue c
			 WHERE  c.cat_supplier     = @sCentcode
			 AND    c.cat_supplier_org = @sCpar2
			 AND    c.cat_part         = @sCpar1
			 AND    c.cat_part_org     = @sCpar3
			If @nCountit > 1 
				Set @nCountit = 1

			SET @nContinue = 1
			RETURN
		END
	IF @sCrentity = N'UOM' 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5uoms u
			WHERE  u.uom_code = @sCentcode
			RETURN
		END
	/*to do - this section */


	IF @sCrentity = N'CLP' AND   @sCenttype = N'1' 
		/* P15113 closing date > existing closing date */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5closedperiods c
			WHERE  dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE ( ca

create PROCEDURE O7EXISTQ
   @sRentity        nvarchar(4),
   @sEnttype        nvarchar(1),
   @sEntcode        nvarchar(30),
   @sPar1           nvarchar(30),
   @sPar2           nvarchar(30),
   @sPar3           nvarchar(30),
   @sPar4           nvarchar(30),
   @sPar5           nvarchar(30),
   @nCountit        int OUTPUT,
   @sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
/* Initialize */
   set @sChk     = N'0'
   set @nCountit = -1

/* Check mandatory parameters */
	IF @sRentity IS NULL  OR @sEnttype IS NULL OR @sEntcode IS NULL OR @sPar1    IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end


	/* Check existance of rentity */
	SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
	FROM   r5entities    r
	WHERE  r.ent_rentity = @sRentity
	IF @nCountit < 1 
		begin
			/* Unknown entity          */
			set @nCountit = -1
			set @sChk     = N'2'
			RETURN
		end

	set @nCountit = -1
   
   
   

IF @sRentity = N'QUOT' 
	begin
		/* Q07511, Q08124, Q08223, Q08411:                        */
		/* Existance of Quotation with rapier status value = N'U'  */
		IF @sPar1 = N'STAT' 
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5quotations  q
			WHERE  q.quo_code    = @sEntcode
			AND    q.quo_seqno   = @sPar2
			AND    q.quo_rstatus = N'U'
		/* Q073141: Existance of Quotation, Sequence number and Part */
		/* in r5quotlines.  @sPar1 = N'PART', @sPar3 = Part code        */
		ELSE
			begin 
				If @sPar1 = N'PART' 
					SELECT   @nCountit = COUNT( * )
					FROM     r5quotlines      q
					WHERE    q.qul_quotation  = @sEntcode
					AND      q.qul_seqno      = @sPar2
					AND      q.qul_part       = @sPar3
					AND      q.qul_part_org   = @sPar4
				/* Q073151, Q08121: Existance of Quotation, Sequence number and Trade */
				/* in r5quotlines.  @sPar1 = N'TRD',  @sPar3 = Trade code                */
				ELSE
					begin
						IF @sPar1 = N'TRD'  
							SELECT   @nCountit = COUNT( * )
							FROM     r5quotlines      q
							WHERE    q.qul_quotation  = @sEntcode
							AND      q.qul_seqno      = @sPar2
							AND      q.qul_trade      = @sPar3
						/* Q056271: Existance of Quotation, Sequence no in r5quotlines */
						/* @sPar1 = N'QUL',                            */
						ELSE
							begin
								if @sPar1 = N'QUL'  
								SELECT   @nCountit = COUNT( * )
								FROM     r5quotlines      q
								WHERE    q.qul_quotation  = @sEntcode
								AND      q.qul_seqno      = @sPar2
							end
					end
			END
	end
ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF @sRentity = N'QUOL' 
			begin
				IF @sPar1 = N'1' 
				/* Check existence of event in quotation lines */
					BEGIN
						SELECT   @nCountit = COUNT( * )
						FROM     r5quotlines      q
						WHERE    q.qul_quotation  = @sEntcode
						AND      q.qul_seqno      = @sPar2
						AND      q.qul_event      = @sPar3
						AND      q.qul_act        = cast( @sPar4 as int)

						If @nCountit > 1 
							set @nCountit = 1
					END
				ELSE
					begin
						IF @sPar1 = N'2' 
							begin
								/* Check existence of additional details */
								SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
								FROM   r5addetails   a
								WHERE  a.add_rentity = N'QUOL'
								AND    a.add_code    = @sEntcode
							
								If @nCountit > 1 
									set @nCountit = 1
							end
					end
			end
		ELSE
			begin
				/* Unknown entity */
				set @sChk     = N'2'
				set @nCountit = -1
			end
	end
