name: O7EXISTS
body:
create procedure O7EXISTS	@sCrentity       nvarchar(4),
							@sCenttype       nvarchar(4),
							@sCentcode       nvarchar(100),
							@sCpar1          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar2          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar3          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar4          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar5          nvarchar(40),
							@nCountit        int OUTPUT,
							@sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT


as

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sVreqdays		nvarchar(200)
	declare @dCloseddate	datetime
	declare @dDate			datetime
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @dCompleted		datetime
	declare @sRstatus		nvarchar(4)

	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sCurrentParent	nvarchar(15)

	/* Initialize */
	SET @sChk      =  N'0'
	SET @nCountit  =  -1
	/* Check mandatory parameters */
	IF @sCrentity IS NULL OR @sCenttype IS NULL or @sCentcode is null
		BEGIN
			SET @sChk  =  N'1'
			RETURN
		END

	SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
	FROM   r5entities r
	WHERE  r.ent_rentity = @sCrentity

	/* Unknown entity */
	IF @nCountit < 1
		BEGIN
			SET @nCountit = -1
			SET @sChk     = N'2'
			RETURN
		END

   SET @nCountit = -1

	/* If all 5 parameters are NULL, do a check, using r5descriptions */
	/* This is used for most (simple) checks on entities such as MRC codes, */
	/* cost codes etc. */
	IF  @sCpar1 IS NULL AND @sCpar2 IS NULL AND @sCpar3 IS NULL AND @sCpar4 IS NULL AND @sCpar5 IS NULL
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
			FROM   r5descriptions  d
			WHERE  d.des_code    = @sCentcode
			AND    d.des_rentity = @sCrentity
			AND    d.des_type    = @sCenttype
			RETURN
		END

	IF @sCrentity =  N'EVNT'
		BEGIN
			IF  @sCpar1    =  N'MATL'
			/* List, Activity exists in r5activities   */
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
					FROM   r5activities a
					WHERE  a.act_act       =  @sCentcode
					AND    a.act_matlist   =  @sCpar3
					RETURN
				END
			IF @sCpar1  =  N'ACTV'
				BEGIN
				/* Activities exists in r5activities   */
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
					FROM   r5activities a
					WHERE  a.act_event  =  @sCentcode
					AND    a.act_act    =  @sCpar3
					RETURN
				END
			/* Event with rstatus > N'C' exists in r5events   */
			IF    @sCpar2    = N'>'
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
					FROM   r5events   e
					WHERE  e.evt_code      =  @sCentcode
					AND    e.evt_rstatus   >  @sCpar1
					--IF  @sCpar2    = N'<>' is dead code if you look closely
				END
			IF  @sCpar2    = N'REQ'
				BEGIN
					/* Event is within reqdays insallation paramater and exists in r5events   */
					execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sVreqdays OUTPUT, N'REQDAYS', @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					SELECT @dCloseddate = COALESCE( MAX( c.clp_closed ),convert( datetime, '01-01-1900',101 ))
					FROM r5closedperiods c

					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
					FROM   r5events   e
					WHERE  e.evt_code      =  @sCentcode
					AND    e.evt_rstatus > N'A'
					AND  ( ( isnull( e.evt_completed + cast(@sVreqdays as int),
						   convert( datetime, '01-01-2099',101 ) ) > dbo.o7gttime2(e.evt_org)
					AND      isnull( e.evt_completed ,
							 convert( datetime, '01-01-2099',101 ) ) > @dCloseddate ) OR
						e.evt_rstatus <> N'C' )
					AND e.evt_rtype IN ( N'PPM', N'JOB' )
				END
			RETURN
		END

	IF @sCrentity = N'PROJ'
		BEGIN
			IF     @sCpar2    = N'>'
			/* Projects with rstatus > N'C' exists in r5projects   */
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
					FROM   r5projects   p
					WHERE  p.prj_code      =  @sCentcode
					AND    p.prj_rstatus   >  @sCpar1
				END
			IF  @sCpar2  =  N'='
			/* Projects with rstatus = N'O' exists in r5projects   */
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCountit= COUNT(*)
					FROM   r5projects   p
					WHERE  p.prj_code      =  @sCentcode
					AND    p.prj_rstatus   =  @sCpar1
				END
			RETURN
		END

	IF @sCrentity = N'OBJ'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
			FROM   r5objects o
			WHERE  o.obj_code   = @sCentcode
			AND    o.obj_org    = @sCpar1
			RETURN
		END


	IF @sCrentity  =  N'STOR'
		BEGIN
			IF @sCpar1 = N'STOR'
				BEGIN
					set @nCountit = 0

					declare @tStack table ( str_code nvarchar(15), LevelID int )

					INSERT INTO @tStack
						SELECT str_code, 1
						FROM   r5stores
						WHERE  str_code = @sCentcode

					SET @nLevel = 1

					WHILE @nLevel > 0
						BEGIN
							IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
								BEGIN
									select	@sCurrentParent = str_code from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
                                    if @sCurrentParent = @sCpar2
									    set @nCountit = @nCountit + 1
									delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND str_code = @sCurrentParent
									insert into @tStack	select	str_code, @nLevel + 1
														  from	r5stores
														 where	str_parent		= @sCurrentParent
									IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
										SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
								END
							ELSE
								SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
						END

					RETURN
				END
			ELSE
				/* Part, Store must exist in r5Stock   */
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
					FROM   r5stock   s
					WHERE  s.sto_part     = @sCpar1
					AND    s.sto_part_org = @sCpar2
					AND    s.sto_store    = @sCentcode
					RETURN
				END
		END

	IF @sCrentity  =  N'BNST'
	/* Bin, Part, Store must exist in r5Binstock   */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
			FROM   r5binstock   b
			WHERE  b.bis_part     = @sCpar2
			AND    b.bis_part_org = @sCpar4
			AND    b.bis_store    = @sCpar1
			AND    b.bis_lot      = Coalesce(@sCpar3, N'*')
			AND    b.bis_bin      = Coalesce(@sCentcode, N'*')
			RETURN
		END


	IF @sCrentity  =  N'LOT'
	/*  Lots exists in r5lots   */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCountit =  COUNT(*)
			FROM   r5lots      l
			WHERE  l.lot_code  =  @sCentcode
			RETURN
		END


	IF @sCrentity  =  N'PORD'
		BEGIN
			IF  @sCpar1    =  N'ORD'
			/*  Orders exists in r5orders   */
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
					FROM   r5orders      o
					WHERE  o.ord_code = @sCentcode
					AND    o.ord_org  = @sCpar2
				END
			IF  @sCpar1  =  N'ORDL'
			/*  Orderlines exists in r5orderlines   */
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
					FROM   r5orderlines      o
					WHERE  o.orl_order     = @sCentcode
					AND    o.orl_order_org = @sCpar4
					AND    o.orl_ordline   = @sCpar3
				END
			RETURN
		END


	IF @sCrentity  =  N'REQ'
		BEGIN
			IF  @sCpar1    =  N'REQ'
			/*  Requisitions with status N'U' exists in r5requisitions   */
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
					FROM   r5requisitions   r
					WHERE  r.req_code     =  @sCentcode
					AND    r.req_rstatus  =  N'U'
				END
			IF  @sCpar1    =  N'REQL'
			/*  Requislines exists in r5requislines   */
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
					FROM   r5requislines   r
					WHERE  r.rql_req      =  @sCentcode
					AND    r.rql_reqline  =  @sCpar3
				END
			RETURN
		END

	IF @sCrentity  =  N'CURR'
		BEGIN
			IF @sCpar1     =  N'EXCH'
				BEGIN
					IF ( @sCpar2 IS NOT NULL ) AND ( @sCpar3 Is Not Null ) AND ( @sCpar4 Is Not Null )
					/*   Active Exchrate exists in r5exchrates   */
						Begin
                           -- Attempt workaround for deadlock issue
                           -- deadlock occurs when the COUNT(*) below is run.  The deadlock itself is on
                           -- the index on crr_orgcurr.  Removing that column from this EXISTS check
                           -- removes that index from contention.  If this EXISTS check comes up empty,
                           -- then the COUNT(*) below would have as well, so we can avoid the deadlock for
                           -- common cases.
                           if exists ( select 1
                                        From   r5exchrates
							            Where  crr_curr    =  @sCentcode

create procedure O7EXISTU
	@sRentity        nvarchar(4),
	@sEnttype        nvarchar(1),
	@sEntcode        nvarchar(17),
	@sPar1           nvarchar(17),
	@sPar2           nvarchar(17),
	@sPar3           nvarchar(17),
	@sPar4           nvarchar(17),
	@sPar5           nvarchar(17),
	@nCountit        int OUTPUT,
	@sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	
	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk     = N'0'
	set @nCountit = -1
	
	/* Check mandatory parameters */
	if @sRentity IS NULL OR @sEnttype IS NULL OR @sEntcode IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end
	
	/* U06221 : Check for non existence of calendar in r5years */
	if  @sRentity = N'CAL' AND @sEnttype = N'1' AND @sEntcode = N'*' AND @sPar1 IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5years y
			WHERE  y.acy_cal = @sPar1
			RETURN
		end
	else
		/* U08124 - Location should exist  */
		begin
			if @sRentity = N'BDT' AND   @sEnttype = N'1' AND   @sEntcode = N'*' AND   @sPar1 IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
					FROM   r5objects o
					WHERE  o.obj_code    = @sPar1
					AND    o.obj_obrtype  = N'L'
					AND    coalesce( o.obj_notused, N'-' ) = N'-'
					return
				end
			else
				begin
					if @sRentity = N'BSTR' AND @sEnttype = N'1' 
						begin
							SELECT	@nCountit = count(*)
							FROM	dbo.O7EXISTU_GET_HIERARCHY_1( @sEntcode, @sPar1 )


							if @nCountit = 0
								return
						end
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'2'
							set @nCountit = -1
							return
						end

				end
		end
end

create function O7EXISTU_GET_HIERARCHY_1 (	@sEntcode	nvarchar(30),
											@sBuscode	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( buscode	nvarchar(17)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						nLevel		int )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sCurrentType	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCurrentRtype	nvarchar(4)
		
	declare @tStack table ( buscode		nvarchar(17),
							busparent		nvarchar(17),
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	bus_code,
				bus_parent, 
				1 
		  from	r5budgetstructure
		 where	bus_code		= @sBuscode	and 
				bus_parent	= @sEntcode		
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sEntcode	= busparent,
							@sBuscode	= buscode
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sBuscode, @nLevel)
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND busparent = @sEntcode and buscode = @sBuscode
					insert into @tStack	select	bus_code, 
												bus_parent, 
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5budgetstructure
										 where	bus_parent		= @sEntcode	and 
												bus_code	= @sBuscode		
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create procedure O7EXISTW	@sCrentity       nvarchar(4),
							@sCenttype       nvarchar(4),
							@sCentcode       nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar1          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar2          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar3          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar4          nvarchar(40),
							@sCpar5          nvarchar(40),
							@nCountit        int OUTPUT,
							@sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

  
as

	set NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nContinue		int
	declare @sOccrtype		nvarchar(4) /* r5bookedhours.boo_ocrtype%TYPE */
	declare @nBit			bit
	declare	@sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
    declare @nError         int
    declare @nCount         int

	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk      =  N'0'
	set @nCountit  =  -1
	set @nContinue = 0
	set @sX = NULL

	/* Does @sCrentity exist ? */
	SELECT @nCountit = COUNT( * )
	FROM   r5entities r
	WHERE  r.ent_rentity = @sCrentity

	If @nCountit < 1 
		begin
			/* Unknown entity */
			set @nCountit = -1
			set @sChk      =  N'2'
			return
		end

	set @nCountit  =  -1

	if @sCrentity in ( N'PERM', N'RECO', N'CAUS', N'FAIL', N'ACT', N'TASK', N'ACCO', N'EVNT', N'TRAN', N'PPM', N'BOOK')
		begin 
			/* PERM tests ------------------------------------------------------ */
			/* W11224 No previous issues (rstatus <> 'C') */
			IF @sCrentity = N'PERM' 
				begin
					SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
					FROM   r5permevents
					WHERE  pev_permit     = @sCpar1
					AND    pev_permit_org = @sCpar2
					AND    pev_permitrev  = CAST( @sCpar3 AS NUMERIC )
					AND    pev_event      = @sCpar4
					AND    pev_active     = N'+'

					if @nCountit > 1 
						set @nCountit = 1
					set @nContinue = 1
				end


			IF @sCrentity = N'RECO' 
				begin
					if @sCpar1 = N'1'
						begin
							/* W07212 - Suggested code must not have been defined earlier in the given */
							/* tree structure.*/
							
							CREATE TABLE #tRootItmes (	 Rotreqm nvarchar(8) )
							insert into #tRootItmes  execute GET_R5Rootitems_Hierarchy  @sCpar2, @sCpar3 
			
							select @nCountit = count(*) from #tRootItmes
							DROP table #tRootItmes
							return
						end
					if @sCpar1 = N'2'
						begin
							/* W07223 - Suggested code and required code must belong to the same Event*/
							/* class (r5reqclasses).*/
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM   r5requircodes a,
								   r5requircodes b
							WHERE  a.rqm_code = @sCpar2
							AND    b.rqm_code = @sCpar3
							AND    a.rqm_gen = N'-'
							AND    b.rqm_gen = N'-'
							return
						end
					if @sCpar1 = N'3'
						begin
							/* W07223 - Suggested code and required code must belong to the same Event*/
							/* class (r5reqclasses).*/
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM   r5reqclasses c,
							   r5reqclasses d
							WHERE  c.rcl_reqm = @sCpar3
							AND    d.rcl_reqm = @sCpar2
							AND    c.rcl_class = d.rcl_class
							AND    c.rcl_class_org = d.rcl_class_org
							return
						end
					if @sCpar1 = N'4'
						begin
							/* W07411 Suggested code must not have children.*/
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM   r5rootitems r
							WHERE  r.rot_reqm = @sCpar2
							return
						end
					if @sCpar1 = N'5'
						begin
						/* Can only make a requirement code general if no class attached. */
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM   r5reqclasses r
							WHERE  r.rcl_reqm = @sCpar2
							return
						end
				end 

			if @sCrentity = N'CAUS' 
				begin
					if @sCpar1 = N'1'
						begin		
							/* Can only make a cause code general if no class attached. */
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM    r5causeclasses c
							WHERE   c.cac_cause = @sCpar2
							return
						end
				end 

			if @sCrentity = N'FAIL' 
				begin
					if @sCpar1 = N'1'
						begin
							/* Can only make a failure code general if no class attached. */
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM    r5failureclasses f
							WHERE   f.fca_failure = @sCpar2
							return
						end		
				end


			if @sCrentity = N'ACT' 
				begin
					if @sCpar1 = N'1'
						begin
							/* W01315 Check for non-existence in r5requislines , if rStatus <> 'U' .*/
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM   r5requislines l,
								   r5requisitions r
							WHERE  l.rql_event   = @sCpar2
							AND    l.rql_act     = CAST( @sCpar3 as int)
							AND    r.req_code    = l.rql_req
							AND    r.req_rstatus <> N'U'

							if @nCountit > 1 
								set @nCountit = 1
							return
						end
					if @sCpar1 = N'2'
						begin
							/* W01316 Check for non-existence in r5quotlines , if rStatus <> 'U' .*/
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM   r5quotlines l,
								   r5quotations q
							WHERE  l.qul_event   = @sCpar2
							AND    l.qul_act     = CAST( @sCpar3 as int)
							AND    q.quo_code    = l.qul_quotation
							AND    q.quo_rstatus <> N'U'

							if @nCountit > 1 
								set @nCountit = 1
							return
						end
					if @sCpar1 = N'4'
						begin
							/* W01316 Check for non-existence in r5activities.*/
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM   r5activities
							WHERE  act_event   = @sCpar2
							AND    act_act     = cast( @sCpar3 as int)
							AND    act_hire    = N'+'
							AND    act_order IS NULL
							AND    coalesce( act_nt, 0 ) = 0
							AND    coalesce( act_ot, 0 ) = 0

							if @nCountit > 1 
								set @nCountit = 1
							return
						end
					if @sCpar1 = N'5'
						begin
							--  For Forms List of Values (LOV) on evt/act, check whether activity is ok
							--  when updated with LOV
							if @sCpar2 is Null and @sCpar3 is null 
								return

							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM   r5activities
							WHERE  act_event   = @sCpar2
							AND    act_act     = cast( @sCpar3 as int)  
							
							if 	@nCountit <= 0 
								set @sChk = N'14'
								
							return				

						end
				end

			if @sCrentity = N'TASK' 
				begin
					if @sCpar1 = N'1'
						begin
							/* Check existence of task .*/
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM   r5tasks t
							WHERE  t.tsk_code  = @sCentcode
							return
						end
				end

			if @sCrentity = N'ACCO' 
				begin
					if @sCpar1 = N'1'
						begin
							/* Check existence of task .*/
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM   r5actclasses
							WHERE  acl_action = @sCpar2
							return
						end
				end



			if @sCrentity = N'EVNT' 
				begin
					if @sCpar1 = N'1'
						begin
						/* W1032J2 - All Fixed Price Service orders must be closed                 */
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM   r5orderlines o
							WHERE o.orl_event   = @sCpar2
							AND   o.orl_active  = N'+'
							AND '-' = (SELECT act_defermaintenance FROM r5activities WHERE act_event = @sCpar2 AND act_act = o.orl_act)

							if @nCountit > 1 
								set @nCountit = 1
							return
						end

					if @sCpar1 = N'2'
						begin
						/* W1032J2 - All Fixed Price Service orders must be closed                 */
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM   r5events
							WHERE  evt_code = @sCpar2
							AND    evt_rstatus > N'C'

							return
						end

					if @sCpar1 = N'3'
						begin
							/* W1032J2 - All requisitionlines must be closed */
							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM   r5requislines r
							WHERE  r.rql_event   = @sCpar2
							AND    r.rql_active  = N'+'
							AND '-' = (SELECT act_defermaintenance FROM r5activities WHERE act_event = @sCpar2 AND act_act = r.rql_act)

							if @nCountit > 1 
								set @nCountit = 1
							return

					if @sCpar1 = N'4'

							SELECT @nCountit = COUNT(*)
							FROM   r5transtock

CREATE FUNCTION O7EXTEVALRECIPIENT( @sPK        nvarchar(30),
                                    @sMail      nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sMailcode  nvarchar(255),
                                    @sParam1    nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sParam2    nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sParam3    nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sParam4    nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sParam5    nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sParam6    nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sParam7    nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sParam8    nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sParam9    nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sParam10   nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sParam11   nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sParam12   nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sParam13   nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sParam14   nvarchar(4000),
                                    @sParam15   nvarchar(4000)) 
returns nvarchar(max)
as 
    begin
        declare @sText      nvarchar(max)
        declare @sEa        nvarchar(255)
        declare @sMapcol    nvarchar(30)
        declare @sMapTable  nvarchar(30)
        declare @sParam     nvarchar(4000)
        declare @sNextParam nvarchar(4000)
        declare @sMailEventTable nvarchar(30)
        declare @sPushNotificationTemplate nvarchar(30)
        declare @nID        int

        declare @tTemp table ( id int NOT NULL, parm nvarchar(4000) NULL, nextparm nvarchar(4000) NULL )

        set @sText = @sMail

        insert into @tTemp values ( 1,  @sParam1,  @sParam2  ) 
        insert into @tTemp values ( 2,  @sParam2,  @sParam3  ) 
        insert into @tTemp values ( 3,  @sParam3,  @sParam4  ) 
        insert into @tTemp values ( 4,  @sParam4,  @sParam5  )
        insert into @tTemp values ( 5,  @sParam5,  @sParam6  )
        insert into @tTemp values ( 6,  @sParam6,  @sParam7  )
        insert into @tTemp values ( 7,  @sParam7,  @sParam8  )
        insert into @tTemp values ( 8,  @sParam8,  @sParam9  )
        insert into @tTemp values ( 9,  @sParam9,  @sParam10 )
        insert into @tTemp values ( 10, @sParam10, @sParam11 )
        insert into @tTemp values ( 11, @sParam11, @sParam12 )
        insert into @tTemp values ( 12, @sParam12, @sParam13 )
        insert into @tTemp values ( 13, @sParam13, @sParam14 )
        insert into @tTemp values ( 14, @sParam14, @sParam15 )
        insert into @tTemp values ( 15, @sParam15, null )

        SELECT  @sPushNotificationTemplate = coalesce(mat_pushnotification, '-'), 
                @sMailEventTable = maa_table 
        FROM   r5mailattribs, r5mailtemplate
        WHERE  maa_pk = @sPK 
        AND    maa_template = mat_code

        declare c_temp cursor local for select id, parm, nextparm from @tTemp order by id desc
        open c_temp
        fetch next from c_temp into @nID, @sParam, @sNextParam
        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
                if charindex( N'%' + cast(@nID as nvarchar(38)), @sText) > 0
                    begin
                        set @sEa = N''  --used in REPLACE later

                        SELECT @sMaptable = map_table, @sMapcol = map_column
                         FROM   r5mailparameters
                         WHERE  map_attribpk = @sPK
                         AND  map_parameter = @nID


                        if @nID <> 15 
                            begin
                                if (@sParam is not null and @sNextParam is not null)
                                    begin
                                            SELECT @sEa = isnull(com_email,N'')
                                             FROM   r5companies
                                             WHERE  com_code = @sParam
                                               AND  com_org  = @sNextParam
                                    end
                            end

                        if @sParam is not null and @sEa = N''
                            begin
                                if @sMapcol in (N'CTR_CONTACTINFOID', N'CTR_ADDRESSALIAS', N'CTI_CODE')
                                    SELECT @sEa = isnull(cti_primaryemail,N'')
                                    FROM   r5contactinfo
                                    WHERE  cti_code = @sParam
                                else
                                    begin
                                                if @sEa = N''
                                                    SELECT @sEa = isnull(usr_emailaddress,N'')
                                                    FROM   r5users
                                                    WHERE  usr_code = @sParam                                                

                                                if @sEa = N''
                                                    SELECT @sEa = isnull(per_emailaddress,N'')
                                                    FROM   r5personnel
                                                    WHERE  per_code = @sParam
                                    end
                            end
                        
                        if @sEa = N'' and charindex( N'@', @sParam ) > 0
                            set @sEa = @sParam

                        set @sText = replace( @sText, N'%' + cast( @nID as nvarchar(38)), @sEa )
                    end
                fetch next from c_temp into @nID, @sParam, @sNextParam
            end
        close c_temp
        deallocate c_temp
        if (@sPushNotificationTemplate = '+' and ( @sMailEventTable = 'R5EVENTS' OR @sMailEventTable = 'R5ACTSCHEDULES' OR @sMailEventTable = 'R5OBJECTS' OR @sMailEventTable = 'R5ASSETINVENTORYPARAMS' OR @sMailEventTable = 'R5TRANSACTIONS' OR @sMailEventTable = 'R5OPERATORCHECKLISTS' OR @sMailEventTable = 'R5DOCKRECEIPTS' ) and (@sMailcode is not null or @sMailcode != ''))
            set @sText = @sText + ';' + @sMailcode
        return @sText
    end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7FLEETBILLS_GETSUBPK
    @sSubpk   nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
    @sBill nvarchar(30), 
    @sCostcode nvarchar(30), 
    @sObj nvarchar(30), 
    @sOrg nvarchar(15), 
    @sAdj nvarchar(1)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sX     nvarchar(1)
	declare @sChk	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn	integer

    /* Try to find a line with the same @sCostcode and object. */
    set @sSubpk = null

    SELECT @sSubpk = fbs_pk
    FROM   r5fleetbillsublines
    WHERE  fbs_bill       = @sBill
    AND    fbs_costcode   = @sCostcode
    AND    fbs_object     = @sObj
    AND    fbs_object_org = @sOrg
    AND    fbs_adjustment = @sAdj

    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        begin
            /* If no line exists, create a new one, but first check line. */
            SELECT @sX = 'x'
            FROM   r5fleetbilllines
            WHERE  fbl_bill       = @sBill
            AND    fbl_costcode   = @sCostcode
            AND    fbl_object     = @sObj
            AND    fbl_object_org = @sOrg
            AND    fbl_adjustment = case  @sAdj when N'*' then N'+' else @sAdj end
            IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                /* Create line first. */
                INSERT INTO r5fleetbilllines(fbl_bill, fbl_costcode, fbl_object, fbl_object_org, fbl_adjustment )
                VALUES( @sBill, @sCostcode, @sObj, @sOrg, case @sAdj when N'*' then N'+' else @sAdj end )
			
            execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSubpk OUTPUT, N'FLEET', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1

            INSERT INTO r5fleetbillsublines( fbs_pk, fbs_bill, fbs_costcode, fbs_object, fbs_object_org, fbs_adjustment )
            VALUES( @sSubpk, @sBill, @sCostcode, @sObj, @sOrg, case @sAdj when N'*' then N'+' else @sAdj end )
        end

                    WHERE  tcc_costcode = @sCC )
        begin
			--SCR18941 -- added check for permissions.
			INSERT INTO r5tempcostcodes( tcc_user, tcc_costcode, tcc_date, tcc_org, tcc_class, tcc_class_org, tcc_notused )
			SELECT @sSess, @sCC, dbo.o7gttime2( null ), cst_org, cst_class, cst_class_org, cst_notused
			FROM   r5costcodes
			WHERE  cst_code = @sCC
			AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
							FROM   r5tempcostcodes
							WHERE  tcc_user  = @sSess
							AND    tcc_costcode = @sCC )
		end

	/* Create relation between session number and ticket/trans/work order/adjustment, but only if the record does not exist yet. */
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'x'
	FROM   r5tempcostcodelines
	WHERE  tcl_user     = @sSess
	AND    tcl_costcode = @sCC
	AND    tcl_type     = @sCCType
	AND    tcl_pk       = @sPk1
	AND    coalesce( tcl_pk2, 0 ) = coalesce( @nPk2, 0 ))
		begin
			/* Create relation between session number and ticket/trans/work order/adjustment. */
			INSERT INTO r5tempcostcodelines( tcl_user, tcl_costcode, tcl_type, tcl_pk, tcl_pk2 )
			VALUES( @sSess, @sCC, @sCCType, @sPk1, @nPk2 ) 

			/* Increase number of tickets/trans/work orders/adjustments. */
			--SCR18941 -- added check for permissions.
			UPDATE r5tempcostcodes
			SET    tcc_tickets     = coalesce( tcc_tickets, 0 )     + CASE @sCCType when N'T' then 1 else 0 end,
				   tcc_translines  = coalesce( tcc_translines, 0 )  + CASE @sCCType when N'F' then 1 else 0 end,
				   tcc_events      = coalesce( tcc_events, 0 )      + CASE @sCCType when N'E' then 1 else 0 end,
				   tcc_adjustments = coalesce( tcc_adjustments, 0 ) + CASE @sCCType when N'A' then 1 else 0 end,
				   tcc_total       = coalesce( tcc_total, 0 ) + 1
			WHERE  tcc_user  = @sSess
			AND    tcc_costcode = @sCC
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7FLEETBILLS_UPDATEADJSUBLINE
    @sSubpk         nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
    @sSess          nvarchar(30),
    @sUbill         nvarchar(30), 
    @sUcostcode     nvarchar(30), 
    @sUobj          nvarchar(30), 
    @sUorg          nvarchar(15), 
    @sUticket       nvarchar(30),
    @nUfuelm        numeric(24,6), 
    @nUmileage      numeric(24,6), 
    @nUmileagem     numeric(24,6), 
    @nUusage        numeric(24,6), 
    @nUusagem       numeric(24,6),
    @nUinsurance    numeric(24,6), 
    @nUinsurancem   numeric(24,6), 
    @nUexceptions   numeric(24,6), 
    @sPk            nvarchar(30),
	@nMiles 	numeric(24,6), 
	@nUhours 	numeric(24,6)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sX     nvarchar(1)
	declare @sChk	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn	integer

    IF @sSess IS NULL 
        begin
            execute @nReturn = o7fleetbills_getsubpk @sSubpk OUTPUT, @sUbill, @sUcostcode, @sUobj, @sUorg, N'*' 
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1
            /* Update sub line. */
            UPDATE r5fleetbillsublines
            SET    fbs_ticket          = @sUticket,
            fbs_fuel            = @nUfuelm,
            fbs_mileage         = @nUmileage,
            fbs_mileagemarkup   = @nUmileagem,
            fbs_usage           = @nUusage,
            fbs_usagemarkup     = @nUusagem,
            fbs_insurance       = @nUinsurance,
            fbs_insurancemarkup = @nUinsurancem,
            fbs_exceptions      = @nUexceptions,
			fbs_miles           = @nMiles,
            fbs_hours           = @nUhours,
            fbs_adjpk           = @sPk
            WHERE  fbs_pk = @sSubpk
        end
    ELSE
        begin
            execute @nReturn = o7fleetbills_getsubpksess @sSubpk OUTPUT, @sSess, @sUcostcode, @sUobj, @sUorg, N'*' 
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1
            /* Update temp sub line. */
            UPDATE r5tempbillsublines
            SET    tfs_ticket          = @sUticket,
            tfs_fuel            = @nUfuelm,
            tfs_mileage         = @nUmileage,
            tfs_mileagemarkup   = @nUmileagem,
            tfs_usage           = @nUusage,
            tfs_usagemarkup     = @nUusagem,
            tfs_insurance       = @nUinsurance,
            tfs_insurancemarkup = @nUinsurancem,
            tfs_exceptions      = @nUexceptions,
			tfs_miles           = @nMiles,
            tfs_hours           = @nUhours,
            tfs_adjpk           = @sPk
            WHERE  tfs_pk = @sSubpk
        end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7FLEETCCUPDATES
  @sUser                nvarchar(255),
  @sOutput              nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
  @nTotalrecords        numeric(38,0) OUTPUT,
  @nTotalupdated        numeric(38,0) OUTPUT,
  @sRole                nvarchar(30) = '*'
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sX                     nvarchar(1)
	declare @sChk	                nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn	            integer
    declare @sErrormessage          nvarchar(500)          --r5tempcostcodeerrors.tce_error%TYPE
    declare @sCostcode_tcc          nvarchar(30)
    declare @sNewcostcode_tcc       nvarchar(30)

    declare @nSqlindentity_tcl      numeric(38,0) 
    declare @sType_tcl              nvarchar(1)
    declare @sPk_tcl                nvarchar(30) 
    declare @nPk2_tcl               numeric(38,0)

	declare @nError					integer

    declare @dClosed        datetime
    declare @sLang          nvarchar(2)--r5users.usr_lang%TYPE;
    declare @sClosedtext    nvarchar(255)--r5errtexts.ert_text%TYPE;
    declare @bErrorfound    bit--BOOLEAN; 
    declare @nUpdatedrows   integer
    

		set @bErrorfound = 0
        /* Username should be provided. */
        IF @sUser IS NULL 
            begin
                set @sOutput = N'1'
                RETURN
            end
        ELSE
        /* Retrieve user's language. */
            begin
                SELECT @sLang = usr_lang
                FROM   r5users
                WHERE  usr_code = @sUser
                If @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
                    begin
                        set @sOutput = N'1'
                        UPDATE r5tempcostcodes 
                        SET    tcc_newcostcode = null
                        RETURN
                    end
                /* Retrieve closed period error message. */
                SELECT @sClosedtext = ert_text
                FROM   r5errtexts
                WHERE  ert_code = N'11518'
                AND    ert_lang = @sLang
            end

		/* Check whether the billing process is running. */
		IF EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM   r5fleetbillingschedules  WHERE  fsc_billinginprogress = N'+' )
			begin
				/* Delete all cost code replacement records. The exit. */
				DELETE FROM r5tempcostcodes
                set @sOutput = N'2'
                RETURN
			end

		/* Check whether the new cost codes are allowed, org wise. */
		IF EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM   r5costcodes, r5tempcostcodes
								WHERE  cst_code = tcc_newcostcode
								AND    tcc_user = @sUser
								AND    cst_org NOT IN ( SELECT uog_org
												  FROM   r5userorganization 
												  WHERE  uog_user = @sUser
												  AND    uog_role = @sRole ))
			begin
				/* Wrong new orgs used. */
                set @sOutput = N'3'
                UPDATE r5tempcostcodes 
                SET    tcc_newcostcode = null
                WHERE  tcc_user = @sUser
                RETURN
			end


		/* Check whether the new cost codes should be replaced ( circular ). */
		IF EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM   r5tempcostcodes c1
							WHERE  tcc_user = @sUser
							AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
								  FROM   r5tempcostcodes c2
								  WHERE  c2.tcc_costcode = c1.tcc_newcostcode ))
			begin
				/* New cost code cannot be replaced. */
                set @sOutput = N'4'
                UPDATE r5tempcostcodes 
                SET    tcc_newcostcode = null
                WHERE  tcc_user = @sUser
                RETURN
			end


		/* Check whether the new cost codes are allowed looking at the org of the old cost code. */
		IF EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM   r5costcodes, r5organization o2, r5organization o1, r5tempcostcodes
								WHERE  tcc_org  = o1.org_code
								AND    cst_code = tcc_newcostcode
								AND    cst_org  = o2.org_code
								AND    tcc_user = @sUser
								AND  ( ( o1.org_common = '+' AND o2.org_common = '-' ) OR
								 ( o2.org_common = '-' AND o1.org_code <> o2.org_code ) ))
			begin
				/* Cannot change common to specific, or specific o1 to specific o2. */
                set @sOutput = N'5'
                UPDATE r5tempcostcodes 
                SET    tcc_newcostcode = null
                WHERE  tcc_user = @sUser
                RETURN
			end


		/* Check whether the new cost codes are billable and used. */
		IF EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM   r5costcodes, r5tempcostcodes 
								WHERE  cst_code = tcc_newcostcode
								AND    tcc_user = @sUser
								AND  ( coalesce( cst_nonbillable, '-' ) = '+' OR coalesce( cst_notused, '-' ) = '+' ))
			begin
				/* New cost codes mnust be billable and used. */
                set @sOutput = N'6'
                UPDATE r5tempcostcodes 
                SET    tcc_newcostcode = null
                WHERE  tcc_user = @sUser
                RETURN
			end


		/* Check whether the new cost codes are billable and used. */
		IF EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM   r5tempcostcodes 
								WHERE  tcc_user = @sUser
								AND    tcc_newcostcode IS NOT NULL
								AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
										  FROM   r5costcodes
										  WHERE  cst_code = tcc_newcostcode ))
			begin
				/* New cost codes must exist. */
                set @sOutput = N'7'
                UPDATE r5tempcostcodes 
                SET    tcc_newcostcode = null
                WHERE  tcc_user = @sUser
                RETURN
			end

        /* Initialize */
        set @nTotalrecords = 0
        set @nTotalupdated = 0
        set @sOutput       = N'0'
  
        SELECT @dClosed = MAX( clp_closed )
        FROM   r5closedperiods
        /* Loop through all cost codes. */
		declare c_tcc cursor local for select tcc_costcode, tcc_newcostcode
                                        FROM   r5tempcostcodes
                                        WHERE  tcc_user = @sUser
                                        AND    tcc_newcostcode IS NOT NULL
                                        ORDER BY tcc_costcode	
		open c_tcc
		fetch next from c_tcc into 	@sCostcode_tcc, @sNewcostcode_tcc 
        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    		begin
				/* First delete all error records. */
				DELETE FROM r5tempcostcodeerrors
				WHERE  tce_user     = @sUser
				AND    tce_costcode = @sCostcode_tcc

				declare c_tcl cursor local for select tcl_sqlidentity, tcl_type, tcl_pk, tcl_pk2
                                                FROM   r5tempcostcodelines
                                                WHERE  tcl_user = @sUser
                                                AND    tcl_costcode = @sCostcode_tcc
				open c_tcl
				fetch next from c_tcl into 	@nSqlindentity_tcl, @sType_tcl, @sPk_tcl, @nPk2_tcl
                while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
                    /* Loop through all lines within the current cost codes. */
                    set @nTotalrecords = @nTotalrecords + 1
                    set @bErrorfound = 0 
                    set @nError = 0    
                    --when others excpetion check on cost code existing (FK constraint check)
                    If exists (select 1 from r5costcodes where cst_code = @sNewcostcode_tcc) 
                        begin
                            IF @sType_tcl = N'T' 
                                begin
                                    /* Update Tickets. */
                                    UPDATE r5fleettickets
                                    SET    fti_costcode = @sNewcostcode_tcc 
                                    WHERE  fti_costcode = @sCostcode_tcc
                                    AND    fti_code     = @sPk_tcl
                                    select @nError = @@ERROR
                                end
                        
                            IF @sType_tcl = N'F' 
                                begin
                                    /* Update Translines. */
                                    UPDATE r5translines
                                    SET    trl_costcode = @sNewcostcode_tc

CREATE PROCEDURE O7FLXPKG_O7FLXCHK
                 @sTableName   NVARCHAR(32)
                ,@sTriggerName NVARCHAR(32)
                ,@nRowId       BIGINT
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @nReturn           INT
       ,@nStatus           TINYINT
       ,@sMessage          NVARCHAR(300)
       ,@dSdate            DATETIME
       ,@dEdate            DATETIME
       ,@nDiff             NUMERIC
       ,@nMs               NUMERIC
       ,@sMs               NVARCHAR(100)
       ,@sObjupd           NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@sForgetme         NVARCHAR(10)
       ,@sPersonorgupdate  NVARCHAR(10)

EXECUTE O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sObjupd OUTPUT
IF @sObjupd = N'TRUE'
  /* No flex if the object is being renumbered. */
  RETURN 0

EXECUTE O7SESS_CUR_INFORGETME @sForgetme OUTPUT
IF @sForgetme = N'TRUE'
  /* No flex during forgetme processing. */
  RETURN 0

EXECUTE O7SESS_CUR_INPERSONORGUPDATE @sPersonorgupdate OUTPUT
IF @sPersonorgupdate = N'TRUE'
  /* No flex if the person org is being updated. */
  RETURN 0

SELECT @sMs = COALESCE( ins_desc, '999999' )
FROM   r5install
WHERE  ins_code = N'FLXAUDIT'

IF ISNUMERIC(@sMs) = 1
  SET @nMs = @sMs
ELSE
  SET @nMs = 999999

SET @dSdate = getdate()
       
EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7FLXPKG_O7FLXEXEC @sTableName, @sTriggerName, @nRowId, @sMessage OUTPUT, @nStatus OUTPUT

SET @dEdate = getdate()

SET @nDiff = DATEDIFF( ms, @dSdate, @dEdate )

IF @nDiff >= COALESCE( @nMs, 999999 )
  INSERT INTO r5flexaudit( 
         fxa_tabname, fxa_trigname, fxa_rowid, fxa_sdate, fxa_edate, fxa_message, fxa_status, fxa_diff )
  VALUES( @sTableName, @sTriggerName, @nRowId, @dSdate, @dEdate, @sMessage, @nStatus, @nDiff )


IF @nReturn != 0 OR @nStatus = 2
   BEGIN
     /*Add indicators for mssql so MPDBException.java can know this is a flex sql message*/
     set @sMessage = 'FLEXBEGIN:' + @sMessage + ':FLEXEND'
     RAISERROR (@sMessage, 16, 1)
     RETURN -1
   END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7FLXPKG_O7FLXEXEC
                 @sTableName   NVARCHAR(128)
                ,@sTriggerName NVARCHAR(128)
                ,@nRowId       BIGINT
                ,@sMessage     NVARCHAR(255) OUTPUT
                ,@nStatus      TINYINT       OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @sFLXTable          NVARCHAR(32)
       ,@sFLXTrigger        NVARCHAR(32)
       ,@nFLXSeq            NUMERIC(18, 0)
       ,@sFLXStmt           NVARCHAR(MAX)
       ,@sFLXAbortOnFailure NVARCHAR(1)
       ,@sFLXReverseReturn  NVARCHAR(1)
       ,@sFLXActive         NVARCHAR(1)
       ,@sFLXMsgFailure     NVARCHAR(240)
       ,@sFLXMustExist      NVARCHAR(1)
       ,@nPosition          INT
       ,@sSelectKeyword     NVARCHAR(7)
       ,@sReceiveValue      NVARCHAR(255)
       ,@nRowCount          INT
       ,@nError             INT
       ,@bDummy             BIT

DECLARE ScrollFlexSQL CURSOR LOCAL FOR
SELECT flx_table
      ,flx_trigger
      ,flx_seq
      ,flx_stmt
      ,flx_abortonfailure
      ,flx_reversereturn
      ,flx_active
      ,rtrim(flx_msgfailure)
      ,ISNULL(flx_mustexist, N'+')
  FROM r5flexsql
 WHERE flx_table = @sTableName
   AND flx_trigger = @sTriggerName
   AND flx_active = N'+'
   AND coalesce(flx_mobile, N'-')  = N'-'
ORDER BY flx_seq

OPEN ScrollFlexSQL

      FETCH ScrollFlexSQL INTO @sFLXTable
                              ,@sFLXTrigger
                              ,@nFLXSeq
                              ,@sFLXStmt
                              ,@sFLXAbortOnFailure
                              ,@sFLXReverseReturn
                              ,@sFLXActive
                              ,@sFLXMsgFailure
                              ,@sFLXMustExist

  if @@FETCH_STATUS != 0 begin
    CLOSE ScrollFlexSQL
    DEALLOCATE ScrollFlexSQL
    SET @nStatus = 100
    return
  end



WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
	  
	  set @bDummy = 0
      SET @sFLXStmt = REPLACE(@sFLXStmt, N':ROWID', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @nRowId))
      SET @sFLXStmt = LTRIM(REPLACE(@sFLXStmt, N':rowid', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @nRowId)))

      SET @nRowCount = 0
      SET @nError = 0
      IF UPPER(LEFT(@sFLXStmt, 7)) = N'SELECT '
         BEGIN
			SET @sSelectKeyword = SUBSTRING(@sFLXStmt, 1, 7)
			SET @sFLXStmt = REPLACE(@sFLXStmt, @sSelectKeyword, @sSelectKeyword + N' @sReceiveValue=')
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sFLXStmt, N'@sReceiveValue NVARCHAR(255) OUTPUT', @sReceiveValue OUTPUT
			SELECT @nError = @@ERROR, @nRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT
         END
      ELSE
		begin
			/* SCR#17189 -- The following check has been added to mimic ORACLE's exception handling of a recursion issue.  
			In SQL Server if we insert/update a row and have a flex statement that updates that specific row
			then the triggers would recurse beyond the limit of 32 nesting levels. In Oracle this exception was handled */

			If @@NESTLEVEL < 28
				begin try
					EXECUTE (@sFLXStmt)
					SELECT @nError = @@ERROR, @nRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT
				end try
				begin catch
					if (@@error = 50000)
						SELECT @nStatus = 2, @sMessage= SUBSTRING( REPLACE( REPLACE(ERROR_MESSAGE(), 'FLEXBEGIN:',''), ':FLEXEND',''), 1, 255 )
					else
						SELECT @nStatus = 2, @sMessage= SUBSTRING( N'DB Error - ' + @sTriggerName + N' ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @nFLXSeq) + N'. ' + ERROR_MESSAGE(), 1, 255 )
					BREAK
				end catch			
			else
				begin
					--adding bit variable since the set statement below would reset the @@ROWCOUNT = 1
					set @bDummy = 1
					set @sFLXMsgFailure = N'Maximum stored procedure, function, trigger, or view nesting level exceeded (limit 32).'
				end
		end

	  If @bDummy = 1
		set @nRowCount = 0 


      IF @nError != 0
         BEGIN
         IF UPPER(LEFT(@sFLXStmt, 7)) = N'SELECT '
            BEGIN
            SELECT @nStatus = 2, @sMessage= SUBSTRING( N'DB Error - ' + @sTriggerName + N' ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @nFLXSeq), 1, 255 )
            BREAK
            END
         END

      --@@ROWCOUNT equivalent in Oracle is null if not one of the four statement types below.
      IF @nRowCount = 0 and UPPER(LEFT(@sFLXStmt, 7)) in ( N'SELECT ', N'UPDATE ', N'INSERT ', N'DELETE ' )
         BEGIN
         IF @sFLXReverseReturn = N'+'
            SELECT @nStatus = 0, @sMessage = NULL
         ELSE
            BEGIN
            IF @sFLXAbortOnFailure = N'+'
               SET @nStatus = 2
            ELSE
               SET @nStatus = 1
            IF NOT (@nStatus = 1 AND @sFLXMustExist = N'-')
               BEGIN
	          IF @sFLXMsgFailure IS NOT NULL
                     SET @sMessage = @sFLXMsgFailure
		  ELSE
		     SET @sMessage = N'no data found'
               BREAK
               END
            END
         END
      ELSE
         BEGIN
         IF @sFLXReverseReturn = N'-'
            SELECT @nStatus  = 0, @sMessage = NULL
         ELSE
            BEGIN
            IF @sFLXAbortOnFailure = N'+'
               SET @nStatus = 2
            ELSE
               SET @nStatus = 1
            IF NOT (@nStatus = 1 AND @sFLXMustExist = N'-')
              BEGIN
                  IF @sFLXMsgFailure IS NOT NULL
                     SET @sMessage = @sFLXMsgFailure
		  ELSE
		     SET @sMessage = N'no data found'
              BREAK
              END
            END
         END

      FETCH ScrollFlexSQL INTO @sFLXTable
                              ,@sFLXTrigger
                              ,@nFLXSeq
                              ,@sFLXStmt
                              ,@sFLXAbortOnFailure
                              ,@sFLXReverseReturn
                              ,@sFLXActive
                              ,@sFLXMsgFailure
                              ,@sFLXMustExist

      END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7FORGETME_EXECUTEUPDATE
  @pk         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @statno     NUMERIC( 4 ),
  @updstat    NVARCHAR( 2000 ),
  @errorfound NVARCHAR( 1 ) OUTPUT
AS
  DECLARE @errm NVARCHAR( 1000 )
BEGIN
  BEGIN TRY
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
      COMMIT  
    EXECUTE ( @updstat )
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
      COMMIT  
  END TRY
  BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
      ROLLBACK  
    /* Log the error. */
    SET @errm = SUBSTRING ( ERROR_MESSAGE(), 1 , 1000 )
    INSERT INTO r5forgetmeerrors( fme_code, fme_statement, fme_errmessage )
    VALUES( @pk, @statno, @errm )
    SET @errorfound = N'+'    
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
      COMMIT
  END CATCH
END

name: O7FORGETME_MAINPROCESS
body:
CREATE PROCEDURE O7FORGETME_MAINPROCESS
AS
  DECLARE @entity     NVARCHAR( 6 )
  DECLARE @pk         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DEClARE @code       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @newcode    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @errorfound NVARCHAR( 1 )
BEGIN
  SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON
  /* Initialize session, so triggers will know the user too. */
  EXECUTE dbo.O7SESS_INIT_SESS N'R5', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
  /* Loop through all scheduled forgetme records. */
  DECLARE fgm CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT fgm_entity, fgm_pk, fgm_code, fgm_newcode
    FROM   r5forgetme
    WHERE  fgm_status = N'S'
    ORDER BY fgm_created
  OPEN fgm
  FETCH NEXT FROM fgm INTO @entity, @pk, @code, @newcode
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @errorfound = N'-'
      /* Set the global 'in forgetme process' package variable to TRUE. */
      EXECUTE O7SESS_CHANGE_INFORGETME 'TRUE'

      /* Also in the table itself. */
      UPDATE r5forgetme
      SET    fgm_status     = N'P',
             fgm_startdate  = getdate(),
             fgm_enddate    = NULL
      WHERE  fgm_pk = @pk

      /* Delete earlier errors. */
      DELETE FROM r5forgetmeerrors
      WHERE  fme_code = @pk

      /* Redirect to the actual process, depending on the entity. */
      IF @entity = N'SGRP' 
        EXECUTE o7forgetme_processsupervisor @pk, @code, @newcode OUTPUT, @errorfound OUTPUT 
      ELSE IF @entity = N'USER' 
        EXECUTE o7forgetme_processuser @pk, @code, @newcode OUTPUT, @errorfound OUTPUT 
      ELSE IF @entity = N'PERS' 
        EXECUTE o7forgetme_processemployee @pk, @code, @newcode OUTPUT, @errorfound OUTPUT 
      ELSE IF @entity = N'CIFO' 
        EXECUTE o7forgetme_processcontactinfo @pk, @code, @newcode OUTPUT, @errorfound OUTPUT 
      ELSE IF @entity = N'CALL' 
        EXECUTE o7forgetme_processcaller @pk, @code, @newcode OUTPUT, @errorfound OUTPUT 

      /* Set the global 'in forgetme process' package variable to FALSE. */
      EXECUTE O7SESS_CHANGE_INFORGETME 'FALSE'

      IF @errorfound = N'+'
        /* If there is an error, set the status to 'In Error'. */
        UPDATE r5forgetme
        SET    fgm_status  = N'E',
               fgm_newcode = @newcode,
               fgm_enddate = getdate()
        WHERE  fgm_pk = @pk
      ELSE
        /* No errors, set the status to 'Completed'. */
        UPDATE r5forgetme
        SET    fgm_status  = N'C',
               fgm_enddate = getdate(),
               fgm_newcode = @newcode,
               fgm_code    = @newcode
        WHERE  fgm_pk = @pk
 
      FETCH NEXT FROM fgm INTO @entity, @pk, @code, @newcode
    END
  CLOSE fgm
  DEALLOCATE fgm
  IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
    COMMIT  
END

name: O7FORGETME_PROCESSCALLER
body:
CREATE PROCEDURE O7FORGETME_PROCESSCALLER
  @pk         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @code       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @newcode    NVARCHAR( 30 ) OUTPUT, 
  @errorfound NVARCHAR( 1 )  OUTPUT
AS
  DECLARE @name    NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @email   NVARCHAR( 255 )
  DECLARE @cnt     NUMERIC
  DECLARE @chk     NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @updstat NVARCHAR( 1000 )
BEGIN  
  SELECT @name  = UPPER( cll_name ), 
         @email = UPPER( cll_email )
  FROM   r5callers
  WHERE  cll_code = @code

  IF @name IS NOT NULL AND @email IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Make sure the original record is flagged as 'out of service'. */
      UPDATE r5callers
      SET    cll_notused = N'+'
      WHERE  cll_code = @code

      /* Update all tables with a caller. */
      SET @updstat = 'UPDATE r5events SET evt_srqcallname = ''xxxx'' WHERE evt_servicerequest IN ( SELECT srq_code ' + 
                     ' FROM r5servicerequests WHERE UPPER( srq_callname ) = ''' + @name + ''' AND UPPER( srq_callemail ) = ''' + @email + ''' ) '
      EXECUTE o7forgetme_executeupdate @pk, 951, @updstat, @errorfound OUTPUT
      SET @updstat = 'UPDATE r5servicerequests SET srq_callname = ''xxxx'', srq_callphone = ''xxxx'', srq_callemail = ''xxxx@x.x'' ' + 
                     ' WHERE UPPER( srq_callname ) = ''' + @name + ''' AND UPPER( srq_callemail ) = ''' + @email + ''' '
      EXECUTE o7forgetme_executeupdate @pk, 952, @updstat, @errorfound OUTPUT

      /* Audits. */
      SET @updstat = 'DELETE FROM r5audvalues WHERE ava_table = ''R5CALLERS'' AND ava_primaryid = ''' + @code + ''''
      EXECUTE o7forgetme_executeupdate @pk, 953, @updstat, @errorfound OUTPUT
  
      IF @errorfound = N'-'
        BEGIN
          /* Delete the 'forgetme' record. */
          SET @updstat = 'DELETE FROM r5callers WHERE cll_code = ''' + @code + ''''
          EXECUTE o7forgetme_executeupdate @pk, 954, @updstat, @errorfound OUTPUT
        END

    END
END

name: O7FORGETME_PROCESSCONTACTINFO
body:
CREATE PROCEDURE O7FORGETME_PROCESSCONTACTINFO
  @pk         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @code       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @newcode    NVARCHAR( 30 ) OUTPUT, 
  @errorfound NVARCHAR( 1 )  OUTPUT
AS
  DECLARE @cnt     NUMERIC
  DECLARE @chk     NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @updstat NVARCHAR( 2000 )
BEGIN  
  SET @cnt = 0
  IF @newcode IS NOT NULL
    SELECT @cnt = COUNT(*)
    FROM   r5contactinfo
    WHERE  cti_code = @newcode

  IF @newcode IS NULL OR @cnt = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @newcode = NULL
      WHILE @newcode IS NULL
        BEGIN
          /* Create new contact info record. */
          EXECUTE r5o7_o7maxseq @newcode OUTPUT, N'FGMC', N'1', @chk OUTPUT
          SET @newcode = N'XXXX-' + dbo.F_LPAD( @newcode, 5, N'0' )
          BEGIN TRY
            INSERT INTO r5contactinfo( cti_code, cti_lastname, cti_org, cti_notused )
            SELECT @newcode, N'xxxx', cti_org, N'+'
            FROM   r5contactinfo
            WHERE  cti_code = @code;
          END TRY
          BEGIN CATCH
            SET @newcode = NULL
          END CATCH
        END
    END

  /* Make sure the original record is flagged as 'out of service'. */
  UPDATE r5contactinfo
  SET    cti_notused = N'+'
  WHERE  cti_code = @code

  /* Update all tables with a contact info. */
  SET @updstat = 'UPDATE r5contactrecords
SET    ctr_contactinfoid    = ''' + @newcode + ''',
       ctr_firstname        = CASE WHEN ctr_firstname IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ''xxxx'' END,
       ctr_middlename       = CASE WHEN ctr_middlename IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ''xxxx'' END,

CREATE PROCEDURE O7FORGETME_UDFS
  @pk         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @entity     NVARCHAR( 6 ),
  @code       NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @newcode    NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @errorfound NVARCHAR( 1 ) OUTPUT
AS
  DECLARE @tablename  NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
  DECLARE @columnname NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @updstat    NVARCHAR( 1000 )
BEGIN
  /* Loop through all scheduled forgetme records. */
  DECLARE udf CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT utc_tablename, utc_columnname
    FROM   r5usertabcolumns, r5entities, r5userdefinedfieldsetup
    WHERE  ent_rentity       = udf_rentity
    AND    udf_lookuprentity = @entity
    AND    utc_tablename  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN = ent_table
    AND    utc_columnname COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN LIKE '____' + UPPER( udf_field )
  OPEN udf
  FETCH NEXT FROM udf INTO @tablename, @columnname
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @updstat = 'UPDATE ' + @tablename + ' SET ' + @columnname + ' = ''' + @newcode + ''' WHERE ' + @columnname + ' = ''' + @code + ''''
      EXECUTE o7forgetme_executeupdate @pk, 70, @updstat, @errorfound OUTPUT
      FETCH NEXT FROM udf INTO @tablename, @columnname
    END
  CLOSE udf
  DEALLOCATE udf
END

	SET NOCOUNT ON

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7FRSCHD
                 @sMRC        NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@dFrom       DATETIME
                ,@dThrough    DATETIME
                ,@sFreezeSign NVARCHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

IF @dFrom IS NULL OR @dThrough IS NULL OR @sFreezeSign IS NULL
   RETURN

UPDATE r5actschedules
   SET acs_frozen = @sFreezeSign
 WHERE ((@sMRC IS NOT NULL AND acs_mrc = @sMRC) OR @sMRC IS NULL)
   AND acs_sched BETWEEN @dFrom AND @dThrough
   AND acs_shiftschedulesession IS NULL

COMMIT

END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7FTAUDT
	@sId         integer,
	@sUser        nvarchar(255) 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sCode  nvarchar(2)
    declare @sAudit nvarchar(4)
    declare @dDate  datetime
    declare @nSQLId integer
    declare @sRent  nvarchar(4)


    if @sUser IS NOT NULL 
        set @dDate = dbo.O7GTTIME2( null )

    declare c_add cursor local for SELECT add_rentity, add_sqlidentity
                                        FROM   r5addetails, r5entities 
										WHERE  add_rentity = ent_rentity
										AND    ent_ftaudit = '+'
										AND add_sqlidentity = @sId


    open c_add 
    fetch next from c_add into @sRent, @nSQLId
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	    begin
            insert into r5detailaudit ( dta_entity, dta_rentity,
            dta_type, dta_code, dta_lang, dta_line,  dta_print,
            dta_updated, dta_upduser, dta_deleted, dta_deluser,
            dta_date, dta_text )
            select add_entity, @sRent, add_type, add_code, add_lang, add_line,
            add_print, coalesce( add_updated, add_created ), coalesce( add_upduser, add_user ),

create function dbo.O7FUELISSUEALLOWED( @sFuel          nvarchar(30),
                                        @sDepot         nvarchar(30),
                                        @sDepotorg      nvarchar(15),
                                        @sPump          nvarchar(30),
                                        @sR5user        nvarchar(255),
                                        @sVehicle       nvarchar(30),
                                        @sVehicleorg    nvarchar(15),
                                        @sPerson        nvarchar(30),
                                        @nIssueqty      numeric(24,6),
                                        @dIssuedate     datetime,
                                        @sR5role        nvarchar(30) = '*' )
returns int
as
    begin
        declare @nReturnvalue   int
        declare @sBlended       nvarchar(1)
        declare @sFuel1         nvarchar(30)
        declare @sFuel2         nvarchar(30)
        declare @sFuel3         nvarchar(30)
        declare @sFuel4         nvarchar(30)
        declare @sFuel5         nvarchar(30)
        declare @nPerc1         numeric(6,3)
        declare @nPerc2         numeric(6,3)
        declare @nPerc3         numeric(6,3)
        declare @nPerc4         numeric(6,3)
        declare @nPerc5         numeric(6,3)
        declare @nBlends        int
        declare @nBlendsdone    int
        declare @nQtydone       numeric(24,6)
        declare @sAllowneg      nvarchar(1)
        declare @sAllowover     nvarchar(1)
        declare @sExternal      nvarchar(1)
        declare @sOrgallowed    nvarchar(1)
        declare @sX             nvarchar(1)

        set @nReturnvalue = 0
        set @nQtydone = 0
        set @nBlendsdone = 0

        if @dIssuedate > dbo.o7gttime2(@sDepotorg)
            return 3

        SELECT @sAllowneg   = dep_allownegqty, 
               @sAllowover  = dep_allowoverqty,
               @sExternal   = dep_external,
               @sOrgallowed = CASE WHEN uog_org is NULL THEN N'-' ELSE N'+' END
        FROM   r5userorganization right outer join r5depots on ( uog_org    = dep_org
                                                             AND uog_user   = @sR5user
                                                             AND uog_role   = @sR5role )
        WHERE  dep_code = @sDepot
        AND    dep_org  = @sDepotorg

        if @sAllowneg is null
            return 2

        if @sOrgallowed = N'-'
            return 4

        if @sExternal = N'-' and @sPump is null
            return 5

        if not exists ( SELECT 'x'
                        FROM   r5userorganization, r5objects
                        WHERE  obj_org = uog_org
                        AND    obj_code = @sVehicle
                        AND    obj_org = @sVehicleorg
                        AND    obj_rstatus <> N'D'
                        AND    obj_notused = N'-'
                        AND  ( obj_org = @sDepotorg OR uog_common = N'+' )
                        AND    uog_user = @sR5user
                        AND    uog_role = @sR5role )
            return 6

        if @sPerson is not null
            begin
                if not exists ( SELECT 'x'
                                FROM   r5userorganization, r5personnel
                                WHERE  per_org = uog_org
                                AND    per_code = @sPerson
                                AND    per_notused = N'-'
                                AND    uog_user = @sR5user
                                AND    uog_role = @sR5role )
                    return 7
            end

        SELECT @sBlended = fue_blended,
               @sFuel1 = fue_blendfuel1, @nPerc1 = fue_blendperc1,
               @sFuel2 = fue_blendfuel2, @nPerc2 = fue_blendperc2,
               @sFuel3 = fue_blendfuel3, @nPerc3 = fue_blendperc3,
               @sFuel4 = fue_blendfuel4, @nPerc4 = fue_blendperc4,
               @sFuel5 = fue_blendfuel5, @nPerc5 = fue_blendperc5,
               @nBlends = CASE WHEN fue_blendfuel1 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
                          CASE WHEN fue_blendfuel2 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
                          CASE WHEN fue_blendfuel3 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
                          CASE WHEN fue_blendfuel4 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
                          CASE WHEN fue_blendfuel5 IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END 
        FROM   r5fuels
        WHERE  fue_code = @sFuel

        if @sBlended is null
            return 2

        if @sExternal = N'+'
            return 0

        if @sBlended = N'-'
            begin
                set @nBlends = 1
                select @nReturnvalue = returnvalue from dbo.o7fuelissueallowed_checktank ( @sFuel, 100, @nBlendsdone, @nBlends, 
                                                                                           @sDepot, @sDepotorg, @sPump, @nIssueqty, 
                                                                                           @nQtydone, @sAllowneg, @sAllowover, @nReturnvalue )
            end
        else
            begin
                if @sFuel1 is not null
                    select @nBlendsdone = blendsdone, @nQtydone = qtydone, @nReturnvalue = returnvalue 
                      from dbo.o7fuelissueallowed_checktank ( @sFuel1, @nPerc1, @nBlendsdone, @nBlends, 
                                                              @sDepot, @sDepotorg, @sPump, @nIssueqty, 
                                                              @nQtydone, @sAllowneg, @sAllowover, @nReturnvalue )

                if @sFuel2 is not null and @nReturnvalue = 0
                    select @nBlendsdone = blendsdone, @nQtydone = qtydone, @nReturnvalue = returnvalue 
                      from dbo.o7fuelissueallowed_checktank ( @sFuel2, @nPerc2, @nBlendsdone, @nBlends, 
                                                              @sDepot, @sDepotorg, @sPump, @nIssueqty, 
                                                              @nQtydone, @sAllowneg, @sAllowover, @nReturnvalue )

                if @sFuel3 is not null and @nReturnvalue = 0
                    select @nBlendsdone = blendsdone, @nQtydone = qtydone, @nReturnvalue = returnvalue 
                      from dbo.o7fuelissueallowed_checktank ( @sFuel3, @nPerc3, @nBlendsdone, @nBlends, 
                                                              @sDepot, @sDepotorg, @sPump, @nIssueqty, 
                                                              @nQtydone, @sAllowneg, @sAllowover, @nReturnvalue )

                if @sFuel4 is not null and @nReturnvalue = 0
                    select @nBlendsdone = blendsdone, @nQtydone = qtydone, @nReturnvalue = returnvalue 
                      from dbo.o7fuelissueallowed_checktank ( @sFuel4, @nPerc4, @nBlendsdone, @nBlends, 
                                                              @sDepot, @sDepotorg, @sPump, @nIssueqty, 
                                                              @nQtydone, @sAllowneg, @sAllowover, @nReturnvalue )

                if @sFuel5 is not null and @nReturnvalue = 0
                    select @nBlendsdone = blendsdone, @nQtydone = qtydone, @nReturnvalue = returnvalue 
                      from dbo.o7fuelissueallowed_checktank ( @sFuel5, @nPerc5, @nBlendsdone, @nBlends, 
                                                              @sDepot, @sDepotorg, @sPump, @nIssueqty, 
                                                              @nQtydone, @sAllowneg, @sAllowover, @nReturnvalue )
            end

        return @nReturnvalue
    end

create function dbo.O7FUELISSUEALLOWED_CHECKTANK( @sCurfuel     nvarchar(30),
                                                  @nCurperc     numeric(6,3),
                                                  @nBlendsdone  int,
                                                  @nBlends      int,
                                                  @sDepot       nvarchar(30),
                                                  @sDepotorg    nvarchar(15),
                                                  @sPump        nvarchar(30),
                                                  @nIssueqty    numeric(24,6),
                                                  @nQtydone     numeric(24,6),
                                                  @sAllowneg    nvarchar(1),
                                                  @sAllowover   nvarchar(1),
                                                  @nReturn      int)
returns @t table( blendsdone int, qtydone numeric(24,6), returnvalue int)
as
    begin
        declare @sTank          nvarchar(30)
        declare @nTankqty       numeric(24,6)
        declare @nTankvolume    numeric(24,6)
        declare @nCurrentqty    numeric(24,6)
        
        set @nBlendsdone = @nBlendsdone + 1
        if @nBlendsdone < @nBlends
            begin
                set @nCurrentqty = round( @nIssueqty * @nCurperc / 100, 6 )
                set @nQtydone = @nQtydone + @nCurrentqty
            end
        else
            set @nCurrentqty = @nIssueQty - @nQtydone

        SELECT @sTank       = tan_code, 
               @nTankqty    = COALESCE( tan_qty, 0 ), 
               @nTankvolume = tan_maxvolume
        FROM   r5tanks, r5tankpumps
        WHERE  tan_depot     = tpu_depot
        AND    tan_depot_org = tpu_depot_org
        AND    tan_code      = tpu_tank
        AND    tpu_depot     = @sDepot
        AND    tpu_depot_org = @sDepotorg
        AND    tpu_pump      = @sPump
        AND    tpu_active    = N'+'
        AND    tan_fuel      = @sCurfuel

        if @sTank is null
            set @nReturn = 2
        else
            begin
                if @sAllowneg = N'-' and @nIssueqty > 0 and @nCurrentqty > @nTankqty
                    set @nReturn = -1
                else
                    begin
                        if @sAllowover = N'-' and @nIssueqty < 0 and @nTankqty - @nCurrentqty > @nTankvolume
                            set @nReturn = 1
                    end
            end
        
        insert into @t values ( @nBlendsdone, @nQtydone, @nReturn )
        return
    end

create function dbo.O7FUELRECEIPTALLOWED( @sTank          nvarchar(30),
                                          @sDepot         nvarchar(30),
                                          @sDepotorg      nvarchar(15),
                                          @sR5user        nvarchar(255),
                                          @sSupplier      nvarchar(30),
                                          @sSupplierorg   nvarchar(15),
                                          @nReceiptqty    numeric(24,6),
                                          @dReceiptdate   datetime,
                                          @sR5role        nvarchar(30))
returns int
as
    begin
        declare @sAllowneg      nvarchar(1)
        declare @sAllowover     nvarchar(1)
        declare @sExternal      nvarchar(1)
        declare @sOrgallowed    nvarchar(1)
        declare @sX             nvarchar(1)
        declare @nTankqty       numeric(24,6)
        declare @nTankmax       numeric(24,6)

        if @dReceiptdate > dbo.o7gttime2(@sDepotorg)
            return 3

        SELECT @sAllowneg   = dep_allownegqty, 
               @sAllowover  = dep_allowoverqty,
               @sExternal   = dep_external, 
               @sOrgallowed = CASE WHEN uog_org IS NULL THEN N'-' ELSE N'+' END
        FROM   r5userorganization right outer join r5depots on ( uog_org    = dep_org
                                                             and uog_user   = @sR5user
                                                             and uog_role   = @sR5role )
        WHERE  dep_code     = @sDepot
        AND    dep_org      = @sDepotorg
        AND    dep_notused  = N'-'

        if @sAllowneg is null
            return 2

        if @sOrgallowed = N'-'
            return 4

        if @sExternal = N'+'
            return 6

        if @sSupplier is not null or @sSupplierorg is not null
            begin
                if not exists ( SELECT 'x'
                                FROM   r5userorganization, r5companies
                                WHERE  com_org = uog_org
                                AND    com_code = @sSupplier
                                AND    com_org = @sSupplierorg
                                AND    com_notused = N'-'
                                AND  ( com_org = @sDepotorg OR uog_common = N'+' )
                                AND    uog_user = @sR5user
                                AND    uog_role = @sR5role )
                    return 5
            end

        SELECT @nTankqty    = coalesce( tan_qty, 0 ), 
               @nTankmax    = tan_maxvolume
        FROM   r5tanks
        WHERE  tan_depot     = @sDepot
        AND    tan_depot_org = @sDepotorg
        AND    tan_code      = @sTank

        if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
            return 2
        else
            begin
                if @sAllowneg = N'-' and -@nReceiptqty > @nTankqty
                    return -1

                if @sAllowover = N'-' and @nReceiptqty + @nTankqty > @nTankmax
                    return 1
            end

        return 0
    end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7FUNACCESS
                 @sReturn  NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT
                ,@sFunc    NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sUser    NVARCHAR(255)
                ,@sGroup   NVARCHAR(250) /* Not used */
                ,@sClass   NVARCHAR(8)  OUTPUT
                ,@sSubType NVARCHAR(1)  OUTPUT
                ,@sFile    NVARCHAR(16) OUTPUT

AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @sFUNDirSel    NVARCHAR(1)
       ,@sFUNPublic    NVARCHAR(1)
       ,@sFUNRS        NVARCHAR(1)
       ,@nFirstPass    BIT
       ,@sFunCode      NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sUSRRequestor NVARCHAR(1)

SELECT @sUSRRequestor = usr_requestor
  FROM r5users
 WHERE usr_code = @sUser

SELECT @sFunCode = @sFunc, @nFirstPass = 0

CHECK_FUNCTION:
	SELECT @sFUNDirSel = fun_dirsel
		  ,@sFUNPublic = fun_public
		  ,@sClass     = fun_class
		  ,@sSubType   = fun_subtype
		  ,@sFile      = fun_file
		  ,@sFUNRS     = fun_rs
	  FROM r5functions
	 WHERE fun_code = @sFunCode

	IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		begin
		   IF @nFirstPass = 0
			  BEGIN
				  SET @sFunCode = NULL
				  SELECT @sFunCode = fus_function
					FROM r5funcusers
				   WHERE fus_user = @sUser
					 AND fus_shortn = @sFunc;
				  IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
					begin 
						set @sReturn = N'-5'
						RETURN
					end
				  ELSE
					 BEGIN
						 SET @nFirstPass = 1
						 GOTO CHECK_FUNCTION
					 END
			  END
		   ELSE
			begin 
				set @sReturn = N'-5'
				RETURN
			end
		end


IF @sFUNDirSel = N'-'
	begin 
		set @sReturn = N'-7'
		RETURN
	end
ELSE
	begin
		IF @sFUNPublic IS NOT NULL
			begin
				IF ISNULL(@sUSRRequestor, N'-') = N'-' or @sFunCode IN ( N'HOME', N'OLSTRU', N'SLPART', N'SLMPAR' )
					begin
						set @sReturn = @sFunCode
						return
					end
				ELSE
					begin
						set @sReturn = N'-6'
						return
					end
			end
		ELSE
		   IF (ISNULL(@sUSRRequestor, N'-') = N'+' AND ISNULL(@sFUNRS, N'-') = N'-') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
																									  FROM r5userorganization UOG
																										  ,r5permissions      PRM
																									 WHERE PRM.prm_group = UOG.uog_group
																									   AND PRM.prm_function = @sFunCode
																									   AND UOG.uog_user = @sUser)
				begin
					set @sReturn = N'-6'
					return
				end
		   ELSE
				begin
					set @sReturn = @sFunCode
					return
				end
	end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7FUNPERM
    @sCperm     	 NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
    @sFunc               NVARCHAR(6),
    @sUsr                NVARCHAR(255),
    @sAuto               NVARCHAR(1) OUTPUT,
    @sRentity            NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
    @sLastvalue          NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
    @sBackgroundrep      NVARCHAR(6) OUTPUT,
    @sBackgroundgraph    NVARCHAR(6) OUTPUT,
    @sApplication        NVARCHAR(6) OUTPUT

AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @sFunselect NVARCHAR(1)
DECLARE @sFuninsert NVARCHAR(1)
DECLARE @sFunupdate NVARCHAR(1)
DECLARE @sFundelete NVARCHAR(1)
DECLARE @sFunpublic NVARCHAR(1)	/*r5functions.fun_public%type;*/
DECLARE @sPrmselect NVARCHAR(1)
DECLARE @sPrminsert NVARCHAR(1)
DECLARE @sPrmupdate NVARCHAR(1)
DECLARE @sPrmdelete NVARCHAR(1)
DECLARE @sPrmfunc   NVARCHAR(6)	/*r5permissions.prm_function%type;*/

/* Get function data  */
SELECT @sFunselect = CASE  WHEN fun_select IS NULL THEN N'-' ELSE N'Q' END
      ,@sFuninsert = CASE  WHEN fun_insert IS NULL THEN N'-' ELSE N'I' END
      ,@sFunupdate = CASE  WHEN fun_update IS NULL THEN N'-' ELSE N'U' END
      ,@sFundelete = CASE  WHEN fun_delete IS NULL THEN N'-' ELSE N'D' END
      ,@sAuto = ISNULL(fun_auto, '-' )
      ,@sFunpublic = fun_public
      ,@sRentity = fun_rentity
      ,@sLastvalue = fun_lastvalue
      ,@sBackgroundrep = fun_backgroundrep
      ,@sBackgroundgraph = fun_backgroundgraph
      ,@sApplication = ISNULL(fun_application, fun_code)
  FROM r5functions
 WHERE fun_code = @sFunc

IF @@ROWCOUNT= 0
   BEGIN
   SET @sCperm = null
   RETURN
   END

/* Get permission */
SET @sPrmfunc = NULL
SELECT @sPrmselect = MAX(CASE  WHEN prm_select IS NULL THEN N'-' ELSE N'Q' END)
      ,@sPrminsert = MAX(CASE  WHEN prm_insert IS NULL THEN N'-' ELSE N'I' END)
      ,@sPrmupdate = MAX(CASE  WHEN prm_update IS NULL THEN N'-' ELSE N'U' END)
      ,@sPrmdelete = MAX(CASE  WHEN prm_delete IS NULL THEN N'-' ELSE N'D' END)
      ,@sPrmfunc = MAX( prm_function)
  FROM r5userorganization, r5permissions
 WHERE uog_group    = prm_group
   AND prm_function = @sFunc
   AND uog_user     = @sUsr

IF @sPrmfunc IS NOT NULL
   BEGIN
   SET @sFunselect = @sPrmselect
   SET @sFuninsert = @sPrminsert
   SET @sFunupdate = @sPrmupdate
   SET @sFundelete = @sPrmdelete
   END
ELSE IF @sFunpublic IS NULL  /* There is no permission for this function  */
   BEGIN
   SET @sCperm = NULL        /* It must be public function */
   RETURN
   END

IF @sFunselect = N'-' AND (@sFunupdate <> N'-' OR @sFundelete <> N'-')
   SET @sFunselect = N'Q'

SET @sCperm = @sFunselect + @sFuninsert + @sFunupdate + @sFundelete
END

create PROCEDURE O7GCONS
   @sPart		nvarchar(30),
   @sPartorg	nvarchar(15),
   @sStore		nvarchar(15),
   @sCons		nvarchar(1) OUTPUT,
   @sSupp		nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
   @sSupporg	nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
   @sChk		nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar( 4 )
	declare @sConsignment  nvarchar( 1 )--r5stock. sto_consignment%TYPE
	declare @sPrefsup      nvarchar( 30 )--r5stock. sto_prefsup%TYPE
	declare @sPrefsuporg   nvarchar( 15 )--r5stock. sto_prefsup_org%TYPE
	declare @nReturn			int

BEGIN
	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk         = N'0' 
	set @sCheckresult = NULL



	IF  @sPart IS NULL  OR  @sStore IS NULL 
		begin 
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end


   	DECLARE cUpdCons CURSOR local FOR SELECT s.sto_consignment, s.sto_prefsup, s.sto_prefsup_org
									   FROM   r5stock     s
									   WHERE  s.sto_part     = @sPart
									   AND    s.sto_part_org = @sPartorg
									   AND    s.sto_store    = @sStore


	OPEN cUpdCons
	FETCH NEXT FROM cUpdCons INTO @sConsignment, @sPrefsup, @sPrefsuporg
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			if @sConsignment = N'+'
				begin
					set @sCons    = N'+'
					set @sSupp    = @sPrefsup
					set @sSupporg = @sPrefsuporg
				end

			FETCH NEXT FROM cUpdCons INTO @sConsignment, @sPrefsup, @sPrefsuporg
		END
	CLOSE cUpdCons
	DEALLOCATE cUpdCons



END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GDCPLX( @sBasequery varchar(3000), @sBasequeryMO varchar(3000) )
returns bit
as
    begin
        declare @bReturn    bit
        declare @sQuery     varchar(3000)
        declare @sQueryMO   varchar(3000)

        set @sQuery = upper(@sBasequery)
        set @sQueryMO = upper(@sBasequeryMO)


        set @bReturn = 0

        if charindex( ' JOIN ', @sQuery ) <> 0 OR
           charindex( '<FIELDLIST', @sQuery ) <> 0 OR
           charindex( ' UNION ', @sQuery ) <> 0 OR
           charindex( ' DUAL', @sQuery ) <> 0 OR
           charindex( ' JOIN ', @sQueryMO ) <> 0 OR
           charindex( '<FIELDLIST', @sQueryMO ) <> 0 OR
           charindex( ' UNION ', @sQueryMO ) <> 0 OR
           charindex( ' DUAL', @sQueryMO ) <> 0
            set @bReturn = 1

        return @bReturn
    end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GDCPLX( @sBasequery varchar(4000), @sBasequeryMO varchar(4000) )
returns bit
as 
    begin
        declare @bReturn    bit
        declare @sQuery     varchar(4000)
        declare @sQueryMO   varchar(4000)

        --replacing all CRLF (ASCII 13 + ASCII 10) and TAB (ASCII 9) with space (ASCII 32)
        --replacing all commas with (space)comma(space) specially for DUAL
	set @sQuery = upper(replace((replace((replace(@sBasequery,char(9),char(32))),char(13) + char(10),char(32))),',',char(32) + ',' + char(32)))
	set @sQueryMO = upper(replace((replace((replace(@sBasequeryMO,char(9),char(32))),char(13) + char(10),char(32))),',',char(32) + ',' + char(32)))

	set @bReturn = 0

	if	charindex( ' JOIN ', @sQuery) <> 0 OR
		charindex( '<FIELDLIST', @sQuery ) <> 0 OR
		charindex( ' UNION ',@sQuery) <> 0 OR
		charindex(' DUAL ',@sQuery)  <> 0 OR
		patindex('% DUAL',@sQuery) <> 0 OR
		charindex( ' JOIN ',@sQueryMO) <> 0 OR
		charindex( '<FIELDLIST', @sQueryMO ) <> 0 OR
		charindex( ' UNION ', @sQueryMO) <> 0 OR
		charindex(' DUAL ',@sQueryMO)  <> 0 OR
		patindex('% DUAL',@sQueryMO) <> 0
	    set @bReturn = 1
	return @bReturn
    end
