CREATE procedure O7GENBUNDLEWOS	@nSessionid             numeric(18),
				@sResource              nvarchar(80),
				@sResourceName          nvarchar(1024),
				@sAccountingEnt         nvarchar(22),
				@sUser                  nvarchar(255),
				@sRangeType             nvarchar(1),
				@sDowntimeType          nvarchar(1),
				@nPriorityCount         numeric(4),
				@schk                   nvarchar(3) OUTPUT

as
        SET NOCOUNT ON

        declare @nCount			        numeric(8)
        declare @dMaxProdStart                  datetime
        declare @dMinProdStart                  datetime
	declare @dMaxProdEnd			datetime
	declare @dMinProdEnd			datetime
        declare @dToday                         datetime
	declare	@sBundleCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare	@sPriority			nvarchar(256)
        declare @nReturn                        int
	declare	@sWorkOrder			nvarchar(30)
	declare	@sWORStatus			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sWorkOrderOrg			nvarchar(15)
        
        /* set intial values */
        set @nCount = 0;
	set @sBundleCode = null;
        set @sChk = N'0'
        
        /* populate date fields end date is earliest then, set it to startdate */
	SELECT  @dMaxProdStart = max(gpr_productionstart), @dMinProdStart = min(gpr_productionstart), 
		@dMaxProdEnd = max(gpr_productionend), @dMinProdEnd = min(gpr_productionend), 
		@nCount= count(gpr_event)
	FROM r5genproductrequest
	WHERE gpr_sessionid = @nSessionid
	AND gpr_select = N'+'
	AND gpr_event is not null
	AND NOT EXISTS (select 'X' from r5eventresources where ere_event = gpr_event and ere_resource <> @sResource);
   
        IF @dMaxProdEnd < @dMinProdStart 
		SET @dMaxProdEnd = @dMinProdStart
   
	IF @dMinProdEnd < @dMaxProdStart 
		SET @dMinProdEnd = @dMaxProdStart

        /* this cursor to update WOs with bundle data */
        declare c_header cursor local for select g.gpr_event, evt_rstatus, evt_org
					  from   r5genproductrequest g, r5events
					  where  g.gpr_sessionid =@nSessionid
					  and    gpr_event = evt_code
					  and    g.gpr_select = N'+'
					  and    not exists (select 'X' from r5eventresources where ere_event = gpr_event and ere_resource <> @sResource)

        open c_header
        fetch next from c_header into @sWorkOrder, @sWORStatus, @sWorkOrderOrg
       
        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
		IF @nCount > 1 
		begin
			IF @sBundleCode IS NULL
			begin
				/* populate Production priority field value */
				IF(@nPriorityCount > 1) 
					SET @sPriority = null
			        ELSE
					SELECT DISTINCT @sPriority = gpr_prodpriority
					FROM r5genproductrequest
					WHERE gpr_sessionid = @nSessionid
					AND gpr_select = N'+'
					AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM r5eventresources WHERE ere_event = gpr_event AND ere_resource <> @sResource)
			
				execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sBundleCode OUTPUT, N'BUNDLES', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
				set @dToday = dbo.o7gttime2( @sWorkOrderOrg )
				INSERT INTO  r5genproductrequest (gpr_sessionid, gpr_select, gpr_event,
                                         			  gpr_resource,  gpr_resourcename, gpr_cooldowntime,
                                         			  gpr_warmuptime,  gpr_downtime, gpr_offset,
                                         			  gpr_offsetvalue,  gpr_operationseq,  gpr_object,
                                         			  gpr_object_org,  gpr_schedstart, gpr_schedend,
                                        			  gpr_requeststart,  gpr_requestend, gpr_accountingentity,
                                         			  gpr_created, gpr_createdby, gpr_productionstart,
                                         			  gpr_productionend, gpr_singleresourcewo, gpr_bundle, gpr_prodpriority)
				SELECT           		  @nSessionid, N'-', null, @sResource, @sResourceName,
			                                          max(gpr_cooldowntime), max(gpr_warmuptime),
                         				          case @sDowntimeType when N'S' then sum(gpr_downtime) else max(gpr_downtime) end , N'-',
			                                          null, 1, null, null, null, null, null, null,
                         			                  @sAccountingEnt, @dToday, @sUser,
			                                          case @sRangeType when N'W' then @dMinProdStart else @dMaxProdStart end,
                   				                  case @sRangeType when N'W' then @dMaxProdEnd else @dMinProdEnd end,
                 			                          N'-', @sBundleCode, @sPriority
				FROM r5genproductrequest
				WHERE gpr_sessionid = @nSessionid
				AND gpr_select = N'+'
				AND NOT EXISTS (select 'X' from r5eventresources where ere_event = gpr_event and ere_resource <> @sResource);
			end
					
		        /* now we need to update r5events table set the new production reqeust code */
			IF @sWORStatus in (N'R', N'Q')
				UPDATE r5genproductrequest set gpr_bundle = @sBundleCode, gpr_select = N'-'
				WHERE  gpr_sessionid = @nSessionid
				AND    gpr_event = @sWorkOrder
				AND    gpr_resource = @sResource
			ELSE
				UPDATE r5genproductrequest set gpr_select = N'-'
				WHERE  gpr_sessionid = @nSessionid
				AND    gpr_event = @sWorkOrder
				AND    gpr_resource = @sResource
		end
				
		/* unselect the once done */		
		UPDATE r5genproductrequest set gpr_select = N'-'
		WHERE  gpr_sessionid = @nSessionid
		AND    gpr_event = @sWorkOrder
		AND    gpr_resource = @sResource;
	
	        fetch next from c_header into @sWorkOrder, @sWORStatus, @sWorkOrderOrg
	end

        close c_header
        deallocate c_header

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GENCURVEPOINTS
  @decaycurve       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @decaycurveorg    NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @chk              NVARCHAR( 4 ) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN

  DECLARE @state  TABLE ( indx  INT, value  NUMERIC( 7, 6 ) )
  DECLARE @nstate TABLE ( indx  INT, value  NUMERIC( 7, 6 ) )
  DECLARE @weight TABLE ( indx  INT, value  NUMERIC( 7, 6 ) )
  DECLARE @states TABLE ( indx1 INT, indx2 INT, value NUMERIC( 7, 6 ) )

  DECLARE @chk2             NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @cnt              INT
  DECLARE @iterations       INT
  DECLARE @i                INT
  DECLARE @s                INT
  DECLARE @t                INT
  DECLARE @invert           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @markovchains     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @numberofstates   INT
  DECLARE @interval         NUMERIC( 18 )
  DECLARE @precision        INT
  DECLARE @condscorestart   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @newrange         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @newmin           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @newmax           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @oldrange         NUMERIC( 9, 6 )
  DECLARE @oldmin           NUMERIC( 9, 6 )
  DECLARE @pk               NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @pointvalue       NUMERIC( 18 )
  DECLARE @healthindex      NUMERIC( 9, 6 )
  DECLARE @score            NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @total            NUMERIC( 7, 6 )
  DECLARE @temp             NUMERIC( 7, 6 )
  DECLARE @dmmfromstate     NUMERIC( 7, 6 )
  DECLARE @dmmtostate1      NUMERIC( 7, 6 )
  DECLARE @dmmtostate2      NUMERIC( 7, 6 )
  DECLARE @dmmtostate3      NUMERIC( 7, 6 )
  DECLARE @dmmtostate4      NUMERIC( 7, 6 )
  DECLARE @dmmtostate5      NUMERIC( 7, 6 )
  DECLARE @dmmtostate6      NUMERIC( 7, 6 )
  DECLARE @dmmtostate7      NUMERIC( 7, 6 )
  DECLARE @dmmtostate8      NUMERIC( 7, 6 )
  DECLARE @dmmtostate9      NUMERIC( 7, 6 )
  DECLARE @dmmtostate10     NUMERIC( 7, 6 )
  DECLARE @cpdpoint         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @cpdhealthindex   NUMERIC( 9, 6 )
  /* Initialize. */
  SET @chk        = 0
  SET @pointvalue = 0

  /* Get some decay curve curve data. */
  SELECT @markovchains   = dcr_markovchains, 
         @numberofstates = dcr_numberofstates, 
         @interval       = dcr_curvepointinterval, 
         @iterations     = FLOOR( dcr_xaxis_max / dcr_curvepointinterval ), 
         @precision      = dcr_precision, 
         @condscorestart = dcr_condscorestart,
         @newrange       = ABS( dcr_condscorestart - dcr_condscoreend ), 
         @newmin         = dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( dcr_condscorestart, dcr_condscoreend ), 
         @newmax         = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( dcr_condscorestart, dcr_condscoreend ), 
         @invert         = CASE WHEN dcr_condscorestart < dcr_condscoreend THEN '+' ELSE '-' END
  FROM   r5decaycurve
  WHERE  dcr_code = @decaycurve
  AND    dcr_org  = @decaycurveorg
  IF ISNULL( @markovchains, '-' ) = '-' 
    BEGIN
      /* Decay Curve has to be flagged as 'Markov Chains'. */
      SET @chk = '1'
      RETURN
    END
  
  /* Check the sum of states. */
  SELECT @cnt = COUNT(*)
  FROM   r5decaycurvemarkovmatrix
  WHERE  dmm_decaycurve     = @decaycurve
  AND    dmm_decaycurve_org = @decaycurveorg
  AND    dmm_type           = 'T'
  AND    dmm_fromstate     <= @numberofstates
  AND    ISNULL( dmm_tostate1, 0 ) + ISNULL( dmm_tostate2, 0 ) + ISNULL( dmm_tostate3, 0 ) + ISNULL( dmm_tostate4, 0 ) + ISNULL( dmm_tostate5, 0 ) +
         ISNULL( dmm_tostate6, 0 ) + ISNULL( dmm_tostate7, 0 ) + ISNULL( dmm_tostate8, 0 ) + ISNULL( dmm_tostate9, 0 ) + ISNULL( dmm_tostate10, 0 ) <> 1
  IF @cnt > 0 
    BEGIN
      /* All records need to have the sum of all states equal to 1. */
      SET @chk = '2'
      RETURN
    END

  /* Check if weights are all the same. */
  SELECT @cnt = COUNT(*)
  FROM   r5decaycurvemarkovmatrix
  WHERE  dmm_decaycurve     = @decaycurve
  AND    dmm_decaycurve_org = @decaycurveorg
  AND    dmm_type           = 'W'
  AND    ISNULL( dmm_tostate1, 0 ) =	ISNULL( dmm_tostate2, 0 ) 
  AND    ISNULL( dmm_tostate1, 0 ) =	ISNULL( dmm_tostate3, 0 ) 
  AND    ISNULL( dmm_tostate1, 0 ) =	ISNULL( dmm_tostate4, 0 ) 
  AND    ISNULL( dmm_tostate1, 0 ) =	ISNULL( dmm_tostate5, 0 ) 
  AND    ISNULL( dmm_tostate1, 0 ) =	ISNULL( dmm_tostate6, 0 ) 
  AND    ISNULL( dmm_tostate1, 0 ) =	ISNULL( dmm_tostate7, 0 ) 
  AND    ISNULL( dmm_tostate1, 0 ) =	ISNULL( dmm_tostate8, 0 ) 
  AND    ISNULL( dmm_tostate1, 0 ) =	ISNULL( dmm_tostate9, 0 ) 
  AND    ISNULL( dmm_tostate1, 0 ) =	ISNULL( dmm_tostate10, 0 )  
  IF @cnt > 0
    BEGIN
      /* All weights cannot be the same. */
      SET @chk = '3'
      RETURN
    END

  /* Delete old curve points first. */
  DELETE FROM r5decaycurvepoints
  WHERE  cpd_dccode = @decaycurve
  AND    cpd_dcorg  = @decaycurveorg

  /* Loop through the matrix to fill the temp table. */
  DECLARE dmm3 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT dmm_fromstate, dmm_tostate1, dmm_tostate2, dmm_tostate3, dmm_tostate4, dmm_tostate5, dmm_tostate6, dmm_tostate7, dmm_tostate8, dmm_tostate9, dmm_tostate10 
    FROM   r5decaycurvemarkovmatrix
    WHERE  dmm_decaycurve     = @decaycurve
    AND    dmm_decaycurve_org = @decaycurveorg
    AND    dmm_type           = N'T'
    AND    dmm_fromstate     <= @numberofstates
    ORDER BY dmm_fromstate
  OPEN dmm3
  FETCH NEXT FROM dmm3 INTO @dmmfromstate, @dmmtostate1, @dmmtostate2, @dmmtostate3, @dmmtostate4, @dmmtostate5, @dmmtostate6, @dmmtostate7, @dmmtostate8, @dmmtostate9, @dmmtostate10 
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO @states VALUES( @dmmfromstate, 1,  @dmmtostate1 );
      INSERT INTO @states VALUES( @dmmfromstate, 2,  @dmmtostate2 );
      INSERT INTO @states VALUES( @dmmfromstate, 3,  @dmmtostate3 );
      INSERT INTO @states VALUES( @dmmfromstate, 4,  @dmmtostate4 );
      INSERT INTO @states VALUES( @dmmfromstate, 5,  @dmmtostate5 );
      INSERT INTO @states VALUES( @dmmfromstate, 6,  @dmmtostate6 );
      INSERT INTO @states VALUES( @dmmfromstate, 7,  @dmmtostate7 );
      INSERT INTO @states VALUES( @dmmfromstate, 8,  @dmmtostate8 );
      INSERT INTO @states VALUES( @dmmfromstate, 9,  @dmmtostate9 );
      INSERT INTO @states VALUES( @dmmfromstate, 10, @dmmtostate10 );
      FETCH NEXT FROM dmm3 INTO @dmmfromstate, @dmmtostate1, @dmmtostate2, @dmmtostate3, @dmmtostate4, @dmmtostate5, @dmmtostate6, @dmmtostate7, @dmmtostate8, @dmmtostate9, @dmmtostate10 
    END
  CLOSE dmm3
  DEALLOCATE dmm3

  /* Get weights. */
  DECLARE dmm4 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT dmm_tostate1, dmm_tostate2, dmm_tostate3, dmm_tostate4, dmm_tostate5, dmm_tostate6, dmm_tostate7, dmm_tostate8, dmm_tostate9, dmm_tostate10 
    FROM   r5decaycurvemarkovmatrix
    WHERE  dmm_decaycurve     = @decaycurve
    AND    dmm_decaycurve_org = @decaycurveorg
    AND    dmm_type           = N'W'
  OPEN dmm4
  FETCH NEXT FROM dmm4 INTO @dmmtostate1, @dmmtostate2, @dmmtostate3, @dmmtostate4, @dmmtostate5, @dmmtostate6, @dmmtostate7, @dmmtostate8, @dmmtostate9, @dmmtostate10 
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO @weight VALUES( 1,  @dmmtostate1 )
      INSERT INTO @weight VALUES( 2,  @dmmtostate2 )
      INSERT INTO @weight VALUES( 3,  @dmmtostate3 )
      INSERT INTO @weight VALUES( 4,  @dmmtostate4 )
      INSERT INTO @weight VALUES( 5,  @dmmtostate5 )
      INSERT INTO @weight VALUES( 6,  @dmmtostate6 )
      INSERT INTO @weight VALUES( 7,  @dmmtostate7 )
      INSERT INTO @weight VALUES( 8,  @dmmtostate8 )
      INSERT INTO @weight VALUES( 9,  @dmmtostate9 )
      INSERT INTO @weight VALUES( 10, @dmmtostate10 )
      FETCH NEXT FROM dmm4 INTO @dmmtostate1, @dmmtostate2, @dmmtostate3, @dmmtostate4, @dmmtostate5, @dmmtostate6, @dmmtostate7, @dmmtostate8, @dmmtostate9, @dmmtostate10 
    END
  CLOSE dmm4
  DEALLOCATE dmm4

  /* Initialize temp table @nstate. */
  SET @i = 1
  WHILE @i <= 10 
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO @nstate VALUES( @i, 0 )
      SET @i = @i + 1
    END
 
  /* Initialize first record. */

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GENCUSTINVWRAPPER
AS
  DECLARE @output NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @return INT
  DECLARE @cnt    NUMERIC
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO r5customerinvoicerunning( cir_date ) VALUES ( getdate() )
  WHILE 1=1 
    BEGIN
      /* Reset in progress flag, if it is older than 2 hours. */
      UPDATE r5customerinvoices
      SET    civ_inprogress = NULL
      WHERE  civ_inprogress < getdate() - ( 2.000 / 24.000 )
      /* Retrieve the number of invoices currently in regenerate process, should be 0 or 1. */
      SELECT @cnt = COUNT(*)
      FROM   r5customerinvoices
      WHERE  civ_inprogress IS NOT NULL
      IF @cnt = 0 
        BEGIN
          /* There is no regenerate process running, so execute the nightly process. */
          EXECUTE @return = o7gencustomerinvoices NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @output OUTPUT
          DELETE FROM r5customerinvoicerunning;
          BREAK
        END
      ELSE
        /* There is a regenerate process running, wait a minute and try again. */
        WAITFOR DELAY '00:01'
    END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GENCUSTINV_CALCQTYS
  @category       NVARCHAR( 4  ), 
  @datefrom       DATETIME, 
  @dateto         DATETIME, 
  @object         NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @objectorg      NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @billsource     NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @billsourceorg  NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @commodity      NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @uom            NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @invperc        NUMERIC( 7, 4 ),
  @chargeestusage NVARCHAR( 1 ), 
  @submetered     NVARCHAR( 1 ), 
  @pavgdailyusage NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @minqty         NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @rollover       NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @rolloverbuffer NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT, 
  @estqty         NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT, 
  @errorfound     NVARCHAR( 1 )    OUTPUT, 
  @qty            NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT
AS
  DECLARE @actqty        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @totqty        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @avgdailyusage NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
BEGIN
  SET @avgdailyusage = @pavgdailyusage
  SET @errorfound = N'-'
  IF @chargeestusage = N'+' AND @datefrom <= @dateto 
    BEGIN
      /* Find average daily usage. */  
      IF @avgdailyusage IS NULL
        BEGIN
          IF @category = N'USCH'
            SELECT @avgdailyusage = ISNULL( oud_dfltdailyusg, oud_calcdailyusg )
            FROM   r5objusagedefs
            WHERE  oud_object     = @object
            AND    oud_object_org = @objectorg
            AND    oud_uom        = @uom
          ELSE
            BEGIN
              IF @submetered = N'+'
                SELECT @avgdailyusage = AVG( oac_actualconsumption )
                FROM   r5objactualconsumption
                WHERE  oac_object     = @object
                AND    oac_object_org = @objectorg
                AND    oac_commodity  = @commodity
                AND    oac_date BETWEEN @datefrom - 365 AND @datefrom  
              ELSE
                SELECT @avgdailyusage = AVG( oac_actualconsumption )
                FROM   r5objactualconsumption
                WHERE  oac_object     = @billsource
                AND    oac_object_org = @billsourceorg
                AND    oac_commodity  = @commodity
                AND    oac_date BETWEEN @datefrom - 365 AND @datefrom  
              IF @avgdailyusage IS NULL
                /* Try utiliyrates. */
                SELECT @avgdailyusage = AVG( utr_avgconsumption )
                FROM   r5utilityrates
                WHERE  utr_commodity  = @commodity
                AND    utr_object     = @billsource
                AND    utr_object_org = @billsourceorg
                AND    utr_billbased  = N'+'
                AND    utr_calculatedaverage = N'+'
                AND    utr_date BETWEEN @datefrom - 365 AND @datefrom 
              SET @avgdailyusage = @avgdailyusage * ISNULL( @invperc, 100.0 ) / 100.0 
            END          
          IF @avgdailyusage IS NULL
            BEGIN
              /* If no avearge daily usage found, set error flag. */
              SET @errorfound = N'+'
              SET @estqty = 0
            END  
          ELSE  
            SET @estqty = ( datediff( DAY, @datefrom, @dateto ) + 1 ) * @avgdailyusage
        END
      ELSE  
        SET @estqty = ( datediff( DAY, @datefrom, @dateto ) + 1 ) * @avgdailyusage
    END    
  ELSE
    SET @estqty = 0

  SET @actqty = @qty
  SET @totqty = @actqty + @estqty
  IF @actqty - @rolloverbuffer < ISNULL( @minqty, -1 )
    SET @qty = @minqty
  ELSE
    SET @qty = @actqty - @rolloverbuffer

  IF @chargeestusage = N'+' AND @datefrom <= @dateto
    BEGIN
      IF @estqty > @rolloverbuffer AND @totqty > @qty
        SET @estqty = @totqty - @qty - @rolloverbuffer
      ELSE
        SET @estqty = 0
    END  
  IF @rollover = N'+'
    SET @rolloverbuffer = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( @rolloverbuffer + @qty - @totqty, 0 )
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GENCUSTINV_INSERTDETAIL
  @inv            NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @rev            NUMERIC( 8 ), 
  @org            NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @line           NUMERIC( 8 ), 
  @pqty           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @uom            NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @category       NVARCHAR( 4 ), 
  @psubcategory   NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @cdlevel        NVARCHAR( 4 ), 
  @estimatedusage NVARCHAR( 1 ), 
  @dailyusage     NUMERIC( 24, 6 ),
  @periods        NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @price          NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @fromdate       DATETIME, 
  @todate         DATETIME, 
  @event          NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @act            NUMERIC( 8 ), 
  @rent           NVARCHAR( 4 ), 
  @code           NVARCHAR( 50 ), 
  @codeorg        NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @trans          NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @transline      NUMERIC( 8 ), 
  @usewocrit      NVARCHAR( 1 ), 
  @cont           NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @contorg        NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @contrev        NUMERIC( 8 ),
  @ciipk          NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @ccdpk          NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @ccdorigpk      NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @orgcurr        NVARCHAR( 3 ), 
  @mrc            NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @invcond        NVARCHAR( 1 ), 
  @adjpercbefore  NUMERIC( 7, 4 ), 
  @adjunitprice   NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @adjtransaction NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @adjpercafter   NUMERIC( 7, 4 ), 
  @freeupto       NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @mincharge      NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @maxcharge      NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @minqty         NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @robuffer       NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @taxable        NVARCHAR( 1 ), 
  @taxcode        NVARCHAR( 20 ), 
  @taxdate        DATETIME, 
  @taxrollup      NUMERIC( 24, 6 ),
  @citexch        NUMERIC( 24, 12 ), 
  @foreigncurr    NVARCHAR( 3 ), 
  @lev            NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @adjustmentcode NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @adjustmentorg  NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @adjustmenttype NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @cadpk          NVARCHAR( 30 )
AS          
  DECLARE @grouping       NVARCHAR( 50 ) 
  DECLARE @errorcode      NVARCHAR( 50 ) 
  DECLARE @amount         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @adjustments    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @transtotal     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @corrtotal      NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @taxbase        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @taxperc        NUMERIC( 7, 4 )
  DECLARE @taxamount      NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @invamount      NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @invtaxamount   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @invoicerollup  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @actsubcat      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @subcategory    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @qty            NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @actqty         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @actprice       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @exchrate       NUMERIC( 24, 12 )
  DECLARE @chk            NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @return         INT
  DECLARE @errortext      NVARCHAR( 500 )
BEGIN
  SET @subcategory = @psubcategory
  SET @qty = @pqty
  IF @usewocrit = N'+' AND @event IS NOT NULL
      /* Determine grouping. */
    SELECT @grouping = cwc_grouping
    FROM   r5contractwocriteria, r5events
    WHERE  cwc_jobtype          = evt_jobtype
    AND    evt_code             = @event
    AND    cwc_contract         = @cont
    AND    cwc_contract_org     = @contorg
    AND    cwc_contractrevision = @contrev
    AND    cwc_jobtype         <> N'*'
    AND    cwc_grouping IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY cwc_grouping DESC

  IF @minqty IS NOT NULL AND @cdlevel = N'TR' AND @qty > 0 AND NOT ( @category = N'WOCH' AND @psubcategory = N'5' )
    /* Use minimum qty, exclude services. */
    SET @qty = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( @qty, @minqty )

  IF ISNULL( @lev, N'TR' ) = N'TR' 
    SET @amount = ISNULL( @qty, 0 ) * ISNULL( @periods, 1 ) * ISNULL( @price, 0 ) 
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      SET @amount = ISNULL( @price, 0 )
      SET @invoicerollup = @price
    END 

  IF @adjustmentcode IS NULL
    BEGIN
      IF @invcond = N'-' OR @amount > 0
        BEGIN
          /* Calculate adjustments. */
          SET @adjustments = @amount * ISNULL( @adjpercbefore, 0 ) / 100.0                              -- Adjustment perc. before
          IF @lev = N'TR'
            SET @adjustments = @adjustments + ( ISNULL( @qty, 0 ) * ISNULL( @adjunitprice, 0 ) )
          ELSE                                                                                          -- Adjustment unit price
            SET @adjustments = @adjustments + ISNULL( @adjunitprice, 0 ) 
          SET @adjustments = @adjustments + ISNULL( @adjtransaction, 0 )                                -- Adjustment transaction
          SET @adjustments = @adjustments + 
                             ( ( @amount + @adjustments ) * ISNULL( @adjpercafter, 0 ) / 100.0 )        -- Adjustment perc. after
        END
      ELSE
        SET @adjustments = 0
    END    

  SET @transtotal = @amount + ISNULL( @adjustments, 0 )

  IF ISNULL( @estimatedusage, N'-' ) = N'-' 
    BEGIN
      IF @transtotal > 0
        BEGIN
          SET @corrtotal = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( 0, @transtotal - ISNULL( @freeupto, 0 ) )              -- Apply free up to
          SET @corrtotal = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( @corrtotal, ISNULL( @mincharge, -999999999999999999 ) )-- At least charge min amt
          SET @corrtotal = dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( @corrtotal, ISNULL( @maxcharge, 999999999999999999 ) )    -- At most charge max amt
        END
      ELSE
        SET @corrtotal = @transtotal
    END  
  ELSE
    SET @corrtotal = @transtotal

  IF ISNULL( @lev, N'TR' ) = N'TR'
    SET @taxbase = @corrtotal
  ELSE
    SET @taxbase = @corrtotal - @amount
    
  IF @taxable = N'+' AND @taxcode IS NOT NULL 
    BEGIN
      /* Calculate tax. */
      SELECT @taxperc = SUM( txv_percent )
      FROM   r5taxratevalues, r5taxcoderates
      WHERE  dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @taxdate, N'DD' ) BETWEEN txv_start AND txv_end
      AND    txv_rate = tcr_rate
      AND    tcr_tax  = @taxcode
      SET @taxamount = @taxbase * @taxperc / 100.0
    END
        
  /* Set exchange rate. */
  IF @citexch IS NOT NULL
    SET @exchrate = @citexch
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      IF @foreigncurr = @orgcurr 
        /* If currencies are the same, exchange rate will be 1, obviously. */
        SET @exchrate = 1
      ELSE 
        SELECT @exchrate = crr_exch
        FROM   r5exchrates
        WHERE  crr_curr    = @foreigncurr
        AND    crr_orgcurr = @orgcurr
        AND    @taxdate BETWEEN crr_start AND crr_end
    END
    
  SET @invamount    = @taxbase * ISNULL( @exchrate, 1 )
  SET @invtaxamount = @taxamount * ISNULL( @exchrate, 1 )
    
  /* Get system ucode for USCH and OTCH. */
  IF @category = N'USCH' AND @subcategory <> N'UCU1' AND @cdlevel = N'TR'
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7rcode @actsubcat OUTPUT, @subcategory, N'CCUC', @chk OUTPUT
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @return <> 0
        BEGIN
          ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
          RETURN -1
        END
      EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @actsubcat OUTPUT, @actsubcat, N'CCUC', @chk OUTPUT
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @return <> 0
        BEGIN
          ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
          RETURN -1
        END
    END  
  ELSE IF @category = N'USCH' AND @subcategory = N'UCU1' AND @cdlevel = N'TR'
    SET @actsubcat = @subcategory
  ELSE IF @category = N'OTCH' AND @subcategory <> N'OTES' AND @cdlevel = N'TR'
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7rcode @actsubcat OUTPUT, @subcategory, N'CCOC', @chk OUTPUT
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @return <> 0
        BEGIN
          ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
          RETURN -1
        END
      EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @actsubcat OUTPUT, @actsubcat, N'CCOC', @chk OUTPUT
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @return <> 0
        BEGIN
          ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
          RETURN -1
        END
    END
  ELSE IF @category = N'WOCH'
    BEGIN
      SET @actsubcat = @subcategory
      EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @subcategory OUTPUT, @subcategory, N'CSTP', @chk OUTPUT
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @return <> 0
        BEGIN

CREATE FUNCTION O7GENCUSTINV_ROUNDMINUTES( 
  @hours         NUMERIC( 24, 6 ),
  @roundinghours NVARCHAR( 10 ) )
RETURNS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) AS 
BEGIN
  DECLARE @roundhours    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @minutes       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @calchours     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  SET @roundhours = SUBSTRING( @roundinghours, 3, 2 ) / 60.0 * 100.0 
  SET @minutes = ( @hours - CAST( @hours AS INT ) ) * 100.0
  /* Do rounding according to value in roundinghours. */
  IF @roundinghours LIKE 'UP%' 
    /* Round up. */  
    SET @calchours = CAST( @hours AS INT ) + ( ( CEILING( @minutes / @roundhours ) * @roundhours ) / 100.0 ) 
  ELSE
    /* Round down. */
    SET @calchours = CAST( @hours AS INT ) + ( ( FLOOR( @minutes / @roundhours ) * @roundhours ) / 100.0 )
  RETURN @calchours
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GENCUSTINV_SALESPRICE(
  @con      NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @conorg   NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @conrev   NUMERIC( 8 ), 
  @rent     NVARCHAR( 4 ), 
  @code     NVARCHAR( 50 ), 
  @org      NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @date     DATETIME, 
  @store    NVARCHAR( 15 ) )
  RETURNS   NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @salesprice  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @orderby     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE c_csp CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT csp_salesprice, CASE WHEN csp_store IS NULL THEN '2' ELSE '1' END
    FROM   r5contractsalesprice
    WHERE  csp_contract         = @con
    AND    csp_contract_org     = @conorg
    AND    csp_contractrevision = @conrev
    AND    csp_rentity          = @rent
    AND    csp_code          LIKE @code
    AND    csp_org              = @org
    AND    ISNULL( csp_store, ISNULL( @store, N's' ) ) = ISNULL( @store, N's' )
    AND    @date BETWEEN csp_startdate AND csp_enddate
    UNION
    SELECT esp_salesprice, CASE WHEN esp_store IS NULL THEN '2' ELSE '1' END
    FROM   r5entitysalesprices
    WHERE  esp_rentity = @rent
    AND    esp_org     = @org
    AND    esp_code LIKE @code
    AND    ISNULL( esp_store, ISNULL( @store, N's' ) ) = ISNULL( @store, N's' )
    AND    @date BETWEEN esp_dateeffective AND esp_dateexpired
    AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x'
                    FROM   r5contractsalesprice
                    WHERE  csp_contract         = @con
                    AND    csp_contract_org     = @conorg
                    AND    csp_contractrevision = @conrev
                    AND    csp_rentity          = @rent
                    AND    csp_code          LIKE @code
                    AND    csp_org              = @org
                    AND    csp_code             = esp_code
                    AND    ISNULL( csp_store, ISNULL( @store, N's' ) ) = ISNULL( @store, N's' ) 
                    AND    @date BETWEEN csp_startdate AND csp_enddate )
    ORDER BY 2
  OPEN c_csp 
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_csp INTO @salesprice, @orderby
  CLOSE c_csp
  DEALLOCATE c_csp
  RETURN @salesprice
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GENEQUIPCHECKS
  @sessionid     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @eamuser       NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @eamgroup      NVARCHAR( 12 ),
  @chk           NVARCHAR( 4 ) OUTPUT,
  @question      NVARCHAR( 1 ) OUTPUT 
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @cnt                  NUMERIC
  DECLARE @errcnt               NUMERIC
  DECLARE @warningcnt           NUMERIC
  DECLARE @chk2                 NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @deptsec              NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @jtauth               NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @status               NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @createcomm           NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @commmrc              NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @eventmrc             NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @commstatus           NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @stwo                 NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @geneqwrn             NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @active               NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @awaitingpurchase     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @processerror         NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @processrunning       NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @generatecount        NUMERIC
  DECLARE @mps                  NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @pms                  NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @egsorg               NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @parent               NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @parentorg            NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @parentrtype          NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @parentrstatus        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @parentcommon         NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @ppmstat              NVARCHAR( 100 )  
  DECLARE @workwost             NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @rtype                NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @tag                  NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @nReturn              INT

  SET @deptsec  = dbo.o7dflt2( N'DEPTSEC' )
  SET @jtauth   = dbo.o7dflt2( N'JTAUTH' )
  SET @ppmstat  = dbo.o7dflt2( N'PPMSTAT' )
  SET @tag      = dbo.o7dflt2( N'OPT_TAGS' )
  SET @chk      = N'0'
  SET @question = N'-'

  SELECT @status           = egs_status, 
         @createcomm       = egs_createcommevent, 
         @commmrc          = egs_commmrc, 
         @commstatus       = ISNULL( egs_commeventstatus, u1.uco_code ), 
         @active           = egs_active,
         @awaitingpurchase = egs_awaitingpurchase,
         @processerror     = egs_processerror,
         @processrunning   = egs_processrunning,
         @stwo             = o1.obj_configstwo, 
         @geneqwrn         = opa_desc,
         @pms              = egs_pms, 
         @mps              = egs_mps,
         @eventmrc         = egs_eventmrc,
         @egsorg           = egs_org,
         @parent           = egs_parent,
         @parentorg        = egs_parent_org,
         @parentrtype      = o2.obj_obrtype,
         @parentrstatus    = o2.obj_rstatus,
         @parentcommon     = org_common,
         @generatecount    = egs_generatecount,
         @rtype            = u2.uco_rcode
  FROM   r5organizationoptions, r5ucodes u1, r5ucodes u2, r5objects o1, r5equipconfigsessions
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects o2 ON ( o2.obj_code = egs_parent AND o2.obj_org = egs_parent_org )
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5organization ON ( org_code = egs_parent_org )         
  WHERE  egs_object          = o1.obj_code
  AND    egs_equipconfig_org = o1.obj_org
  AND    opa_code            = N'GENEQWRN' 
  AND    opa_org             = egs_org
  AND    egs_code            = @sessionid
  AND    u1.uco_rentity      = N'EVST'
  AND    u1.uco_rcode        = N'R'
  AND    u1.uco_system       = N'+'
  AND    u2.uco_rentity      = N'OBTP'
  AND    u2.uco_code         = o1.obj_configtype

  /* Set value for organization options. */
  EXECUTE @nReturn = o7getorgoption @workwost OUTPUT, N'WORKWOST', @egsorg, @chk OUTPUT 
    IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
        RETURN -1

  IF @status IS NULL
    BEGIN
      SET @chk = N'10'
      RETURN  
    END  

  IF @active = N'+' AND @processerror = N'-' 
    BEGIN
      IF @processrunning = N'+'
        BEGIN
          /* Process already running. */
          SET @chk = N'12'
          RETURN
        END
      ELSE IF @awaitingpurchase = N'+'
        BEGIN
          /* Awaiting purchase. */
          SET @chk = N'13'
          RETURN
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          /* Process already queued. */
          SET @chk = N'11'
          RETURN
        END
    END

  IF @deptsec = N'ON'
    BEGIN
      /* Check department used. */
      SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
      FROM   r5ecsessiondetails
      WHERE  csd_mrc IS NOT NULL
      AND    csd_session = @sessionid
      AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x'
                         FROM   r5departmentsecurity 
                         WHERE  dse_user     = @eamuser 
                         AND    dse_mrc      = csd_mrc
                         AND    dse_readonly = N'-' )
      IF @cnt > 0
        BEGIN
          SET @chk = N'1'
          RETURN
        END
    END

  /* Check status authorization. */
  SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
  FROM   r5auth a
  WHERE  ( a.aut_user  = @eamuser OR ( a.aut_group = @eamgroup AND a.aut_user = N'*' ) )
  AND    a.aut_status IN ( N'*', N'-' )
  AND    a.aut_rentity = N'OBJ'
  AND    a.aut_type    = N'+'
  AND    a.aut_statnew = @status
  AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                      FROM   r5auth a2
                      WHERE  a2.aut_group   = a.aut_group
                      AND    a2.aut_user    = a.aut_user
                      AND    a2.aut_status IN ( N'*', N'-' )
                      AND    a2.aut_statnew = @status
                      AND    a2.aut_rentity = N'OBJ'
                      AND    a2.aut_type    = N'-' )
  IF @cnt = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @chk = N'2'
      RETURN
    END

  /* Check Electroninc signature. */
  SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
  FROM   r5elecrec
  WHERE  elr_rentity   = N'OBJ'
  AND    elr_status    = N'-'
  AND    elr_newstatus = @status
  AND    elr_signature = N'+'
  IF @cnt > 0
    BEGIN
      SET @chk = N'14'
      RETURN
    END 

  /* Check exchange rate. */
  SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
  FROM   r5organization o1, r5organization o2, r5ecsessiondetails
  WHERE  o1.org_code  = csd_equipconfig_org
  AND    o2.org_code  = csd_org
  AND    o1.org_curr <> o2.org_curr
  AND    ISNULL( dbo.o7gtexch2( o1.org_curr, csd_org, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) ), 0 ) = 0
  AND    csd_session  = @sessionid
  IF @cnt > 0
    BEGIN
      SET @chk = N'3'
      RETURN
    END

  IF @deptsec = N'ON' AND @createcomm = N'+' AND @commmrc IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Check department used on commissioning WO. */
      SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
      FROM   r5departmentsecurity
      WHERE  dse_user     = @eamuser 
      AND    dse_mrc      = @commmrc
      AND    dse_readonly = N'-'
      IF @cnt = 0 
        BEGIN
          SET @chk = N'4'
          RETURN
        END 
    END
  
  IF @jtauth = N'YES' AND @createcomm = N'+' AND @stwo IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Check job type authorization. */
      SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
      FROM   r5jobtypeauth, r5standworks
      WHERE  jta_jobtype = stw_jobtype
      AND    jta_group   = @eamgroup
      AND    jta_insert  = N'+'
      AND    jta_status IN ( 'ALLSTATS', @commstatus )
      AND    stw_code    = @stwo
      IF @cnt = 0
        BEGIN
          SET @chk = N'5'
          RETURN
        END
    END

  IF @createcomm = N'+' AND @commstatus IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Check WO status authorization. */
      SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
      FROM   r5auth a
      WHERE  ( a.aut_user  = @eamuser OR ( a.aut_group = @eamgroup AND a.aut_user = N'*' ) )
      AND    a.aut_status IN ( N'*', N'-' )
      AND    a.aut_rentity = N'EVNT'
      AND    a.aut_type    = N'+'
      AND    a.aut_statnew = @commstatus
      AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                          FROM   r5auth a2
                          WHERE  a2.aut_group   = a.aut_group
                          AND    a2.aut_user    = a.aut_user

					@sUser               nvarchar(255),
					@sRangeType          nvarchar(1),
					@dDowntimeType       nvarchar(1),
					@schk                nvarchar(3) OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare	@nBundle	  nvarchar(30)
	declare	@sResource        nvarchar(80)
	declare @sResourceName    nvarchar(1024)
	declare @sAccountingEnt   nvarchar(22)
	declare @nPriorityCount	  numeric(4)
	declare @nResCount        numeric(4)
	declare @nReturn          int
	declare	@sLang		  nvarchar(2)


	/* set some initial values */
        set @sChk = N'0'
		
        /* get user language */
        select @sLang = usr_lang from r5users where usr_code = @sUser
		
	/* first check if bundle is part of selection and remove if so */
        declare c_bundlewos cursor local for SELECT GPR_BUNDLE
					     FROM R5GENPRODUCTREQUEST
					     WHERE GPR_SESSIONID = @nSessionid AND GPR_SELECT = N'+' AND GPR_BUNDLE IS NOT NULL
        open c_bundlewos
        fetch next from c_bundlewos into @nBundle

        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
		UPDATE R5GENPRODUCTREQUEST
		SET GPR_BUNDLE = null, GPR_SELECT = N'+'
		WHERE GPR_SESSIONID = @nSessionid AND GPR_BUNDLE = @nBundle AND GPR_EVENT is not null
		
		fetch next from c_bundlewos into @nBundle
	end
	close c_bundlewos
        deallocate c_bundlewos

	/* delete bundle record once all WOs are removed from bundle */
        declare c_bundlewos cursor local for SELECT GPR_BUNDLE
					     FROM R5GENPRODUCTREQUEST
					     WHERE GPR_SESSIONID = @nSessionid AND GPR_SELECT = N'+' AND GPR_BUNDLE IS NOT NULL
        open c_bundlewos
        fetch next from c_bundlewos into @nBundle

        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
	        DELETE FROM R5GENPRODUCTREQUEST
		WHERE GPR_SESSIONID = @nSessionid AND GPR_SELECT = N'+'
		AND GPR_EVENT IS NULL AND GPR_BUNDLE = @nBundle
			
		fetch next from c_bundlewos into @nBundle
	end
	close c_bundlewos
        deallocate c_bundlewos

	/* now loop through the resources to create actual bundle */
        declare c_header cursor local for  SELECT GPR_RESOURCE, GPR_RESOURCENAME, GPR_ACCOUNTINGENTITY,
						  COUNT(GPR_RESOURCE), COUNT(DISTINCT GPR_PRODPRIORITY)
					   FROM R5GENPRODUCTREQUEST
					   WHERE GPR_SESSIONID = @nSessionid AND GPR_SELECT = N'+' AND GPR_BUNDLE IS NULL AND GPR_SINGLERESOURCEWO = N'+'
					   GROUP BY GPR_RESOURCE, GPR_RESOURCENAME, GPR_ACCOUNTINGENTITY
					   HAVING COUNT(GPR_RESOURCE) > 1
	open c_header
	fetch next from c_header into @sResource, @sResourceName, @sAccountingEnt, @nResCount, @nPriorityCount
		
        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
		IF @nResCount > 1		
		begin
			execute @nReturn = o7genbundlewos @nSessionid, @sResource, @sResourceName, @sAccountingEnt, @sUser, @sRangeType, @dDowntimeType, @nPriorityCount, @schk OUTPUT
		end
			
		fetch next from c_header into @sResource, @sResourceName, @sAccountingEnt, @nResCount, @nPriorityCount
	end
	close c_header
        deallocate c_header
		
	/* error message for WOs which have multiple resources and tried to be bundled */
	UPDATE R5GENPRODUCTREQUEST SET GPR_ERROR = (SELECT ERT_TEXT FROM r5errtexts where ert_code = N'39229' and ert_lang = @sLang), GPR_SELECT = N'-'
	WHERE GPR_SESSIONID = @nSessionid AND GPR_SELECT = N'+' AND GPR_SINGLERESOURCEWO = N'-'

	/* now unselect all only one occurance of resource WOs */
	UPDATE r5genproductrequest set gpr_select = N'-'
	WHERE  gpr_sessionid = @nSessionid
	AND    gpr_select = N'+';

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GENERATEWOLABORSHIFTDATA @pSessionID NUMERIC(38), @pStartDate DATETIME, @pEndDate DATETIME
AS
  DECLARE @vLastDate  DATETIME;
  DECLARE @vCursorEmp NVARCHAR(15);
  DECLARE @vCurrEmp   NVARCHAR(15);
  DECLARE @vShift     NVARCHAR(4);
  DECLARE @vPatternDesc1 NVARCHAR( 1000 );
  DECLARE @vPatternDesc2 NVARCHAR( 1000 );
  DECLARE @vPatternNum   NUMERIC(38);
  DECLARE @vDPatternNum  NUMERIC(38);
  DECLARE @vPPatternNum  NUMERIC(38);
  DECLARE @vCount        NUMERIC(38);
  DECLARE @vCursorETime  NUMERIC(26,2);
  DECLARE @vCursorSTime  NUMERIC(26,2);
  DECLARE @vCursorHours  NUMERIC(24,6);
  DECLARE @vOldETime     NUMERIC(26,2);
  DECLARE @vOldSTime     NUMERIC(26,2);
  DECLARE @vOldHours     NUMERIC(24,6);
  DECLARE @vReset        BIT;

BEGIN
  SET @vLastDate = @pStartDate;
  SET @vCurrEmp = 'a';
  SET @vPatternNum = 1;

  WHILE @vLastDate <= @pEndDate
    BEGIN
      SET @vCurrEmp = 'a';

      DECLARE cShift CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT p.per_code,
               COALESCE( sd.shd_time, 0 ) stime,
               COALESCE( sd.shd_hours, 0 ) hours,
               COALESCE( sd.shd_time, 0 ) + ( COALESCE( sd.shd_hours, 0 ) * 3600 ) etime
        FROM   r5shifts     sh,
               r5shfdays    sd,
               r5wolaborschedemp w,
               r5shfpers    sp
               right outer join r5personnel  p on p.per_code = sp.shp_person
        WHERE  p.per_code = w.wlo_person
        AND    w.wlo_sessionid = @pSessionID
        AND    ( w.wlo_select  = '+' OR w.wlo_related = '+' )
        AND    w.wlo_person LIKE '%'
        AND    sp.shp_shift = sh.shf_code
        AND    sp.shp_start <= @vLastDate
        AND    sh.shf_start <= @vLastDate
        AND    sp.shp_end >= @vLastDate
        AND    sd.shd_shift = sh.shf_code
        AND    sd.shd_day = (DATEDIFF(Day, sh.shf_start, @vLastDate) % cast(sh.shf_length as integer))  + 1
        AND    p.per_notused = '-'
        AND    COALESCE( sd.shd_hours, 0 ) > 0
        ORDER BY 1, 2, 3;

      OPEN cShift
      FETCH NEXT FROM cShift into @vCursorEmp, @vCursorSTime, @vCursorHours, @vCursorETime
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          SET @vReset = 0;
          IF @vCursorEmp <> @vCurrEmp
            BEGIN
              IF @vCurrEmp <> 'a'
                BEGIN
                  INSERT INTO r5wolaborscheddaypattern ( sdp_sessionid, sdp_patternnum, sdp_patterndesc )
                  SELECT @pSessionID, @vPatternNum, @vPatternDesc1
                  FROM   dual
                  WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                                    FROM   r5wolaborscheddaypattern
                                    WHERE  sdp_sessionid = @pSessionID
                                    AND    sdp_patterndesc = @vPatternDesc1 );
                  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
                    SET @vPatternNum = @vPatternNum + 1;
                END
              SET @vPatternDesc1 = cast(@vCursorSTime as nvarchar(38)) + '-' + cast(@vCursorHours as nvarchar(38));
              SET @vCurrEmp = @vCursorEmp;
            END
          ELSE
            BEGIN
              IF @vCursorSTime <= @vOldETime
                BEGIN
                  IF @vCursorETime > @vOldETime
                    BEGIN
                      SET @vPatternDesc1 = REPLACE( @vPatternDesc1, cast(@vOldSTime as nvarchar(38)) + '-' + cast(@vOldHours as nvarchar(38)),
                                         cast(@vOldSTime as nvarchar(38)) + '-' + cast(ROUND( ( @vCursorETime - @vOldSTime ) / 3600, 2 ) as nvarchar(38)) );
                      SET @vOldETime = @vCursorETime;
                      SET @vOldHours = ROUND( ( @vCursorETime - @vOldSTime ) / 3600, 2 );
                    END
                  SET @vReset = 1;
                END
              ELSE
                BEGIN
                  SET @vPatternDesc1 = @vPatternDesc1 + '#' + cast(@vCursorSTime as nvarchar(38)) + '-' + cast(@vCursorHours as nvarchar(38));
                END
            END
          IF @vReset = 0
            BEGIN
              SET @vOldSTime = @vCursorSTime;
              SET @vOldETime = @vCursorETime;
              SET @vOldHours = @vCursorHours;
            END

          FETCH NEXT FROM cShift into @vCursorEmp, @vCursorSTime, @vCursorHours, @vCursorETime
        END

      CLOSE cShift
      DEALLOCATE cShift

      IF @vPatternDesc1 IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
          INSERT INTO r5wolaborscheddaypattern ( sdp_sessionid, sdp_patternnum, sdp_patterndesc )
          SELECT @pSessionID, @vPatternNum, @vPatternDesc1
          FROM   dual
          WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                            FROM   r5wolaborscheddaypattern
                            WHERE  sdp_sessionid = @pSessionID
                            AND    sdp_patterndesc = @vPatternDesc1 );
          IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
            SET @vPatternNum = @vPatternNum + 1;
        END
      SET @vLastDate = DATEADD(Day, 1, @vLastDate );
    END

  SET @vPatternNum = 1;

  DECLARE cEmployee CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT wlo_person
    FROM   r5wolaborschedemp
    WHERE  wlo_sessionid = @pSessionID
    AND    ( wlo_select  = '+' OR wlo_related = '+' )
    ORDER BY 1;

  OPEN cEmployee
  FETCH NEXT FROM cEmployee into @vCursorEmp
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @vLastDate = @pStartDate;
      WHILE @vLastDate <= @pEndDate
        BEGIN
          SET @vCount = 1;
          SET @vPatternDesc1 = '';

          DECLARE cShift CURSOR LOCAL FOR
            SELECT p.per_code,
                   COALESCE( sd.shd_time, 0 ) stime,
                   COALESCE( sd.shd_hours, 0 ) hours,
                   COALESCE( sd.shd_time, 0 ) + ( COALESCE( sd.shd_hours, 0 ) * 3600 ) etime
            FROM   r5shifts     sh,
                   r5shfdays    sd,
                   r5wolaborschedemp w,
                   r5shfpers    sp
                   right outer join r5personnel  p on p.per_code = sp.shp_person
            WHERE  p.per_code = w.wlo_person
            AND    w.wlo_sessionid = @pSessionID
            AND    ( w.wlo_select  = '+' OR w.wlo_related = '+' )
            AND    w.wlo_person LIKE @vCursorEmp
            AND    sp.shp_shift = sh.shf_code
            AND    sp.shp_start <= @vLastDate
            AND    sh.shf_start <= @vLastDate
            AND    sp.shp_end >= @vLastDate
            AND    sd.shd_shift = sh.shf_code
            AND    sd.shd_day = (DATEDIFF(Day, sh.shf_start, @vLastDate) % cast(sh.shf_length as integer))  + 1
            AND    p.per_notused = '-'
            AND    COALESCE( sd.shd_hours, 0 ) > 0
            ORDER BY 1, 2, 3;

          OPEN cShift
          FETCH NEXT FROM cShift into @vCursorEmp, @vCursorSTime, @vCursorHours, @vCursorETime

          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SET @vReset = 0;
              IF @vCount = 1
                BEGIN
                  SET @vPatternDesc1 = cast(@vCursorSTime as nvarchar(38)) + '-' + cast(@vCursorHours as nvarchar(38));
                  SET @vCount = 2;
                END
              ELSE
                BEGIN
                  IF @vCursorSTime <= @vOldETime
                    BEGIN
                      IF @vCursorETime > @vOldETime
                        BEGIN
                          SET @vPatternDesc1 = REPLACE( @vPatternDesc1, cast(@vOldSTime as nvarchar(38)) + '-' + cast(@vOldHours as nvarchar(38)),
                                             cast(@vOldSTime as nvarchar(38)) + '-' + cast(ROUND( ( @vCursorETime - @vOldSTime ) / 3600, 2 ) as nvarchar(38)) );
                          SET @vOldETime = @vCursorETime;
                          SET @vOldHours = ROUND( ( @vCursorETime - @vOldSTime ) / 3600, 2 );
                        END
                      SET @vReset = 1;
                    END
                  ELSE
                    BEGIN
                      SET @vPatternDesc1 = @vPatternDesc1 + '#'

create PROCEDURE O7GENINVOICE
  @sEvent                   nvarchar(30),--r5events.evt_code%TYPE,
  @sDebtor                  nvarchar(30),--r5debtors.deb_code%TYPE,
  @sOriginvoice             nvarchar(30),--r5extinvlines.eil_invoice%TYPE,
  @sOrg                     nvarchar(15),--r5organization.org_code%TYPE,
  @dFromdate                datetime,
  @dTodate                  datetime,
  @sFixedpayment            nvarchar(1),
  @sApprovecalcwo           nvarchar(1),
  @sUnapprovecalcwo         nvarchar(1),
  @sUser                    nvarchar(255),--r5users.usr_code%TYPE,
  @sUserorg                 nvarchar(15),--r5organization.org_code%TYPE,
  @sGeneratedinvoices       nvarchar(2000) OUTPUT,
  @sOutput                  nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
  @sRole                    nvarchar(30)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

    /*variables used to set the criteria for the main query. These values are derived from input parameters */
    declare @sMevent             nvarchar(30)--r5events.evt_code%TYPE 
    declare @sMdebtor            nvarchar(30)--r5debtors.deb_code%TYPE 
    declare @sMoriginvoice       nvarchar(30)--r5extinvlines.eil_invoice%TYPE 
    declare @sMorg               nvarchar(15)--r5organization.org_code%TYPE 
    declare @dMfromdate          datetime 
    declare @dMtodate            datetime 
    declare @sMfixedpayment      nvarchar(1) 
    declare @sMapprovecalcwo     nvarchar(1) 
    declare @sMunapprovecalcwo   nvarchar(1) 
    declare @sMchk               nvarchar(10) 
    declare @sMuser              nvarchar(255)--r5users.usr_code%TYPE 
    declare @sMrole              nvarchar(30)

    /*Variables to control the loop which generates lines for invoices*/
    declare @sMcurrentdebtor     nvarchar(30)--r5debtors.deb_code%TYPE 
    declare @sMcurrentorg        nvarchar(15)--r5organization.org_code%TYPE 
    declare @nMneweivcode        numeric(30)
    declare @nMnewline           numeric(8,0)
    declare @sMdebmos            nvarchar(1) 
    declare @dMcurdate           datetime

    declare @sMrecdebtor        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sMrecorg           nvarchar(15)
    declare @sMrecagreement     nvarchar(30)
    declare @nMrecagrline       numeric(8,0)
    declare @sMrecevent         nvarchar(30)
    declare @nMrecincr          numeric(4,0)
    declare @nMrecprice         numeric(24,6)
    declare @sTempVariable      nvarchar(80)

	declare @nReturn			integer
	/*variables used to set the criteria for the main query. These values are derived from input parameters */
	set @sMevent             = coalesce( @sEvent, N'%' )
	set @sMdebtor            = coalesce( @sDebtor, N'%' )
	set @sMoriginvoice       = coalesce( @sOriginvoice, N'%' )
	set @sMorg               = coalesce( @sOrg, N'%' )
	set @dMfromdate          = coalesce( @dFromdate, dbo.TO_DATE ( N'01-01-1900', N'DD-MM-YYYY' ) )
	set @dMtodate            = coalesce( @dTodate, dbo.TO_DATE ( N'31-12-2099', N'DD-MM-YYYY' ) )
	set @sMfixedpayment      = coalesce( @sFixedpayment, N'-' )
	set @sMapprovecalcwo     = coalesce( @sApprovecalcwo, N'-' )
	set @sMunapprovecalcwo   = coalesce( @sUnapprovecalcwo, N'-' )
	set @sMuser              = coalesce( @sUser, N'R5' )
	set @sMrole              = coalesce( @sRole, N'*' )
	
	--This is a hack since the Java developer could not send in null for one of the paramaters (@sOriginvoice).  He's sending in an empty string????
	If len(@sMevent) = 0 
		set @sMevent = '%'
	if Len(@sMdebtor) = 0 
		set  @sMdebtor =  N'%'
	if len(@sMoriginvoice) = 0 
		set @sMoriginvoice =  N'%' 
	if len(@sMorg) = 0 
		set @sMorg =  N'%' 
	if len(@sMfixedpayment) = 0  
		set @sMfixedpayment =  N'-' 
	if len(@sMapprovecalcwo) = 0 
		set @sMapprovecalcwo = N'-' 
	if len(@sMunapprovecalcwo) =  0 
		set @sMunapprovecalcwo  = N'-' 
	if len(@sMuser) = 0 
		set @sMuser = N'R5' 
	if len(@sMrole) = 0 
		set @sMrole = N'*' 

  

  /*Variables to control the loop which generates lines for invoices*/
  set @sMcurrentdebtor     = N' '
  set @sMcurrentorg        = N' '
  set @sMdebmos            = N'+'

BEGIN
    set @sOutput = N'0'
    set @nMneweivcode = 0
    set @sMdebmos = dbo.o7getmos( N'DEB' )

    set @sGeneratedinvoices = ''

declare c_mrec cursor local for         SELECT   f.fpa_debtor debtor, a.agr_org org, f.fpa_agreement agreement,
                                             f.fpa_line agrline, cast ( NULL as nvarchar) event,
                                             cast( NULL as numeric) incr, f.fpa_price price
                                        FROM     r5agreements a,r5fixedpayments f, r5debtors d
                                    WHERE    f.fpa_rstatus = 'A'
									    AND      a.agr_rstatus = 'A'
									AND      f.fpa_agreement = a.agr_code
                                    AND      f.fpa_debtor = d.deb_code
                                    AND      ( f.fpa_due IS NULL
                                               OR ( f.fpa_due BETWEEN @dMfromdate
                                                               AND dbo.F_GREATEST_date ( ( @dMtodate + 0.99999 ),
                                                                                 dbo.O7GTTIME2 ( deb_org )
                                                                               )

create PROCEDURE O7GENOBJ 
	@sTranscode        nvarchar(30),
	@sLang             nvarchar(2),
	@sR5group          nvarchar(12),
	@sR5user           nvarchar(255),
	@sChk              nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sAuto			nvarchar(200)
	declare @sObj			nvarchar(30)	/*r5objects.obj_code%TYPE*/
	declare @sObjorg        nvarchar(15)	/*r5objects.obj_org%TYPE; */
	declare @sX				nvarchar(20)  
	declare @sRstatus		nvarchar(4)	/*r5objects.obj_rstatus%TYPE*/   
	declare @sStatus		nvarchar(4)/*r5objects.obj_status%TYPE*/ 
	declare @sObrtype		nvarchar(4)/*r5objects.obj_obrtype%TYPE*/   
	declare @sObtype		nvarchar(4)/*r5objects.obj_obtype%TYPE*/ 
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)/*r5objects.obj_class%TYPE*/  
	declare @sClsorg		nvarchar(15)/*r5objects.obj_class_org%TYPE*/  
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sTemp			nvarchar(50)
	declare @sTempPart		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sTempPartOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sTempObjDesc	nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTempMRC		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sTempSerialNo	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sTempObjcode	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sTempObjorg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sTempObjtype	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sTempSQLID		integer
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @sTransline		integer


begin
	set @sX = null
	set @sChk  = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult = N''
	set @sClass = null
	set @sClsorg = null
	set @sRstatus = N'A'
	set @sObrtype = N'A'

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sAuto OUTPUT, N'AUTOANUM', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @sAuto = coalesce(@sAuto, N'NO')


	declare c_trans cursor local for   SELECT trl_part, trl_part_org , tla_objdesc, tla_mrc, tla_serialno, tla_objcode, tla_objorg, tla_objtype,tla_transline, trl_SQLIDENTITY
											FROM   r5translines , r5translineassets, r5parts
											WHERE  tla_transcode = trl_trans
											AND    tla_transline = trl_line
											AND    par_code = trl_part
											AND    par_org = trl_part_org
											AND    par_byasset = N'+'
											AND    trl_trans = @sTranscode
											AND    trl_object IS NULL

	open c_trans
	fetch next from c_trans into	@sTempPart, @sTempPartOrg, @sTempObjDesc, @sTempMRC, @sTempSerialNo, 
	 								@sTempObjcode,@sTempObjorg, @sTempObjtype, @sTransline, @sTempSQLID

	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			if @sAuto in (N'YES',N'+') OR @sTempObjcode IS NOT NULL
				begin
					IF @sTempObjcode IS NOT NULL
	  					set @sObj = @sTempObjcode
        			ELSE IF @sAuto in (N'YES',N'+')
					begin 
						execute @nReturn = o7getauto @sObj OUTPUT, N'AUTOOBJ', N'*',@sCheckresult OUTPUT
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							begin
								close c_trans
								deallocate c_trans
								return - 1
							end
					end
					
					IF @sTempObjtype IS NOT NULL
					begin
					    set @sObrtype = null
					    set @sObtype = @sTempObjtype
				    end
				 
				    IF @sTempObjorg IS NOT NULL
					    set @sObjorg = @sTempObjorg
				    ELSE 
					    set @sObjorg = @sTempPartOrg
				    
					execute @nReturn = o7preobj  N'INS',@sTempPartOrg,@sX OUTPUT,@sX OUTPUT,@sRstatus OUTPUT, @sStatus OUTPUT, @sObrtype OUTPUT ,@sClass OUTPUT,@sClsorg OUTPUT, '*', N'-', @sObtype OUTPUT,@sX,@sX, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
						begin
							close c_trans
							deallocate c_trans
							return - 1
						end

					if @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
						set @sChk = N'999'

					if @sTempObjDesc IS NULL 
						begin
							set @sTemp = @sTempPart + N'#'+ @sTempPartOrg
							set @sTempObjDesc = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(@sLang, N'PART', @sTempPart + N'#'+ @sTempPartOrg, NULL, NULL)
						end
					ELSE
						begin
							if @sTempMRC IS NULL 
								set @sTempMRC = N'*'
						end

					/* Stores the new object information */
					INSERT INTO r5objects ( OBJ_OBTYPE,
						OBJ_OBRTYPE,
						OBJ_CODE,
						OBJ_DESC,
						OBJ_DEPend,
						OBJ_MRC,
						OBJ_STATUS,
						OBJ_RSTATUS,
						OBJ_STATE,
						OBJ_RSTATE,
						OBJ_GROUP,
						OBJ_USER,
						OBJ_PRODUCTION,
						OBJ_NOTUSED,
						OBJ_SAFETY,
						OBJ_ORG,
						OBJ_PART,
						OBJ_PART_ORG,
						OBJ_SERIALNO )
					VALUES ( @sObtype,
						@sObrtype,
						@sObj,
						@sTempObjDesc,
						N'-',
						@sTempMRC,
						@sStatus,
						@sRstatus,
						N'GOOD',
						N'GOOD',
						@sR5group,
						@sR5user,
						N'+',
						N'-',
						N'-',
						@sObjorg,
						@sTempPart,
						@sTempPartOrg,
						@sTempSerialNo ) 
					/* Updating the r5translines for the lines which doesn't have object code specified */
					UPDATE r5translines
					SET trl_obtype =@sObtype,
						trl_obrtype =@sObrtype,
						trl_object = @sObj,
						trl_object_org = @sObjorg
					WHERE trl_SQLIDENTITY = @sTempSQLID

					DELETE FROM r5translineassets
					WHERE tla_transcode = @sTranscode
					AND tla_transline = @sTransline
				end
			  ELSE
				  begin
					if @sAuto in (N'NO', N'-') and @sObj is null
						set @sChk = N'1'
				  end

			fetch next from c_trans into @sTempPart, @sTempPartOrg, @sTempObjDesc, @sTempMRC, @sTempSerialNo, @sTempObjcode,
	 									 @sTempObjorg, @sTempObjtype, @sTransline, @sTempSQLID

		end

	close c_trans
	deallocate c_trans


end

create procedure O7GENPRODUCTIONREQUEST @nSessionid             numeric(18),
                                        @sStatus                nvarchar(4),
                                        @sUser                  nvarchar(255),
                                        @nRowProcessed          int OUTPUT,
                                        @sChk                   nvarchar(3) OUTPUT

as
        SET NOCOUNT ON

        declare @sWorkOrder                         nvarchar(30)
        declare @sWorkOrderOrg                      nvarchar(15)
        declare @sWorkOrderDesc                     nvarchar(80)
        declare @sMinProdRequest                    nvarchar(30)
        declare @sMaxProdRequest                    nvarchar(30)
        declare @sResourceCode                      nvarchar(80)
        declare @sProdReqResourceKey                nvarchar(30)
        declare @sProdRequestCode                   nvarchar(30)
        declare @sProdPriority                      nvarchar(256)
        declare @sAccountingEntity                  nvarchar(22)
        declare @sOffSet                            nvarchar(1)
        declare @sRStatus                           nvarchar(4)
        declare @sLang                              nvarchar(2)
        declare @nOperationSeq                      numeric(8)
        declare @nCoolDownTime                      numeric(7,2)
        declare @nWarmupTime                        numeric(7,2)
        declare @nDownTime                          numeric(7,2)
        declare @nOffSetValue                       numeric(7,2)
        declare @dRequestStart                      datetime
        declare @dRequestEnd                        datetime
        declare @dToday                             datetime
        declare @nReturn                            int
        declare @sWORStatus                         nvarchar(4)
        declare @sProductionRequestRStatus          nvarchar(4)
	declare	@sBundle			    nvarchar(30)
        declare @dProdStartDate                     datetime
        declare @dProdEndDate                       datetime
        
        
        /* set intial values */
        set @sMinProdRequest = null;
        set @sChk = N'0'
        set @nRowProcessed  = 0;
        
        /* get rstatus */
        execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sRStatus OUTPUT, @sStatus,  N'PQST', @sChk OUTPUT
                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                return -1

        /* get user language */
        select @sLang = usr_lang from r5users where usr_code = @sUser
        
        
       /* get the work orders */
       declare c_header cursor local for select distinct g.gpr_event,
                                                         e.evt_org,
                                                         e.evt_rstatus,
                                                         r.prq_rstatus,
                                                         e.evt_prodpriority,
                                                         g.gpr_requeststart,
                                                         g.gpr_requestend
                                         from            r5genproductrequest g,
                                         		 r5events e left outer join r5productionrequests r 
                                         		 on (r.prq_code = e.evt_productionrequest  and r.prq_revision = e.evt_productionrequestrev and r.prq_org = e.evt_productionrequest_org)
                                         where           g.gpr_sessionid =@nSessionid
                                         and             g.gpr_select = N'+'
                                         and             e.evt_code = g.gpr_event
       open c_header
       fetch next from c_header into @sWorkOrder, @sWorkOrderOrg,@sWORStatus, @sProductionRequestRStatus,@sProdPriority, @dRequestStart, @dRequestEnd
       
       while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin
                if @sWORStatus in (N'R', N'Q')  and (@sProductionRequestRStatus is null or @sProductionRequestRStatus not in (N'U', N'A'))
                begin
                        execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sProdRequestCode OUTPUT, N'PRQ', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
                        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        begin
                                close c_header
                                deallocate c_header
                                RETURN  -1
                        end
                        IF @sChk <> N'0'
                        begin
                         close c_header
                        deallocate c_header
                        return -1 
                        end
                
                        /* Get the current time */
                        set @dToday = dbo.o7gttime2( @sWorkOrderOrg )
                        /* get work order description */
                        set @sWorkOrderDesc = dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@sLang,N'EVNT', @sWorkOrder,null,null )
                
                        /* now create the production request header */
                        insert into r5productionrequests (      prq_code,
                                                                prq_revision,
                                                                prq_desc,
                                                                prq_org,
                                                                prq_event,
                                                                prq_status,
                                                                prq_rstatus,
                                                                prq_priority,
                                                                prq_prodrequeststart,
                                                                prq_prodrequestend,
                                                                prq_created,
                                                                prq_createdby)
                        values (@sProdRequestCode,
                                0,
                                @sWorkOrderDesc,
                                @sWorkOrderOrg,
                                @sWorkOrder,
                                @sStatus,
                                @sRStatus,
                                @sProdPriority,
                                @dRequestStart,
                                @dRequestEnd,
                                @dToday,
                                @sUser)
                end
                /* now we need to create the  resources for production request */
                declare c_resource cursor local for select  gpr_resource,
                                                            gpr_operationseq,
                                                            gpr_cooldowntime,
                                                            gpr_warmuptime,
                                                            gpr_downtime,
                                                            gpr_offset,
                                                            gpr_offsetvalue,
                                                            gpr_accountingentity
                                                    from    r5genproductrequest
                                                    where   gpr_sessionid =@nSessionid
                                                    and     gpr_event = @sWorkOrder
                                                    
                open c_resource
                fetch next from c_resource into @sResourceCode, @nOperationSeq, @nCoolDownTime, @nWarmupTime, @nDownTime, @sOffSet, @nOffSetValue, @sAccountingEntity
                while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                                set @nRowProcessed  = @nRowProcessed

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GENRESLOAD
    @nSessionid        NUMERIC(18,0),
    @dStartdate        DATETIME,
    @dEnddate          DATETIME,
    @sChk              NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON

	/* Storage for cursor c_getacts */
    DECLARE @sActsTrade      NVARCHAR(15)  /* R5ACTIVITIES.ACT_TRADE%TYPE */
    DECLARE @dActsDuedate    DATETIME
    DECLARE @nActsDuration   NUMERIC(8,0)  /* R5ACTIVITIES.ACT_DURATION%TYPE */
    DECLARE @nActsEstHours   NUMERIC(24,6) /* R5ACTIVITIES.ACT_EST%TYPE */
    DECLARE @nActsStartAdj   NUMERIC(3,0)  /* R5PPMACTS.PPA_EST%TYPE */

    /* Other variables for calculations */
    DECLARE @dCurEnddate     DATETIME
    DECLARE @dDuedate        DATETIME
    DECLARE @nAvghours       NUMERIC(24,12)  /* Hours averaged across the duration of the activity */

BEGIN
    SET @sChk = N'0'

    /* Check for missing parameters */
    IF @nSessionid IS NULL OR @dStartdate IS NULL OR @dEnddate IS NULL
    BEGIN
      SET @sChk = N'1'
      RETURN -1
    END

    /* Clear resource load table for this session */
    DELETE FROM R5PMFORECASTRESLOAD where PFT_SESSIONID = @nSessionid

    /* Define Cursor to fetch activity information for each PM and WO in the planning session */
    DECLARE c_getacts CURSOR local FOR
      SELECT CASE WHEN ppd_workorder IS NULL THEN COALESCE(ppa_trade, tsk_trade, tat_trade) ELSE act_trade END trade, dbo.f_trunc_date(ppd_duedate, N'DD') duedate, CASE WHEN ppd_workorder IS NULL THEN ppa_duration ELSE act_duration END duration, SUM(CASE WHEN ppd_workorder IS NULL THEN COALESCE(ppa_est, tsk_hours, 0) ELSE COALESCE(act_est, 0) END) esthours, CASE WHEN ppd_workorder IS NULL THEN ppa_start ELSE 1 END startadjust
      FROM r5pmplansession
        INNER JOIN r5pmpsessiondates
          ON pps_sessionid = @nSessionid
          AND ppd_ppspk = pps_pk
          AND ppd_duedate >= @dStartdate
          AND ppd_duedate <= @dEnddate
        LEFT OUTER JOIN r5ppmobjects
          ON ppo_pk = pps_ppopk
          AND ppo_revision = pps_pmrevision
        LEFT OUTER JOIN r5ppmacts
          ON ppo_ppm = ppa_ppm
          AND ppo_revision = ppa_revision
        LEFT OUTER JOIN r5tasks
          ON tsk_code = ppa_task
          AND tsk_revrstatus = 'A'
        LEFT OUTER JOIN r5tasktrades
          ON (tat_task = tsk_code AND tat_revision = tsk_revision )
        LEFT OUTER JOIN r5activities
          ON ppd_workorder = act_event
      AND (ppd_workorder IS NULL OR EXISTS (select 1 from r5events where evt_code = ppd_workorder and evt_rstatus = 'R'))
      GROUP BY CASE WHEN ppd_workorder IS NULL THEN COALESCE(ppa_trade, tsk_trade, tat_trade) ELSE act_trade END, dbo.f_trunc_date(ppd_duedate, N'DD'), CASE WHEN ppd_workorder IS NULL THEN ppa_duration ELSE act_duration END, CASE WHEN ppd_workorder IS NULL THEN ppa_start ELSE 1 END
      HAVING CASE WHEN ppd_workorder IS NULL THEN COALESCE(ppa_trade, tsk_trade, tat_trade) ELSE act_trade END IS NOT NULL;

    /* Loop through cursor for PM and WO activities -
       Each returned record represents an activity (either from the PM or
       WO) for which we need to insert records into the temp table based
       on the start and end dates of the activity and the est hours averaged
       over the duration.  The start dates for the activities come from the
       PM forecasting session. */
    OPEN c_getacts
    FETCH next FROM c_getacts into @sActsTrade, @dActsDuedate, @nActsDuration, @nActsEstHours,  @nActsStartAdj

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        SET @dDuedate = @dActsDuedate + (@nActsStartAdj - 1)
        SET @dCurEnddate = @dDuedate + (@nActsDuration - 1)
        SET @nAvghours = @nActsEstHours/@nActsDuration /* duration must be >= 1 and not null by constraint */

        /* One record gets inserted to the temp table for each date in the
           activity's duration, but only if that date falls within the given date range. */
        WHILE @dDuedate <= @dCurEnddate AND @dDuedate <= @dEnddate
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO R5PMFORECASTRESLOAD (PFT_SESSIONID, PFT_TRADE, PFT_DATE, PFT_HOURS)
            VALUES( @nSessionid, @sActsTrade, @dDuedate, @nAvghours )

			/* Increment due date to the next day */
            SET @dDuedate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @dDuedate)
        END /* while loop */

        /* Fetch next record from cursor */
        FETCH next FROM c_getacts into @sActsTrade, @dActsDuedate, @nActsDuration, @nActsEstHours,  @nActsStartAdj
    END /* for loop */

    /* Close cursor */
    CLOSE c_getacts
    DEALLOCATE c_getacts


    /* Define Cursor to fetch unique trades in the temp table for the given sessionid */
    DECLARE c_uniquetrades CURSOR local FOR
      SELECT DISTINCT pft_trade trade
      FROM R5PMFORECASTRESLOAD
      WHERE pft_sessionid = @nSessionid

    /* At this point, the temp table contains trade records for all PM and WO Activities, but
       only on specific dates. For the data to be meaningful in the frontend, we need to fill
       in this table with ALL dates in the date range, but these dates will have zero hours.
       This temp table is designed to have multiple records for each trade, date combination,
       so we will just create additional records (with 0 est hrs) in this table for each unique
       trade and on each date in the date range. */
    OPEN c_uniquetrades
    FETCH next FROM c_uniquetrades into @sActsTrade

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	 BEGIN
        /* Loop through each date in the date range for this trade inserting a record with 0
           hrs for each one. */
        SET @dDuedate = @dStartdate

        WHILE @dDuedate <= @dEnddate
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO R5PMFORECASTRESLOAD (PFT_SESSIONID, PFT_TRADE, PFT_DATE, PFT_HOURS)
            VALUES( @nSessionid, @sActsTrade, @dDuedate, 0 )

			/* Increment due date to the next day */
            SET @dDuedate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @dDuedate)
        END /* while loop */

        /* Fetch next record from cursor */
        FETCH next FROM c_uniquetrades into @sActsTrade
    END /* for loop */

    /* Close cursor */
    CLOSE c_uniquetrades
    DEALLOCATE c_uniquetrades

END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETACT (@sEvent NVARCHAR(30), @sSpecial NVARCHAR(30), @sSupplierCode nvarchar(30), @sSupplierOrganization nvarchar(15)) RETURNS NUMERIC(8, 0)
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @nAct NUMERIC(8, 0)

IF @sSpecial IS NULL 
	begin
		SELECT @nAct = act_act
		  FROM r5activities
		 WHERE act_event = @sEvent
		 AND   act_defermaintenance=N'-'
		 AND   act_act > 0 
		 AND   1 = (select count(*) FROM r5activities WHERE act_event = @sEvent and act_defermaintenance=N'-' and act_act > 0 )
		IF @@ROWCOUNT != 1
		   SET @nAct = NULL
	end
else
	begin
		if @sSpecial = N'Services on Reqs'
			begin
				SELECT @nAct = act_act
				FROM r5activities a
				WHERE a.act_event = @sEvent
				AND   a.act_hire = N'+'
				AND   a.act_defermaintenance=N'-'
				AND   a.act_act > 0 
				AND   ( a.act_order IS NULL AND a.act_req IS NULL )
				AND   coalesce(coalesce( CASE a.act_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN ( CASE a.act_supplier_org WHEN N'*' THEN NULL ELSE a.act_supplier END ) ELSE a.act_supplier END , @sSupplierCode ),N'x') = coalesce(coalesce(@sSupplierCode,CASE a.act_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN (CASE a.act_supplier_org WHEN N'*' THEN NULL ELSE a.act_supplier END) ELSE a.act_supplier END),N'x')
				AND   coalesce(coalesce( CASE a.act_supplier_org WHEN N'*' THEN ( CASE a.act_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN NULL ELSE a.act_supplier_org END ) ELSE a.act_supplier_org END , @sSupplierOrganization ),N'x') = coalesce(coalesce(@sSupplierOrganization, CASE a.act_supplier_org WHEN N'*' THEN (CASE a.act_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN NULL ELSE a.act_supplier_org END) ELSE a.act_supplier_org END ),N'x')
				AND   1 = ( select count(*) FROM r5activities a1
							WHERE a1.act_event = @sEvent
							AND   a1.act_hire = N'+'
							AND   a1.act_defermaintenance=N'-'
							AND   a1.act_act > 0 
							AND   ( a1.act_order IS NULL AND a1.act_req IS NULL )
							AND   coalesce(coalesce( CASE a1.act_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN ( CASE a1.act_supplier_org WHEN N'*' THEN NULL ELSE a1.act_supplier END ) ELSE a1.act_supplier END, @sSupplierCode ),N'x') = coalesce(coalesce(@sSupplierCode,CASE a1.act_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN (CASE a1.act_supplier_org WHEN N'*' THEN NULL ELSE a1.act_supplier END) ELSE a1.act_supplier END),N'x')
							AND   coalesce(coalesce( CASE a1.act_supplier_org WHEN N'*' THEN ( CASE a1.act_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN NULL ELSE a1.act_supplier_org END ) ELSE a1.act_supplier_org END, @sSupplierOrganization ),'x') = coalesce(coalesce(@sSupplierOrganization, CASE a1.act_supplier_org WHEN N'*' THEN ( CASE a1.act_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN NULL ELSE a1.act_supplier_org END) ELSE a1.act_supplier_org END ),N'x') )

				IF @@ROWCOUNT != 1
				   SET @nAct = NULL
			end
		else
			begin
				if @sSpecial = N'Services on POs'
					begin
						SELECT @nAct = act_act
						FROM r5activities a
						WHERE a.act_event = @sEvent
						AND   a.act_hire = N'+'
						AND   a.act_defermaintenance=N'-'
						AND   a.act_act > 0 
						AND   ( a.act_order IS NULL AND a.act_req IS NULL )
						AND   coalesce( CASE a.act_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN ( CASE a.act_supplier_org WHEN N'*' THEN NULL ElSE a.act_supplier END) ELSE a.act_supplier END , @sSupplierCode ) = @sSupplierCode
						AND   coalesce( CASE a.act_supplier_org WHEN N'*' THEN ( CASE a.act_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN NULL ELSE a.act_supplier_org END) ELSE a.act_supplier_org END, @sSupplierOrganization ) = @sSupplierOrganization
						AND   1 = ( select count(*) FROM r5activities a1
									WHERE a1.act_event = @sEvent
									AND   a1.act_hire = N'+'
									AND   a1.act_defermaintenance=N'-'
									AND   a1.act_act > 0
									AND   ( a1.act_order IS NULL AND a1.act_req IS NULL )
									AND   coalesce( CASE a1.act_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN ( CASE a1.act_supplier_org WHEN N'*' THEN NULL ELSE a1.act_supplier END) ELSE a1.act_supplier END, @sSupplierCode ) = @sSupplierCode
									AND   coalesce( CASE a1.act_supplier_org WHEN N'*' THEN ( CASE a1.act_supplier WHEN N'*' THEN NULL ELSE a1.act_supplier_org END) ELSE a1.act_supplier_org END, @sSupplierOrganization ) = @sSupplierOrganization )


						IF @@ROWCOUNT != 1
						   SET @nAct = NULL
					end
			end

	end

RETURN @nAct
END

CREATE FUNCTION o7getactdesc(
  @event        NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @activity     NUMERIC( 8 ),
  @topparent    NUMERIC( 8 ),
  @trade        NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @note         NVARCHAR( 256 ),
  @orgoption    NVARCHAR( 100 ),
  @lang         NVARCHAR( 2 ) )
RETURNS NVARCHAR( 100 ) AS  
BEGIN 
  DECLARE @actact    NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @acttrade  NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @actnote   NVARCHAR( 80 )

  IF @topparent IS NOT NULL
    /* Get parent activity data. */
    SELECT @actact   = CAST( act_act AS NVARCHAR ), 
           @acttrade = act_trade, 
           @actnote  = act_note
    FROM   r5activities
    WHERE  act_event = @event
    AND    act_act   = @topparent
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      /* Use activity data. */
      SET @actact   = CAST( @activity AS NVARCHAR )
      SET @acttrade = @trade
      SET @actnote  = @note
    END  

  IF @orgoption = N'NOTE'
    BEGIN
      IF @actnote IS NOT NULL
        RETURN @actact + N' - ' + @actnote
    END    
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      IF @acttrade IS NOT NULL 
        RETURN @actact + N' - ' + dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang, N'TRAD', @acttrade, NULL, NULL )
    END
  RETURN @actact  
END

	select @nCount = Count(*)
