CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETACTWARRANTY(
  @event             NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @syslevel          NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @asmlevel          NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @complevel         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @reasonforrepair   NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @workaccomplished  NVARCHAR( 4 ) )
  RETURNS            NVARCHAR( 1 ) AS
BEGIN

  DECLARE @object       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objectorg    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @due          DATETIME 
  DECLARE @meterdue     NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @metuom       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @meterdue2    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @metuom2      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @wowarranty   NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @warranty     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @evtorg       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  /* Retrieve event data. */
  SELECT @object     = evt_object, 
         @objectorg  = evt_object_org, 
         @due        = evt_due, 
         @meterdue   = evt_meterdue, 
         @metuom     = evt_metuom, 
         @meterdue2  = evt_meterdue2, 
         @metuom2    = evt_metuom2,
         @wowarranty = evt_warranty,
	 @evtorg     = evt_org
  FROM   r5events
  WHERE  evt_code = @event
  AND    ( evt_due IS NOT NULL OR evt_meterdue IS NOT NULL OR evt_meterdue2 IS NOT NULL )

  IF @wowarranty = N'+'
    /* If the WO is under warranty, then the activity is too. */
    RETURN '+'
  
  IF @due IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Check for calendar warranty. */
      SELECT @warranty = N'+'
      FROM   r5organization, r5documents, r5warcoverages
      WHERE  doc_code       = wcv_warranty
      AND    org_code       = doc_org
      AND    wcv_object     = @object
      AND    wcv_object_org = @objectorg
      AND    wcv_active     = '+'
      AND    wcv_uom        IS NULL
      AND    (doc_org = @evtorg OR org_common = N'+')
      AND    ISNULL( doc_excludepmworkorder, N'-' ) = N'-'
      AND    @due BETWEEN ISNULL( wcv_startdate, @due ) AND COALESCE( wcv_expirationdate, @due )
      AND    EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                      FROM   r5warcomponents
                      WHERE  wcm_warranty = wcv_warranty
                      AND    wcm_syslevel = @syslevel
                      AND    ISNULL( ISNULL( wcm_asmlevel, @asmlevel ), N'xz' )                 = ISNULL( @asmlevel, N'xz' )
                      AND    ISNULL( ISNULL( wcm_complevel, @complevel ), N'xz' )               = ISNULL( @complevel, N'xz' ) 
                      AND    ISNULL( ISNULL( wcm_reansonforrepair, @reasonforrepair ), N'xz' )  = ISNULL( @reasonforrepair, N'xz' ) 
                      AND    ISNULL( ISNULL( wcm_workaccomplished, @workaccomplished ), N'xz' ) = ISNULL( @workaccomplished, N'xz' ) )
      IF @warranty = N'+'
        /* There is a warranty, so return. */
        RETURN '+'
    END

  IF @meterdue IS NOT NULL AND @metuom IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Check for usage warranty. */
      SELECT @warranty = N'+'
      FROM   r5organization, r5documents, r5warcoverages
      WHERE  doc_code       = wcv_warranty
      AND    org_code       = doc_org
      AND    wcv_object     = @object
      AND    wcv_object_org = @objectorg
      AND    wcv_uom        = @metuom
      AND    wcv_active     = N'+'
      AND    ISNULL( doc_excludepmworkorder, N'-' ) = N'-'
      AND    (doc_org = @evtorg OR org_common = N'+')
      AND    @meterdue BETWEEN ISNULL( wcv_startusage, @meterdue ) AND COALESCE( wcv_expiration, @meterdue )
      AND    EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                      FROM   r5warcomponents
                      WHERE  wcm_warranty = wcv_warranty
                      AND    wcm_syslevel = @syslevel
                      AND    ISNULL( ISNULL( wcm_asmlevel, @asmlevel ), N'xz' )                 = ISNULL( @asmlevel, N'xz' )
                      AND    ISNULL( ISNULL( wcm_complevel, @complevel ), N'xz' )               = ISNULL( @complevel, N'xz' ) 
                      AND    ISNULL( ISNULL( wcm_reansonforrepair, @reasonforrepair ), N'xz' )  = ISNULL( @reasonforrepair, N'xz' ) 
                      AND    ISNULL( ISNULL( wcm_workaccomplished, @workaccomplished ), N'xz' ) = ISNULL( @workaccomplished, N'xz' ) )
      IF @warranty = N'+'
        /* There is a warranty, so return. */
        RETURN '+'
    END

  IF @meterdue2 IS NOT NULL AND @metuom2 IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Check for usage warranty. */
      SELECT @warranty = N'+'
      FROM   r5organization, r5documents, r5warcoverages
      WHERE  doc_code       = wcv_warranty
      AND    org_code       = doc_org
      AND    wcv_object     = @object
      AND    wcv_object_org = @objectorg
      AND    wcv_uom        = @metuom2
      AND    wcv_active     = N'+'
      AND    (doc_org = @evtorg OR org_common = N'+')
      AND    ISNULL( doc_excludepmworkorder, N'-' ) = N'-'
      AND    @meterdue2 BETWEEN ISNULL( wcv_startusage, @meterdue2 ) AND ISNULL( wcv_expiration, @meterdue2 )
      AND    EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
                      FROM   r5warcomponents
                      WHERE  wcm_warranty = wcv_warranty
                      AND    wcm_syslevel = @syslevel
                      AND    ISNULL( ISNULL( wcm_asmlevel, @asmlevel ), N'xz' )                 = ISNULL( @asmlevel, N'xz' )
                      AND    ISNULL( ISNULL( wcm_complevel, @complevel ), N'xz' )               = ISNULL( @complevel, N'xz' ) 
                      AND    ISNULL( ISNULL( wcm_reansonforrepair, @reasonforrepair ), N'xz' )  = ISNULL( @reasonforrepair, N'xz' ) 
                      AND    ISNULL( ISNULL( wcm_workaccomplished, @workaccomplished ), N'xz' ) = ISNULL( @workaccomplished, N'xz' ) )
      IF @warranty = N'+'
        /* There is a warranty, so return. */
        RETURN '+'
    END

  RETURN '-'

END

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETADDRESS(
  @rentity NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @code    NVARCHAR( 50 ) ) 
  RETURNS  NVARCHAR( 2000 ) 
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @text NVARCHAR( 2000 )
  DECLARE adr CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT adr_text
    FROM   r5address
    WHERE  adr_rentity = @rentity
    AND    adr_code    = @code
    ORDER BY CASE adr_rtype WHEN N'M' THEN N'1' WHEN N'D' THEN N'2' WHEN N'I' THEN N'3' END
  OPEN  adr
  FETCH NEXT FROM adr INTO @text
  CLOSE adr
  RETURN( @text )
END

create function O7GETAGR_GET_OBJ_HIERARCHY (@sLocation nvarchar(30), @sOrg nvarchar(15))
returns @tReturn table( obj_code nvarchar(65) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
                        LevelID  int )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel				int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode		nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sCurrentOrg		nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @sCurrentParent		nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sCurrentParentOrg	nvarchar(15)
		
	declare @tStack table ( obj_code nvarchar(30), obj_org nvarchar(15), obj_parent nvarchar(30), obj_parent_org nvarchar(15), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select obj_code, obj_org, obj_parent, obj_parent_org, 1 
						from r5objects
						where obj_code = @sLocation and obj_org = @sOrg
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCurrentCode		= obj_code,
							@sCurrentOrg		= obj_org,
							@sCurrentParent		= obj_parent,
							@sCurrentParentOrg	= obj_parent_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode + N'#' + @sCurrentOrg, @nLevel )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND obj_code = @sCurrentCode and obj_org = @sCurrentOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	obj_code, obj_org, obj_parent, obj_parent_org, @nLevel + 1
										  from	r5objects
										 where	obj_code	= @sCurrentParent and 
												obj_org		= @sCurrentParentOrg
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create function O7GETAGR_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY (@sCode nvarchar(20))
returns @tReturn table( prj_code nvarchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, LevelID integer )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(20)
		
	declare @tStack table ( prj_code nvarchar(20), LevelID int )
	
    --Add condition to keep null parents from being added.  Causes infinite loop below
	INSERT INTO @tStack select prj_parent, 1 from r5projects where prj_code = @sCode and prj_parent is not null
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = prj_code from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode, @nLevel )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND prj_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select PRJ_PARENT, @nLevel + 1
										  from R5PROJECTS
										 where PRJ_CODE = @sCurrentCode
                                         and prj_parent is not null
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create function O7GETAGR_GET_STC_HIERARCHY (@sObject nvarchar(30), @sOrg nvarchar(15))

							@sCurrentOrg	= stc_parent_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentParent + N'#' + @sCurrentOrg, @nLevel )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_parent = @sCurrentParent and stc_parent_org = @sCurrentOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_parent, stc_parent_org, @nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_child		= @sCurrentParent and 
												stc_child_org	= @sCurrentOrg

					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETAPPROVEDREQLINE(@sPrequisition nvarchar(30), @sSpecial nvarchar(255))
RETURNS numeric(8,0)
as
begin
    declare @nVline numeric(8,0)
	set @nVline = null
	

	if @sSpecial IS NULL 
		SELECT @nVline = rql_reqline FROM r5requislines
		WHERE rql_req = @sPrequisition
		AND   rql_rstatus = N'A'
		AND   rql_rtype IN (N'PS',N'PD',N'RE')
		AND   NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x' FROM r5orderlines
						   WHERE orl_req     = rql_req
						   AND   orl_reqline = rql_reqline)		
		AND   1 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r5requislines
					WHERE rql_req = @sPrequisition
					AND   rql_rstatus= N'A'
					AND   rql_rtype IN (N'PS',N'PD',N'RE') 
					AND   NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x' FROM r5orderlines
									   WHERE orl_req     = rql_req
									   AND   orl_reqline = rql_reqline) )
	else
		begin
		    if @sSpecial = N'Services for POs' 
				SELECT @nVline = rql_reqline FROM r5requislines r
				WHERE r.rql_req = @sPrequisition
				AND   r.rql_rstatus= N'A'
				AND   coalesce(r.rql_active, N'-') = N'+'
				AND   coalesce(r.rql_recvqty, 0) = 0
				AND   r.rql_quotflag = N'0'
				AND   r.rql_rtype LIKE N'S%'
				AND   NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x' FROM r5orderlines o
								   WHERE o.orl_req     = r.rql_req
								   AND   o.orl_reqline = r.rql_reqline)
				AND 1 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r5requislines r1
						  WHERE r1.rql_req = @sPrequisition
						  AND   r1.rql_rstatus = N'A'
						  AND   coalesce(r1.rql_active, N'-') = N'+'
						  AND   coalesce(r1.rql_recvqty, 0) = 0
						  AND   r1.rql_quotflag = N'0'
						  AND   r1.rql_rtype LIKE N'S%'
						  AND   NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x' FROM r5orderlines o
											   WHERE o.orl_req     = r1.rql_req
											   AND   o.orl_reqline = r1.rql_reqline ) )



		end

  
    RETURN @nVline
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GETAUTO @sAutonum nvarchar(40) OUTPUT,
     @sEtype   nvarchar(15),
     @sOrg     nvarchar(40),
     @sErrchk  nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON

declare @sChk nvarchar(4)
declare @sX   nvarchar(50)
declare @nReturn 	integer

begin

	set @sChk = N'0'

	if @sEtype IS NULL OR @sOrg IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sErrchk = N'1'
			return
		end

	if @sEtype = N'AUTOOBJ' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'0'
			WHILE (@sChk <> N'2' )
				begin
					/*Get the next number from the sequence*/
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sAutonum OUTPUT, N'AUTOOBJ', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1
					/*Check for the existence of part code for the organization*/
					execute @nReturn = O7GMOREO N'OBJ', 3, @sAutonum, @sOrg, @sX, @sX, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1
				end

		end 
	else
		begin
			if @sEtype = N'AUTOPART' 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'0'
					WHILE (@sChk <> N'2' )
						begin
							/*Get the next number from the sequence*/
							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sAutonum OUTPUT, N'AUTOPART', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1
							/*Check for the existence of part code for the organization*/
							execute @nReturn = O7GMORES N'PART', 1, @sAutonum, @sOrg, @sX, @sX, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1
						end

				end 
		end

end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETAVAILABLEHOURS(
  @shift   NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @person  NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @crew    NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @creworg NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @ddate   DATETIME )
RETURNS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @hours NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  IF @person IS NOT NULL
    SELECT @hours = SUM( ISNULL( exc_hours, shd_hours ) )
    FROM   r5shifts,
           r5shfdays_view,
           r5shfpers
           LEFT OUTER JOIN r5exceptions ON ( exc_person = shp_person AND exc_date = @ddate )
    WHERE  shf_code   = shp_shift
    AND    shd_shift  = shp_shift
    AND    shd_day    = ( DATEDIFF( day, shf_start, @ddate) % shf_length ) + 1
    AND    shp_person = @person
    AND    shp_shift  LIKE @shift
    AND    @ddate BETWEEN shp_start AND shp_end 
  ELSE IF @crew IS NOT NULL
    SELECT @hours = SUM( shd_hours )
    FROM   r5shifts,
           r5shfdays_view,
           r5shfcrews
    WHERE  shf_code     = shc_shift
    AND    shd_shift    = shc_shift
    AND    shd_day      = ( DATEDIFF( day, shf_start, @ddate) % shf_length ) + 1
    AND    shc_crew     = @crew
    AND    shc_crew_org = @creworg
    AND    shc_shift    LIKE @shift
    AND    @ddate BETWEEN shc_start AND shc_end 
  RETURN @hours
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GETBAM              @sType        nvarchar(8),
                                       @sBudget      nvarchar(17),
                                       @sYear        nvarchar(8),
                                       @nLevel       numeric(1),
                                       @sPeriod      nvarchar(4),
                                       @sMrc         nvarchar(15),
                                       @sLocation    nvarchar(30),
                                       @sLocationorg nvarchar(15),
                                       @sObject      nvarchar(30),
                                       @sObjectorg   nvarchar(15),
                                       @sJobtype     nvarchar(8),
                                       @sCosttype    nvarchar(4),
									   @sCostcode    nvarchar(30),
                                       @sProject     nvarchar(20),
                                       @sMrcgr       nvarchar(5),
                                       @sLocationgr  nvarchar(5),
                                       @sObjectgr    nvarchar(5),
                                       @sJobtypegr   nvarchar(5),
                                       @sCosttypegr  nvarchar(5),
									   @sCostcodegr  nvarchar(5),
                                       @sProjectgr   nvarchar(5),
                                       @nCost        numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
                                       @sChk         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sColumn    nvarchar(20)
	declare @sParen     nvarchar(1)
	declare @sSQL       nvarchar(2000)  
	declare @sPerclause nvarchar(200) 
	declare @sMrcclause nvarchar(200) 
	declare @sLocclause nvarchar(200) 
	declare @sObjclause nvarchar(200) 
	declare @sJbtclause nvarchar(200) 
	declare @sCstclause nvarchar(200) 
	declare @sCclause	nvarchar(200) 
	declare @sPrjclause nvarchar(200) 


BEGIN


	set @sPerclause = N''
	set @sMrcclause = N''
	set @sLocclause = N''
	set @sObjclause = N''
	set @sJbtclause = N''
	set @sCstclause = N''
	set @sCclause	= N''
	set @sPrjclause = N''

	set @sParen = N')'
	set @sChk   = N'0'
   
	IF    @sType IN ( N'ESTLAB', N'ESTMAT', N'ESTHIR', N'ESTDMA', N'ESTFIX', N'ESTTOL' ) 
		set @sColumn = N'a.bda_expc'
	IF @sType IN ( N'REMLAB', N'REMMAT', N'PNOHIR', N'PNODMA', N'PNOFIX', N'REMTOL' ) 
		set @sColumn = N'a.bda_expcrem'
	IF @sType IN ( N'ORDHIR', N'ORDDMA', N'ORDFIX' ) 
		set @sColumn = N'a.bda_ordr'
	IF @sType IN ( N'REMHIR', N'REMDMA', N'REMFIX' ) 
		set @sColumn = N'a.bda_ordrrem'
	IF @sType IN ( N'ACTLAB', N'ACTMAT', N'ACTHIR', N'ACTDMA', N'ACTFIX', N'ACTTOL' ) 
		set @sColumn = N'a.bda_spent'
   
   
   /* Get calculated budget */
	set @sSQL = N' SELECT @nCost = SUM( N' + @sColumn + ' )
		FROM   r5budgetamounts a
		WHERE  a.bda_version = ( SELECT MAX( a2.bda_version )
									FROM   r5budgetamounts a2
									WHERE  a2.bda_code = a.bda_code )
									AND    a.bda_code IN (
										SELECT d.bdt_code
										FROM   r5budgetdetails d
										WHERE  d.bdt_budget = ''' + @sBudget +
										N''' AND    d.bdt_year   = ''' + @sYear +
										N''' AND    d.bdt_level  = ' + cast( @nLevel as nvarchar(38) )
	
	
	IF @sPeriod IS NOT NULL 
		set @sPerclause = N' AND d.bdt_period = ''' + @sPeriod + N''''
	IF @sMrc IS NOT NULL 
		set @sMrcclause = N' AND d.bdt_mrc = ''' + @sMrc + N''''
	IF @sMrcgr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sMrcclause = N' AND d.bdt_mrcgr = ''' + @sMrcgr + N''''
	IF @sLocation IS NOT NULL 
		set @sLocclause = N' AND d.bdt_location     = ''' + @sLocation + N'''' +
			N' AND d.bdt_location_org = ''' + @sLocationorg + N''''
	IF @sLocationgr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sLocclause = N' AND d.bdt_locationgr = ''' + @sLocationgr + N''''
	IF @sObject IS NOT NULL 
		set @sObjclause = N' AND d.bdt_object     = ''' + @sObject + N'''' +
			N' AND d.bdt_object_org = ''' + @sObjectorg + N''''
	IF @sObjectgr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sObjclause = N' AND d.bdt_objectgr = ''' + @sObjectgr + N''''
	IF @sJobtype IS NOT NULL 
		set @sJbtclause = N' AND d.bdt_jobtype = ''' + @sJobtype + N''''
	IF @sJobtypegr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sJbtclause = N' AND d.bdt_jobtypegr = ''' + @sJobtypegr + N''''
	IF @sCosttype IS NOT NULL 
		set @sCstclause = N' AND d.bdt_costtype = ''' + @sCosttype + N''''
	IF @sCosttypegr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sCstclause = N' AND d.bdt_costtypegr = ''' + @sCosttypegr + N''''
	IF @sCostcode IS NOT NULL 
		set @sCclause = N' AND d.bdt_costcode = ''' + @sCostcode + N''''
	IF @sCostcodegr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sCclause = N' AND d.bdt_costcodegr = ''' + @sCostcodegr + N''''
	IF @sProject IS NOT NULL 
		set @sPrjclause = N' AND d.bdt_project = ''' + @sProject + N''''
	IF @sProjectgr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sPrjclause = N' AND d.bdt_projectgr = ''' + @sProjectgr + N''''

	set @sSQL  = @sSQL + @sPerclause + @sMrcclause + @sLocclause + @sObjclause + @sJbtclause + @sCstclause + @sCclause + @sPrjclause +  @sParen

	EXEC sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost int OUTPUT', @nCost OUTPUT


   RETURN
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GETBOO
   @sCode1        nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,

   @sUsrgrp       nvarchar(12),

AS

	declare @sChk2          nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCount		integer
	declare	@sX		nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn	integer
BEGIN
	set @sChk      = N'0'
	set @sOrrbook = N'-'
	set @sCode1    = N'ZZZZZ' /* code which user can not enter */
	set @sCode2    = N'ZZZZZ'

	if  @sUsrgrp IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end


	select @nCount = count(*) 
	from   r5groups
	where  ugr_code = @sUsrgrp

	if @nCount > 0 
		select @sOrrbook = ugr_corrbook
		from   r5groups
		where  ugr_code = @sUsrgrp
	else
		set  @sX = Null

	if @sOrrbook = N'-' 
		begin
			set @sChk2  = N'0'
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sCode1 OUTPUT, N'CN', N'OCTP', @sChk2 OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sCode2 OUTPUT, N'CO', N'OCTP', @sChk2 OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sChk2  <> N'0' 
				set @sChk = N'2'
		end

create function O7GETBSTRLEVELCODE( @nLevel numeric(1,0), @sBstrcode nvarchar(30) )
returns nvarchar(4)
as
begin
    declare @nPeri  numeric(1,0) --r5budgetstructure.bus_peri%type
    declare @nLoc   numeric(1,0) --r5budgetstructure.bus_loc%type
    declare @nMrc 	numeric(1,0) --r5budgetstructure.bus_mrc%type
    declare @nObj 	numeric(1,0) --r5budgetstructure.bus_obj%type
    declare @nJbtp  numeric(1,0) --r5budgetstructure.bus_jbtp%type
    declare @nCstp  numeric(1,0) --r5budgetstructure.bus_cstp%type
    declare @nProj  numeric(1,0) --r5budgetstructure.bus_proj%type
    declare @nCstc 	numeric(1,0) --r5budgetstructure.bus_cstc%type
    declare @sCode  nvarchar(4) 
    
    set @sCode = NULL 

    SELECT @nPeri = s.bus_peri, 
           @nLoc = s.bus_loc, 
           @nMrc = s.bus_mrc, 
           @nObj = s.bus_obj, 
           @nJbtp = s.bus_jbtp, 
           @nCstp = s.bus_cstp, 
           @nCstc = s.bus_cstc, 
           @nProj = s.bus_proj
    FROM   r5budgetstructure s
    WHERE  s.bus_code    = @sBstrcode
    if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
        RETURN null 

    --Since SQL Server does not have Elseif the code below will have multiple return statements.
    IF @nPeri = @nLevel 
        RETURN  N'PERI'
    IF @nLoc = @nLevel 
         RETURN  N'LOC'
    IF @nMrc = @nLevel 
        RETURN  N'MRC'
    IF @nObj = @nLevel 
         RETURN N'OBJ'
    IF @nJbtp = @nLevel 
         RETURN  N'JBTP'
    IF @nCstp = @nLevel 
         RETURN  N'CSTP'
    IF @nCstc = @nLevel 
         RETURN  N'CSTC'
    IF @nProj = @nLevel 
         RETURN  N'PROJ'
   
   RETURN @sCode
end

create function O7GETBSTRLEVELDESC( @sLang     	nvarchar(2),   
                                    @nLevel     numeric(1,0),
                                    @sBstrcode  nvarchar(30))
returns nvarchar(255)
as
begin

declare @sCode  nvarchar(4)
declare @sRetdesc  nvarchar(255)--r5boilertexts.bot_text%type/* Returned area description    */
declare @sLangwork nvarchar(2)--r5languages.lan_code%type  /* Language of description */
declare @sDefaultLang   nvarchar(2)    		         /* Dummy to get language   */
declare @nCount integer
    set @sRetdesc = NULL 
    /* Get default language (if clang was not specified) */
    
    --DUE TO NEED to keep this as a function since it's called from the Text system the following work around is used -- The o7lang called has been coded in this function
    --If the o7lang function changes then this will need to change.

    --begin o7lang call
    set @sDefaultLang = N'EN'
    /* Get default language */
	select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5install  i
	WHERE  i.ins_code = N'DEFLANG'

	if @nCount = 1
		SELECT @sDefaultLang = i.ins_desc
		FROM   r5install  i
		WHERE  i.ins_code = N'DEFLANG'
    --end o7lang call

    set @sLangwork = coalesce( @sLang, @sDefaultLang )
    /* Get the area code for the level number */  
	  set @sCode = dbo.o7getbstrlevelcode(@nLevel, @sBstrcode)
  
    IF @sCode is NULL 
        RETURN @sRetdesc

    SELECT @sRetdesc = b.bot_text
    FROM   r5boilertexts b
    WHERE  b.bot_fld1  = @sCode
    AND    b.bot_fld2 = N'BSTRLEVELS'
    AND    b.bot_function    = N'USBSTR'
    AND    b.bot_lang    = @sLangwork
    if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
        RETURN NULL
    
   
   RETURN @sRetdesc
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GETBUD			@sBudget    nvarchar(17),
                                       @sYear        nvarchar(8),
                                       @nLevel       numeric(1),
                                       @sPeriod      nvarchar(4),
                                       @sMrc         nvarchar(15),
                                       @sLocation    nvarchar(30),
                                       @sLocationorg nvarchar(15),
                                       @sObject      nvarchar(30),
                                       @sObjectorg   nvarchar(15),
                                       @sJobtype     nvarchar(8),
                                       @sCosttype    nvarchar(4),
									   @sCostcode    nvarchar(30),
                                       @sProject      nvarchar(20),
                                       @sMrcgr       nvarchar(5),
                                       @sLocationgr  nvarchar(5),
                                       @sObjectgr    nvarchar(5),
                                       @sJobtypegr   nvarchar(5),
                                       @sCosttypegr  nvarchar(5),
                                       @sCostcodegr  nvarchar(5),
                                       @sProjectgr   nvarchar(5),
                                       @nCost        numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
                                       @sChk         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
									   
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL nvarchar( 3000 )  
	declare @sPerclause nvarchar( 200 ) 
	declare @sMrcclause nvarchar( 200 ) 
	declare @sLocclause nvarchar( 200 ) 
	declare @sObjclause nvarchar( 200 ) 
	declare @sJbtclause nvarchar( 200 ) 
	declare @sCstclause nvarchar( 200 ) 
	declare @sScclause  nvarchar( 200 ) 
	declare @sPrjclause nvarchar( 200 ) 
	declare @sBudget_child    	nvarchar(17)
	declare @sYear_child      	nvarchar(8)
	declare @nCount_child     	int
	declare @nBudget_total_child    numeric(24,6)
	declare @nBudget_total    	numeric(24,6)
BEGIN
	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @nCount_child = 0
	set @nBudget_total = 0
	set @nBudget_total_child = 0
	
	DECLARE c_budget_hierachy CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
	SELECT bud_code, bud_year 
	FROM r5budgets 
	WHERE bud_code IN (
	SELECT bus_code FROM dbo.F_GET_BUDGETSTRUCTURE_HIER( @sBudget ))
	
	OPEN c_budget_hierachy
	
	FETCH NEXT FROM c_budget_hierachy into @sBudget_child, @sYear_child
	
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN

		EXEC DBO.O7GETBUD @sBudget_child, @sYear_child, 1, null,
			null,null,null,null,
			null,null,null,null,
			null,null,null,null,
			null,null,null,null,
			@nBudget_total_child OUTPUT, @sChk
			
		SET @nBudget_total = @nBudget_total + @nBudget_total_child
		SET @nCount_child = @nCount_child + 1

		FETCH NEXT FROM c_budget_hierachy into @sBudget_child, @sYear_child
	END
	
	CLOSE c_budget_hierachy
	DEALLOCATE c_budget_hierachy

	IF @nCount_child > 0 
	BEGIN
		SET @nCost = @nBudget_total
		RETURN
	END
	
	set @sPerclause = N''
	set @sMrcclause = N''
	set @sLocclause = N''
	set @sObjclause = N''
	set @sJbtclause = N''
	set @sCstclause = N''
	set @sScclause = N''
	set @sPrjclause = N''

	set @sSQL = N' SELECT @nCost = SUM( bdt_amount ) 
				FROM   r5budgetdetails 
				WHERE  bdt_budget = ''' + @sBudget +
			  N''' AND    bdt_year   = ''' + @sYear +
			  N''' AND    bdt_level  = ''' + cast( @nLevel as nvarchar(38) ) + ''''


	if @sPeriod IS NOT NULL 
		set @sPerclause = N' AND bdt_period = ''' + @sPeriod + N''''
	if @sMrc IS NOT NULL 
		set @sMrcclause = N' AND bdt_mrc = ''' + @sMrc + N''''
	if @sMrcgr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sMrcclause = N' AND bdt_mrcgr = ''' + @sMrcgr + N''''
	if @sLocation IS NOT NULL 
		set @sLocclause = N' AND bdt_location     = ''' + @sLocation + N'''' +
			   N' AND bdt_location_org = ''' + @sLocationorg + N''''
	if @sLocationgr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sLocclause = N' AND bdt_locationgr = ''' + @sLocationgr + ''''
	if @sObject IS NOT NULL 
		set @sObjclause = N' AND bdt_object     = ''' + @sObject + N'''' +
			   N' AND bdt_object_org = ''' + @sObjectorg + N''''
	if @sObjectgr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sObjclause = N' AND bdt_objectgr = ''' + @sObjectgr + N''''
	if @sJobtype IS NOT NULL 
		set @sJbtclause = N' AND bdt_jobtype = ''' + @sJobtype + N''''
	if @sJobtypegr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sJbtclause = N' AND bdt_jobtypegr = ''' + @sJobtypegr + N''''
	if @sCosttype IS NOT NULL 
		set @sCstclause = N' AND bdt_costtype = ''' + @sCosttype + N''''
	if @sCosttypegr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sCstclause = N' AND bdt_costtypegr = ''' + @sCosttypegr + N''''

	IF @sCostcode IS NOT NULL 
		set @sScclause = N' AND bdt_costcode = ''' + @sCostcode + N''''
	IF @sCostcodegr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sScclause = N' AND bdt_costcodegr = ''' + @sCostcodegr + N''''
	IF @sProject IS NOT NULL 
		set @sPrjclause = N' AND bdt_project = ''' + @sProject + N''''
	IF @sProjectgr IS NOT NULL 
		set @sPrjclause = N' AND bdt_projectgr = ''' + @sProjectgr + N''''


	set @sSQL  = @sSQL + @sPerclause + @sMrcclause + @sLocclause + @sObjclause + @sJbtclause + @sCstclause + @sScclause + @sPrjclause

	EXEC sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(24,6) OUTPUT', @nCost OUTPUT


   RETURN
END

CREATE FUNCTION o7getcalpertime(@nTimeIn int) returns nvarchar(10)
as begin
  declare @sRetVal nvarchar(10)
  declare @sHour   nvarchar(2)
  declare @sMinute nvarchar(2)

  set @sRetVal = '';

  if @nTimeIn is not NULL
  begin
    set @sHour = CAST(FLOOR(@nTimeIn / 60) as varchar(2));
    set @sMinute = CAST(@nTimeIn % 60 as varchar(2));

    if len(@sHour) = 1
    begin
      set @sHour = '0' + @sHour; 
    end

    if len(@sMinute) = 1
    begin
      set @sMinute = '0' + @sMinute; 
    end

    set @sRetVal = @sHour + ':' + @sMinute;
  end

  return @sRetVal
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GETCASEMANTASKSCHENDDATE
  @casemanorg       NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @schstartdate     DATETIME,
  @duration         NUMERIC,
  @durationunit     NVARCHAR( 10 ),
  @schdend          DATETIME  OUT
  
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @calgroupcode        NVARCHAR( 15 )      -- Calendar group
  DECLARE @calgrouporg         NVARCHAR( 15 )      -- Calendar group organization
  DECLARE @usecalendar         NVARCHAR( 1 )       -- Whether calendar data should be used
  DECLARE @dayfound            NVARCHAR( 1 )       -- Used in loop to determine exit ( end of loop )
  DECLARE @tries               NUMERIC             -- Used in loop to determine exit ( end of loop )
  DECLARE @remduration         NUMERIC             -- Remaining duration

  DECLARE @endtime             NUMERIC( 12, 6 )    -- End time of a calendar day ( in minutes after midnight )
  DECLARE @curtime             NUMERIC( 12, 6 )    -- Current time ( in minutes after midnight )
  DECLARE @newtime             NUMERIC( 12, 6 )    -- Used during actual calculations
  DECLARE @deflang             NVARCHAR( 30 )      -- Default language
  DECLARE @startdate           DATETIME            -- Scheduled start date of a task
  DECLARE @calcstartdate       DATETIME            -- Used during actual calculations
  DECLARE @calcenddate         DATETIME            -- Used during actual calculations

  /* Calendar Group Period variables. */
  DECLARE @cgpgroupcode        NVARCHAR( 15 )

  DECLARE @cgpmonend           NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgptuesstart        NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgptuesend          NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpwedstart         NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpwedend           NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpthursstart       NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpthursend         NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpfristart         NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpfriend           NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpsatstart         NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpsatend           NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpsunstart         NUMERIC( 12, 6 )
  DECLARE @cgpsunend           NUMERIC( 12, 6 )

  SET @deflang = @@Language
  SET @startdate = @schstartdate
  SET @usecalendar = N'-'

  IF @durationunit IN ( N'MINUTES', N'HOURS', N'DAYS' )
    BEGIN
      /* Get the value for the Calendar Group. */
      SELECT @calgroupcode = org_calgroupcode, 
             @calgrouporg  = org_calgrouporg 
      FROM   r5organization, r5casemanagement, r5cctrcalgroups
      WHERE  csm_org = @casemanorg
      AND    org_code = csm_org
      AND    cgr_org = org_calgrouporg
  
      SET @cgpgroupcode = NULL
      IF @calgroupcode IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
          /* Retrieve calendar group period. */
          SELECT @cgpgroupcode  = cgp_groupcode,
                 @cgpmonstart   = cgp_monstart,
                 @cgpmonend     = cgp_monend,
                 @cgptuesstart  = cgp_tuesstart,
                 @cgptuesend    = cgp_tuesend,
                 @cgpwedstart   = cgp_wedstart,
                 @cgpwedend     = cgp_wedend,
                 @cgpthursstart = cgp_thursstart,
                 @cgpthursend   = cgp_thursend,
                 @cgpfristart   = cgp_fristart,
                 @cgpfriend     = cgp_friend,
                 @cgpsatstart   = cgp_satstart,
                 @cgpsatend     = cgp_satend,
                 @cgpsunstart   = cgp_sunstart,
                 @cgpsunend     = cgp_sunend
          FROM   r5cctrcalgroupperiods
          WHERE  cgp_groupcode = @calgroupcode
          AND    cgp_grouporg  = @calgrouporg
          AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @startdate, N'DD' ) BETWEEN cgp_start AND cgp_end
          AND    cgp_internalofficehours = N'+'
          IF @cgpgroupcode IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
              SET @usecalendar = N'+'
              IF @durationunit IN ( N'MINUTES', N'HOURS' )
                BEGIN
                  /* Make sure start date falls within calendar. */
                  SET @tries    = 0
                  SET @dayfound = N'-'
                  WHILE @dayfound = N'-' AND @tries < 8
                    BEGIN
                      SET @tries = @tries + 1
                      SET LANGUAGE N'English'
                      SET @dayofweek = UPPER( DATENAME( dw, @startdate ) )
                      SET LANGUAGE @deflang
                      IF @dayofweek = N'MONDAY'
                        BEGIN
                          SET @starttime = @cgpmonstart
                          SET @endtime   = @cgpmonend
                        END 
                      ELSE IF @dayofweek = N'TUESDAY'
                        BEGIN
                          SET @starttime = @cgptuesstart
                          SET @endtime   = @cgptuesend
                        END  
                      ELSE IF @dayofweek = N'WEDNESDAY'
                        BEGIN
                          SET @starttime = @cgpwedstart
                          SET @endtime   = @cgpwedend
                        END
                      ELSE IF @dayofweek = N'THURSDAY'
                        BEGIN
                          SET @starttime = @cgpthursstart
                          SET @endtime   = @cgpthursend
                        END
                      ELSE IF @dayofweek = N'FRIDAY'
                        BEGIN
                          SET @starttime = @cgpfristart
                          SET @endtime   = @cgpfriend
                        END
                      ELSE IF @dayofweek = N'SATURDAY'
                        BEGIN
                          SET @starttime = @cgpsatstart
                          SET @endtime   = @cgpsatend
                        END
                      ELSE IF @dayofweek = N'SUNDAY'
                        BEGIN
                          SET @starttime = @cgpsunstart
                          SET @endtime   = @cgpsunend
                        END
                      SET @curtime = DATEDIFF( mi, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @startdate, N'DD' ), @startdate )
                      IF @curtime < @starttime
                        BEGIN
                          /* The current start time is before the calendar start time, so set it to the calendar start time. */
                          SET @startdate = DATEADD( mi, @starttime, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @startdate, N'DD' ) )
                          SET @dayfound = N'+'
                        END  
                      ELSE IF @curtime BETWEEN @starttime AND @endtime
                        BEGIN
                          /* The current start time falls within the calendar range, so the start date can be used. */
                          SET @dayfound = N'+'
                        END  
                      ELSE
                        BEGIN
                          /* The current start time falls outside the calendar, We need to find another day. */
                          SET @startdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @startdate + 1, N'DD' )
                        END  
                    END
                END
              ELSE
                BEGIN
                  /* Days, set start date to actual start date. */
                  SET @startdate = @schstartdate
                END
            END
        END
    END
  IF @usecalendar = N'+'
    BEGIN
      SET @calcstartdate = @startdate

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETCHILDCASEMAN(
  @caseman       NVARCHAR( 30 ) )
  RETURNS @child TABLE( child NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN ) 
BEGIN
  DECLARE @case      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE csm CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    WITH cs ( csm_code) AS 
      ( SELECT csm_code
        FROM   r5casemanagement
        WHERE  csm_parent = @caseman
        UNION ALL   
        SELECT np.csm_code
        FROM   r5casemanagement AS np JOIN cs ON np.csm_parent = cs.csm_code )
    SELECT csm_code
    FROM   cs
  OPEN csm
  FETCH NEXT FROM csm INTO @case
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO @child VALUES( @case )
      FETCH NEXT FROM csm INTO @case
    END
  CLOSE csm
  DEALLOCATE csm
  RETURN  
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETCLASSCONTEXT(
  @emrscode      NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @emrsstructure NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @codeentity    NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @codeclass     NVARCHAR( 8 ),
  @codeclassorg  NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @code          NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @org           NVARCHAR( 15 ) )
RETURNS NVARCHAR AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @class      NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @classorg   NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @entity     NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @structure  NVARCHAR( 255 )
  DECLARE @structcode NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @recfound   NVARCHAR( 1 )

  IF @codeclass = N'????' 
    BEGIN
      /* Determine the class. */  
      IF @codeentity = N'EVNT' 
        /* Equipment class of Work Order. */
        SELECT  @class    = obj_class, 
                @classorg = obj_class_org 
        FROM    r5objects, r5events
        WHERE   obj_code = evt_object 
        AND     obj_org  = evt_object_org 
        AND     evt_code = @code
      ELSE IF @codeentity = N'OBJ' 
        /* Equipment class. */
        SELECT  @class    = obj_class, 
                @classorg = obj_class_org 
        FROM    r5objects
        WHERE   obj_code = @code
        AND     obj_org  = @org
      ELSE IF @codeentity = N'PART' 
        /* Part class. */
        SELECT  @class    = par_class, 
                @classorg = par_class_org 
        FROM    r5parts
        WHERE   par_code = @code
        AND     par_org  = @org
      ELSE
        RETURN N'-'
    END
  ELSE IF @codeclass IS NOT NULL 
    BEGIN
      /* Class is already known, no need to retrieve it. */
      SET @class    = @codeclass
      SET @classorg = @codeclassorg
    END
    
  IF @class IS NULL 
    /* No class, so return '-'. */
    RETURN N'-'

  /* Set the entity. */
  IF @codeentity IN ( N'EVNT', N'OBJ' ) 
    SET @entity = N'OBJ'
  ELSE
    SET @entity = N'PART'
  
  /* Always try current level first. */
  SELECT @recfound = N'+'
  FROM   r5codestructureclasses
  WHERE  csl_code      = @emrscode
  AND    csl_rentity   = @entity 
  AND    csl_class     = @class 
  AND    csl_class_org = @classorg
  
  IF ISNULL( @recfound, '-' ) = '+' OR CHARINDEX( '.', @emrsstructure ) = 0 
    /* Class found, so return. Always return if level = 1, since there are no parents to look for. */
    RETURN ISNULL( @recfound, N'-' )
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      /* Try next level. */
      IF CHARINDEX( '.', SUBSTRING( @emrsstructure, CHARINDEX( '.', @emrsstructure ) + 1, 100 ) ) > 0
        SET @structure = REVERSE( SUBSTRING( REVERSE( @emrsstructure ), CHARINDEX( '.', REVERSE( @emrsstructure ) ) + 1, 100 ) )
      ELSE
        SET @structure  = SUBSTRING( @emrsstructure, 1, CHARINDEX(  N'.', @emrsstructure ) - 1 )
      SELECT @structcode = csr_code
      FROM   r5codestructure
      WHERE  csr_rentity   = N'ACT'
      AND    csr_structure = @structure
      SELECT @recfound = N'+'
      FROM   r5codestructureclasses
      WHERE  csl_code      = @structcode
      AND    csl_rentity   = @entity 
      AND    csl_class     = @class 
      AND    csl_class_org = @classorg
      AND    csl_applytochildren = N'+'
      IF ISNULL( @recfound, N'-' ) = N'+' OR CHARINDEX( '.', @structure ) = 0 
        /* Class found, so return. Always return if level = 2, since there are no parents to look for. */
        RETURN ISNULL( @recfound, N'-' )
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          /* Try last level. */
          SET @structure  = SUBSTRING( @structure, 1, CHARINDEX(  N'.', @structure ) - 1 )
          SET @structcode = NULL
          SELECT @structcode = csr_code
          FROM   r5codestructure
          WHERE  csr_rentity   = N'ACT'
          AND    csr_structure = @structure
          SELECT @recfound = N'+'
          FROM   r5codestructureclasses
          WHERE  csl_code      = @structcode
          AND    csl_rentity   = @entity 
          AND    csl_class     = @class 
          AND    csl_class_org = @classorg
          AND    csl_applytochildren = N'+'
          RETURN ISNULL( @recfound, N'-' )
        END
    END
  RETURN ISNULL( @recfound, N'-' )
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GETCLASSICON
  @rentity        NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @entitycode     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @entityorg      NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @icon           NVARCHAR( 30 ) OUT,
  @iconpath       NVARCHAR( 1000 ) OUT 
AS
BEGIN
    -- reset @icon and @iconpath to null
    SET @icon  = null
    SET @iconpath  = null
    if @rentity = 'OBJ' 
        begin
            DECLARE cicon CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
            SELECT  cls_icon, cls_iconpath 
            FROM    r5classes , r5objects
            WHERE   cls_rentity = @rentity
            AND     cls_code = obj_class
            AND     cls_org = obj_class_org
            AND     obj_code = @entitycode
            AND     obj_org  = @entityorg
            OPEN cicon
            FETCH NEXT FROM cicon INTO @icon, @iconpath
            DEALLOCATE cicon
        end
    else
        begin
            if @rentity = 'WKSP' 
                begin
                    DECLARE cworkspaceicon CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
                    SELECT  cls_icon, cls_iconpath 
                    FROM    r5classes, r5workspaces
                    WHERE   cls_rentity = @rentity
                    AND     cls_code    = wks_class
                    AND     cls_org     = wks_class_org
                    AND     wks_pk      = @entitycode
                    AND     wks_org     = @entityorg
                    OPEN cworkspaceicon
                    FETCH NEXT FROM cworkspaceicon INTO @icon, @iconpath
                    DEALLOCATE cworkspaceicon
                end
            else
                begin
                    DECLARE cparticon CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
                    SELECT  cls_icon, cls_iconpath 
                    FROM    r5classes, r5parts
                    WHERE   cls_rentity = @rentity
                    AND     cls_code = par_class
                    AND     cls_org =  par_class_org
                    AND     par_code = @entitycode
                    AND     par_org  = @entityorg
                    OPEN cparticon
                    FETCH NEXT FROM cparticon INTO @icon, @iconpath
                    DEALLOCATE cparticon
                end
        end
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETCLOSINGCODEHIERARCHY ( @sParent nvarchar(8), @sParentType nvarchar(4),
@ppartfailureparam nvarchar(4), @pworkorderparam nvarchar(4),
@pequipmeclass nvarchar(8), @pequipmenclassorg nvarchar(15),
@pequipment nvarchar(30), @pequiporg nvarchar(15))
RETURNS @tReturn TABLE(parentclosingcode  nvarchar(13) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,                        
                       childclosingcode  nvarchar(13) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN) 
                        
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @tStack TABLE (cch_childclosingcode nvarchar(8),
                           cch_childclosingcodetype nvarchar(4),
                           cch_parentclosingcode nvarchar(8),
                           cch_parentclosingcodetype nvarchar(4),
                           LevelID int )
    DECLARE @nLevel     int                       
	DECLARE @sChild     nvarchar(8)
    DECLARE @sChildType nvarchar(4)
	
	set @nLevel=1

	
    INSERT INTO @tStack
      SELECT CCH_CHILDCLOSINGCODE,
             CCH_CHILDCLOSINGCODETYPE,
             CCH_PARENTCLOSINGCODE,
             CCH_PARENTCLOSINGCODETYPE,
             1
        FROM r5closingcodehierarchy
       WHERE CCH_PARENTCLOSINGCODE = @sParent
         AND CCH_PARENTCLOSINGCODETYPE = @sParentType
		 AND (( COALESCE( @pequipment, N'#' ) = N'#' AND cch_object IS NULL AND cch_object_org IS NULL )
         OR ((cch_object = @pequipment AND cch_object_org = @pequiporg) OR (cch_object IS NULL AND cch_object_org IS NULL)))
		 AND cch_childclosingcode + N'#' + cch_childclosingcodetype IN
             (SELECT rqm_code + N'#' + rqm_type
                FROM (SELECT rqm_code rqm_code, N'RECO' rqm_type
                        FROM r5requircodes
                       WHERE COALESCE(rqm_notused, N'-') <> N'+'
                         AND ((@ppartfailureparam = N'true' AND
                              COALESCE(rqm_partfailure, N'-') = N'+') OR
                              (@pworkorderparam = N'true' AND
                              COALESCE(rqm_enableworkorders, N'-') = N'+' AND
                              COALESCE(rqm_partfailure, N'-') = N'-' AND
                              (COALESCE(rqm_gen, N'-') = N'+' OR EXISTS
                               (SELECT 1
                                   FROM r5reqclasses
                                  WHERE rcl_reqm = rqm_code
                                    AND rcl_class = @pequipmeclass
                                    AND rcl_class_org = @pequipmenclassorg))))
                      UNION
                      SELECT cau_code rqm_code, N'CAUS' rqm_type
                        FROM r5causes
                       WHERE COALESCE(cau_notused, N'-') <> N'+'
                         AND ((@ppartfailureparam = N'true' AND
                              COALESCE(cau_partfailure, N'-') = N'+') OR
                              (@pworkorderparam = N'true' AND
                              COALESCE(cau_enableworkorders, N'-') = N'+' AND
                              COALESCE(cau_partfailure, N'-') = N'-' AND
                              (COALESCE(cau_gen, N'-') = N'+' OR EXISTS
                               (SELECT 1
                                   FROM r5causeclasses
                                  WHERE cac_cause = cau_code
                                    AND cac_class = @pequipmeclass
                                    AND cac_class_org = @pequipmenclassorg))))
                      UNION
                      SELECT fal_code rqm_code, N'FAIL' rqm_type
                        FROM r5failures
                       WHERE COALESCE(fal_notused, N'-') <> N'+'
                         AND ((@ppartfailureparam = N'true' AND
                              COALESCE(fal_partfailure, N'-') = N'+') OR
                              (@pworkorderparam = N'true' AND
                              COALESCE(fal_enableworkorders, N'-') = N'+' AND
                              COALESCE(fal_partfailure, N'-') = N'-' AND
                              (COALESCE(fal_gen, N'-') = N'+' OR EXISTS
                               (SELECT 1
                                   FROM r5failureclasses
                                  WHERE fca_failure = fal_code
                                    AND fca_class = @pequipmeclass
                                    AND fca_class_org = @pequipmenclassorg
                                 
                                 ))))
                      UNION
                      SELECT acc_code rqm_code, N'ACCO' rqm_type
                        FROM r5actioncodes
                       WHERE COALESCE(acc_notused, N'-') <> N'+'
                         AND ((@ppartfailureparam = N'true' AND
                              COALESCE(acc_partfailure, N'-') = N'+') OR
                              (@pworkorderparam = N'true' AND
                              COALESCE(acc_enableworkorders, N'-') = N'+' AND
                              COALESCE(acc_partfailure, N'-') = N'-' AND
                              (COALESCE(acc_gen, N'-') = N'+' OR EXISTS
                               (SELECT 1
                                   FROM r5actclasses
                                  WHERE acl_action = acc_code
                                    AND acl_class = @pequipmeclass
                                    AND acl_class_org = @pequipmenclassorg))))) r)

                               
                               

	WHILE( @nLevel > 0 )
	BEGIN
        IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
        BEGIN
            SELECT @sChild = cch_childclosingcode,
                   @sChildType = cch_childclosingcodetype,
                   @sParent = cch_parentclosingcode,
                   @sParentType = cch_parentclosingcodetype
              FROM @tStack
             WHERE LevelID = @nLevel

                   
            INSERT INTO @tReturn
            VALUES
              (@sParent + N'#' + @sParentType, @sChild + N'#' + @sChildType)

            DELETE FROM @tStack
             WHERE LevelID = @nLevel
               AND @sChild = cch_childclosingcode
               and @sChildType = cch_childclosingcodetype

            INSERT INTO @tStack
              SELECT CCH_CHILDCLOSINGCODE,
                     CCH_CHILDCLOSINGCODETYPE,
                     CCH_PARENTCLOSINGCODE,
                     CCH_PARENTCLOSINGCODETYPE,
                     @nLevel + 1
                FROM r5closingcodehierarchy
               WHERE CCH_PARENTCLOSINGCODE = @sChild
                 AND CCH_PARENTCLOSINGCODETYPE = @sChildType


             IF( @@ROWCOUNT > 0 )
                SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
          END
          ELSE
            SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
    END
    RETURN
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GETCONDITIONSCORE
  @org        NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @severity   NVARCHAR( 8 ), 
  @intensity  NVARCHAR( 8 ), 
  @size       NUMERIC( 24, 6 ),
  @importance NVARCHAR( 8 ),
  @score      NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT, 
  @index      NVARCHAR( 8 ) OUTPUT,    
  @nextdate   DATETIME OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @proj               NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @pk                 NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @reinspectafter     NUMERIC( 6 )
  DECLARE @reinspectafteruom  NVARCHAR( 10 )
  DECLARE @chk                NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @return             INT

  /* Get the project. */
  SELECT @proj = org_streamplusproject
  FROM   r5organization
  WHERE  org_code = @org
  IF @proj IS NULL
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @proj OUTPUT, N'*', N'STPR', @chk OUTPUT
      IF @proj IS NULL 
        /* No project found, so exit. */
        RETURN
    END

  SELECT @pk                = cms_pk, 
         @score             = cms_conditionscore, 
         @index             = cms_conditionindex, 
         @reinspectafter    = cms_reinspectafter, 
         @reinspectafteruom = cms_reinspectafteruom 
  FROM   r5condscorematrixsetup
  WHERE  cms_rcmproject = @proj
  AND    COALESCE( cms_severity, N'x' )   = COALESCE( @severity, N'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( cms_intensity, N'x' )  = COALESCE( @intensity, N'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( cms_importance, N'x' ) = COALESCE( @importance, N'x' )
  AND    ( ( @size BETWEEN cms_sizefrom AND cms_sizeto ) OR
           ( @size IS NULL AND cms_sizefrom IS NULL AND cms_sizeto IS NULL ) )

  IF @pk IS NULL 
    BEGIN
      SELECT @pk                = cms_pk, 
             @score             = cms_conditionscore, 
             @index             = cms_conditionindex, 
             @reinspectafter    = cms_reinspectafter, 
             @reinspectafteruom = cms_reinspectafteruom 
      FROM   r5condscorematrixsetup
      WHERE  cms_rcmproject = @proj
      AND    COALESCE( cms_severity, N'x' )  = COALESCE( @severity, N'x' )
      AND    COALESCE( cms_intensity, N'x' ) = COALESCE( @intensity, N'x' )
      AND    cms_importance IS NULL
      AND    ( ( @size BETWEEN cms_sizefrom AND cms_sizeto ) OR
               ( @size IS NULL AND cms_sizefrom IS NULL AND cms_sizeto IS NULL ) )

      IF @pk IS NULL 
        BEGIN
          SELECT @pk                = cms_pk, 
                 @score             = cms_conditionscore, 
                 @index             = cms_conditionindex, 
                 @reinspectafter    = cms_reinspectafter, 
                 @reinspectafteruom = cms_reinspectafteruom 
          FROM   r5condscorematrixsetup
          WHERE  cms_rcmproject = @proj
          AND    COALESCE( cms_severity, N'x' )  = COALESCE( @severity, N'x' )
          AND    COALESCE( cms_intensity, N'x' ) = COALESCE( @intensity, N'x' )
          AND    cms_importance IS NULL
          AND    cms_sizefrom   IS NULL
          AND    cms_sizeto     IS NULL

          IF @pk IS NULL 
            SELECT @pk                = cms_pk, 
                   @score             = cms_conditionscore, 
                   @index             = cms_conditionindex, 
                   @reinspectafter    = cms_reinspectafter, 
                   @reinspectafteruom = cms_reinspectafteruom 
            FROM   r5condscorematrixsetup
            WHERE  cms_rcmproject = @proj
            AND    COALESCE( cms_severity, N'x' ) = COALESCE( @severity, N'x' )
            AND    cms_intensity  IS NULL
            AND    cms_importance IS NULL
            AND    cms_sizefrom   IS NULL
            AND    cms_sizeto     IS NULL
        END 
    END

  IF @pk IS NOT NULL
    SET @nextdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( @org ) + 
                    dbo.o7gtfreq( @reinspectafter, @reinspectafteruom, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( @org ), N'DD' ) ), N'DD' )

END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETDDFIELDS(
  @fromclause       NVARCHAR( 500 ) )
  RETURNS @ddfields TABLE( fieldid  NUMERIC )
BEGIN
  DECLARE @fieldid   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @string    NVARCHAR( 500 )
  DECLARE @tablename NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @alias     NVARCHAR( 100 )
  SET @string = UPPER( @fromclause ) + ','
  /* Loop through all provided tables, separated by a comma. */
  WHILE CHARINDEX( ',', @string ) > 0
    BEGIN
      SET @tablename = SUBSTRING( @string, 1, CHARINDEX( ',', @string ) - 1 )
      IF CHARINDEX( ' ', @tablename ) > 0 
        BEGIN
          /* There is an alias, get it */
          SET @alias = SUBSTRING( @tablename, CHARINDEX( ' ', @tablename ) + 1, 100 ) 
          SET @tablename = SUBSTRING( @tablename, 1, CHARINDEX( ' ', @tablename ) - 1 )
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          /* There is no alias, set it to a dummy value that won't exist. */
          SET @alias = '@Q#w1'
        END
      /* Get all ddfields belonging to the current table. Retrieve all records without an alias and all records with the provided alias. */
      DECLARE ddf CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT ddf_fieldid
        FROM   r5ddfield d1
        WHERE  ddf_tablename = @tablename
        AND    ( CHARINDEX( '.', ddf_sourcename ) = 0 OR UPPER( ddf_sourcename ) LIKE @alias + '.%' )
        AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5ddfield d2 WHERE d2.ddf_fieldid < d1.ddf_fieldid AND UPPER( d2.ddf_sourcename ) = UPPER( d1.ddf_sourcename ) )
      OPEN ddf
      FETCH NEXT FROM ddf INTO @fieldid
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          INSERT INTO @ddfields VALUES( @fieldid )
          FETCH NEXT FROM ddf INTO @fieldid
        END
      CLOSE ddf
      DEALLOCATE ddf
      SET @string = SUBSTRING( @string, CHARINDEX( ',', @string ) + 1, 500 )
    END 
  RETURN  
END

as
begin
	declare @nDecimalPoint numeric
    set @nDecimalPoint = @nDefValue
	SELECT @nDecimalPoint = CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(ins_desc)!= 0 THEN COALESCE(CONVERT( numeric, ins_desc),@nDefValue) ELSE @nDefValue END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETDEFAULTTAX(
  @sLinertype    NVARCHAR(  1 ),
  @sOrg          NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @sStore        NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @sSupplier     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sSupplierorg  NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @sPart         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sPartorg      NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @sTrade        NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @sTask         NVARCHAR( 20 ),
  @nTaskrev      NUMERIC ) 
  RETURNS NVARCHAR( 20 ) AS
BEGIN  
  DECLARE @sReturntax NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @sParttax   NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @sCommodity NVARCHAR( 15 )

  /* Retrieve commodity. */
  IF @sLinertype = N'P' 
    SELECT @sParttax   = par_tax, 
           @sCommodity = par_commodity
    FROM   r5parts
    WHERE  par_code = @sPart
    AND    par_org  = @sPartorg
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      IF @sTask IS NOT NULL
        SELECT @sCommodity = tsk_commodity
        FROM   r5tasks 
        WHERE  tsk_code     = @sTask
        AND    tsk_revision = @nTaskrev
    END    

  
  IF @sCommodity IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* If there is a commodity, check whether there is a tax associated to it. */
      SELECT @sReturntax = stt_tax
      FROM   r5storetaxes
      WHERE  stt_store     = @sStore
      AND    stt_commodity = @sCommodity
      IF @sReturntax IS NOT NULL
        RETURN @sReturntax
    END 
    
  /* If no commodity tax, try the store. */
  SELECT @sReturntax = CASE WHEN @sLinertype = N'P' THEN str_tax_parts ELSE str_tax_services END
  FROM   r5stores
  WHERE  str_code = @sStore
  IF @sReturntax IS NOT NULL
    RETURN @sReturntax

  IF @sLinertype = N'P'
    BEGIN
      /* If still no tax, for parts, try catalogue and then part. */
      SELECT @sReturntax = cat_tax
      FROM   r5catalogue
      WHERE  cat_supplier     = @sSupplier
      AND    cat_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
      AND    cat_part         = @sPart
      AND    cat_part_org     = @sPartorg
      IF @sReturntax IS NOT NULL
        RETURN @sReturntax
      ELSE
        RETURN @sParttax
    END    
  ELSE
    IF @sTask IS NOT NULL
      BEGIN
        /* If still no tax, for services with task, try service catalogue. */
        SELECT @sReturntax = sca_tax
        FROM   r5servicecatalogue
        WHERE  sca_supplier     = @sSupplier
        AND    sca_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
        AND    sca_task         = @sTask
        IF @sReturntax IS NOT NULL
          RETURN @sReturntax
     END  
    
    /* If still no tax, try trade rates. */
    SELECT @sReturntax = trr_tax
    FROM   r5traderates
    WHERE  trr_mrc          = N'*'
    AND    trr_trade        = @sTrade
    AND    trr_org          = @sOrg
    AND    trr_supplier     = @sSupplier
    AND    trr_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
    AND    trr_start       <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), 'DD' )
    AND    trr_end         >= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), 'DD' )
    AND    trr_octype IN ( SELECT uco_code 
                           FROM   r5ucodes
                           WHERE  uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
                           AND    uco_rcode   = N'N'
                           AND    uco_system  = N'+' )

  RETURN @sReturntax    
END

create function O7GETDEP( @pParent nvarchar(30), @pParentOrg nvarchar(15) )
returns nvarchar(1)
as
begin
	declare @dependent		nvarchar(1)

	IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5structures
                    WHERE  stc_child = @pParent
                    AND    stc_child_org = @pParentOrg
	                AND    stc_rolldown=N'+' )
		SELECT @dependent = coalesce(stc_rolldown,N'-')
		FROM   r5structures
        	WHERE  stc_child = @pParent
        	AND    stc_child_org = @pParentOrg
		AND    stc_rolldown=N'+'
	else
		set @dependent = N'-'

	return (@dependent)
end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETDISPATCHEDHOURS(
  @person   NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @crew     NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @creworg  NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @event    NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @act      NUMERIC( 8 ),
  @ddate    DATETIME )
  RETURNS NUMERIC( 18 ) AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @hours       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @hourstotal  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  SET @ddate = ISNULL( @ddate, GETDATE() + 10000 )

  SET @hourstotal = 0

  IF @person IS NOT NULL
    DECLARE diw CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
      SELECT ( act_rem / ( act_persons *
               dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( act_duration - ISNULL( ( SELECT MAX( DATEDIFF( dd, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( boo_date, 'DD' ), dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( GETDATE(), 'DD' ) ) ) 
                                                               FROM   r5bookedhours 
                                                               WHERE  boo_event = diw_event 
                                                               AND    boo_act = diw_act ), 0 ), 1 ) ) )
      FROM   r5activities, r5dispatchevents 
      WHERE  act_event       = diw_event
      AND    act_act         = diw_act
      AND    diw_complete    = '-'
      AND    diw_person      = @person
      AND    diw_event       = ISNULL( @event, diw_event )
      AND    diw_act         = ISNULL( @act, diw_act )
      AND    diw_dispatched <= ISNULL( @ddate, GETDATE() + 10000 )
  ELSE IF @crew IS NOT NULL
    DECLARE diw CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
      SELECT ( act_rem / ( act_persons *
               dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( act_duration - ISNULL( ( SELECT MAX( DATEDIFF( dd, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( boo_date, 'DD' ), dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( GETDATE(), 'DD' ) ) ) 
                                                               FROM   r5bookedhours 
                                                               WHERE  boo_event = diw_event 
                                                               AND    boo_act = diw_act ), 0 ), 1 ) ) )
      FROM   r5activities, r5dispatchevents 
      WHERE  act_event       = diw_event
      AND    act_act         = diw_act
      AND    diw_complete    = '-'
      AND    diw_crew        = @crew
      AND    diw_crew_org    = @creworg
      AND    diw_event       = ISNULL( @event, diw_event )
      AND    diw_act         = ISNULL( @act, diw_act )
      AND    diw_dispatched <= ISNULL( @ddate, GETDATE() + 10000 )
  ELSE IF @event IS NOT NULL AND @act IS NOT NULL
    DECLARE diw CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
      SELECT ( act_rem / ( act_persons *
               dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( act_duration - ISNULL( ( SELECT MAX( DATEDIFF( dd, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( boo_date, 'DD' ), dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( GETDATE(), 'DD' ) ) ) 
                                                               FROM   r5bookedhours 
                                                               WHERE  boo_event = diw_event 
                                                               AND    boo_act = diw_act ), 0 ), 1 ) ) )
      FROM   r5activities, r5dispatchevents 
      WHERE  act_event       = diw_event
      AND    act_act         = diw_act
      AND    diw_complete    = '-'
      AND    diw_event       = @event
      AND    diw_act         = @act
      AND    diw_dispatched <= ISNULL( @ddate, GETDATE() + 10000 )
  ELSE
    RETURN 0
  
  OPEN diw
  FETCH NEXT FROM diw INTO @hours
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @hourstotal = @hourstotal + ISNULL( @hours, 0 )
      FETCH NEXT FROM diw INTO @hours
    END
  CLOSE diw
  DEALLOCATE diw
 
  IF @event IS NOT NULL AND @act IS NOT NULL
    /* If there is a WO specified, round to 1 decimal. */
    SET @hourstotal = ISNULL( ROUND( @hourstotal, 1 ), 0 )
  ELSE
    /* If there is no WO specified, round to 0 decimal. */
    SET @hourstotal = ISNULL( ROUND( @hourstotal, 0 ), 0 )

  RETURN @hourstotal

END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETECWARNINGS( @detailpk NUMERIC, @cnt NUMERIC, @language NVARCHAR( 2 ) ) RETURNS NVARCHAR( 4000 ) AS BEGIN DECLARE @message NVARCHAR( 1000 ) DECLARE @text NVARCHAR( 4000 ) DECLARE @returntext NVARCHAR( 4000 ) DECLARE @cswentity NVARCHAR( 4 ) DECLARE @cswcode NVARCHAR( 100 ) DECLARE @cswcodeorg NVARCHAR( 15 ) DECLARE @cswmessageid NUMERIC DECLARE @cswmessage NVARCHAR( 255 ) DECLARE csw CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR SELECT csw_entity, csw_code, csw_code_org, csw_messageid, csw_message FROM r5ecsessionwarnings WHERE csw_detailpk = @detailpk AND csw_count IN ( @cnt, 0 ) ORDER BY csw_type, csw_messageid OPEN csw FETCH NEXT FROM csw INTO @cswentity, @cswcode, @cswcodeorg, @cswmessageid, @cswmessage WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN SET @text = '' IF @cswmessage IS NOT NULL SET @text = @cswmessage ELSE BEGIN IF @cswentity IS NOT NULL SET @text = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @language, N'RCOD' , @cswentity, N'ENTP', NULL ) + N' - ' IF @cswcode IS NOT NULL BEGIN SET @text = @text + @cswcode IF @cswcodeorg IS NOT NULL SET @text = @text + N'(' + @cswcodeorg + N') - ' ELSE SET @text = @text + N' - ' END IF @cswmessageid IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT @message = bot_text FROM r5boilertexts WHERE bot_function = N'OSEQGN' AND bot_fld1 = N'ERRORMESSAGE' AND bot_fld2 = @cswmessageid AND bot_lang = @language SET @text = @text + @message END END SET @text = N'

' + @text + N'

' IF @returntext IS NULL SET @returntext = @text ELSE BEGIN IF LEN( @returntext + @text ) < 3990 SET @returntext = @returntext + CHAR( 10 ) + @text END FETCH NEXT FROM csw INTO @cswentity, @cswcode, @cswcodeorg, @cswmessageid, @cswmessage END CLOSE csw DEALLOCATE csw RETURN @returntext END

create function dbo.O7GETEMPSHIFTSCHEDSESSID( 
        @sEmployee   nvarchar(30),
        @sShift      nvarchar(30))
returns numeric(18)
as
begin
    declare @nSessionId  numeric(18) --r5fleetbooklabor.flb_shiftschedulesession%type;
    set @nSessionId = NULL;

    if @sEmployee IS NULL AND @sShift IS NULL
        return NULL;

    if @sShift IS NOT NULL AND @sShift <> ''
        begin
          SELECT top 1 @nSessionId = CAST(wls_code AS NUMERIC)
          FROM   r5wolaborschedparams, r5wolaborschedemp
          WHERE  wls_code     = wlo_sessionid
          AND    wlo_person   = @sEmployee
          AND    wls_empshift = @sShift	
          AND    coalesce(wls_shiftscheduling, '-') = '+' 
          AND    coalesce(wlo_select, '-')          = '+'
          AND    wls_shiftstart > dbo.o7gttime2( wls_event_org )
          AND    wls_shiftstart <= DATEADD(hour,8,dbo.o7gttime2( wls_event_org ))
          ORDER BY wls_shiftstart;
          if @nSessionId IS NULL
            SELECT top 1 @nSessionId = CAST(wls_code AS NUMERIC)
            FROM   r5wolaborschedparams, r5wolaborschedemp
            WHERE  wls_code     = wlo_sessionid
            AND    wlo_person   = @sEmployee
            AND    wls_empshift = @sShift	
            AND    coalesce(wls_shiftscheduling, '-') = '+' 
            AND    coalesce(wlo_select, '-')          = '+'
            ORDER BY wls_shiftstart desc;
		end
	else
        begin
          SELECT top 1 @nSessionId = CAST(wls_code AS NUMERIC)
          FROM   r5wolaborschedparams, r5wolaborschedemp
          WHERE  wls_code     = wlo_sessionid
          AND    wlo_person   = @sEmployee
          AND    coalesce(wls_shiftscheduling, '-') = '+' 
          AND    coalesce(wlo_select, '-')          = '+'
          AND    wls_shiftstart > dbo.o7gttime2( wls_event_org )
          AND    wls_shiftstart <=  DATEADD(hour,8,dbo.o7gttime2( wls_event_org ))
          ORDER BY wls_shiftstart;
          if @nSessionId IS NULL
            SELECT top 1 @nSessionId = CAST(wls_code AS NUMERIC)
            FROM   r5wolaborschedparams, r5wolaborschedemp
            WHERE  wls_code     = wlo_sessionid
            AND    wlo_person   = @sEmployee
            AND    coalesce(wls_shiftscheduling, '-') = '+' 
            AND    coalesce(wlo_select, '-')          = '+'
            AND    wls_shiftstart < dbo.o7gttime2( wls_event_org )
            AND    wls_shiftstart > (DATEADD(hour,-8,dbo.o7gttime2( wls_event_org )) - wls_shiftduration)
            ORDER BY wls_shiftstart desc;
        end

        return @nSessionId
    end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETEQUIPCHILDPARENT(
  @obj       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @objorg    NVARCHAR( 15 ) )
  RETURNS @parents TABLE( parent    NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                          parentorg NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                          child     NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                          childorg  NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                          lev       INT ) 
BEGIN
  DECLARE @par      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @parorg   NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @child    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @childorg NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @lev      INT
  DECLARE stc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    WITH parents ( stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, lev ) AS 
    ( SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, 1
      FROM   r5structures
      WHERE  stc_child = @obj
      AND    stc_child_org = @objorg 
      UNION ALL   
      SELECT np.stc_parent, np.stc_parent_org, np.stc_child, np.stc_child_org, parents.lev+1  
      FROM   r5structures AS np JOIN parents ON np.stc_child = parents.stc_parent AND np.stc_child_org = parents.stc_parent_org )
    SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, lev
    FROM   parents
  OPEN stc
  FETCH NEXT FROM stc INTO @par, @parorg, @child, @childorg, @lev
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO @parents VALUES( @par, @parorg, @child, @childorg, @lev )
      FETCH NEXT FROM stc INTO @par, @parorg, @child, @childorg, @lev
    END
  CLOSE stc
  DEALLOCATE stc
  RETURN  
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETEQUIPCHILDRENS(

BEGIN

  DECLARE @childorg NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @lev      INT
  DECLARE stc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    WITH childrens ( stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, lev ) AS 
      ( SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, 1
        FROM   r5structures
        WHERE  stc_parent     = @obj
        AND    stc_parent_org = @objorg
        UNION ALL   
        SELECT np.stc_parent, np.stc_parent_org, np.stc_child, np.stc_child_org, childrens.lev+1  
        FROM   r5structures AS np JOIN childrens ON np.stc_parent = childrens.stc_child AND np.stc_parent_org = childrens.stc_child_org )
    SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, lev

  OPEN stc
  FETCH NEXT FROM stc INTO @par, @parorg, @child, @childorg, @lev
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO @childrens VALUES( @par, @parorg, @child, @childorg, @lev )
      FETCH NEXT FROM stc INTO @par, @parorg, @child, @childorg, @lev
    END
  CLOSE stc
  DEALLOCATE stc
  RETURN

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETEQUIPNONCONFORMITY (@sRootCode NVARCHAR(30), @sRootOrg NVARCHAR(30), @sIncludeRelatedEquip NVARCHAR(5))
RETURNS @tReturn TABLE(
	lrf_ncfcode      NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
	lrf_frompoint	 NUMERIC(24,6),
	lrf_topoint		 NUMERIC(24,6))
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @nLevel             INT
  DECLARE @sNcfCode			  NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sObjLrfUOM		  NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sInternalType      NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sLrfType			  NVARCHAR(1)
  DECLARE @sCurEquip          NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sCurEquipOrg       NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sCurParentEquip    NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sCurParentEquipOrg NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sFromPoint         NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @sToPoint           NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @sObjFromPoint	  NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @sObjToPoint		  NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @sRootLinearRefUOM  NVARCHAR(10)
  DECLARE @sRootDirection     NVARCHAR(8)
  DECLARE @cursorObjectPar    NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @cursorObjectParOrg NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sObjDirection      NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @uomConv			  NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @totalOffset		  NUMERIC(24,6)

  DECLARE @tEquipStack TABLE (lrf_re_objcode NVARCHAR(30), lrf_re_objorg NVARCHAR(30), lrf_objcode NVARCHAR(30), lrf_objorg NVARCHAR(30), lrf_frompoint NUMERIC(24,6), lrf_topoint NUMERIC(24,6), lrf_linear_reftype NVARCHAR(1), LevelID INT);
  
  -- This table will hold all of the equipment records related to the root.
  DECLARE @tNonconformityEquip TABLE (
	obj_code		 NVARCHAR(30)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
	obj_org			 NVARCHAR(30)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
	obj_parentcode	 NVARCHAR(30)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
	obj_parentorg	 NVARCHAR(30)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
	obj_frompoint	 NUMERIC(24,6),
	obj_topoint		 NUMERIC(24,6),
	obj_totaloffset  NUMERIC(24,6),
	obj_lrftype		 NVARCHAR(30)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
	obj_internaltype NVARCHAR(30)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN	-- Used for internal purposes to determine how to calc from/to points. Values = root, rootchildren, routeseg, routesegrelatedequip. 
  );

  -- Store some important information about the root parent record.
  SELECT @sRootLinearRefUOM = obj_linearrefuom, @sRootDirection = obj_direction
  FROM   r5objects 
  WHERE  obj_code = @sRootCode 
  AND    obj_org  = @sRootOrg;

  SET @nLevel = 1

  -- ========= Process all Routes, Segments, (Direct, no children) Related Equipment records.
  INSERT INTO @tEquipStack SELECT obj_code, obj_org, 'DDD', 'DDD', COALESCE(obj_frompoint, 0), COALESCE(obj_topoint, 0), NULL, 1 FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = @sRootCode AND obj_org = @sRootOrg;
  WHILE @nLevel > 0 AND @sRootCode IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tEquipStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
        BEGIN
          SELECT @sCurEquip = lrf_re_objcode, @sCurEquipOrg = lrf_re_objorg, @sCurParentEquip = lrf_objcode, @sCurParentEquipOrg = lrf_objorg, @sFromPoint = lrf_frompoint, @sToPoint = lrf_topoint, @sLrfType = lrf_linear_reftype from @tEquipStack where LevelID = @nLevel
          
          -- Always include the parent record.
		  INSERT INTO @tNonconformityEquip VALUES (@sCurEquip, @sCurEquipOrg, @sCurParentEquip, @sCurParentEquipOrg, @sFromPoint, @sToPoint, 0, @sLrfType, 'routeseg');
          
		  -- Remove item from the stack.
          DELETE FROM @tEquipStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel AND lrf_re_objcode = @sCurEquip AND lrf_re_objorg =  @sCurEquipOrg;

		  -- Continue down the tree.
          INSERT INTO @tEquipStack SELECT lrf_re_objcode, lrf_re_objorg, lrf_objcode, lrf_objorg, lrf_frompoint, lrf_topoint, lrf_linear_reftype, @nLevel + 1
                    FROM r5objlinearref
                    WHERE lrf_objcode = @sCurEquip and lrf_objorg = @sCurEquipOrg
                    AND lrf_re_objcode + '#' + LRF_RE_OBJORG <> @sCurEquip + '#' + @sCurEquipOrg
                    AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( GETDATE(), N'DD' ) BETWEEN ISNULL( lrf_dateeffective, GETDATE() - 1 ) AND ISNULL( lrf_dateexpired, GETDATE() + 1 )
                    AND lrf_linear_reftype <> CASE WHEN @sRootCode = lrf_objcode AND @sRootOrg = lrf_objorg THEN 'O' ELSE '-' END -- Exclude all related equipment records of the header.
					AND '+' = ( CASE WHEN ( lrf_displayonoverview = '+' AND @sIncludeRelatedEquip = '+' AND lrf_refrtype = 'RE' AND lrf_linear_reftype = 'O') 
                            OR ( lrf_refrtype <> 'RE' OR lrf_linear_reftype <> 'O') THEN '+' ELSE '-' END );
                    IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
            SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
        END
      ELSE
        SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
    END

  -- All Related Equipment and their children on the Linear References tab
  INSERT INTO @tEquipStack SELECT lrf_re_objcode, lrf_re_objorg, lrf_objcode, lrf_objorg, lrf_frompoint, lrf_topoint, lrf_linear_reftype, 1 FROM r5objlinearref WHERE lrf_objcode = @sRootCode AND lrf_objorg = @sRootOrg AND lrf_reftype = 'RE' AND lrf_linear_reftype = 'O' AND lrf_displayonoverview = '+' AND @sIncludeRelatedEquip = '+' AND lrf_re_objcode + '#' + LRF_RE_OBJORG <> @sRootCode + '#' + @sRootOrg
  SET @nLevel = 1
  
  -- Find all Related Equipment
  WHILE @nLevel > 0
    BEGIN
      IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tEquipStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
        BEGIN
          SELECT @sCurEquip = lrf_re_objcode, @sCurEquipOrg = lrf_re_objorg, @sCurParentEquip = lrf_objcode, @sCurParentEquipOrg = lrf_objorg, @sFromPoint = lrf_frompoint, @sToPoint = lrf_topoint, @sLrfType = lrf_linear_reftype from @tEquipStack where LevelID = @nLevel
          INSERT INTO @tNonconformityEquip VALUES (@sCurEquip, @sCurEquipOrg, @sCurParentEquip, @sCurParentEquipOrg, @sFromPoint, @sToPoint, 0, @sLrfType, 'rootrelatedequip');

          DELETE FROM @tEquipStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel AND lrf_re_objcode = @sCurEquip AND lrf_re_objorg = @sCurEquipOrg;
          
          INSERT INTO @tEquipStack SELECT stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_parent, stc_parent_org, NULL , NULL, 'O', @nLevel + 1
                    FROM r5structures, r5objects
                    WHERE stc_parent = @sCurEquip 
					AND stc_parent_org = @sCurEquipOrg
					AND obj_code = stc_child
					AND obj_org  = stc_child_org;

          IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
            SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
        END
      ELSE
        SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
    END

  -- Select all children of the parent record. 
  INSERT INTO @tEquipStack SELECT @sRootCode, @sRootOrg, null, null, null, null, null, 1 FROM R5OBJECTS WHERE obj_code = @sRootCode AND obj_org = @sRootOrg;
  SET @nLevel = 1

  WHILE @nLevel > 0
    BEGIN
      IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tEquipStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
        BEGIN
          select @sCurEquip = lrf_re_objcode, @sCurEquipOrg = lrf_re_objorg from @tEquipStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel
          
          IF @sCurEquip + '#' + @sCurEquipOrg <> @sRootCode + '#' + @sRootOrg -- Skip the header record. 
            INSERT INTO @tNonconformityEquip VALUES (@sCurEquip, @sCurEquipOrg, @sCurParentEquip, @sCurParentEquipOrg, @sFromPoint, @sToPoint, 0, 'O', 'rootchildren');
          
          DELETE FROM @tEquipStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel AND lrf_re_objcode = @sCurEquip AND lrf_re_objorg = @sCurEquipOrg;
          
          INSERT INTO @tEquipStack SELECT stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_parent, stc_parent_org, NULL , NULL, 'O',  @nLevel + 1
                    FROM r5structures
                    WHERE stc_parent = @sCurEquip AND stc_parent_org = @sCurEquipOrg

          IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
            SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
        END
      ELSE
        SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
    END

	-- We need to make sure all nonconformities have the proper from/to point. I am very sorry if you've found yourself here having to debug this.
	DECLARE @cNonConformityCursor AS CURSOR;
	SET @cNonConformityCursor = CURSOR FOR
		SELECT 
			 ncf_code, 
			 ncf_object,
			 ncf_object_org,
			 o.obj_direction,
			 o.obj_linearrefuom,
			 tEquip.obj_parentcode,
			 tEquip.obj_parentorg,
			 tEquip

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETEQUIPPARENTS(
  @obj       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @objorg    NVARCHAR( 15 ) )
  RETURNS @parents TABLE( parent NVARCHAR( 50 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN ) AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @par    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @parorg NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @code   NVARCHAR( 50 )
  DECLARE stc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    WITH parents ( stc_parent, stc_parent_org, codeorg ) AS 
    ( SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_parent+'#'+stc_parent_org
      FROM   r5structures
      WHERE  stc_child = @obj
      AND    stc_child_org = @objorg 
      UNION ALL   
      SELECT np.stc_parent, np.stc_parent_org, np.stc_parent+'#'+np.stc_parent_org 
      FROM   r5structures AS np JOIN parents ON np.stc_child = parents.stc_parent AND np.stc_child_org = parents.stc_parent_org )
    SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, codeorg
    FROM   parents
  OPEN stc
  FETCH NEXT FROM stc INTO @par, @parorg, @code
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO @parents VALUES( @code )
      FETCH NEXT FROM stc INTO @par, @parorg, @code
    END
  RETURN  
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETERECSTATDESC
               (@sLang     NVARCHAR(2)
               ,@sREntity  NVARCHAR(4)
               ,@sSCode    NVARCHAR(40)
               ,@sSEntity  NVARCHAR(4)
               ,@sFuncName NVARCHAR(30)) RETURNS NVARCHAR(255) 
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @sDescText NVARCHAR(255)
       ,@sFld1     NVARCHAR(20)
       ,@sStatent  NVARCHAR(4)

SET @sDescText = NULL
IF @sSCode IN (N'+', N'-', N'P')
   BEGIN
   IF @sSCode = N'+'
      SET @sFld1 = N'PLUSSTATUS'
   ELSE IF @sSCode = N'-'
      SET @sFld1 = N'MINUSSTATUS'
   ELSE IF @sSCode = N'P'
      SET @sFld1 = N'PSTATUS'

   SELECT @sDescText = bot_text
     FROM r5boilertexts
    WHERE bot_function = @sFuncName
      AND bot_lang = @sLang
      AND bot_fld1 = @sFld1
   END
ELSE
   BEGIN
   SELECT @sStatent = ent_statent
     FROM r5entities
    WHERE ent_rentity = @sSEntity
   IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      SET @sDescText = dbo.R5O7_O7GET_DESC(@sLang, @sREntity, @sSCode, @sStatent, NULL)
   END
RETURN @sDescText
END
