CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETEVENTWARRANTY(
  @event        NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @pobject      NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @pobjectorg   NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @pdue         DATETIME, 
  @pmeterdue    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @pmetuom      VARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @pmeterdue2   NUMERIC( 24, 6 ), 
  @pmetuom2     NVARCHAR( 30 ) ,
  @peventorg     NVARCHAR( 15 ) )
  RETURNS       NVARCHAR( 1 ) AS
BEGIN

  DECLARE @object       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objectorg    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @due          DATETIME 
  DECLARE @meterdue     NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) 
  DECLARE @metuom       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @meterdue2    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @metuom2      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @warranty     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @eventorg     NVARCHAR( 15 )

  IF @event IS NOT NULL
    /* Retrieve event data. */
    SELECT @object    = evt_object, 
           @objectorg = evt_object_org, 
           @due       = evt_due, 
           @meterdue  = evt_meterdue, 
           @metuom    = evt_metuom, 
           @meterdue2 = evt_meterdue2, 
           @metuom2   = evt_metuom2,
           @eventorg  = evt_org
    FROM   r5events
    WHERE  evt_code = @event
    AND    ( evt_due IS NOT NULL OR evt_meterdue IS NOT NULL OR evt_meterdue2 IS NOT NULL )
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      /* Use parameters. */
      SET @object    = @pobject
      SET @objectorg = @pobjectorg
      SET @due       = @pdue
      SET @meterdue  = @pmeterdue
      SET @metuom    = @pmetuom
      SET @meterdue2 = @pmeterdue2
      SET @metuom2   = @pmetuom2
      SET @eventorg  = @peventorg
    END

  IF @object IS NULL
    /* No object, so for sure no warranty. */
    RETURN N'-'
  
  IF @due IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Check for calendar warranty. */
      SELECT @warranty = N'+'
      FROM   r5organization, r5documents, r5warcoverages
      WHERE  doc_code       = wcv_warranty
      AND    org_code       = doc_org
      AND    wcv_object     = @object
      AND    wcv_object_org = @objectorg
      AND    wcv_active     = N'+'
      AND    wcv_uom        IS NULL
      AND    (doc_org =  @eventorg  OR ( org_common = '+'))
      AND    ISNULL( doc_excludepmworkorder, N'-' ) = N'-'
      AND    @due BETWEEN ISNULL( wcv_startdate, @due ) AND COALESCE( wcv_expirationdate, @due )
      AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X'
                          FROM   r5warcomponents
                          WHERE  wcm_warranty = wcv_warranty )

      IF @warranty = N'+'
        /* There is a warranty, so return. */
        RETURN N'+'
    END

  IF @meterdue IS NOT NULL AND @metuom IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Check for usage warranty. */
      SELECT @warranty = N'+'
      FROM   r5organization, r5documents, r5warcoverages
      WHERE  doc_code       = wcv_warranty
      AND    org_code       = doc_org
      AND    wcv_object     = @object
      AND    wcv_object_org = @objectorg
      AND    wcv_uom        = @metuom
      AND    wcv_active     = N'+'
      AND    (doc_org =  @eventorg  OR ( org_common = '+'))
      AND    ISNULL( doc_excludepmworkorder, N'-' ) = N'-'
      AND    @meterdue BETWEEN ISNULL( wcv_startusage, @meterdue ) AND COALESCE( wcv_expiration, @meterdue )
      AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X'
                          FROM   r5warcomponents
                          WHERE  wcm_warranty = wcv_warranty )
      IF @warranty = N'+'
        /* There is a warranty, so return. */
        RETURN N'+'
    END

  IF @meterdue2 IS NOT NULL AND @metuom2 IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Check for usage warranty. */
      SELECT @warranty = N'+'
      FROM   r5documents, r5warcoverages
      WHERE  doc_code       = wcv_warranty
      AND    wcv_object     = @object
      AND    wcv_object_org = @objectorg
      AND    wcv_uom        = @metuom2
      AND    wcv_active     = N'+'
      AND    ISNULL( doc_excludepmworkorder, N'-' ) = N'-'
      AND    @meterdue2 BETWEEN ISNULL( wcv_startusage, @meterdue2 ) AND ISNULL( wcv_expiration, @meterdue2 )
      AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X'
                          FROM   r5warcomponents
                          WHERE  wcm_warranty = wcv_warranty )
      IF @warranty = N'+'
        /* There is a warranty, so return. */
        RETURN N'+'
    END

  RETURN '-'

END

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETFIELDTEXT( @sFuncName  nvarchar(10),
                @sFieldName nvarchar(61),
                @sLang      nvarchar(2) )
returns nvarchar(255)
as
begin

    declare @nFieldText nvarchar(255)
    declare @funClass   NVARCHAR(8)

    set @nFieldText = NULL
    set @funClass   = NULL

    SELECT  @funClass = fun_class 
    FROM    r5functions 
    WHERE   fun_code = (CASE WHEN charindex( N'_', @sFuncName ) = 0 THEN @sFuncName 
                             ELSE substring( @sFuncName, 1, charindex( N'_', @sFuncName ) - 1 ) END);

    IF ( @funClass = 'REPB' OR @funClass ='REPC' ) 
        SELECT @nFieldText = dbo.f_get_repparamtext( @sFuncName, @sFieldName, @sLang )
    ELSE
        SELECT  TOP 1 @nFieldText = bot_text
        FROM    r5boilertexts
        WHERE   bot_function = substring(@sFuncName, 1, 6)
        AND
        (
            UPPER(bot_fld1) = CASE WHEN LEN(SUBSTRING(@sFuncName,8,3)) > 0 AND SUBSTRING(@sFuncName,8,3) <> 'HDR' AND SUBSTRING(@sFuncName,8,3) <> 'LST' AND SUBSTRING(@sFuncName,8,1) <> 'X'
                THEN SUBSTRING(@sFuncName,8,3) + '_' + UPPER(@sFieldName) ELSE UPPER(@sFieldName) END
            OR bot_fld1 = @sFieldName
            )
        AND bot_lang = @sLang
        AND bot_fld2 IS NULL
        AND bot_dest = 'F'

    return( @nFieldText )

end

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETFUELMIX( 
  @sSupplier    NVARCHAR(30), 
  @sSupplierOrg NVARCHAR(15), 
  @sCommodity   NVARCHAR(15), 
  @dDate        DATETIME )
RETURNS NUMERIC(24,6)
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @nFuelMix       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nTotalCapacity NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  IF @sSupplier IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      SELECT @nTotalCapacity = SUM( cfm_capacity )
      FROM   r5compfuelmix
      WHERE  cfm_supplier     = @sSupplier
      AND    cfm_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
      AND    cfm_commodity    = @sCommodity
      AND    cfm_capacity     > 0
      AND    @dDate BETWEEN cfm_fromdate AND cfm_todate

      SELECT @nFuelMix = SUM( cfl_emissions * ghg_co2eratio * cfm_capacity / @nTotalCapacity )
      FROM   r5greenhousegases, r5cmdfueltypes, r5compfuelmix
      WHERE  ghg_code         = cfl_ghg
      AND    cfm_type         = cfl_type
      AND    cfm_supplier     = @sSupplier
      AND    cfm_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
      AND    cfm_commodity    = @sCommodity
      AND    cfm_capacity     > 0
      AND    cfl_commodity    = @sCommodity  
      AND    @dDate BETWEEN cfm_fromdate AND cfm_todate
      AND    @dDate BETWEEN cfl_fromdate AND cfl_todate
    END  
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      SELECT @nFuelMix = SUM( cfl_emissions * ghg_co2eratio )
      FROM   r5greenhousegases, r5cmdfueltypes
      WHERE  ghg_code         = cfl_ghg
      AND    cfl_commodity    = @sCommodity  
      AND    @dDate BETWEEN cfl_fromdate AND cfl_todate
    END

  RETURN @nFuelMix

END

create function dbo.O7GETFUELPRICE( @sFuel       nvarchar(30),
                                    @sDepot      nvarchar(30),
                                    @sDepotorg   nvarchar(15),
                                    @sPump       nvarchar(30))
returns numeric(24,6)
as
    begin
        declare @sBlended   nvarchar(1)
        declare @sFuel1     nvarchar(30)
        declare @sFuel2     nvarchar(30)
        declare @sFuel3     nvarchar(30)
        declare @sFuel4     nvarchar(30)
        declare @sFuel5     nvarchar(30)
        declare @nPerc1     numeric(6,3)
        declare @nPerc2     numeric(6,3)
        declare @nPerc3     numeric(6,3)
        declare @nPerc4     numeric(6,3)
        declare @nPerc5     numeric(6,3)

        declare @nTempprice numeric(24,6)
        declare @nPrice     numeric(24,6)

        SELECT @sBlended = fue_blended,
               @sFuel1 = fue_blendfuel1, @nPerc1 = fue_blendperc1,
               @sFuel2 = fue_blendfuel2, @nPerc2 = fue_blendperc2,
               @sFuel3 = fue_blendfuel3, @nPerc3 = fue_blendperc3,
               @sFuel4 = fue_blendfuel4, @nPerc4 = fue_blendperc4,
               @sFuel5 = fue_blendfuel5, @nPerc5 = fue_blendperc5
        FROM   r5fuels
        WHERE  fue_code = @sFuel
        
        if @sBlended = '-'
            SELECT @nPrice = ( ( tan_avgprice * ( 1 + ( coalesce( dep_markupperc, 0 ) / 100 ) ) ) +

                        AND    dep_org       = tpu_depot_org
                        AND    tan_depot     = tpu_depot

                if @sFuel2 is not null

                        AND    tan_depot     = tpu_depot

                        AND    tan_code      = tpu_tank
                        AND    tpu_depot     = @sDepot
                        AND    tpu_depot_org = @sDepotorg
                        AND    tpu_pump      = @sPump
                        AND    tpu_active    = N'+'
                        AND    tan_fuel      = @sFuel2
                        set @nPrice = @nPrice + COALESCE( @nTempprice, 0 )
                    end

                if @sFuel3 is not null
                    begin
                        SELECT @nTempprice = ( ( tan_avgprice * ( 1 + ( coalesce( dep_markupperc, 0 ) / 100 ) ) ) +
                               coalesce( dep_fixedmarkup, 0 ) ) * @nPerc3 / 100
                        FROM   r5depots, r5tanks, r5tankpumps
                        WHERE  dep_code      = tpu_depot
                        AND    dep_org       = tpu_depot_org
                        AND    tan_depot     = tpu_depot

                        AND    tpu_active    = N'+'
                        AND    tan_fuel      = @sFuel3
                        set @nPrice = @nPrice + COALESCE( @nTempprice, 0 )
                    end

                if @sFuel4 is not null
                    begin
                        SELECT @nTempprice = ( ( tan_avgprice * ( 1 + ( coalesce( dep_markupperc, 0 ) / 100 ) ) ) +
                               coalesce( dep_fixedmarkup, 0 ) ) * @nPerc4 / 100
                        FROM   r5depots, r5tanks, r5tankpumps
                        WHERE  dep_code      = tpu_depot
                        AND    dep_org       = tpu_depot_org
                        AND    tan_depot     = tpu_depot
                        AND    tan_depot_org = tpu_depot_org
                        AND    tan_code      = tpu_tank
                        AND    tpu_depot     = @sDepot
                        AND    tpu_depot_org = @sDepotorg
                        AND    tpu_pump      = @sPump
                        AND    tpu_active    = N'+'
                        AND    tan_fuel      = @sFuel4
                        set @nPrice = @nPrice + COALESCE( @nTempprice, 0 )
                    end

                if @sFuel5 is not null
                    begin
                        SELECT @nTempprice = ( ( tan_avgprice * ( 1 + ( coalesce( dep_markupperc, 0 ) / 100 ) ) ) +
                               coalesce( dep_fixedmarkup, 0 ) ) * @nPerc5 / 100
                        FROM   r5depots, r5tanks, r5tankpumps
                        WHERE  dep_code      = tpu_depot
                        AND    dep_org       = tpu_depot_org
                        AND    tan_depot     = tpu_depot

                        AND    tpu_depot     = @sDepot
                        AND    tpu_depot_org = @sDepotorg
                        AND    tpu_pump      = @sPump
                        AND    tpu_active    = N'+'
                        AND    tan_fuel      = @sFuel5
                        set @nPrice = @nPrice + COALESCE( @nTempprice, 0 )
                    end
            end

        set @nPrice = round( @nPrice, 6 )

        return @nPrice
    end

create function O7GETFUNCNAME(	@sFrom_functionname	nvarchar(6),
								@sFrom_functiontype	nvarchar(32),
								@sUserfunc_selector	nvarchar(32) )
returns nvarchar(24)
as
begin
	declare @nCount		int
	declare @sReturn	nvarchar(24)

	set @sReturn = null

	if @sFrom_functionname is null or @sFrom_functiontype is null or upper( @sFrom_functiontype ) NOT IN ( N'SYSTEM', N'USER' )
		return null

	select @nCount = count(*)
	from r5functions
	where fun_code = @sFrom_functionname

	if @nCount > 0
		begin
			if upper( @sFrom_functiontype ) = N'USER'
				select @sReturn = fun_application
				from r5functions
				where fun_code = @sFrom_functionname
			else
				select @sReturn = fun_code
				from r5functions
				where fun_code = @sFrom_functionname

			if @sReturn is null
				set @sReturn = @sFrom_functionname
		end

	return (@sReturn)
end

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETLEADTIME (
    @sOrdercode     nvarchar(30),
    @sOrderorg      nvarchar(15),
    @sOrderpart     nvarchar(30),
    @sOrderpartorg  nvarchar(15),
    @sRecvqty       nvarchar(30)
  )
  returns int
as
begin
    declare @dApprovdate  datetime 
    declare @dRecvdate    datetime 
	declare @nLeadtime	int
	declare @nRecvqty		numeric(24,6)

    SELECT @dApprovdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( ord_approv, N'DD' )
    FROM   r5orders
    WHERE  ord_code = @sOrdercode
    AND    ord_org  = @sOrderorg

	set @nRecvqty = Cast(@sRecvqty as numeric(30,0))
    IF isnull( @nRecvqty, 0 ) > 0
	begin
        SELECT @dRecvdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( MIN( trl_date ), N'DD' )
        FROM   r5translines, r5transactions
        WHERE  tra_order     = @sOrdercode
        AND    tra_order_org = @sOrderorg
        AND    trl_trans     = tra_code
        AND    trl_part      = @sOrderpart
        AND    trl_part_org  = @sOrderpartorg
	end
    IF @dRecvdate IS NOT NULL AND @dApprovdate IS NOT NULL
        set @nLeadtime= datediff(Day, @dApprovdate, @dRecvdate)

	if @nLeadtime is not null
		return @nLeadtime
	else
		return null

	return null
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETLINE(@sText nvarchar(2000), @nLine numeric(24,6)) 
RETURNS nvarchar(2000) 
as
begin
    declare @nStart     integer
    declare @nEnd       integer
    declare @sReturn    nvarchar(2000)
    declare @nCounter   integer
    declare @nStartpos  integer

    set @nCounter = 1
    set @nStartpos = 1
    
    IF @nLine IS NULL OR @nLine < 1 OR @sText IS NULL 
        set @sReturn = null
    else 
        begin
            -- Must loop for the @nLine occurance of char(10) since SQLServer does not have an exact instr function
            While @nCounter <= @nLine
                begin 
                    set @nEnd  = charindex( char( 10 ), @sText, @nStartpos)
                    set @nStartpos = @nEnd + 1
                    set @nCounter = @nCounter + 1
                end

            
            /* First line*/
            IF @nLine = 1 
                begin
                    IF @nEnd = 0 
                        set @sReturn = @sText
                    ELSE
                        set @sReturn = SUBSTRING( @sText, 1, @nEnd -1)
                end
            else
                begin
                    set @nCounter = 1
                    set @nStartpos = 1
                    set @nStart = 0
                    -- Must loop for the @nLine occurance of char(10) since SQLServer does not have an exact instr function
                    While @nCounter <= @nLine - 1
                        begin 
                            set @nStart  = coalesce(charindex( char( 10 ), @sText, @nStartpos),0)
                            set @nStartpos = @nStart + 1
                            set @nCounter = @nCounter + 1
                        end

                   /* Last line*/
                    IF @nEnd = 0 AND @nStart  > 0 
                        set @sReturn = SUBSTRING( @sText, @nStart + 1, len(@sText) )
                    /* Lines inbetween first  last */
                    ELSE
                        set @sReturn = SUBSTRING( @sText, @nStart + 1, @nEnd - @nStart - 1)
                end
        end

	RETURN @sReturn
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETLRFEQUIP(
  @obj       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @objorg    NVARCHAR( 15 ) )
  RETURNS @r5lrfequiptype TABLE( leq_object        NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                                 leq_object_org    NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                                 leq_structuretype NVARCHAR( 1 )  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
BEGIN
  DECLARE @par      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @parorg   NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @stype    NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE stc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    WITH parents ( stc_parent, stc_parent_org ) AS 
    ( SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org
      FROM   r5structures
      WHERE  stc_child = @obj
      AND    stc_child_org = @objorg 
      UNION ALL   
      SELECT np.stc_parent, np.stc_parent_org
      FROM   r5structures AS np JOIN parents ON np.stc_child = parents.stc_parent AND np.stc_child_org = parents.stc_parent_org )
    SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, 'P'
    FROM   parents
    UNION
    SELECT @obj, @objorg, N'E'
    FROM   dual 
    UNION
    SELECT lrf_objcode, lrf_objorg, N'P'
    FROM   r5objlinearref
    WHERE  lrf_re_objcode = @obj
    AND    lrf_re_objorg  = @objorg
    AND    lrf_linear_reftype IN ( N'R', N'S' )
    UNION
    SELECT l2.lrf_objcode, l2.lrf_objorg, N'P'
    FROM   r5objlinearref l1, r5objlinearref l2
    WHERE  l2.lrf_re_objcode     = l1.lrf_objcode
    AND    l2.lrf_re_objorg      = l1.lrf_objorg
    AND    l2.lrf_linear_reftype = N'R'
    AND    l1.lrf_re_objcode     = @obj
    AND    l1.lrf_re_objorg      = @objorg
    AND    l1.lrf_linear_reftype = N'S'
    UNION
    SELECT lrf_re_objcode, lrf_re_objorg, N'C'
    FROM   r5objlinearref
    WHERE  lrf_objcode = @obj
    AND    lrf_objorg  = @objorg
    AND    lrf_linear_reftype IN ( N'R', N'S' )
    UNION
    SELECT l2.lrf_re_objcode, l2.lrf_re_objorg, 'C'
    FROM   r5objlinearref l1, r5objlinearref l2
    WHERE  l2.lrf_objcode         = l1.lrf_re_objcode
    AND    l2.lrf_objorg          = l1.lrf_re_objorg
    AND    l2.lrf_linear_reftype  = N'S'
    AND    l1.lrf_objcode         = @obj
    AND    l1.lrf_objorg          = @objorg
    AND    l1.lrf_linear_reftype  = N'R'
  OPEN stc
  FETCH NEXT FROM stc INTO @par, @parorg, @stype
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO @r5lrfequiptype VALUES( @par, @parorg, @stype )
      FETCH NEXT FROM stc INTO @par, @parorg, @stype
    END
  CLOSE stc
  DEALLOCATE stc
  RETURN  
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETMINQUOTLINEDUEDATE ( @sRfqCode     nvarchar(30),

returns nvarchar(1)
as
    begin
        declare @dEarliestDelDate  datetime

        select @dEarliestDelDate = min( rlr_duedate )
        from   r5rfqlineresponses, r5rfqresponses
        where  rlr_rfq      = @sRfqCode
        and    rlr_rfq_org  = @sRfqOrg
        and    rlr_quotline = @nQuotLine

        and    ( (rfr_expiration IS NULL) OR (rfr_expiration >= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dbo.O7GTTIME2(rlr_rfq_org), 'DD')) )
        and    rlr_price is not null
        and    coalesce(rlr_notoffered, '-') = '-'
        and    rfr_rstatus = 'R'

        if ( @dEarliestDelDate = ( @dDelDate ) )
            set @nRetValue = '+'
        else
            set @nRetValue = '-'

        return ( @nRetValue )
    end

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETMINQUOTLINEPRICE( @sRfqCode       nvarchar(30),
                                       @sRfqOrg        nvarchar(15),
                                       @nQuotLine      numeric(8),
                                       @nPrice         numeric(24,6),
                                       @RfqCurrency    nvarchar(3),
                                       @nExchRate      numeric(24,12),
                                       @sRfqSelection  nvarchar(15),
                                       @nQtyPerUOP     numeric(10,4) )
returns nvarchar(1)
as
    begin
        declare @nMinPrice      numeric(24,6)
        declare @nRetValue      nvarchar(1)
        declare @nCalcMinPrice  numeric(24,6)
        declare @dCurrentDate   datetime
        declare @nExchangeRate  numeric(24,12)

        set @dCurrentDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dbo.o7gttime2( @sRfqOrg ), 'DD' )
        set @nExchangeRate = dbo.f_catinfo_getexchrate(@RfqCurrency, @sRfqOrg, @dCurrentDate)

        select @nMinPrice = case @sRfqSelection when 'PARTS' then min( (((rlr_price / coalesce(rlr_exch,1)) * @nExchangeRate) / coalesce(rlr_multiply,1)) )
                                                else min ( (rlr_price / coalesce(rlr_exch,1)) * @nExchangeRate ) end
        from   r5rfqlineresponses, r5rfqresponses
        where  rlr_rfq      = @sRfqCode
        and    rlr_rfq_org  = @sRfqOrg
        and    rlr_quotline = @nQuotLine
        and    rfr_quotid   = rlr_quotid
        and    ( (rfr_expiration IS NULL) OR (rfr_expiration >= @dCurrentDate) )
        and    rlr_price is not null
        and    coalesce(rlr_notoffered, '-') = '-'
        and    rfr_rstatus = 'R'

        set @nCalcMinPrice = ( (@nPrice / coalesce(@nExchRate,1)) * @nExchangeRate )

        if ( @sRfqSelection = 'PARTS' )
            set @nCalcMinPrice = @nCalcMinPrice / @nQtyPerUOP

        if ( @nMinPrice = @nCalcMinPrice )
            set @nRetValue = '+'
        else 
            set @nRetValue = '-'

        return ( @nRetValue )
    end

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETMINQUOTLINETOTAL( @sRfqCode     nvarchar(30),
                                       @sRfqOrg      nvarchar(15),
                                       @nQuotLine    numeric(8),
                                       @sRType       nvarchar(4),
                                       @nPurchaseQty numeric(24,6),
                                       @nPrice       numeric(24,6),
                                       @sTax         nvarchar(20),
                                       @sTax2        nvarchar(20),
                                       @RfqCurrency  nvarchar(3),
                                       @nExchRate    numeric(24,12) )
returns nvarchar(1)
as
    begin
        declare @nMinLineTotal      numeric(30,6)
        declare @nRetValue          nvarchar(1)
        declare @nCalcMinLineTotal  numeric(30,6)
        declare @dCurrentDate       datetime
        declare @nExchangeRate      numeric(24,12)
        declare @nTotalTaxAmount    numeric(24,6)

        set @dCurrentDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dbo.o7gttime2( @sRfqOrg ), 'DD' )
        set @nExchangeRate = dbo.f_catinfo_getexchrate(@RfqCurrency, @sRfqOrg, @dCurrentDate)
        
        select @nMinLineTotal = min( round(((rlr_purqty * (rlr_price / coalesce(rlr_exch,1)) * @nExchangeRate) + 
				( 
					CASE WHEN rlr_tax2 IS NULL THEN (CASE WHEN rlr_tax IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (rlr_purqty * (rlr_price / coalesce(rlr_exch,1)) * @nExchangeRate * (dbo.o7gettax(rlr_tax, @dCurrentDate)/100)) END) 
					ELSE (rlr_purqty * (rlr_price / coalesce(rlr_exch,1)) * @nExchangeRate * ( (dbo.o7gettax(rlr_tax, @dCurrentDate) / 100) + (dbo.o7gettax(rlr_tax2, @dCurrentDate) / 100) )) END)
				), 6 ))
        from   r5rfqlineresponses, r5rfqresponses
        where  rlr_rfq      = @sRfqCode
        and    rlr_rfq_org  = @sRfqOrg
        and    rlr_quotline = @nQuotLine
        and    rfr_quotid   = rlr_quotid
        and    ( (rfr_expiration IS NULL) OR (rfr_expiration >= @dCurrentDate) )
        and    rlr_price is not null
        and    coalesce(rlr_notoffered, '-') = '-'
        and    rfr_rstatus = N'R'

		set @nTotalTaxAmount = 0
  
		if( @sRType = N'PS' or @sRType = N'PD' or @sRType = N'RE' or @sRType is null )
			if @sTax2 is null 
				if @sTax is not null 
					set @nTotalTaxAmount = @nPurchaseQty * (@nPrice / @nExchRate) * @nExchangeRate * (dbo.o7gettax(@sTax,@dCurrentDate)/100)
			else
				set @nTotalTaxAmount = @nPurchaseQty * (@nPrice / @nExchRate) * @nExchangeRate * ((dbo.o7gettax(@sTax, @dCurrentDate) / 100) + (dbo.o7gettax2(@sTax2, @dCurrentDate) / 100))  

        set @nCalcMinLineTotal = Round((( @nPurchaseQty * (@nPrice / coalesce(@nExchRate,1)) * @nExchangeRate ) + @nTotalTaxAmount), 6)

        if ( @nMinLineTotal = @nCalcMinLineTotal )
            set @nRetValue = '+'
        else
            set @nRetValue = '-'

        return ( @nRetValue )
    end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETMNBEQUIP(
  @level1         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @level1org      NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @level2         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @level2org      NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @level3         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @level3org      NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @level4         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @level4org      NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @level3a        NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @level3aorg     NVARCHAR( 15 ) )
RETURNS @tab TABLE( 
  lev_object      NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  lev_object_org  NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  lev_level1      NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  lev_level1_org  NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  lev_level2      NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  lev_level2_org  NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  lev_level3      NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  lev_level3_org  NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  lev_level4      NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  lev_level4_org  NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  lev_level3a     NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  lev_level3a_org NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN ) 
AS 
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO @tab
  SELECT stc_child equip, stc_child_org equiporg, stc_parent lev1, stc_parent_org lev1org, NULL lev2, NULL lev2org, 
         NULL lev3, NULL lev3org, NULL lev4, NULL lev4org, NULL lev3a, NULL lev3aorg
  FROM   r5level1, r5structures
  WHERE  stc_parent     = lv1_code
  AND    stc_parent_org = lv1_org
  AND    lv1_rstatus IN ( 'B', 'C', 'CIR', 'CRR', 'I' )
  AND    lv1_notused = '-'
  AND    COALESCE( lv1_code, 'x' ) = COALESCE( @level1, lv1_code, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( lv1_org, 'x' )  = COALESCE( @level1org, lv1_org, 'x' )
  AND    @level2  IS NULL 
  AND    @level3  IS NULL 
  AND    @level4  IS NULL 
  AND    @level3a IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT stc_child, stc_child_org, lv2_level1, lv2_level1_org, stc_parent, stc_parent_org, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL 
  FROM   r5level2, r5structures
  WHERE  stc_parent     = lv2_code
  AND    stc_parent_org = lv2_org
  AND    lv2_rstatus IN ( 'B', 'C', 'CIR', 'CRR', 'I' )
  AND    lv2_notused = '-'
  AND    COALESCE( lv2_code, 'x' )       = COALESCE( @level2, lv2_code, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( lv2_org, 'x' )        = COALESCE( @level2org, lv2_org, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( lv2_level1, 'x' )     = COALESCE( @level1, lv2_level1, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( lv2_level1_org, 'x' ) = COALESCE( @level1org, lv2_level1_org, 'x' )
  AND    @level3  IS NULL 
  AND    @level4  IS NULL 
  AND    @level3a IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT stc_child, stc_child_org, lv3_level1, lv3_level2_org, lv3_level2, lv3_level2_org, stc_parent, stc_parent_org, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL 
  FROM   r5level3, r5structures
  WHERE  stc_parent     = lv3_code
  AND    stc_parent_org = lv3_org
  AND    lv3_rstatus IN ( 'B', 'C', 'CIR', 'CRR', 'I' )
  AND    lv3_notused = '-'
  AND    COALESCE( lv3_code, 'x' )       = COALESCE( @level3, lv3_code, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( lv3_org, 'x' )        = COALESCE( @level3org, lv3_org, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( lv3_level1, 'x' )     = COALESCE( @level1, lv3_level1, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( lv3_level1_org, 'x' ) = COALESCE( @level1org, lv3_level1_org, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( lv3_level2, 'x' )     = COALESCE( @level2, lv3_level2, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( lv3_level2_org, 'x' ) = COALESCE( @level2org, lv3_level2_org, 'x' )
  AND    @level4  IS NULL 
  UNION
  SELECT stc_child, stc_child_org, l3a_level1, l3a_level2_org, l3a_level2, l3a_level2_org, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, stc_parent, stc_parent_org
  FROM   r5level3a, r5structures
  WHERE  stc_parent     = l3a_code
  AND    stc_parent_org = l3a_org
  AND    l3a_rstatus IN ( 'B', 'C', 'CIR', 'CRR', 'I' )
  AND    l3a_notused = '-'
  AND    COALESCE( l3a_code, 'x' )       = COALESCE( @level3a, l3a_code, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( l3a_org, 'x' )        = COALESCE( @level3aorg, l3a_org, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( l3a_level1, 'x' )     = COALESCE( @level1, l3a_level1, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( l3a_level1_org, 'x' ) = COALESCE( @level1org, l3a_level1_org, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( l3a_level2, 'x' )     = COALESCE( @level2, l3a_level2, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( l3a_level2_org, 'x' ) = COALESCE( @level2org, l3a_level2_org, 'x' )
  AND    @level3 IS NULL
  AND    @level4 IS NULL 
  UNION
  SELECT stc_child, stc_child_org, lv4_level1, lv4_level2_org, lv4_level2, lv4_level2_org, lv4_level3, lv4_level3_org, stc_parent, stc_parent_org, NULL, NULL
  FROM   r5level4, r5structures
  WHERE  stc_parent     = lv4_code
  AND    stc_parent_org = lv4_org
  AND    lv4_rstatus IN ( 'B', 'C', 'CIR', 'CRR', 'I' )
  AND    lv4_notused = '-'
  AND    COALESCE( lv4_code, 'x' )       = COALESCE( @level4, lv4_code, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( lv4_org, 'x' )        = COALESCE( @level4org, lv4_org, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( lv4_level1, 'x' )     = COALESCE( @level1, lv4_level1, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( lv4_level1_org, 'x' ) = COALESCE( @level1org, lv4_level1_org, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( lv4_level2, 'x' )     = COALESCE( @level2, lv4_level2, 'x' )
  AND    COALESCE( lv4_level2_org, 'x' ) = COALESCE( @level2org, lv4_level2_org, 'x' )

  AND    COALESCE( lv4_level3_org, 'x' ) = COALESCE( @level3org, lv4_level3_org, 'x' )

CREATE FUNCTION o7getmobilegridsql(@grid VARCHAR(100))
returns VARCHAR(max)
AS
  BEGIN
      DECLARE @currentfield VARCHAR(max),
              @currenttype  INT,
              @gridsql      VARCHAR(max);

      SELECT @gridsql = ' '

      DECLARE cursor_results CURSOR FOR
        SELECT ddf_sourcename + ' as ' + gfd_tagname AS data,
               1                                     AS type
        FROM   r5grid,
               r5gridfield,
               r5ddfield,
               r5queryfield,
               r5dddataspy
        WHERE  grd_gridname = @grid
               AND gfd_gridid = grd_gridid
               AND gfd_fieldid = ddf_fieldid
               AND gfd_gridid = dds_gridid
               AND dds_ddspyid = dqf_ddspyid
               AND gfd_fieldid = dqf_fieldid
        UNION ALL
        SELECT grd_basequery,
               2 AS type
        FROM   r5grid
        WHERE  grd_gridname = @grid
               AND ( grd_basequery_multiorg IS NULL
                      OR grd_basequery_multiorg = '' )
        UNION ALL
        SELECT grd_basequery_multiorg,
               2 AS type
        FROM   r5grid
        WHERE  grd_gridname = @grid
               AND ( grd_basequery_multiorg IS NOT NULL
                     AND grd_basequery_multiorg <> '' )

      OPEN cursor_results

      FETCH next FROM cursor_results INTO @currentfield, @currenttype

      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            IF @gridsql = ' '
              BEGIN
                  SELECT @gridsql = 'select ' + @currentfield
              END
            ELSE
              BEGIN
                  IF @currenttype = 1
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT @gridsql = @gridsql + ' , ' + @currentfield
                    END
                  ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        SELECT @gridsql = @gridsql + ' ' + @currentfield
                    END
              END

            FETCH next FROM cursor_results INTO @currentfield, @currenttype
        END

      CLOSE cursor_results;

      DEALLOCATE cursor_results;

      RETURN @gridsql
  END

CREATE FUNCTION o7getmobileudgtblsql(@p_grid VARCHAR(100)) 
returns VARCHAR(max) 
AS 
  BEGIN 
      DECLARE @retvalue VARCHAR(max); 
      DECLARE @sqltext VARCHAR(max); 
      DECLARE @maxorder INT; 

      SET @retvalue = ' '; 

      SELECT @maxorder = Max(dqf_columnorder) 
      FROM   r5grid, 
             r5gridfield, 
             r5ddfield, 
             r5queryfield, 
             r5dddataspy 
      WHERE  grd_gridname = @p_grid 
             AND gfd_gridid = grd_gridid 
             AND gfd_fieldid = ddf_fieldid 
             AND gfd_gridid = dds_gridid 
             AND dds_ddspyid = dqf_ddspyid 
             AND gfd_fieldid = dqf_fieldid 
             AND dds_defaultflag = '+'
             AND Charindex(',' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(40), gfd_fieldid) + ',', ',' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(400), grd_keyfields) + ',') > 0; 

      DECLARE cursor_results CURSOR FOR 
        SELECT sqltext 
        FROM   (SELECT 'CREATE TABLE ' + Isnull(grd_gridname, '') 
                       + '(' AS SQLTEXT, 
                       0     AS od1, 
                       0     AS od2 
                FROM   r5grid 
                WHERE  grd_gridname = @p_grid 
                UNION ALL 
                SELECT '    ' + Isnull(gfd_tagname, '') + ' ' + Isnull(CASE 
                       ddf_datatype 
                       WHEN 
                       'DATE' 
                       THEN 'DATETIME' ELSE 'VARCHAR' END, '') 
                       + ' ' + Isnull(CASE Charindex(',' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(40), 
                       gfd_fieldid) + 
                       ',', ',' 
                       + CONVERT(VARCHAR(400), grd_keyfields) + ',') WHEN 0 THEN 
                       'NULL' 
                       ELSE 
                       'NOT NULL' 
                       END, '') + ',', 
                       1               AS od1, 
                       dqf_columnorder AS od2 
                FROM   r5grid, 
                       r5gridfield, 
                       r5ddfield, 
                       r5queryfield, 
                       r5dddataspy 
                WHERE  grd_gridname = @p_grid 
                       AND gfd_gridid = grd_gridid 
                       AND gfd_fieldid = ddf_fieldid 
                       AND gfd_gridid = dds_gridid 
                       AND dds_ddspyid = dqf_ddspyid 
                       AND gfd_fieldid = dqf_fieldid 
                       AND dds_defaultflag = '+' 
                UNION ALL 
                SELECT '    ' + 'PRIMARY KEY(', 
                       2, 
                       0 
                UNION ALL 
                SELECT '    ' + '    ' + Isnull(gfd_tagname, '') 
                       + Isnull(CASE @maxorder WHEN dqf_columnorder THEN '))' 
                       ELSE 
                       ',' 
                       END, '') 
                       AS 
                       SQLTEXT, 
                       3 
                       AS od1, 
                       dqf_columnorder 
                       AS od2 
                FROM   r5grid, 
                       r5gridfield, 
                       r5ddfield, 
                       r5queryfield, 
                       r5dddataspy 
                WHERE  grd_gridname = @p_grid 
                       AND gfd_gridid = grd_gridid 
                       AND gfd_fieldid = ddf_fieldid 
                       AND gfd_gridid = dds_gridid 
                       AND dds_ddspyid = dqf_ddspyid 
                       AND gfd_fieldid = dqf_fieldid 
                       AND dds_defaultflag = '+' 
                       AND Charindex(',' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(40), gfd_fieldid) +  ',',',' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(400), grd_keyfields) + ',') > 0) s 
        ORDER  BY od1, 
                  od2; 

      OPEN cursor_results; 

      FETCH cursor_results INTO @sqltext; 

      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
        BEGIN 
            IF @retvalue = ' ' 
              BEGIN 
                  SET @retvalue = Isnull(@sqltext, '') + Isnull(Char(13), ''); 
              END 
            ELSE 
              BEGIN 
                  SET @retvalue = Isnull(@retvalue, '') + Isnull(@sqltext, '') + Isnull(Char(13), ''); 
              END 

            FETCH cursor_results INTO @sqltext 
        END; 

      CLOSE cursor_results; 

      DEALLOCATE cursor_results; 

      RETURN @retvalue; 
  END;

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETMULTIPLEOBJECTS(
  @string NVARCHAR( MAX ) )
  RETURNS @r5lrfequiptype TABLE( leq_object        NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                                 leq_object_org    NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                                 leq_structuretype NVARCHAR( 1 )  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
BEGIN
  DECLARE @vstring NVARCHAR( MAX )
  DECLARE @id      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @code    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @org     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @len     NUMERIC
  
  SET @vstring = @string
  SET @len     = LEN( @vstring )
  WHILE @vstring IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN 
      IF CHARINDEX( ',', @vstring ) > 1
        BEGIN   
          SET @id      = SUBSTRING( @vstring, 1, CHARINDEX( ',', @vstring ) - 1 )
          SET @vstring = SUBSTRING( @vstring, CHARINDEX( ',', @vstring ) + 1, @len )
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          SET @id      = @vstring
          SET @vstring = NULL
        END
      SET @code = NULL
      SET @org  = NULL
      SELECT @code = obj_code, 
             @org  = obj_org
      FROM   r5objects
      WHERE  obj_gisobjid = @id
      IF @code IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
          INSERT INTO @r5lrfequiptype VALUES( @code, @org, NULL )
        END
    END
  RETURN  
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETOBJUPDATEPARENTS(
  @obj       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @objorg    NVARCHAR( 15 ) )
  RETURNS @parents TABLE( parent NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN ) AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @par    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE oup CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    WITH parents ( oup_oldcode, oup_org, oup_date ) AS 
    ( SELECT oup_oldcode, oup_org, oup_date
      FROM   r5objectupdate
      WHERE  oup_newcode = @obj
      AND    oup_org     = @objorg
      UNION ALL   
      SELECT np.oup_oldcode, np.oup_org, np.oup_date
      FROM   r5objectupdate AS np JOIN parents ON np.oup_newcode = parents.oup_oldcode 
                                              AND np.oup_org     = parents.oup_org 
                                              AND np.oup_date    < parents.oup_date )
    SELECT oup_oldcode
    FROM   parents
  OPEN oup
  FETCH NEXT FROM oup INTO @par
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO @parents VALUES( @par )
      FETCH NEXT FROM oup INTO @par
    END
  CLOSE oup
  DEALLOCATE oup
  RETURN  
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETOPTIONS
                (@sCode      NVARCHAR(80)
                ,@sOrg       NVARCHAR(200)
                ,@sEntity    NVARCHAR(4)) RETURNS NVARCHAR(7)
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @sReturn  NVARCHAR(7)
       ,@sCodeOrg NVARCHAR(200)
       ,@sChk     NVARCHAR(4)

IF dbo.O7DFLT2(N'OPTIONS') = N'-'
   RETURN NULL
IF @sOrg IS NOT NULL
   SET @sCodeOrg = @sCode + N'#' + @sOrg
ELSE
   SET @sCodeOrg = @sCode

SET @sReturn = N''
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5address WHERE adr_rentity = @sEntity AND adr_code = @sCodeOrg)
   SET @sReturn = N'A'

IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5docentities WHERE dae_rentity = @sEntity AND dae_code = @sCodeOrg)
   SET @sReturn = @sReturn + N'D'

IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5entityparts WHERE epa_rentity = @sEntity AND epa_code = @sCodeOrg)
   SET @sReturn = @sReturn + N'P'

IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5permentities WHERE pre_rentity = @sEntity AND pre_code = @sCodeOrg)
   SET @sReturn = @sReturn + N'E'

IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5addetails WHERE add_rentity = @sEntity AND add_code = @sCodeOrg)
   SET @sReturn = @sReturn + N'F'

IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5propertyvalues WHERE prv_rentity = @sEntity AND prv_code = @sCodeOrg)
   SET @sReturn = @sReturn + N'C'

IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM   r5audvalues, r5entities WHERE  ent_rentity = @sEntity  AND    ent_table = ava_table  AND    ava_primaryid = @sCode )
   SET @sReturn = @sReturn + N'U'

IF @sEntity = N'TRAN' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5elecsign WHERE els_entity IN (N'RECV', N'RETN', N'STOS', N'I') AND els_entcode = @sCode)
   SET @sReturn = @sReturn + N'S'
ELSE IF @sEntity = N'PPM' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5elecsign WHERE els_entity = @sEntity AND els_entcode = @sCodeOrg)
   SET @sReturn = @sReturn + N'S'
ELSE IF @sEntity = N'OBJ' AND EXISTS  (SELECT 1 FROM r5elecsign WHERE els_entity = @sEntity   AND els_entcode  = @sCode   AND els_org      = @sCode  )
   SET @sReturn = @sReturn + N'S'
ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5elecsign WHERE els_entity = @sEntity AND els_entcode = @sCode)
   SET @sReturn = @sReturn + N'S'

IF @sReturn = ''
   SET @sReturn = NULL
RETURN @sReturn
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETORG (

    @sCcode    nvarchar(30),

    @sCcommon  nvarchar(1))
    RETURNS nvarchar(15) AS
BEGIN

declare @sRetorg nvarchar(15)		/* r5organization.org_code%TYPE */

SET @sRetorg = NULL
IF @sCrentity = N'EVNT' 
   IF @sCcommon = N'-'
      SELECT @sRetorg = e.evt_org
        FROM r5events e
            ,r5userorganization u
       WHERE e.evt_code = @sCcode
         AND e.evt_org = u.uog_org
         AND u.uog_user = @sCuser
         AND u.uog_common = @sCcommon
   ELSE
      SELECT @sRetorg = e.evt_org
        FROM r5events e, r5userorganization u
       WHERE e.evt_code = @sCcode
         AND e.evt_org = u.uog_org
         AND u.uog_user = @sCuser
ELSE IF @sCrentity = N'STOR'
   IF @sCcommon = N'-'
      BEGIN
      SELECT @sRetorg = s.str_org
        FROM r5stores s, r5userorganization u
       WHERE s.str_code = @sCcode
         AND s.str_org  = u.uog_org
         AND u.uog_user = @sCuser
         AND u.uog_common = @sCcommon

       WHERE s.str_code = @sCcode

RETURN @sRetorg

create function O7GETOUTPUTVALUE( @pActualInput numeric(24,6), @pTPEquipment nvarchar(30), 
									@pTPEquipmentOrg nvarchar(15),@pWOEquipment nvarchar(30), 
									@pWOEquipmentOrg nvarchar(15),@pOutputValue numeric(24,6),
									@pOutputCalcType nvarchar(4))
									
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin
    declare @vOutputValue   numeric(24,6)
	declare @vYmax		    numeric(24,6)
	declare @vYmin		    numeric(24,6)
	declare @vXmax		    numeric(24,6)
	declare @vXmin		    numeric(24,6)
	declare @vPrecision		numeric(2)
	declare @vTemp			numeric(24,6)
	declare @vIsLoop		nvarchar(1)
	declare @vEquipCode		nvarchar(30)
	declare @vEquipOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @vWhichEquipment			nvarchar(15)
	declare @vEquipOutputCalcType		nvarchar(4)
	
	/* Decide from which equipment details we need to calculate the output value*/
	IF(@pTPEquipment = @pWOEquipment AND @pTPEquipmentOrg = @pWOEquipmentOrg)
		SET @vWhichEquipment = N'TPEQUIPMENT'
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			/* check whether WO Header Equipment is Loop Type*/
			SELECT  @vIsLoop = obj_loop
			FROM r5objects
			WHERE obj_code = @pWOEquipment AND obj_org = @pWOEquipmentOrg;
			IF(@vIsLoop = N'+')
				SET @vWhichEquipment = N'WOHEQUIPMENT'
			ELSE	
				SET @vWhichEquipment = N'TPEQUIPMENT'
		END
	/* After decided the Equipment, populate the Equipment*/
	IF(@vWhichEquipment = N'WOHEQUIPMENT')
		BEGIN
			SET @vEquipCode = @pWOEquipment
			SET @vEquipOrg = @pWOEquipmentOrg
		END	
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @vEquipCode = @pTPEquipment
			SET @vEquipOrg = @pTPEquipmentOrg
		END
	/* get Equipment Details*/	
	SELECT @vYmax = obj_outputrangeto , @vYmin = obj_outputrangefrom ,@vXmax = obj_devicerangeto, @vXmin = obj_devicerangefrom, @vPrecision = obj_precision, @vEquipOutputCalcType = obj_outputcalctype
	FROM r5objects
	WHERE obj_code = @vEquipCode AND obj_org = @vEquipOrg
	
	IF(@pOutputCalcType IS NOT NULL)
		SET @vEquipOutputCalcType = @pOutputCalcType
		
	IF (UPPER(@vEquipOutputCalcType) = 'LINR')
		BEGIN
			/* linear */		
			SET @vOutputValue = (((@vYmax-@vYmin) / (@vXmax-@vXmin)) * @pActualInput) + (@vYmax - ((@vYmax-@vYmin) / (@vXmax-@vXmin))*@vXmax)
		END
	ELSE IF (UPPER(@vEquipOutputCalcType) = 'SQRT' )
		BEGIN
			/* Square root */
			SET @vTemp   = @pActualInput - @vXmin
			SET @vOutputValue = @vYmin + (sign(@vTemp) * (SQRT(abs(@vTemp)/(@vXmax-@vXmin))) * (@vYmax - @vYmin))
		END	
	ELSE
		SET @vOutputValue = @pOutputValue;

	SET @vOutputValue = ROUND(@vOutputValue, isnull(@vPrecision,6))
    return ( @vOutputValue )
end

        declare @sCode          nvarchar(30)
        declare @sOrg           nvarchar(15)
        declare @sRtype         nvarchar(4)
		declare @sReturn		nvarchar(46)
        declare @tStack table ( stc_parent              nvarchar(30),
                                stc_parent_org          nvarchar(15),
                                stc_parentrtype         nvarchar(4),
                                LevelID                 int )
        
        INSERT INTO @tStack 
                select  stc_parent,
                        stc_parent_org,
                        stc_parentrtype,
                        1
                  from  r5structures
                  where stc_child               = @sChild
					and stc_child_org	=@sChildOrg

        SET @nLevel = 1

        WHILE @nLevel > 0
                BEGIN
                        IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                                BEGIN
                                        select  @sCode    = stc_parent,
                                                @sOrg     = stc_parent_org,
                                                @sRtype   = stc_parentrtype
                                        from    @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
										IF @sRtype =@sParentRType 
										 BEGIN
													IF @sField = 'CODE'
														SET @sReturn = @sCode
													else if @sField ='ORG'
														SET @sReturn = @sOrg
													else
														set @sReturn =@sCode+'#'+ @sOrg
													BREAK
										 END

                                        delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_parent = @sCode and stc_parent_org = @sOrg and stc_parentrtype=@sRtype
                                        insert into @tStack     select  stc_parent, 
                                                                        stc_parent_org,
                                                                        stc_parentrtype,
                                                                        @nLevel + 1
                                                                from    r5structures
                                                                where   stc_child       = @sCode and
																	    stc_child_org =@sOrg

                                        IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
                                                SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                                END
                        ELSE
                                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
                END

        return @sReturn
end

as
begin

    FROM   r5translines l

      WHERE  l2.lrf_objcode    = np.stc_parent

      AND    l2.lrf_re_objcode = np.stc_child

      AND    o2.obj_code       = l2.lrf_objcode

                                                            ISNULL( l2.lrf_dateexpired, getdate() + 1 ) OR @lov = N'-' )

                         AND    l5.lrf_re_objcode     = np.stc_child

                         AND    l5.lrf_dateeffective  > l2.lrf_dateeffective 
                         AND    l5.lrf_dateeffective <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) )
      AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x'

                         AND    l6.lrf_objorg         = np.stc_parent_org
                         AND    l6.lrf_re_objcode     = np.stc_child

                         AND    l6.lrf_dateeffective  < l2.lrf_dateeffective

    SELECT MIN( frompoint )

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETPRC2(	@sStore nvarchar(15), 
							@sPart nvarchar(30), 
							@sPartorg nvarchar(15), 
							@sOrg nvarchar(15), 
							@sType nvarchar(30), 
							@sLev nvarchar(200), 
							@sCom nvarchar(1) )
RETURNS NUMERIC(24, 6)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @sTrack		nvarchar(4) --r5parts.par_trackrtype%type
	declare @nPrice		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sPricelev	nvarchar(200) --r5install.ins_desc%type
	declare @sCommon	nvarchar(1)  --r5organization.org_common%type
	declare @nCount		int

	/* Retrieve tracking method */
	SELECT @sTrack = par_trackrtype
	FROM   r5parts
	WHERE  par_code = @sPart
	AND    par_org  = @sPartorg

	/* IF tracking method = TRQ, price = 0 */
	IF ISNULL( @sCom, 'x' ) <> 'I' AND @sTrack = N'TRQ'
		RETURN 0

    /* Retrieve level, if not already known */
	IF case @sLev when N'' then null else @sLev end IS NULL 
		SET @sPricelev = dbo.O7DFLT2(N'PRICELEV')
	ELSE
		SET @sPricelev = @sLev

	IF @sPricelev = N'P' 
		BEGIN
			/* retrieve common, if not already known */
			IF case @sCom when N'' then null else @sCom end IS NULL OR @sCom = 'I'
				BEGIN
					SELECT @sCommon = org_common
					FROM   r5organization
					WHERE  org_code = @sPartorg
				END
			ELSE
				SET @sCommon = @sCom

			/* Get price from part */
			SELECT @nPrice = CASE @sType WHEN N'B' THEN ppr_baseprice
										WHEN N'L' THEN ppr_lastprice
										WHEN N'A' THEN ppr_avgprice
										WHEN N'S' THEN ppr_stdprice
										END
			FROM   r5partprices
			WHERE  ppr_part     = @sPart
			AND    ppr_part_org = @sPartorg
			AND    ppr_org      = CASE @sCommon WHEN N'-' THEN @sPartorg
										ELSE @sOrg
										END
            if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
                set @nPrice = null
		END
	ELSE
		/* Get price from stock */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nPrice = CASE @sType WHEN N'B' THEN sto_baseprice
										WHEN N'L' THEN sto_lastprice
										WHEN N'A' THEN sto_avgprice
										WHEN N'S' THEN sto_stdprice
										END
			FROM   r5stock
			WHERE  sto_store    = @sStore
			AND    sto_part     = @sPart
			AND    sto_part_org = @sPartorg
            if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
                set @nPrice = null
		END
	
	return @nPrice
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETPRC3( @sStore nvarchar(15),
                     @sPart nvarchar(30),
                     @sPartorg nvarchar(15),
                     @sOrg nvarchar(15),
                     @sPriceType nvarchar(30),
                     @sLev nvarchar(200),
                     @sCom nvarchar(1),
                     @nQty numeric(24,6) = 0 )
RETURNS NUMERIC(24, 6)
AS  
BEGIN
   declare @sTrack      nvarchar(4) --r5parts.par_trackrtype%type
   declare @nPrice      numeric(24,6)
   declare @nRunQty  numeric(24,6)
   declare @nFifPrice  numeric(24,6)
   declare @nFifQty    numeric(24,6)

   IF ( @sPriceType = N'FIFO' OR @sPriceType = N'LIFO')
   BEGIN
      /* Retrieve tracking method */
      SELECT @sTrack = par_trackrtype
      FROM   r5parts
      WHERE  par_code = @sPart
      AND    par_org  = @sPartorg

      /* IF tracking method = TRQ, price = 0 */
      IF ISNULL( @sCom, 'x' ) <> 'I' AND @sTrack = N'TRQ'
         RETURN 0

      SET @nPrice = 0
      SET @nRunQty = 0

      IF ( @sPriceType = N'FIFO' )
      BEGIN
         DECLARE cFIFO CURSOR LOCAL FOR
         SELECT fif_price, fif_qty
         FROM   r5fifo
         WHERE fif_store    = @sStore
         AND   fif_part     = @sPart
         AND   fif_part_org = @sPartorg
         ORDER BY fif_date

         OPEN cFIFO
         FETCH NEXT FROM cFIFO INTO @nFifPrice, @nFifQty

         IF ( @nQty = 0 AND @@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
         BEGIN
            SET @nPrice = @nFifPrice
            SET @nRunQty = 1
         END
         ELSE
            WHILE ( @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @nQty > @nRunQty)
            BEGIN
               IF (@nQty > @nRunQty + @nFifQty)
               BEGIN
                  SET @nPrice = @nPrice + @nFifQty * @nFifPrice
                  SET @nRunQty = @nRunQty + @nFifQty
               END
               ELSE
               BEGIN
                  SET @nPrice = @nPrice + (@nQty - @nRunQty) * @nFifPrice
                  SET @nRunQty = @nRunQty + (@nQty - @nRunQty)
               END

               FETCH NEXT FROM cFIFO INTO @nFifPrice, @nFifQty
            END
         IF (@nRunQty = 0 )
            SET @nPrice = NULL
         ELSE
            SET @nPrice = @nPrice / @nRunQty

         CLOSE cFIFO
      END;
      ELSE
      IF ( @sPriceType = N'LIFO' )
      BEGIN
         DECLARE cLIFO CURSOR LOCAL FOR
         SELECT fif_price, fif_qty
         FROM   r5fifo
         WHERE fif_store    = @sStore
         AND   fif_part     = @sPart
         AND   fif_part_org = @sPartorg
         ORDER BY fif_date desc

         OPEN cLIFO
         FETCH NEXT FROM cLIFO INTO @nFifPrice, @nFifQty

         IF ( @nQty = 0 AND @@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
         BEGIN
            SET @nPrice = @nFifPrice
            SET @nRunQty = 1
         END
         ELSE
            WHILE ( @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @nQty > @nRunQty)
            BEGIN
               IF (@nQty > @nRunQty + @nFifQty)
               BEGIN
                  SET @nPrice = @nPrice + @nFifQty * @nFifPrice
                  SET @nRunQty = @nRunQty + @nFifQty
               END
               ELSE
               BEGIN
                  SET @nPrice = @nPrice + (@nQty - @nRunQty) * @nFifPrice
                  SET @nRunQty = @nRunQty + (@nQty - @nRunQty)
               END

               FETCH NEXT FROM cLIFO INTO @nFifPrice, @nFifQty
            END
         IF (@nRunQty = 0 )
            SET @nPrice = NULL
         ELSE
            SET @nPrice = @nPrice / @nRunQty

         CLOSE cLIFO
      END
   END
   ELSE
	SET @nPrice = dbo.o7getprc2( @sStore, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sOrg, @sPriceType, @sLev, @sCom ) 

   return isnull( @nPrice, 0 )
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GETPRCRATE
	@sEventorg    nvarchar(15),
	@sEvtmrc      nvarchar(15),
	@sActtrade    nvarchar(15),
	@dActstart    datetime,
	@sActordrtype nvarchar(4),
	@sTask        nvarchar(20),
	@sSupplier    nvarchar(30),
	@sSupplierorg nvarchar(15),
	@sTotalprice  numeric(24,12),
	@nExch        numeric(24,12)	OUTPUT,
	@nPrice       numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @nPriceTemp		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTskprice		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTskhours		numeric(14,4)
	declare @nCamultiply		numeric(10,4)
	declare @nCaprice		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nExchtodual		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nExchfromdual		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nExchTemp		numeric(24,12)
	declare @sCurr			nvarchar(3)
	declare @nTraderate		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @nCount			integer

    set @sCurr  =   dbo.o7getservcur( @sEventorg, @sTask, @sSupplier, @sSupplierorg)

    execute @nReturn = o7gtdual @sCurr, @sTotalprice, @nExchtodual OUTPUT, @nExchfromdual OUTPUT, @nExchTemp OUTPUT, @sEventorg, @dActstart 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sTask IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			SELECT @nTskprice = tpr_price,
					@nTskhours = case @sActordrtype when 'SF' then 1 else coalesce(tsk_hours,1) end
			From r5tasks LEFT OUTER JOIN r5Taskprices ON tsk_code = tpr_task and tsk_revision = tpr_revision and tpr_org = @sEventorg 
			WHERE tsk_code = @sTask and tsk_revrstatus = N'A'


			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5servicecatalogue
			WHERE  sca_task         = @sTask
			AND    sca_supplier     = @sSupplier
			AND    sca_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg;

			if @nCount > 0 
			begin
				SELECT @nCamultiply = coalesce( sca_multiply, 1 ),
					 @nCaprice = sca_price
				FROM   r5servicecatalogue
				WHERE  sca_task         = @sTask
				AND    sca_supplier     = @sSupplier
				AND    sca_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg;

				set @nPriceTemp = ROUND( @nCaprice / @nCamultiply / @nTskhours, 6 )
			end
			if @nPriceTemp IS NULL 
				set @nPriceTemp = ROUND( @nTskprice / @nTskhours * @nExchTemp, 6 )
		end



	 if @nPriceTemp IS NULL 
		 begin
			SELECT @nTraderate = t.trr_ntrate
			FROM   r5traderates t
			WHERE  t.trr_mrc      IN ( N'*', @sEvtmrc )
				AND    t.trr_trade    = @sActtrade
				AND    t.trr_org      = @sEventorg
				AND    t.trr_supplier = @sSupplier
				AND    t.trr_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
				AND    t.trr_start   <= dbo.o7gttime2( @sEventorg )
				AND    t.trr_end     >= dbo.o7gttime2( @sEventorg )
				AND    t.trr_person   = N'*'  
				AND    t.trr_octype   IN (SELECT uco_code
							  FROM r5ucodes
							  WHERE uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
							  AND   uco_rcode   = N'N'
							  AND   uco_system  = N'+')
				ORDER BY CASE t.trr_mrc WHEN N'*' THEN N'2' ELSE N'1' END		
				
			if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				set @nTraderate = 0		

			set @nPriceTemp = coalesce( @nTraderate, 0 )
		end

	set @nExch = @nExchTemp
	set @nPrice = @nPriceTemp

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETPRVSEQNO(
  @property NVARCHAR( 8 ), 
  @rentity  NVARCHAR( 4 ) ) 
  RETURNS   NUMERIC( 38, 0 )
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @seqno  NUMERIC( 38, 0 )
  SELECT @seqno = ISNULL( MAX( prv_seqno ), 0 ) + 1
  FROM   r5propertyvalues
  WHERE  prv_property = @property
  AND    prv_rentity  = @rentity
  AND    prv_code IS NULL

  RETURN ISNULL( @seqno, 1 )
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETRECVDATE (
    @sOrdercode     nvarchar(30),
    @sOrderorg      nvarchar(15),
    @sOrderpart     nvarchar(30),
    @sOrderpartorg  nvarchar(15),
    @sRecvqty       nvarchar(30),
    @sVreturntype   nvarchar(30)
  )
  returns datetime
as
begin
    declare @dApprovdate  datetime 
    declare @dRecvdate    datetime 
	declare @nLeadtime	int
	declare @nRecvqty		numeric(24,6)


    SELECT @dApprovdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( ord_approv, N'DD' )
    FROM   r5orders
    WHERE  ord_code = @sOrdercode
    AND    ord_org  = @sOrderorg

	set @nRecvqty = Cast(@sRecvqty as numeric(30,0))
    IF isnull( @nRecvqty, 0 ) > 0
	begin
        SELECT @dRecvdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( MIN( trl_date ), N'DD' )
        FROM   r5translines, r5transactions
        WHERE  tra_order     = @sOrdercode
        AND    tra_order_org = @sOrderorg
        AND    trl_trans     = tra_code
        AND    trl_part      = @sOrderpart
        AND    trl_part_org  = @sOrderpartorg
	end
    IF @dRecvdate IS NOT NULL AND @dApprovdate IS NOT NULL
        set @nLeadtime= datediff(Day, @dApprovdate, @dRecvdate)

    IF @sVreturntype = N'recvdate'
        RETURN @dRecvdate

    IF @sVreturntype = N'approvdate'
       RETURN @dApprovdate

    IF @sVreturntype NOT IN (N'recvdate',N'approvdate')
   		RETURN NULL
	return null
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETREFDIRECTION(
  @entity           NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @code             NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @activity         NUMERIC( 8 ),
  @fromreferenceid  NUMERIC( 24, 6 ),
  @toreferenceid    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) )
  RETURNS           NVARCHAR( 30 ) AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @direction              NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @offset                 NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @lrfoffset              NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @lrfdirection           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @wooffset               NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @wodirection            NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
  DECLARE @equipdirection         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @equipuom               NVARCHAR( 10 )
  DECLARE @oppositeequipdirection NVARCHAR( 30 )

  IF (@fromreferenceid IS NULL AND @toreferenceid IS NULL)  OR 
     (@fromreferenceid IS NOT NULL AND @toreferenceid IS NOT NULL)
    RETURN NULL
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      IF @entity IN ( N'EVNT', N'ACT' )
        SELECT @equipdirection = obj_direction,
               @equipuom       = obj_linearrefuom
        FROM   r5objects, r5events 
        WHERE  obj_code = evt_object 
        AND    obj_org  = evt_object_org 
        AND    evt_code = @code
      ELSE IF @entity = N'EPO'
        SELECT @equipdirection = obj_direction,
               @equipuom       = obj_linearrefuom 
        FROM   r5objects, r5eventpoints 
        WHERE  obj_code = epo_object 
        AND    obj_org  = epo_object_org 
        AND    epo_code = @code
      ELSE IF @entity = N'ACK' 
        SELECT @equipdirection = obj_direction,
               @equipuom       = obj_linearrefuom 
        FROM   r5objects, r5actchecklists 
        WHERE  obj_code = ack_object 
        AND    obj_org  = ack_object_org 
        AND    ack_code = @code
      ELSE IF @entity = N'DFA'
        SELECT @equipdirection = obj_direction,
               @equipuom       = obj_linearrefuom 
        FROM   r5objects, r5deferredact
        WHERE  obj_code = dfa_object 
        AND    obj_org  = dfa_object_org 
        AND    dfa_code = @code
      ELSE IF @entity = N'NCF'
        SELECT @equipdirection = obj_direction,
               @equipuom       = obj_linearrefuom 
        FROM   r5objects, r5nonconformities
        WHERE  obj_code = ncf_object 
        AND    obj_org  = ncf_object_org 
        AND    ncf_code = @code
     
      SELECT @oppositeequipdirection = t.direction 
      FROM   ( SELECT ldr_direction AS direction 
               FROM   r5lineardirections 
               WHERE  ( ldr_direction = @equipdirection OR ldr_oppositedirection = @equipdirection ) 
               UNION 
               SELECT ldr_oppositedirection AS direction 
               FROM   r5lineardirections 
               WHERE  ( ldr_direction = @equipdirection OR ldr_oppositedirection = @equipdirection ) ) t
      WHERE  t.direction != @equipdirection     
      
      IF @fromreferenceid IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN 
          SELECT @lrfoffset    = COALESCE( lrf_from_offset, 0 ) * dbo.o7pointuomconv( obj_linearrefuom, @equipuom ), 
                 @lrfdirection = lrf_from_offset_direction
          FROM   r5objects, r5objlinearref 
          WHERE  obj_code = lrf_objcode 
          AND    obj_org  = lrf_objorg
          AND    lrf_id   = @fromreferenceid
          AND    lrf_from_reference IS NOT NULL
          IF @lrfoffset IS NULL
            RETURN NULL
 
          IF @entity = N'EVNT'   
            SELECT @wodirection = COALESCE( evt_from_offset_direction, @equipdirection ), @wooffset = COALESCE( evt_from_offset, 0 )
            FROM   r5events 
            WHERE  evt_code = @code
          ELSE IF @entity = N'EPO' 
            SELECT @wodirection = COALESCE( epo_from_offset_direction, @equipdirection ), @wooffset = COALESCE( epo_from_offset, 0 )
            FROM   r5eventpoints 
            WHERE  epo_code = @code
          ELSE IF @entity = N'ACK'
            SELECT @wodirection = COALESCE( ack_from_offset_direction, @equipdirection ), @wooffset = COALESCE( ack_from_offset, 0 )
            FROM   r5actchecklists
            WHERE  ack_code = @code
          ELSE IF @entity = N'ACT' 
            SELECT @wodirection = COALESCE( act_from_offset_direction, @equipdirection ), @wooffset = COALESCE( act_from_offset, 0 )
            FROM   r5activities 
            WHERE  act_event = @code
            AND    act_act   = @activity
          ELSE IF @entity = N'DFA' 
            SELECT @wodirection = COALESCE( dfa_from_offset_direction, @equipdirection ), @wooffset = COALESCE( dfa_from_offset, 0 )
            FROM   r5deferredact 
            WHERE  dfa_code = @code
          ELSE IF @entity = N'NCF' 
            SELECT @wodirection = COALESCE( ncf_from_offset_direction, @equipdirection ), @wooffset = COALESCE( ncf_from_offset, 0 )
            FROM   r5nonconformities 
            WHERE  ncf_code = @code
        END
	 
      IF @toreferenceid IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
          SELECT @lrfdirection = COALESCE( lrf_to_offset_direction, @equipdirection ), 
                 @lrfoffset    = COALESCE( lrf_to_offset, 0 ) * dbo.o7pointuomconv( obj_linearrefuom, @equipuom )
          FROM   r5objects, r5objlinearref 
          WHERE  obj_code = lrf_objcode 
          AND    obj_org  = lrf_objorg
          AND    lrf_id   = @toreferenceid
          AND    lrf_to_reference IS NOT NULL
          IF @lrfoffset IS NULL
            RETURN NULL

          IF @entity = N'EVNT'   
            SELECT @wodirection = COALESCE( evt_to_offset_direction, @equipdirection ), @wooffset = COALESCE( evt_to_offset, 0 )
            FROM   r5events 
            WHERE  evt_code = @code
          ELSE IF @entity = N'EPO' 
            SELECT @wodirection = COALESCE( epo_to_offset_direction, @equipdirection ), @wooffset = COALESCE( epo_to_offset, 0 )
            FROM   r5eventpoints 
            WHERE  epo_code = @code
          ELSE IF @entity = N'ACK'
            SELECT @wodirection = COALESCE( ack_to_offset_direction, @equipdirection ), @wooffset = COALESCE( ack_to_offset, 0 )
            FROM   r5actchecklists
            WHERE  ack_code = @code
          ELSE IF @entity = N'ACT' 
            SELECT @wodirection = COALESCE( act_to_offset_direction, @equipdirection ), @wooffset = COALESCE( act_to_offset, 0 )
            FROM   r5activities 
            WHERE  act_event = @code
            AND    act_act   = @activity
          ELSE IF @entity = N'DFA' 
            SELECT @wodirection = COALESCE( dfa_to_offset_direction, @equipdirection ), @wooffset = COALESCE( dfa_to_offset, 0 )
            FROM   r5deferredact 
            WHERE  dfa_code = @code
          ELSE IF @entity = N'NCF' 
            SELECT @wodirection = COALESCE( ncf_to_offset_direction, @equipdirection ), @wooffset = COALESCE( ncf_to_offset, 0 )
            FROM   r5nonconformities 
            WHERE  ncf_code = @code
	END
         
      IF @lrfdirection = @oppositeequipdirection 
        SET @lrfoffset = (-1) * @lrfoffset

      IF @wodirection = @oppositeequipdirection 
        SET @wooffset = (-1) * @wooffset
 
      SET @offset = @wooffset + @lrfoffset
      
      IF @offset < 0 
        SET @direction = @oppositeequipdirection
      ELSE
        SET @direction = @equipdirection    
    END
  RETURN @direction
END

create function O7GETREQTOTAL(	@sReqcode	nvarchar(30))
returns numeric(30,6)
as
begin
	declare @nRequisition	numeric(30,6)
	declare @nCount			int

	select	@nCount = count(*)
      FROM  r5requislines e
     WHERE  e.rql_req    = @sReqcode

	if @nCount = 0
		set @nRequisition = 0
	else
		SELECT	@nRequisition = ROUND( SUM( (CASE e.rql_rtype 
											WHEN 'SF'	THEN e.rql_price
											ELSE e.rql_price * e.rql_qty
											END) / COALESCE( e.rql_exch, 1 ) ), 2 )
		  FROM  r5requislines e
	     WHERE  e.rql_req    = @sReqcode
		
	return( @nRequisition )
end

create function O7GETSAFETY(	@sObject			nvarchar(30),

			OR o.obj_code	= @sObject_location )

			AND    o.obj_safety = N'+'

				set @nResult = -1
		end
	
	return (@nResult)

create function O7GETSCH( @sEmpCode nvarchar(15) )
returns nvarchar(4000)
as
begin
	declare @sReturn    nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sDummy     nvarchar(30)
    declare @sReinitial nvarchar(15) 
    declare @dDate      datetime
    declare @nHours     numeric(5,2)

    set @sReturn    = N''

	declare c_empavail cursor local for select mpv_resinitial,
                                                mpv_date,
                                                mpv_hours
                                                FROM r5mpavailabilities
                                                WHERE mpv_resinitial= @sEmpCode
	open c_empavail
	fetch next from c_empavail into @sReinitial, @dDate, @nHours
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
            if @sReinitial is not null
                begin
                    if @sReturn <> N'' or len(@sReturn) <> 0 
                        set @sReturn = @sReturn + N','

                    set @sReturn = @sReturn +  @sReinitial +  N'#'
                    set @sReturn = @sReturn + convert(nvarchar, @dDate, 101) + N'#'
                    set @sReturn = @sReturn + cast(@nHours as nvarchar(8))
                end
			fetch next from c_empavail into @sReinitial, @dDate, @nHours
		end
	close c_empavail
	deallocate c_empavail

	return ( @sReturn )
end

create function O7GETSEARCHSCORE( @sText nvarchar(4000), @sSearch nvarchar(400),@sRequired nvarchar(400) )
returns numeric(38,0)
as
begin

    declare @nScore         numeric(38,0)
    declare @nPos           integer
    declare @nLastPos       integer
    declare @sUText         nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sUSearch       nvarchar(400)
    declare @sUReq          nvarchar(400)
    declare @sWord          nvarchar(200)
    declare @nWordCount     integer
    declare @nMatchCount    integer
    declare @sUReqtemp      nvarchar(400)
    declare @sUSearchtemp   nvarchar(400)
    
    set @nScore=0
    set @sUText =   UPPER(@sText)
    set @nMatchCount = 0
    set @nWordCount = 0
    set @nLastPos = 1
    set @nPos = 0

    IF @sRequired is not null 
        BEGIN
            set @sUReq = UPPER(@sRequired)
            set @nPos = charindex(N'+',@sUReq) -- we use + as phrase delimiter
            WHILE @nPos>0 
                begin
                    set @sWord = substring(@sUReq,@nLastPos,@nPos-@nLastPos)
                    IF charindex(@sWord,@sUText) <1 
						return @nScore  -- required word not in, return 0 score.

                    set @nWordCount =@nWordCount+1
                    set @nMatchCount = @nMatchCount+1
                    set @nLastPos = @nPos+ 1 -- skip the '+'
                    
                    --work around for vPos:=instr(vUReq,'+',vLastPos);
                    set @nPos=charindex(N'+',@sUReq,@nLastPos)
                    
                end
            --check the last one.
            set @sWord = substring(@sUReq,@nLastPos, len(@sUReq))

            IF charindex(@sWord,@sUText) <1 
                return @nScore  -- required word not in, return 0 score.

            set @nWordCount =@nWordCount+1
            set @nMatchCount = @nMatchCount+1
        END
 
  -- now check for optional phrase/words
    IF @sSearch is not null 
        BEGIN
            set @sUSearch =UPPER(@sSearch)
            set @nLastPos = 1
            set @nPos = charindex(N'+',@sUSearch) -- we use + as phrase delimiter
            WHILE @nPos>0 
            begin
                set @sWord = substring(@sUSearch,@nLastPos,@nPos-@nLastPos)
                set @nWordCount =@nWordCount+1
                IF charindex(@sWord,@sUText) >0 
                    set @nMatchCount = @nMatchCount+1
                
                set @nLastPos = @nPos+1 -- skip the '+'
                set @nPos=charindex('+',@sUSearch,@nLastPos)
                
            end 
            --check the last one.
            set @sWord = substring(@sUSearch,@nLastPos,len(@sUSearch))
            set @nWordCount =@nWordCount+1
            IF charindex(@sWord,@sUText) >0 
                set @nMatchCount = @nMatchCount+1
        END
  
   -- now calculate the score
   if(@nWordCount <>0) 
         set @nScore = @nMatchCount*100/@nWordCount
                 
	return (@nScore)
end

create FUNCTION O7GETSERVCUR (
	@sEventorg    nvarchar(15),
	@sTask        nvarchar(20),
	@sSupplier    nvarchar(30),
	@sSupplierorg nvarchar(15)
  )
returns nvarchar(3)
as
begin
	declare @nCount		integer
	declare @sCurrency     nvarchar(3)


	select @nCount = count(*)
    FROM   R5SERVICECATALOGUE
    WHERE  sca_task = @sTask
    AND    sca_supplier = @sSupplier
    AND    sca_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg

	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT @sCurrency = sca_curr
		FROM   R5SERVICECATALOGUE
		WHERE  sca_task = @sTask
		AND    sca_supplier = @sSupplier
		AND    sca_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
	else
      set @sCurrency = null

	IF @sCurrency IS NULL 
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   R5COMPANIES
			WHERE  com_code = @sSupplier
			AND    com_org = @sSupplierorg

			if @nCount > 0 
				SELECT @sCurrency = com_curr
				FROM   R5COMPANIES
				WHERE  com_code = @sSupplier
				AND    com_org = @sSupplierorg
			else
			      set @sCurrency = null
		end


	IF @sCurrency IS NULL 
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   R5ORGANIZATION
			WHERE  org_code = @sEventorg

			if @nCount > 0 
				SELECT @sCurrency = org_curr
				FROM   R5ORGANIZATION
				WHERE  org_code = @sEventorg
			else
			      set @sCurrency = null
		end



  RETURN (@sCurrency)
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETSERVPRC2( @sEventorg    nvarchar(15),
								@sEvtmrc      nvarchar(15),
								@sActtrade    nvarchar(15),
								@dActstart    datetime,
								@sActordrtype nvarchar(4),
								@sTask        nvarchar(20),
								@sSupplier    nvarchar(30),
								@sSupplierorg nvarchar(15))
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin 
	declare @nPriceTemp		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTskprice		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTskhours		numeric(14,4)
	declare @nCamultiply		numeric(10,4)
	declare @nCaprice		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nExchtodual		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nExchfromdual		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nExchTemp		numeric(24,12)
	declare @sCurr			nvarchar(3)
	declare @nTraderate		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @nCount			integer

	declare @nTotalprice		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nPrice			numeric(24,6)		

	declare @sBasecurr		nvarchar(3)		
	declare @sDualcurr		nvarchar(200)	
	declare @nBasecurr_dual		int
	declare @nActcurr_dual		int
	declare @nBasevalue		int
	declare @nNvalue		numeric(24,12)
	declare @sOrdorgcurr		nvarchar(3)	
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(3) 
	declare @nContinue		int	

	set @nTotalprice	= 10000
	set @nPriceTemp		= null
	set @sCurr		= dbo.o7getservcur( @sEventorg, @sTask, @sSupplier, @sSupplierorg)

	/*This function must abosrb 07GTDUAL*/
	/*beginning of 07GTDUAL*/
	SET @nExchtodual   = null
	SET @nExchfromdual = null
	SET @nExchTemp     = null

	/* If no currency supplied  return without doing anything */
	IF @sCurr IS NULL 
		GOTO O7GTDUAL_END

	SET @nNvalue = @nTotalprice

	/* Get the base currency for the order organization. If no organization */
	/* supplied  return without doing anything. */
	IF @sEventorg IS NOT NULL 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @sBasecurr = org_curr
			FROM   r5organization
			WHERE  org_code = @sEventorg

			if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				GOTO O7GTDUAL_END
		END

	/* If the currency equals the base currency,  rate should always be 1. */
	SELECT @sDualcurr = ins_desc
	FROM   r5install
	WHERE  ins_code = N'DUALCURR'

	IF @sBasecurr = @sCurr 
		BEGIN
			SET @nExchTemp = 1
			GOTO O7GTDUAL_END
		END

	/* Check whether base currency belongs to Euro. */
	SELECT @nBasecurr_dual = cur_dual
	FROM   r5currencies
	WHERE  cur_code = @sBasecurr


	/* Check whether given currency belongs to Euro. */
	SELECT @nActcurr_dual = cur_dual
	FROM   r5currencies
	WHERE  cur_code = @sCurr

	/* If given currency = dual currency and base currency belongs to Euro  */
	/* return reciproke of above retrieved rate.                                */
	IF @nBasecurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @sCurr = @sDualcurr 
		BEGIN
			SET @nExchTemp = ROUND( 1 / @nBasecurr_dual, 6 )
			GOTO O7GTDUAL_END
		END

	/* If base currency = dual currency and given currency belongs to Euro  */
	/* return above retrieved rate.                                             */
	IF @nActcurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @sBasecurr = @sDualcurr 
		BEGIN
			SET @nExchTemp = @nActcurr_dual
			GOTO O7GTDUAL_END
		END 

	IF @nBasecurr_dual IS NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NULL 
		/* Normal exchange rate. */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nExchTemp = crr_exch
			FROM   r5exchrates
			WHERE  crr_curr    = @sCurr
			AND    crr_orgcurr = @sBasecurr
			AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dActstart, N'DD') BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE ( crr_start, N'DD' ) AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD' )
			
			GOTO O7GTDUAL_END
		END

	IF @nBasecurr_dual IS NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NOT NULL 
	 /* Triangular!! */
		BEGIN
			SET @nExchtodual = @nActcurr_dual
			
			SELECT @nExchfromdual = crr_exch
			FROM   r5exchrates
			WHERE  crr_curr    = @sDualcurr
			AND    crr_orgcurr = @sBasecurr
			AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dActstart, N'DD') BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE ( crr_start, N'DD' ) AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD' )
			
			SET @nBasevalue = round( @nNvalue / @nExchtodual / @nExchfromdual, 4 )
			SET @nExchTemp = round( @nNvalue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
			
			GOTO O7GTDUAL_END
		END

	IF @nBasecurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NULL 
	/* Triangular!! */
		BEGIN
			SET @nExchfromdual = @nBasecurr_dual

			SELECT @nExchtodual = crr_exch
			FROM   r5exchrates
			WHERE  crr_curr    = @sCurr
			AND    crr_orgcurr = @sDualcurr
			AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dActstart, N'DD') BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE ( crr_start, N'DD' ) AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD' )

			SET @nBasevalue = round( @nNvalue / @nExchtodual * @nExchfromdual, 4 )
			SET @nExchTemp = round( @nNvalue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
			
			GOTO O7GTDUAL_END
		END

	--if you get this far tehn none of the above conditions were met
	/* Triangular!! */
	SET @nExchfromdual = @nBasecurr_dual
	SET @nExchtodual = @nActcurr_dual
	SET @nBasevalue = round( @nNvalue / @nExchtodual * @nExchfromdual, 4 )
	SET @nExchTemp = round( @nNvalue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
	/*end of GTDUAL FUNCTION */

O7GTDUAL_END:
	
	if @sTask IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			SELECT @nTskprice = tpr_price,
					@nTskhours = case @sActordrtype when 'SF' then 1 else coalesce(tsk_hours,1) end
			From r5tasks LEFT OUTER JOIN r5Taskprices ON tsk_code = tpr_task and tsk_revision = tpr_revision and tpr_org = @sEventorg 
			WHERE tsk_code = @sTask and tsk_revrstatus = N'A'


			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5servicecatalogue
			WHERE  sca_task         = @sTask
			AND    sca_supplier     = @sSupplier
			AND    sca_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg

			if @nCount > 0 
			begin
				SELECT @nCamultiply = coalesce( sca_multiply, 1 ),
					 @nCaprice = sca_price
				FROM   r5servicecatalogue
				WHERE  sca_task         = @sTask
				AND    sca_supplier     = @sSupplier
				AND    sca_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg

				set @nPriceTemp = ROUND( @nCaprice / @nCamultiply / @nTskhours, 6 )
			end
			if @nPriceTemp IS NULL 
				set @nPriceTemp = ROUND( @nTskprice / @nTskhours * @nExchTemp, 6 )
		end



	 if @nPriceTemp IS NULL 
		 begin
			SELECT @nTraderate = t.trr_ntrate
			FROM   r5traderates t
			WHERE  t.trr_mrc      IN ( N'*', @sEvtmrc )
			AND    t.trr_trade    = @sActtrade
			AND    t.trr_org      = @sEventorg
			AND    t.trr_supplier = @sSupplier
			AND    t.trr_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
			AND    t.trr_start   <= dbo.o7gttime2( @sEventorg )
			AND    t.trr_end     >= dbo.o7gttime2( @sEventorg )
			AND    t.trr_person   = N'*'
			AND    t.trr_octype   IN (SELECT uco_code
						  FROM r5ucodes
						  WHERE uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
						  AND   uco_rcode   = N'N'
						  AND   uco_system  = N'+')
			ORDER BY CASE t.trr_mrc WHEN N'*' THEN N'ZZZZ' else t.trr_mrc end		
				
			if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				set @nTraderate = 0		

			set @nPriceTemp = coalesce( @nTraderate, 0 )
		end

	if @nPriceTemp IS NULL
		set @nPriceTemp = 0

	set @nExchTemp = @nExchTemp
	set @nPrice = @nPriceTemp
	RETURN (@nPrice)
end
