CREATE PROCEDURE O7GETSLOPE
  @sTablename    NVARCHAR( 50 ),
  @sValuecolumn  NVARCHAR( 50 ),
  @sValuecolumn2 NVARCHAR( 50 ),
  @sDatecolumn   NVARCHAR( 50 ),
  @sWhereclause  NVARCHAR( 1000 ),
  @nSlope        NUMERIC(20, 10 ) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN  
  DECLARE @sRefdate   NVARCHAR( 100 )
  DECLARE @nAvgdate   NUMERIC(20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nAvgvalue  NUMERIC(20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nAvgvalue2 NUMERIC(20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nSumxx     NUMERIC(20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nSumxy     NUMERIC(20, 10 )
  DECLARE @sSql       NVARCHAR( 1000 )
  DECLARE @nResult    NUMERIC(20, 10 )

  SET @sRefdate = 'dbo.TO_DATE( N''01-01-2009'', N''MM-DD-YYYY'' )'

  /* Retrieve the average value of the column specified in parameter valuecolumn. */
  SET @sSql = N'SELECT @nOutput = AVG( ' + @sValuecolumn + ' ) FROM ' + @sTablename + ' ' + @sWhereclause
  EXEC sp_executeSql @sSql, N'@nOutput NUMERIC(20, 10 ) OUTPUT', @nAvgvalue OUTPUT

  IF @sDatecolumn IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Retrieve the average value of the date column specified in parameter datecolumn. */
      SET @sSql = N'SELECT @nOutput = AVG( DATEDIFF( dd, ' + @sRefdate + ', ' + @sDatecolumn + ' ) ) FROM ' + 
                  @sTablename + ' ' + @sWhereclause
      EXEC sp_executeSql @sSql, N'@nOutput NUMERIC(20, 10 ) OUTPUT', @nAvgdate OUTPUT
    END
  ELSE
    /* Retrieve the average value of the column specified in parameter valuecolumn2. */
    BEGIN
      SET @sSql = N'SELECT @nOutput = AVG( ' + @sValuecolumn2 + ' ) FROM ' + @sTablename + ' ' + @sWhereclause
      EXEC sp_executeSql @sSql, N'@nOutput NUMERIC(20, 10 ) OUTPUT', @nAvgvalue2 OUTPUT
    END

  /* Calculate intermediate values. */
  IF @nAvgvalue IS NOT NULL AND @nAvgdate IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      SET @sSql = N'SELECT @nOutput = SUM( ( DATEDIFF( dd, ' + @sRefdate + ', ' + @sDatecolumn + ' ) - ' + CAST( @nAvgdate AS NVARCHAR ) + ' ) * ' +
                                         N'( DATEDIFF( dd, ' + @sRefdate + ', ' + @sDatecolumn + ' ) - ' + CAST( @nAvgdate AS NVARCHAR ) + ' ) )' +
                  N'FROM ' + @sTablename + ' ' + @sWhereclause
      EXEC sp_executeSql @sSql, N'@nOutput NUMERIC(20, 10 ) OUTPUT', @nSumxx OUTPUT

      SET @sSql = N'SELECT @nOutput = SUM( ( DATEDIFF( dd, ' + @sRefdate + ', ' + @sDatecolumn + ' ) - ' + CAST( @nAvgdate AS NVARCHAR ) + ' ) * ' +
                                         N'( ' + @sValuecolumn + ' - ' + CAST( @nAvgvalue AS NVARCHAR ) + ' ) )' +
                  N'FROM ' + @sTablename + ' ' + @sWhereclause
      EXEC sp_executeSql @sSql, N'@nOutput NUMERIC(20, 10 ) OUTPUT', @nSumxy OUTPUT
     END
  ELSE IF @nAvgvalue IS NOT NULL AND @nAvgvalue2 IS NOT NULL 
    BEGIN
      SET @sSql = N'SELECT @nOutput = SUM( ( ' + @sValuecolumn2 + ' - ' + CAST( @nAvgvalue2 AS NVARCHAR )  + ' ) * ' +
                                         N'( ' + @sValuecolumn2 + ' - ' + CAST( @nAvgvalue2 AS NVARCHAR ) + ' ) )' +
                  N'FROM ' + @sTablename + ' ' + @sWhereclause
      EXEC sp_executeSql @sSql, N'@nOutput NUMERIC(20, 10 ) OUTPUT', @nSumxx OUTPUT

      SET @sSql = N'SELECT @nOutput = SUM( ( ' + @sValuecolumn2 + ' - ' + CAST( @nAvgvalue2 AS NVARCHAR ) + ' ) * ' +
                                         N'( ' + @sValuecolumn  + ' - ' + CAST( @nAvgvalue  AS NVARCHAR ) + ' ) )' +
                  N'FROM ' + @sTablename + ' ' + @sWhereclause
      EXEC sp_executeSql @sSql, N'@nOutput NUMERIC(20, 10 ) OUTPUT', @nSumxy OUTPUT
    END

  /* Calculate slope. */
  IF @nSumxx <> 0
    SET @nSlope = @nSumxy / @nSumxx

END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETSTORE( @sPart      nvarchar(30), 
                                @sOrg       nvarchar(15),
                                @sR5group   nvarchar(30),
                                @sR5user    nvarchar(255),
                                @sBin       nvarchar(30),
                                @sR5role    nvarchar(30) = '*' )
returns nvarchar(15)
as 
    begin
        declare @sStore     nvarchar(15)
        declare @sDefbin    nvarchar(15)
        declare @sRepbin    nvarchar(15)
        declare @sReturn    nvarchar(15)

        set @sReturn = null

        SELECT @sStore = sto_store, @sDefbin = sto_defaultbin, @sRepbin = sto_repdefaultbin
        FROM   r5userorganization, r5install, r5stores, r5stock
        WHERE  sto_store    = str_code
        AND    str_org      = uog_org
        AND    uog_user     = @sR5user
        AND    uog_role     = @sR5role
        AND    sto_part     = @sPart
        AND    sto_part_org = @sOrg
        AND    ins_code     = N'STORESEC'
        AND  ( UPPER( ins_desc ) <> N'ON' OR
                 EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                         FROM   r5storesecurity
                         WHERE  ssc_group = @sR5group
                         AND    ssc_store = sto_store
                         AND    ssc_issuereturn = N'+' ) )

        if @@ROWCOUNT = 1
            select @sReturn = CASE @sBin WHEN N'+' THEN @sDefbin WHEN N'R' THEN @sRepbin ELSE @sStore END

        return @sReturn
    end

create function O7GETTAB( @sFunc  nvarchar(6), @sBlock nvarchar(15) )
returns nvarchar(6)
as
begin
	declare @nCount 		integer
	declare @sTab			nvarchar(6) 
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nContinue		integer

	set @sTab = NULL
	set @nContinue = 0

	IF @sFunc = N'OMOBJC' AND @sBlock = N'B2WCV2' 
		begin
			set @nContinue = 1
			set @sTab = N'WCV'
		end

	IF @sFunc = N'BMFUNC' AND @sBlock = N'B2PMT' 
		begin
			set @nContinue = 1
			set @sTab = N'GPM'
		end

	IF @sFunc = N'BMGROU' AND @sBlock IN ( N'B2PDM1', N'PDM2', N'PDM3' ) 
		begin
			set @nContinue = 1
			set @sTab = N'PDM1'
		end

	IF @sFunc = N'BMGROU' AND @sBlock = N'B2TRP' 
		begin
			set @nContinue = 1
			set @sTab = N'PRM'
		end

	IF @sBlock LIKE  N'B2%' and @nContinue = 0
		set @sTab = substring( @sBlock, 3, 4 )

	if @sTab is not null 
		begin
			if not exists (	SELECT 'x'
							FROM   r5functiontabs f
							WHERE  f.ftb_function = @sFunc
							AND    f.ftb_tab      = @sTab )
				set @sTab = null  
		end

	return(@sTab)

END

create function O7GETTAX (	@sTaxCode			nvarchar(30),
							@dDate				datetime )
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin
	declare @nPercent	numeric(24,6)

	set @nPercent = 0

	/* Find taxpercentage */
	IF @sTaxCode IS NOT NULL and @dDate is not null
		SELECT @nPercent = coalesce( SUM(txv_percent), 0 )
		FROM   r5taxratevalues, r5taxcoderates
		WHERE  dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dDate, N'DD') BETWEEN txv_start AND txv_end
		AND    txv_rate = tcr_rate
		AND    tcr_tax = @sTaxCode

	return ( @nPercent )
end

create function O7GETTAX2 (	@sTaxCode			nvarchar(30),
							@dDate				datetime )
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin
	declare @nPercent	numeric(24,6)

	set @nPercent = 0

	/* Find taxpercentage */
	IF @sTaxCode IS NOT NULL and @dDate is not null
		SELECT @nPercent = coalesce( SUM(d.txv_percent), 0 )
        FROM   r5taxes a, r5taxcoderates b, r5taxrates c, r5taxratevalues d
        WHERE  a.tax_code  = b.tcr_tax      
        AND    b.tcr_rate  = c.txr_code     
        AND    c.txr_code  = d.txv_rate     
        AND    a.tax_code  = @sTaxCode
        AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dDate, N'DD') BETWEEN d.txv_start AND d.txv_end
        AND    c.txr_invcalc <> N'-'
	return ( @nPercent )
end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETTEXTWSRVCS(
  @sPagename      NVARCHAR( 40 ),
  @sElementid     NVARCHAR( 40 ),
  @sLang          NVARCHAR( 2 ) )
  RETURNS NVARCHAR( 80 ) AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @sText NVARCHAR( 80 )

  IF LEN( @sPagename ) = 6
    SELECT @sText = bot_text 
    FROM   r5boilertexts 
    WHERE  bot_function = @sPagename 
    AND    bot_lang = @sLang
    AND    bot_fld1 = UPPER( @sElementid )
  ELSE  
    SELECT @sText = bot_text 
    FROM   r5boilertexts 
    WHERE  bot_function = SUBSTRING( @sPagename, 1, 6 ) 
    AND    bot_lang = @sLang
    AND    bot_fld1 = SUBSTRING( @sPagename, 8, 3 ) + '_' + UPPER( @sElementid )

  RETURN ISNULL( @sText, @sElementid )
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GETTOPOBJECT
  @object       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @org          NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @rtype        NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @topobject    NVARCHAR( 30 ) OUTPUT,
  @topobjectorg NVARCHAR( 15 ) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @obrtype           NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @parent            NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @parentorg         NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @position          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @positionorg       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @primarysystem     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @primarysystemorg  NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @child             NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @childorg          NVARCHAR( 15 )

  /* Retrieve data of the current object. */
  SELECT @obrtype          = obj_obrtype, 
         @parent           = obj_parent, 
         @parentorg        = obj_parent_org, 
         @position         = obj_position, 
         @positionorg      = obj_position_org, 
         @primarysystem    = obj_primarysystem, 
         @primarysystemorg = obj_primarysystem_org 
  FROM   r5objects
  WHERE  obj_code = @object
  AND    obj_org  = @org

  IF @obrtype IS NULL
    /* If no valid object found, return. */
    RETURN

  IF @obrtype = N'P' AND @rtype = N'A'  
     /* Special case when the current object is a Position and the top object to retrieve is an Asset, use r5structures to get the first parent. */
    SELECT @child    = stc_parent, 
           @childorg = stc_parent_org
    FROM   r5structures
    WHERE  stc_child       = @object
    AND    stc_child_org   = @org
    AND    stc_parentrtype = N'A'
  ELSE IF @obrtype = N'A' AND @rtype = N'P'
    BEGIN
      /* Special case when the current object is an Asset and the top object to retrieve is a Position, use column obj_position. */
      IF @position IS NOT NULL 
        BEGIN
          SET @child    = @position
          SET @childorg = @positionorg
        END
    END
  ELSE IF @obrtype IN ( N'L', N'C', N'I' ) 
    /* Locations ( and Categories, Profiles ) don't have parents, so return. */
    RETURN
  ELSE IF @obrtype = N'S' AND @rtype IN ( N'A', N'P' ) 
    /* Systems can't have Asset or Position parents, so return. */
    RETURN
  ELSE IF @rtype = N'S' 
    BEGIN
      /* For parent Systems, use the primary system column. */
      SET @child    = @primarysystem
      SET @childorg = @primarysystemorg
    END
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      /* Otherwise ( top Asset for Asset and top Position for Position ), use the parent column. */
      SET @child    = @parent
      SET @childorg = @parentorg
    END

  WHILE @child IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* As long as there still is an object, try to find its parent. */
      SET @topobject    = @child
      SET @topobjectorg = @childorg
      SELECT @child    = CASE @rtype WHEN N'S' THEN obj_primarysystem     ELSE obj_parent     END,
             @childorg = CASE @rtype WHEN N'S' THEN obj_primarysystem_org ELSE obj_parent_org END
      FROM   r5objects
      WHERE  obj_code = @child
      AND    obj_org  = @childorg

    END
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETTRADERATE(
  @mrc     NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @trade   NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @sdate   DATETIME,
  @org     NVARCHAR( 15 ) )
  RETURNS NUMERIC(24,6) AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @rate NUMERIC(24,6)
  SELECT @rate = trr_ntrate
  FROM   r5traderates
  WHERE  trr_trade    = @trade
  AND    trr_mrc     IN ( N'*', @mrc )
  AND    trr_supplier = N'*'
  AND    trr_org      = @org
  AND    trr_start   <= @sdate
  AND    trr_end     >=  @sdate
  AND    trr_person   = '*'
  AND    trr_octype	  = ( SELECT uco_code
                          FROM   r5ucodes
                          WHERE  uco_rentity = N'OCTP'
                          AND    uco_rcode   = N'N'
                          AND    uco_system  = N'+' )
  ORDER BY CASE trr_mrc WHEN N'*' THEN N'2' ELSE N'1' END DESC
  RETURN  ISNULL( @rate, 0 )
END

create function O7GETTSKPRICE (
   @sTask          nvarchar(20),
   @sOrg           nvarchar(15),
   @nRevision      numeric(4),
   @sUser          nvarchar(255),
   @sRole          nvarchar(30) = '*' )
returns numeric(24,6) 
as
begin
	declare @sVorg          nvarchar(15)		
	declare @sVcommon       nvarchar(1)		
	declare @sVdeforg       nvarchar(15)	
	declare @nVprice        numeric(24,6)	
	declare @nCount 		integer
	declare @sTab			nvarchar(6) 
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nContinue		integer

	set @nVprice = null
	set @sVorg = null

	SELECT @sVcommon = org_common 
	FROM   r5organization
	WHERE  org_code = @sOrg

	IF @sVcommon = N'-' 
		set @sVorg = @sOrg
	ELSE
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5userorganization
			WHERE  uog_user    = @sUser
			AND    uog_role    = @sRole
			AND    uog_default = N'+'
			if @nCount > 0 
				SELECT @sVdeforg = uog_org 
				FROM   r5userorganization
				WHERE  uog_user    = @sUser
				AND    uog_user    = @sRole
				AND    uog_default = N'+'
			else
				set @sX = NULL
			if @sVdeforg IS NOT NULL 
				set @sVorg = @sVdeforg
			else
				SELECT @sVorg = SUBSTRING(ins_desc,1,15) 
				FROM   r5install
				WHERE  ins_code = N'DEFORG'
		end

	IF @sVorg IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5taskprices
			WHERE  tpr_task     = @sTask
			AND    tpr_revision = @nRevision
			AND    tpr_org      = @sVorg
			if @nCount > 0 
				SELECT @nVprice = tpr_price 
				FROM   r5taskprices
				WHERE  tpr_task     = @sTask
				AND    tpr_revision = @nRevision
				AND    tpr_org      = @sVorg

		end

   return(@nVprice)
END

create procedure O7GETUSERPARAMETER( @sParam nvarchar(15), 
                                     @sResult nvarchar(255) OUTPUT)
as
begin

    declare @nResult           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sChk              nvarchar(1)
    declare @sSQL              nvarchar(200)
    declare @sTable            nvarchar(32)
    declare @sValue            nvarchar(255)
    declare @sUser             nvarchar(255)
    declare @sRole             nvarchar(30)

    SET @sTable = N'##GTMP_PACKAGE_VARIABLES' + CAST( @@SPID as nvarchar(10) )

    --create if table does not already exist
    if object_id('tempdb..' + @sTable ) is not null
        BEGIN
            SET @sSQL = N'select @sValue = VARIABLE_VALUE from ' + @sTable
            SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N' where PACKAGE_NAME = ''O7SESS'' and '
            SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N' VARIABLE_NAME = ''R5USER'''
            EXEC sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@sValue nvarchar(2000) OUTPUT', @sValue OUTPUT
            SET @sUser = @sValue

            SET @sSQL = N'select @sValue = VARIABLE_VALUE from ' + @sTable
            SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N' where PACKAGE_NAME = ''O7SESS'' and '
            SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N' VARIABLE_NAME = ''R5ROLE'''
            EXEC sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@sValue nvarchar(2000) OUTPUT', @sValue OUTPUT
            SET @sRole = @sValue
        END

   IF @sUser IS NOT NULL

      begin

          IF @sParam ='USER' 
             begin
                SET @sResult = @sUser
             end

          IF @sParam ='ROLE' 
             begin
                SET @sResult = @sRole
             end

          IF @sParam ='ORG'
             begin
                SELECT @sResult = uog_org
                FROM   r5userorganization
                WHERE  uog_user = @sUser
                AND    uog_role = @sRole
                AND    uog_default = N'+'
             end

          IF @sParam = 'GROUP'
             begin
                SELECT @sResult = usr_group
                FROM   r5users
                WHERE  usr_code = @sUser
             end

          IF @sParam = 'DFLTORG' 
             begin
                 SET @sResult = dbo.o7dflt2('DEFORG');
                 IF @sResult IS NULL
                     begin
                        SELECT @sResult = usr_group
                        FROM   r5users
                        WHERE  usr_code = @sUser
                     end
            end
       end
end

create function O7GETWAR(	@sObject		nvarchar(30),
							@sObject_org	nvarchar(15),
							@sObtype		nvarchar(40)
)
returns int
as
begin
	declare @sChk		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sUnderwar	nvarchar(1)
	declare @nResult	int
	declare @nCount		int
        declare @sWOorg      nvarchar(15)

        if charindex( '#', @sObtype ) > 0
            set @sWOorg = substring( @sObtype, charindex( '#', @sObtype ) + 1, 20 )
        else
            set @sWOorg = null

	--Begin o7chkwar procedure here
	set @sUnderwar = N'-'
	if @sObject is not null
	begin
		if exists( SELECT 'x'
				FROM   r5organization, r5documents, r5warcoverages
				WHERE  wcv_object     = @sObject 
                                AND    wcv_object_org = @sObject_org
				AND    doc_code = wcv_warranty 
                                AND    org_code       = doc_org				
				AND    wcv_active       = N'+'
				AND    wcv_uom IS NULL   
                                AND    (doc_org  =  ISNULL(@sWOorg, doc_org ) OR org_common = N'+')
				AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sObject_org), N'DD' ) BETWEEN ISNULL( wcv_startdate, getdate() - 2 ) AND ISNULL(wcv_expirationdate, getdate() + 2 ) 
				AND NOT EXISTS
				( SELECT 'x'
					FROM   r5warcomponents
					WHERE  wcm_warranty = wcv_warranty )
				UNION
				SELECT 'X'
				FROM   r5organization, r5documents, r5objusagedefs,
					   r5warcoverages
				WHERE  oud_object     = wcv_object
				AND    oud_object_org = wcv_object_org
                                AND    doc_code = wcv_warranty 
                                AND    org_code       = doc_org
				AND    oud_uom        = wcv_uom
				AND    wcv_object     = @sObject
				AND    wcv_object_org = @sObject_org
				AND    wcv_active     = N'+'
                                AND    (doc_org  =  ISNULL(@sWOorg, doc_org ) OR org_common = N'+')
				AND    isnull( oud_totalusage, 0 ) BETWEEN isnull( wcv_startusage, isnull( oud_totalusage, 0 ) ) AND isnull( wcv_expiration, isnull( oud_totalusage, 0 ) )
				AND NOT EXISTS
				( SELECT 'X'
					FROM   r5warcomponents
					WHERE  wcm_warranty = wcv_warranty )			    
		)
		set @sUnderwar = N'+'
	end
		

	--End o7chkwar procedure

	if @sUnderwar = N'+'
		set @nResult = -1
	else
		set @nResult = 0

	return (@nResult)
end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETWOACTDISPATCHHRS(
  @event    NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @act      NUMERIC( 8 ))
  RETURNS NUMERIC( 18 ) AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @hours       NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  SELECT @hours = ( act_rem / ( act_persons *
           dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( act_duration - ISNULL( ( SELECT MAX( DATEDIFF( dd, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( boo_date, 'DD' ), dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( GETDATE(), 'DD' ) ) ) 
                                                           FROM   r5bookedhours 
                                                           WHERE  boo_event = @event 
                                                           AND    boo_act = @act ), 0 ), 1 ) ) )
  FROM   r5activities act 
  WHERE  act.act_event       = @event
  AND    act.act_act         = @act
 
  IF @event IS NOT NULL AND @act IS NOT NULL
    /* If there is a WO-Act specified, round to 1 decimal. */
    SET @hours = ISNULL( ROUND( @hours, 1 ), 0 )
  ELSE
    /* If there is no WO - Act specified, round to 0 decimal. */
    SET @hours = ISNULL( ROUND( @hours, 0 ), 0 )

  RETURN @hours

END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GETWOCOST(
  @sWo                NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sCosttype          NVARCHAR(  5 ),
  @sIncludechildcost  NVARCHAR(  1 ) )
  RETURNS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) AS
BEGIN  
  DECLARE @nReturn INT
  DECLARE @sX      NVARCHAR( 1000 )
  DECLARE @nMat    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Stock Material.
  DECLARE @nDma    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Direct Material.
  DECLARE @nTls    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Tool.
  DECLARE @nLab    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Internal Labor.
  DECLARE @nHir    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Hired Labor.
  DECLARE @nFix    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Fixed Cost Labor.

  SELECT @sX = 'x'
  FROM   r5events
  WHERE  evt_code = @sWo

  IF @sX IS NULL OR @sCosttype NOT IN ( N'SM', N'DM', N'MAT', N'TOOL', N'IL', N'ILH', N'FL', N'HL', N'HLH', N'EL', N'LABOR', N'TOTAL' )
    -- If the Work Order does not exist, or an invalid cost type has been specified: return NULL.
    RETURN NULL

  IF @sCosttype IN ( N'SM', N'MAT', N'TOTAL' )
    -- Stock Material 
    BEGIN
      IF COALESCE( @sIncludechildcost, N'+' ) = N'-'
        select @nMat = round( sum( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) * isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ), 2 )
        from   r5translines t  
        where ( ( t.trl_rtype IN ( N'I', N'RR') and t.trl_io = -1 ) or
                ( t.trl_rtype IN ( N'INVA' ) and t.trl_io = 0 ) ) 
        and    t.trl_event = @sWo 
      ELSE  
        select @nMat = round( sum( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) * isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ), 2 )
        from   r5translines t  
        where ( ( t.trl_rtype IN ( N'I', N'RR') and t.trl_io = -1 ) or 
                ( t.trl_rtype IN ( N'INVA' ) and t.trl_io = 0 ) ) 
        and    t.trl_event in ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sWo ) )
    END

  IF @sCosttype IN ( N'DM', N'MAT', N'TOTAL' )
    -- Direct Material, include invoice differences.
    BEGIN
      IF COALESCE( @sIncludechildcost, N'+' ) = N'-'
        select @nDma = round( sum( CASE t.trl_rtype WHEN N'RETN' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * 
               ( ( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) * isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ) +
               dbo.O7AXTDMA( t.trl_order, t.trl_order_org, t.trl_ordline, t.trl_qty ) ) ), 2 ) 
        from   r5transactions a, r5translines t  
        where  t.trl_trans   = a.tra_code           
        and    a.tra_rstatus = N'A'           
        and    t.trl_io      = 0           
        and    t.trl_rtype   IN ( N'RECV', N'RETN', N'MISC' ) 
        and    t.trl_event = @sWo
      ELSE  
        select @nDma = round( sum( CASE t.trl_rtype WHEN N'RETN' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * 
               ( ( isnull( t.trl_qty, 0 ) * isnull( t.trl_price, 0 ) ) +
               dbo.O7AXTDMA( t.trl_order, t.trl_order_org, t.trl_ordline, t.trl_qty ) ) ), 2 ) 
        from   r5transactions a, r5translines t  
        where  t.trl_trans   = a.tra_code           
        and    a.tra_rstatus = N'A'           
        and    t.trl_io      = 0           
        and    t.trl_rtype   IN ( N'RECV', N'RETN', N'MISC' ) 
        and    t.trl_event in ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sWo ) )
    END

  IF @sCosttype IN ( N'TOOL', N'TOTAL' )
    -- Tool.
    BEGIN
      IF COALESCE( @sIncludechildcost, N'+' ) = N'-'
        select @nTls = round( sum( isnull( t.tou_cost, 0 ) ), 2 )            
        from   r5toolusage t, r5events e, r5activities a 
        where  a.act_event = t.tou_event           
        and    a.act_event = e.evt_code           
        and    a.act_act   = t.tou_act  
        and    t.tou_event = @sWo
      ELSE  
        select @nTls = round( sum( isnull( t.tou_cost, 0 ) ), 2 )            
        from   r5toolusage t, r5events e, r5activities a 
        where  a.act_event = t.tou_event           
        and    a.act_event = e.evt_code           
        and    a.act_act   = t.tou_act  
        and    t.tou_event in ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ACTXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sWo ) )
    END

  IF @sCosttype IN ( N'IL', N'ILH', N'LABOR', N'TOTAL' )
    -- Internal Labor.
    BEGIN
      IF COALESCE( @sIncludechildcost, N'+' ) = N'-'
        select @nLab = round( sum( isnull( CASE WHEN @sCosttype = 'ILH' THEN b.boo_hours ELSE b.boo_cost END, 0 ) ), 2 )           
        from   r5activities a, r5bookedhours b  
        where  a.act_event = b.boo_event         
        and    a.act_act   = b.boo_act         
        and    b.boo_order is null         
        and    b.boo_routertype is null                           
        and not ( b.boo_misc = N'+' and b.boo_ocrtype = N'O' )         
        and   ( a.act_order is null or b.boo_misc = N'+' )  
        and   b.boo_event = @sWo
      ELSE  
        select @nLab = round( sum( isnull( CASE WHEN @sCosttype = 'ILH' THEN b.boo_hours ELSE b.boo_cost END, 0 ) ), 2 )           
        from   r5activities a, r5bookedhours b  
        where  a.act_event = b.boo_event         
        and    a.act_act   = b.boo_act         
        and    b.boo_order is null         
        and    b.boo_routertype is null                           
        and not ( b.boo_misc = N'+' and b.boo_ocrtype = N'O' )         
        and   ( a.act_order is null or b.boo_misc = N'+' )

CREATE FUNCTION O7GETWOPARTS(
  @event   NVARCHAR( 30 ) ) 
  RETURNS @r5getwoparts TABLE( trl_part              NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                               trl_part_org          NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                               trl_store             NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                               trl_event             NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                               trl_act               NUMERIC( 8 ),
                               trl_direct            NVARCHAR( 1 )  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                               trl_qty               NUMERIC( 24, 6 ),
                               trl_resqty            NUMERIC( 24, 6 ),
                               trl_allqty            NUMERIC( 24, 6 ),
                               trl_plannedqty        NUMERIC( 24, 6 ),
                               trl_coreqty           NUMERIC( 24, 6 ),
                               trl_line              NUMERIC( 8 ),
                               trl_object            NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                               trl_object_org        NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                               trl_woheaderequipment NVARCHAR( 1 )  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
BEGIN
  DECLARE @multiequip        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @part              NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @partorg           NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @store             NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @act               NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @direct            NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @line              NUMERIC( 8 )
  DECLARE @qty               NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @resqty            NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @allqty            NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @plannedqty        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @coreqty           NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @object            NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objectorg         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @woheaderequipment NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @resevent          NVARCHAR( 30 )

  /* Is the Work Order a MEC Work Order? */
  SELECT @multiequip = ISNULL( evt_multiequip, '-' )
  FROM   r5events
  WHERE  evt_code = @event
  IF @multiequip IS NULL
    RETURN

  /* First get all material list parts belonging to the work order. */
  DECLARE mlp CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT mlp_part, mlp_part_org, mrc_store, act_act, mlp_direct, mlp_line, mlp_qty
    FROM   r5matlparts, r5objects o LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events ON ( o.obj_code = evt_object AND o.obj_org  = evt_object_org ), r5mrcs, r5activities
    WHERE  mlp_matlist = act_matlist
    AND    mlp_matlrev = act_matlrev
    AND    evt_code    = act_event
    AND    evt_mrc     = mrc_code
    AND    act_event   = @event
    AND    dbo.o7checkmatch( mlp_equipfilter, obj_checklistfilter ) = '+'
    AND    (    (     ISNULL( mlp_code, ISNULL( evt_object, '!@#$' ) ) = ISNULL( evt_object, '!@#$' )
                  AND ISNULL( mlp_code_org, ISNULL( evt_object_org, '!@#$' ) ) = ISNULL( evt_object_org, '!@#$' ) )
             OR (     mlp_obrtype = 'C'
                  AND EXISTS ( SELECT obj_code
                               FROM   r5objects
                               WHERE  obj_code     = evt_object
                               AND    obj_org      = evt_object_org
                               AND    obj_category = mlp_code ) ) )
  OPEN mlp
  FETCH NEXT FROM mlp INTO @part, @partorg, @store, @act, @direct, @line, @plannedqty
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @qty     = NULL
      SET @resqty  = NULL
      SET @allqty  = NULL
      SET @coreqty = NULL

      /* Get the issued quantity for the current part. */
      SELECT @qty     = SUM( CASE trl_rtype WHEN 'RR' THEN 0 WHEN 'RETN' THEN -trl_qty ELSE trl_qty END ),
             @coreqty = SUM( CASE trl_rtype WHEN 'RR' THEN -trl_qty ELSE 0 END )
      FROM   r5transactions LEFT OUTER JOIN r5orders ON ( ord_code = tra_order AND ord_org = tra_order_org ), r5translines
      WHERE  tra_code     = trl_trans
      AND    tra_rstatus  = 'A'
      AND    trl_act      = @act
      AND    trl_part_org = @partorg
      AND    CASE trl_rtype WHEN 'RETN' THEN ISNULL( trl_store, ord_store ) ELSE trl_store END = @store
      AND    COALESCE( trl_issuedpart, trl_part ) = @part
      AND    (    ( trl_rtype IN ( 'I', 'RR' ) AND trl_io = -1 AND @direct = '-' )
               OR ( trl_rtype IN ( 'RECV', 'RETN' ) AND trl_io = 0 AND @direct = '+' ) )
      AND    trl_event IN ( SELECT evt_code
                            FROM   r5events
                            WHERE  evt_code = @event
                            UNION
                            SELECT evt_code
                            FROM   r5events
                            WHERE  evt_parent  = @event
                            AND    @multiequip = '+' )

      /* Get the reserved and allocated quantity for the current part. */
      SELECT @resqty = SUM( res_qty ), 
             @allqty = SUM( res_allqty )
      FROM   r5reservations
      WHERE  res_part              = @part
      AND    res_part_org          = @partorg
      AND    res_store             = @store
      AND    res_event             = @event
      AND    res_act               = @act
      AND    res_woheaderequipment = '-'
 
      /* Insert record into temp table. */
      INSERT INTO @r5getwoparts( trl_part, trl_part_org, trl_store, trl_event, trl_act, trl_direct, trl_qty, trl_resqty, trl_allqty, trl_plannedqty, trl_coreqty, trl_line, trl_woheaderequipment )
      VALUES( @part, @partorg, @store, @event, @act, @direct, ISNULL( @qty, 0 ), ISNULL( @resqty, 0 ), ISNULL( @allqty, 0 ), @plannedqty, @coreqty, @line, '-' )

      FETCH NEXT FROM mlp INTO @part, @partorg, @store, @act, @direct, @line, @plannedqty
    END
   

  /* Get parts on transaction lines that are not on a material list. */
  DECLARE trl2 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT COALESCE( trl_issuedpart, trl_part ), trl_part_org, CASE trl_rtype WHEN 'RETN' THEN ISNULL( trl_store, ord_store ) ELSE trl_store END, trl_act,
           CASE trl_io WHEN 0 THEN '+' ELSE '-' END, 
           SUM( CASE trl_rtype WHEN 'RR' THEN 0 WHEN 'RETN' THEN -trl_qty ELSE trl_qty END ),
           SUM( CASE trl_rtype WHEN 'RR' THEN -trl_qty ELSE 0 END )
    FROM   r5transactions LEFT OUTER JOIN r5orders ON ( ord_code = tra_order AND ord_org = tra_order_org ), r5translines
    WHERE  tra_code    = trl_trans
    AND    tra_rstatus = 'A'
    AND    ( ( trl_rtype IN ( 'I', 'RR' ) AND trl_io = -1 ) OR ( trl_rtype IN ( 'RECV', 'RETN' ) AND trl_io = 0 ) )
    AND    trl_event IN ( SELECT evt_code
                          FROM   r5events
                          WHERE  evt_code = @event
                          UNION
                          SELECT evt_code
                          FROM   r5events
                          WHERE  evt_parent  = @event
                          AND    @multiequip = '+' )
    AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                        FROM   r5matlparts,
                        r5events LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects o ON ( o.obj_code = evt_object AND o.obj_org  = evt_object_org ), r5mrcs, r5activities
                        WHERE  mlp_matlist  = act_matlist
                        AND    mlp_matlrev  = act_matlrev
                        AND    evt_code     = act_event
                        AND    evt_mrc      = mrc_code
                        AND    mlp_part     = COALESCE( trl_issuedpart, trl_part )
                        AND    mlp_part_org = trl_part_org
                        AND    (    ( trl_rtype IN ( 'I', 'RR' ) AND trl_io = -1 AND mlp_direct = '-' )
                                 OR ( trl_rtype IN ( 'RECV', 'RETN' ) AND trl_io = 0 AND mlp_direct = '+' ) )
                        AND    mrc_store    = trl_store
                        AND    act_act      = trl_act
                        AND    act_event    = @event
                        AND

create function O7GETWORESOURCES( @sWOCode nvarchar(30) )
returns nvarchar(4000)
as
begin
    declare @sReturn        nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sResource      nvarchar(80)
    declare @nOffsetValue   numeric(7,2) 

    set @sReturn    = N''

    declare c_woresources cursor local for 
        SELECT ere_resource, ere_offsetvalue
        FROM   r5eventresources
        WHERE  ere_event = @sWOCode AND ere_active = '+'
        ORDER BY ere_operationseq
  
    open c_woresources
    fetch next from c_woresources into @sResource, @nOffsetValue
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin

            set @sReturn = @sReturn +  @sResource +  N'-' + + cast(@nOffsetValue as nvarchar(9)) + N'#'

            fetch next from c_woresources into @sResource, @nOffsetValue
        end
    close c_woresources
    deallocate c_woresources

    return ( @sReturn )
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GETXCHARGE
	@sCorder	  nvarchar(30),
	@sCorderorg	  nvarchar(15),
	@nNordline	  numeric(18,0),
	@nNpurqty	  numeric(24,6),
	@nNprice	  numeric(24,6),
	@nNdiscperc	  numeric(24,6),
	@sTax		  nvarchar(30),
	@sTax2		  nvarchar(30),
	@sCorderlinerstatus   	nvarchar(4),
	@nNrcptqty        	numeric(24,6),
	@nTotextra	  numeric(30,6) OUTPUT,
	@nTottaxamt	  numeric(30,6) OUTPUT,
	@nInvCalctaxamt	  numeric(30,6) OUTPUT
as
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nV_base		 numeric(30,6)
	declare @nV_gross		 numeric(30,6)
	declare @nV_tot		     numeric(30,6)
	declare @nNchgdisctotal  numeric(24,6)
	declare @nVtmp		     numeric(30,6)
	declare @sRdtp		     nvarchar(4)  -- r5extcharges.ECH_RTYPE%type ='PRT'

	/* CURSOR Variables */
	declare @nEch_discount   numeric(24,6)
	declare @nEch_discperc   numeric(24,6)
	declare @sEch_rtype      nvarchar(4)
	declare @sEch_cumulative nvarchar(1)
	declare @nI int

	declare @nPercent1		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nPercent2		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTottaxperc	numeric(24,6)
	declare @dToday			datetime


	declare @nInvCalPercent1	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nInvCalPercent2	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nInvCalperc	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nInvCalTottamt		numeric(30,6)

	/* Initialize */
    set @nNchgdisctotal	= 0
    set @nVtmp				= 0
    set @nV_tot = 0
	set @nTotextra = 0
	set @sRdtp = N'PRT'
	set @nPercent1 = 0
	set @nPercent2 = 0
	set @nTottaxamt = 0
	set @nInvCalPercent1 = 0 
	set @nInvCalPercent2 = 0
	set @nInvCalperc = 0 
	set @nInvCalTottamt = 0 


    /* Calculate total price */
    IF(isnull(@sCorderlinerstatus ,'X') ='C')
    	set @nV_base = isnull(@nNrcptqty,0)* isnull(@nNprice,0)
    ELSE
    	set @nV_base = isnull(@nNpurqty,0)* isnull(@nNprice,0)

 	set @nV_base = @nV_base * (1 - isnull(@nNdiscperc,0) / 100)
    set @nV_gross = @nV_base

	set @nI = 1
	while (@nI < 3)
	begin
		declare cC_extcharges cursor local for
		SELECT ech_discount, ech_discperc, ech_rtype, ech_cumulative
	    FROM r5extcharges a
	    WHERE a.ech_invord_code = @sCorder
	    AND a.ech_invord_org = @sCorderorg
	    AND a.ech_invord_line = @nNordline
	    AND a.ech_invord = N'O'
	    AND a.ech_parprice = N'+'
	    AND a.ech_rtype = @sRdtp
	    ORDER BY a.ech_code

		OPEN cC_extcharges

		FETCH NEXT FROM cC_extcharges INTO @nEch_discount, @nEch_discperc, @sEch_rtype, @sEch_cumulative

		while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
	   	    IF @nEch_discount IS NOT NULL
		   	    set @nVtmp = @nEch_discount
		    ELSE
				begin
					IF @nEch_discperc IS NOT NULL
						begin
		   					IF @sEch_cumulative = N'+'
				 				set @nVtmp = ROUND( @nV_gross * @nEch_discperc / 100 , 2 )
							ELSE
								set @nVtmp = ROUND( @nV_base * @nEch_discperc / 100 , 2 )
						end
					ELSE
						set @nVtmp = 0
				end

		    set @nV_tot = @nV_tot + @nVtmp
	  	    set @nV_gross = @nV_gross + @nVtmp

			FETCH NEXT FROM cC_extcharges INTO @nEch_discount, @nEch_discperc, @sEch_rtype, @sEch_cumulative
		end /* end of inner while */
		close cC_extcharges
		deallocate cC_extcharges

		IF @sRdtp = N'PRT'
			begin
				set @sRdtp = N'POT'
				set @dToday    = dbo.O7GTTIME2(@sCorderorg)
				set @nPercent1 = dbo.o7gettax( @sTax, @dToday )
				set @nPercent2 = dbo.o7gettax( @sTax2, @dToday )
				set @nTottaxperc = @nPercent1 +  @nPercent2
				set @nTottaxamt  = ROUND( coalesce( @nV_gross * @nTottaxperc/100, 0 ), 2 )

				set @nInvCalPercent1 = dbo.o7gettax2( @sTax, @dToday )
				set @nInvCalPercent2 = dbo.o7gettax2( @sTax2, @dToday )
				set @nInvCalperc = @nInvCalPercent1 +  @nInvCalPercent2
				set @nInvCalctaxamt = ROUND( coalesce( @nV_gross * @nInvCalperc/100, 0 ), 2 )

				set @nV_gross    = @nV_gross + @nTottaxamt

			end

		set @nI = @nI + 1
	end /* end of outer while */

   /* Assign calculated extra charges */
    IF @nV_tot <> 0
   	    set @nTotextra = @nV_tot
    ELSE
   	    set @nTotextra = 0

CREATE FUNCTION O7GET_ADJUSTMENT_VALUE2FUN( @sBillcode NVARCHAR(30), @sColumn NVARCHAR(32) ) 
RETURNS NUMERIC(32,6)
AS 
BEGIN
    DECLARE @nOutput    NUMERIC(32,6)

    IF @sColumn = N'fbl_usage'
        SELECT @nOutput = SUM( fbl_usage ) 
            FROM r5vfleetbilllines
            WHERE fbl_bill = @sBillcode
            AND fbl_adjustment = '+'
    ELSE IF @sColumn = N'fbl_mileage'
        SELECT @nOutput = SUM( fbl_mileage ) 
            FROM r5vfleetbilllines
            WHERE fbl_bill = @sBillcode
            AND fbl_adjustment = '+'
    ELSE IF @sColumn = N'fbl_maintenance'
        SELECT @nOutput = SUM( fbl_maintenance ) 
            FROM r5vfleetbilllines
            WHERE fbl_bill = @sBillcode
            AND fbl_adjustment = '+'
    ELSE IF @sColumn = N'fbl_nonmaintenance'
        SELECT @nOutput = SUM( fbl_nonmaintenance ) 
            FROM r5vfleetbilllines
            WHERE fbl_bill = @sBillcode
            AND fbl_adjustment = '+'
    ELSE IF @sColumn = N'fbl_fuel'
        SELECT @nOutput = SUM( fbl_fuel ) 
            FROM r5vfleetbilllines
            WHERE fbl_bill = @sBillcode
            AND fbl_adjustment = '+'
    ELSE IF @sColumn = N'fbl_insurance'
        SELECT @nOutput = SUM( fbl_insurance ) 
            FROM r5vfleetbilllines
            WHERE fbl_bill = @sBillcode
            AND fbl_adjustment = '+'
    ELSE IF @sColumn = N'fbl_exceptions'
        SELECT @nOutput = SUM( fbl_exceptions ) 
            FROM r5vfleetbilllines
            WHERE fbl_bill = @sBillcode
            AND fbl_adjustment = '+'
    ELSE IF @sColumn = N'fbl_total'
        SELECT @nOutput = SUM( fbl_total ) 
            FROM r5vfleetbilllines
            WHERE fbl_bill = @sBillcode
            AND fbl_adjustment = '+'

    RETURN COALESCE( @nOutput, 0.0 )

END

create procedure O7GLPROCESS_READBACKTRACELOG
	as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn			integer
	declare @nCount				integer	
	declare @sTraceFileDir		nvarchar(512)
	declare @sTraceFileName		nvarchar(256)
	declare @sFileFullPath		nvarchar(760)
	declare @sCommand			nvarchar(800)
	declare @nLoop				integer
	declare @sMessage			nvarchar(4000)
	declare @nError				integer
	declare @sTraceEnabledFlag	nvarchar(8)
	declare @sLogFile			varchar(2000)

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceFileDir', @sTraceFileDir OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceFileName', @sTraceFileName OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceEnabledFlag', @sTraceEnabledFlag OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	DELETE FROM R5GLPROCTRACE

	if upper(@sTraceEnabledFlag) = N'TRUE'
		begin
			set @nLoop = 0
			set @sFileFullPath = @sTraceFileDir + '\' + @sTraceFileName 

			INSERT INTO r5glproctrace(gpt_linenumber, gpt_tracetext)
			VALUES(@nLoop,@sFileFullPath);

			create table #Tracetemp ([logmessage] varchar(4000), ROWIDENTITY     int IDENTITY)
			set @sLogFile = cast( @sFileFullPath as varchar(2000) )

			insert #Tracetemp execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_readlog @sLogFile
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					drop table #Tracetemp
					return -1
				end

			INSERT INTO r5glproctrace(gpt_linenumber, gpt_tracetext)
				select ROWIDENTITY, logmessage from #Tracetemp
			
			drop table #Tracetemp
		end

   declare @sFromstmt         nvarchar(1000)      --r5glprocessdef.gpd_fromstmt%TYPE
   declare @sWherestmt         nvarchar(1000)      --r5glprocessdef.gpd_wherestmt%TYPE

   declare @sSelstring         nvarchar(2000)

   set @sMarker='main function'

   execute @nReturn = DSTM_ORATRACE_StartTrace N'O7GLROWCT'
   set @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

   execute @nReturn = DSTM_ORATRACE_ENTERPROC1 N'O7GLROWCT',NULL, NULL

   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

   execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceEnabledFlag', @sTraceEnabledFlag OUTPUT

      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

   execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceFileDir', @sTraceFileDir OUTPUT

      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

   execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'DSTM_ORATRACE', N'g_TraceFileName', @sTraceFileName OUTPUT
   set @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

   execute @nReturn = BAIMERROR_NEWERROR
   set @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
  
   execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'BAIMERROR', N'InterfaceProcessName', N'O7GLROWCT'
   set @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

   execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'BAIMERROR', N'PositionCode', N'29-0-1'
   set @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
   
   set @sDate = convert(nvarchar, getdate(), 106)

   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

   set @dDate=getdate()

   set @sProcess = @sName

   IF (@sProcess IS NULL OR @sProcess = N'') 
      begin
         set @sDummy1 = SUBSTRING('Position : Main procedure getting process name',1,250)
         set @sDummy2 = SUBSTRING('No process @sName given for the procedure to process',1,250)
         set @nChk    = 0
      end


   --start fetch_glprocessdef

   execute @nReturn = DSTM_ORATRACE_ENTERPROC1 N'FETCH_GLPROCESSDEF',NULL, NULL
   set @nError = @@ERROR

      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

   set @sMarker = N'fetch_glprocessdef'
  
   execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'BAIMERROR', N'PositionCode', N'29-1-1'
   set @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

   SELECT  @sDescription = gpd_desc,
         @sSummary = gpd_summary,
         @sGroupcol = gpd_groupcol,
         @sDatecol = gpd_datecol,
         @sAmountcol = gpd_amountcol,
         @sSegmentscol = gpd_segmentscol,
         @sUpdatestmt = gpd_updatestmt,
         @sFromstmt = gpd_fromstmt,
         @sWherestmt = gpd_wherestmt,
         @sRowidcol = gpd_rowidcol,
         @sDestupdatestmt = gpd_destupdatestmt
   FROM r5glprocessdef
   WHERE gpd_code = @sProcess
   select @nRowcount = @@ROWCOUNT

   if @nRowcount = 1 
      begin
           execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'BAIMERROR', N'PositionCode', N'29-1-2'
         set @nError = @@ERROR
         if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

         execute @nReturn = DSTM_ORATRACE_ExitProc_Normal N'FETCH_GLPROCESSDEF',NULL, NULL
         set @nError = @@ERROR
         if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            GOTO ERROR_HANDLER

   else
      begin
         If @nRowcount  = 0

               set @nChk   = 0
            end
         else
            begin
               set @nError = 99999 --set to this value so we know that it was too many rows vs some other error
               if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                  GOTO ERROR_HANDLER
            end
      end
   --end fetch_glprocessdef


   --start prepare_main_cursor
   execute @nReturn = DSTM_ORATRACE_ENTERPROC1 N'PREPARE_MAIN_CURSOR',NULL, NULL
   set @nError = @@ERROR
   if @nError <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

     execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'BAIMERROR', N'PositionCode', N'29-2-1'

   set @sMain_select = N'SELECT @nCount = count(*)  from '  +  @sFromstmt  +  N' where '  +  @sWherestmt

create PROCEDURE O7GMOREC
   @sRentity       nvarchar(4),
   @nCode          int,
   @sKey1           nvarchar(64),
   @sKey2           nvarchar(64),
   @sKey3           nvarchar(64),
   @sKey4           nvarchar(64),
   @sPar1           nvarchar(64) OUTPUT,
   @sPar2           nvarchar(64) OUTPUT,
   @sPar3           nvarchar(64) OUTPUT,
   @sPar4           nvarchar(64) OUTPUT,
   @sPar5           nvarchar(64) OUTPUT,
   @sPar6           nvarchar(64) OUTPUT,
   @sPar7           nvarchar(64) OUTPUT,
   @sPar8           nvarchar(64) OUTPUT,
   @sChk            nvarchar(4)  OUTPUT 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCount		int
	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @dTempdate	datetime
	declare @sStore     nvarchar(15)

	/* Initialise */
	if @spar1 is not null
		set @sStore = @sPar1
	else
		set @sStore = N'%'

	set @sChk             = N'0' 
	set @sPar1            = NULL
	set @sPar2            = NULL
	set @sPar3            = NULL
	set @sPar4            = NULL
	set @sPar5            = NULL
	set @sPar6            = NULL
	set @sPar7            = NULL
	set @sPar8            = NULL

	set @sChk          = N'0' 

	-- table ORDERCONTRACTS no 11
	IF  @sRentity = N'CONT' AND @nCode = 11 
		begin
			IF  @sKey1 IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sKey2 
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						RETURN -1
					
					set @dTempdate  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD')
					
					while 1=1
						begin
							select @nCount = count(*)
							FROM   r5contracts    c,
								  r5condiscounts d
							WHERE  c.con_supplier     = SUBSTRING( @sKey1, 1, CHARINDEX( N'#', @sKey1) -1 )
							AND    c.con_supplier_org = SUBSTRING( @sKey1, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sKey1) +1 , len(@sKey1) - CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sKey1) +1 )
							AND    c.con_org          = @sKey2
							AND    ISNULL( c.con_store, 'x' ) LIKE ISNULL( @sStore, 'x' )
							AND    c.con_rstatus      = N'A'
							AND    c.con_start       <= @dTempdate
							AND    c.con_end         >= @dTempdate
							AND    c.con_curr         = @sKey3
							AND    d.cdi_contract     = c.con_code
							AND    d.cdi_rtype        = N'O'
							AND    d.cdi_part IS NULL

							if @nCount > 0 
								begin
									SELECT @sPar1 = c.con_code
									FROM   r5contracts    c,
										  r5condiscounts d
									WHERE  c.con_supplier     = SUBSTRING( @sKey1, 1, CHARINDEX( N'#', @sKey1) -1 )
									AND    c.con_supplier_org = SUBSTRING( @sKey1, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sKey1) +1 , len(@sKey1) - CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sKey1) +1 )
									AND    c.con_org          = @sKey2
									AND    ISNULL( c.con_store, 'x' ) LIKE ISNULL( @sStore, 'x' )
									AND    c.con_rstatus      = N'A'
									AND    c.con_start       <= @dTempdate
									AND    c.con_end         >= @dTempdate
									AND    c.con_curr         = @sKey3
									AND    d.cdi_contract     = c.con_code
									AND    d.cdi_rtype        = N'O'
									AND    d.cdi_part IS NULL
									RETURN
								end	
							else
								begin
									if isnull( @sStore, N'%' ) = N'%'
										begin
											set @sChk = N'2'
											RETURN
										end
									else
										SELECT @sStore = str_parent
										FROM   r5stores
										WHERE  str_code = @sStore
								end		
						end
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					set @sChk = N'1'
					RETURN
				end
		end

	-- table PARTSCONTRACTS no 2
	IF  @sRentity = N'CONT' AND @nCode = 2 
		begin
			IF  @sKey1 IS NOT NULL AND @sKey2 IS NOT NULL 
				begin

					execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sKey2 
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						RETURN -1
					
					set @dTempdate  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD')

					while 1=1
						begin					
							select @nCount = count(*)
							FROM   r5contracts    c,
								  r5conparts     p
							WHERE  c.con_supplier     = SUBSTRING( @sKey1, 1, CHARINDEX( N'#', @sKey1) -1 )
							AND    c.con_supplier_org = SUBSTRING( @sKey1, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sKey1) +1 , len(@sKey1) - CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sKey1) +1 )
							AND    ISNULL( c.con_store, 'x' ) LIKE ISNULL( @sStore, 'x' )
							AND    c.con_org          = @sKey2
							AND    c.con_rstatus      = N'A'
							AND    c.con_start       <= @dTempdate
							AND    c.con_end         >= @dTempdate
							AND    c.con_curr         = @sKey3
							AND    p.cpa_contract     = c.con_code
							AND    p.cpa_part         = SUBSTRING( @sKey4, 1, CHARINDEX( N'#',@sKey4 ) -1 )
							AND    p.cpa_part_org     = SUBSTRING( @sKey4, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sKey4) +1 , len(@sKey4) - CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sKey4) +1 )

							if @nCount > 0 
								begin
									SELECT @sPar1 = c.con_code,
										  @sPar2 = cast( p.cpa_price as nvarchar(31) ),
										  @sPar3 = cast( p.cpa_leadtime as nvarchar(6)),
										  @sPar4 = p.cpa_ref,
										  @sPar5 = cast( p.cpa_multiply as nvarchar(15) ),
										  @sPar6 = p.cpa_puruom
									FROM   r5contracts    c,
										  r5conparts     p
									WHERE  c.con_supplier     = SUBSTRING( @sKey1, 1, CHARINDEX( N'#', @sKey1) -1 )
									AND    c.con_supplier_org = SUBSTRING( @sKey1, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sKey1) +1 , len(@sKey1) - CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sKey1) +1 )
									AND    c.con_org          = @sKey2
									AND    ISNULL( c.con_store, 'x' ) LIKE ISNULL( @sStore, 'x' )
									AND    c.con_rstatus      = N'A'
									AND    c.con_start       <= @dTempdate
									AND    c.con_end         >= @dTempdate
									AND    c.con_curr         = @sKey3
									AND    p.cpa_contract     = c.con_code
									AND    p.cpa_part         = SUBSTRING( @sKey4, 1, CHARINDEX( N'#',@sKey4 ) -1 )
									AND    p.cpa_part_org     = SUBSTRING( @sKey4, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sKey4) +1 , len(@sKey4) - CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sKey4) +1 )
									RETURN
								end	
							else
								begin
									if isnull( @sStore, N'%' ) = N'%'
										begin
											set @sChk = N'2'
											RETURN
										end
									else
										SELECT @sStore = str_parent
										FROM   r5stores
										WHERE  str_code = @sStore
								end		
						end
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					set @sChk = N'1'
					RETURN
				end
		end


	-- table PARTSCONTRACTS no 3
	IF  @sRentity = N'CONT' AND @nCode = 3 
		begin
			IF  @sKey1 IS NOT NULL AND @sKey2 IS NOT NULL 
				begin

					select @nCount = count(*)
					FROM   r5condiscounts
					WHERE  cdi_contract = @sKey1
					AND    cdi_part     = SUBSTRING( @sKey2, 1, CHARINDEX(  N'#',@sKey2) -1 )
					AND    cdi_part_org = SUBSTRING( @sKey2, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sKey2) +1 , len(@sKey2) - CHARINDEX(  N'#', @sKey2) +1 )
					AND    cdi_rtype    = N'Q'
					AND  ( cdi_value   <= cast( @sKey3 as numeric(24,6) ) OR
						  cdi_purqty  <= cast( @sKey4 as numeric(24,6)) )

					if @nCount > 0 
						SELECT @sPar1 = cast( MAX(cdi_disperc) as nvarchar(64))
						FROM   r5condiscounts
						WHERE  cdi_contract = @sKey1
						AND    cdi_part     = SUBSTRING( @sKey2, 1, CHARINDEX(  N'#',@sKey2) -1 )

					else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'2'
							RETURN
						end
					RETURN
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					set @sChk = N'1'
					RETURN
				end
		end

	SET NOCOUNT ON

/* Retrieve class for categories */

					FROM   r5objects 
					WHERE  obj_code = @sKey1

						BEGIN

					SELECT @nCount = count(*)

					AND    obj_org    = @sKey2

							RETURN

			ELSE

					AND    obj_org    = @sKey2

						END
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @sChk = N'2'
							RETURN
						END
					RETURN
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @sChk = N'1'
					RETURN
				END
		END

					RETURN
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @sChk = N'1'
					RETURN
				END
		END


/* table MRC no 1 */
	IF  @sCrentity = N'MRC' AND @nCode = 1
		BEGIN
			IF  @sKey1 IS NOT NULL 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCount = count(*)
					FROM   r5mrcs m
					WHERE  m.mrc_code = @sKey1
					If @nCount > 0 
						BEGIN
							SELECT @sPar1 = m.mrc_desc,
								  @sPar2 = m.mrc_class,
								  @sPar3 = m.mrc_class_org,
								  @sPar4 = m.mrc_store
							FROM   r5mrcs m
							WHERE  m.mrc_code = @sKey1
						END
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @sChk = N'2'
							RETURN
						END
					RETURN
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @sChk = N'1'
					RETURN
				END
		END


/* table PARTS no 1 */
	IF  @sCrentity = N'PART' AND @nCode = 1
		BEGIN
			IF  @sKey1 IS NOT NULL 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCount = count(*)
					FROM   r5parts p
					WHERE  p.par_code = @sKey1
					AND    p.par_org  = @sKey2
					If @nCount > 0 
						BEGIN
							SELECT @sPar1 = p.par_desc,
								  @sPar2 = p.par_class + N'#' + p.par_class_org,
								  @sPar3 = p.par_category,
								  @sPar4 = p.par_uom,
								  @sPar5 = coalesce(p.par_byasset,'-'),
								  @sPar6 = null,
								  @sPar7 = p.par_tax,
								  @sPar8 = p.par_buyer
							FROM   r5parts p
							WHERE  p.par_code = @sKey1
							AND    p.par_org  = @sKey2
						END
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @sChk = N'2'
							RETURN
						END
					RETURN
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @sChk = N'1'
					RETURN
				END
		END


/* table REQUISITIONS no 1 */
	IF  @sCrentity = N'REQ' AND @nCode = 1
		BEGIN
			IF  @sKey1 IS NOT NULL 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCount = count(*)
					FROM   r5requisitions r
					WHERE  r.req_code = @sKey1
					If @nCount > 0 
						BEGIN
							SELECT @sPar1 = r.req_desc,
								  @sPar2 = r.req_class + N'#' + r.req_class_org,
								  @sPar3 = r.req_rstatus,
								  @sPar4 = r.req_rtype,
								  @sPar5 = r.req_fromrentity,
								  @sPar6 = r.req_fromcode + N'#' + r.req_fromcode_org,
								  @sPar7 = r.req_torentity,
								  @sPar8 = r.req_tocode
							FROM   r5requisitions r
							WHERE  r.req_code = @sKey1
						END
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @sChk = N'2'
							RETURN
						END
					RETURN
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @sChk = N'1'
					RETURN
				END
		END

/* table REQUISITIONS no 2 */
	IF  @sCrentity = N'REQ' AND @nCode = 2
		BEGIN
			IF  @sKey1 IS NOT NULL 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCount = count(*)
					FROM   r5requisitions r
					WHERE  r.req_code = @sKey1
					If @nCount > 0 
						BEGIN
							SELECT @sPar1 = r.req_event,
								  @sPar2 = cast(r.req_act as nvarchar(10)),
								  @sPar3 = r.req_costcode,
								  @sPar4 = r.req_status,
								  @sPar5 = r.req_origin,

								  @sPar7 = r.req_fromcode + N'#' + r.req_fromcode_org,

							FROM   r5requisitions r
							WHERE  r.req_code = @sKey1
						END
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @sChk = N'2'
							RETURN
						END
					RETURN
				END
			ELSE

/* table REQUISLINES no 1 */

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GMOREW
	@sRentity       nvarchar(4),
	@nCode			int,
	@sKey1           nvarchar(40),
	@sKey2           nvarchar(40),
	@sKey3           nvarchar(40),
	@sKey4           nvarchar(40),
	@sPar1           nvarchar(40)		OUTPUT,
	@sPar2           nvarchar(40)		OUTPUT,
	@sPar3           nvarchar(40)		OUTPUT,
	@sPar4           nvarchar(40)		OUTPUT,
	@sPar5           nvarchar(40)		OUTPUT,
	@sPar6           nvarchar(40)		OUTPUT,
	@sPar7           nvarchar(40)		OUTPUT,
	@sPar8           nvarchar(40)		OUTPUT,
	@sChk            nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sBookedmrc			nvarchar(15) --r5mrcs.mrc_code%TYPE
	declare @sBookedtrade		nvarchar(15) --r5trades.trd_code%TYPE
	declare @sChk2				nvarchar( 4 ) 
	declare @sBooplan			nvarchar(200) --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nPos#              int
	declare @nOrderNumber       nvarchar(30) --r5orders.ord_code%TYPE
	declare @sOrderorg          nvarchar(15) --r5orders.ord_org%TYPE
	declare @sOrltype           nvarchar(4) --r5orderlines.orl_type%TYPE= N''
	declare @sOrdstatus         nvarchar(4) --r5orders.ord_rstatus%TYPE= N''
	declare @sOrlstatus         nvarchar(4) --r5orderlines.orl_rstatus%TYPE= N''
	declare @sOrlactive         nvarchar(1) --r5orderlines.orl_active%TYPE= N''
	declare @sCheckresult       nvarchar(4)
	declare @nPrice				int
	declare @nRecv				int
	declare @nExch				int
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCount				int
	declare	@nReturn			int

	-- Initialise
	set @sChk     = N'0'
	-- do not nulify MRC and trade
	if NOT ( @sRentity = N'PERS' AND @nCode = N'1' ) 
		begin
			set @sPar1    = NULL
			set @sPar2    = NULL
		end

	set @sPar3    = NULL
	set @sPar4    = NULL
	set @sPar5    = NULL
	set @sPar6    = NULL
	set @sPar7    = NULL
	set @sPar8    = NULL


	-- W03127 Retrieve mrc, trade  if NULL
	if ( @sRentity = N'PERS' AND @nCode = N'1' ) AND ( @sPar1 IS NULL OR @sPar2 IS NULL ) 
		begin
			-- par1 mrc
			-- par2 trade
			-- @sKey1 person
			-- @sKey2 event
			-- @sKey3 activity
			execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sBooplan OUTPUT, N'BOOPLAN', @sChk2 OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			
			if @sChk2 = N'0' 
				begin
					if ( ( @sKey1 IS NOT NULL ) AND ( UPPER( @sBooplan ) NOT IN ( N'YES', N'Y', N'ON', N'+', N'TRUE' ) )   )  -- W03127A from r5personnel
						begin				
							SELECT @nCount = count(*) 
							FROM   r5personnel p
							WHERE  p.per_code  = @sKey1

							if @nCount > 0 
								SELECT @sBookedmrc = p.per_mrc,
	  								   @sBookedtrade = p.per_trade
								FROM   r5personnel p
								WHERE  p.per_code  = @sKey1
							else
								set @sChk = N'2'
						end				
					else  -- W03127B from r5activities otherwise
						begin
							if ( @sKey2 IS NULL  ) OR ( @sKey3  IS NULL ) 
								set @sX = NULL
							else
								begin
                                    --prevent conversion error
                                    if @sKey3 is not null and isnumeric( @sKey3 ) = 0
                                        begin
                                            set @sChk = N'994'
                                            return
                                        end
                                    

									SELECT @nCount = count(*)  						
									FROM   r5events e,
										  r5activities a
									WHERE  a.act_event = e.evt_code
									AND    a.act_event = @sKey2
									AND    a.act_act   = cast( convert( numeric, @sKey3) as int)
									if @nCount = 1
										SELECT @sBookedmrc = e.evt_mrc ,
											  @sBookedtrade = a.act_trade
										FROM   r5events e,
											  r5activities a
										WHERE  a.act_event = e.evt_code
										AND    a.act_event = @sKey2
										AND    a.act_act   = cast( convert( numeric, @sKey3) as int)
									else
										begin
											if @nCount <= 0
												begin
													set @sChk = N'992' 
													return
												end
											else
												begin
													set @sChk = N'993'
													return 
												end
										end
								end
						end  -- @sKeys 2 and 3 filled
					-- activities
					set @sPar1   = coalesce ( @sPar1, @sBookedmrc  )
					set @sPar2 = coalesce (  @sPar2, @sBookedtrade )
				end
			else -- @sChk2 <> N'0', problem getting @sBooplan
				set @sChk  = N'11'
		end


	if ( @sRentity = N'AVL' AND @nCode = N'1' ) 
		begin
			if ( @sKey1 IS NOT NULL AND	@sKey2 IS NOT NULL AND 	@sKey3 IS NOT NULL ) 
				SELECT  @sPar1 = cast( avl_ownhours as nvarchar(30))
				FROM    r5availability
				WHERE   avl_date  = cast( @sKey3 as datetime)
				AND     avl_trade = @sKey1
				AND     avl_mrc   = @sKey2
			else
				set @sPar1 = NULL
		end


	set @nPos#         = CHARINDEX( N'#', @sKey4 )
	if @nPos# > 0
		set @nOrderNumber = SUBSTRING( @sKey4, 1, @nPos# -1 )
	else
		set @nOrderNumber = null
	set @sOrderorg    = SUBSTRING( @sKey4, @nPos# +1, len(@sKey4) )


	if ( @sRentity = N'BOOK' AND @nCode =  N'1'  )  AND ( @sKey1 IS NOT NULL   )   AND ( @sKey2 IS NOT NULL   )    AND ( @nOrderNumber IS NOT NULL   )    AND ( @sOrderorg IS NOT NULL   ) 
			--          par1 = order line rtype
			--          par2 = order line currency
			--          par3 = order line ordered
			--          par4 = order line received
			--          par5 = order line invoiced
			--          par6 = order line type
			--          par7 = order line exchange rate
			--          @sKey1 = event
			--          @sKey2 = activity
			--          @sKey3 = act_hire (not used as @sKey)
			--          @sKey4 = act_order
			-- W0312S get  order line rtype etc. and do some checking
			-- ST:      price
			-- SF:      amount ordered still to be received if no such amount entered
			-- SF, ST:  exchange rate
		begin
            --prevent conversion error
            if @sKey2 is not null and isnumeric( @sKey2 ) = 0
                begin
                    set @sChk = N'996'
                    return
                end

			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM      r5orderlines l
			WHERE  l.orl_event     = @sKey1
			AND    l.orl_act       = cast( convert( numeric, @sKey2) as int )
			AND    l.orl_order     = @nOrderNumber
			AND    l.orl_order_org = @sOrderorg
			AND    l.orl_rtype IN ( N'SF', N'ST' )
			AND    ( l.orl_rstatus NOT IN ( 'C', 'J' ) OR ( l.orl_rstatus IN ( 'C', 'J' ) AND isnull( l.orl_recvvalue, 0 ) <> 0 ) )
			
			if @nCount = 1
				SELECT       @sPar1 =  l.orl_rtype ,
				@sPar2 = cast (l.orl_curr as nvarchar(40)),
				@sPar3 = cast( l.orl_price as nvarchar(40)),
				@sPar4 = cast( l.orl_recvvalue as nvarchar(40)),
				@sPar5 = cast ( l.orl_invvalue as nvarchar(40) ),
				@sPar6 = l.orl_type  ,
				@sPar7 = cast( l.orl_exch  as nvarchar(40)),
				@sPar8 = cast( l.orl_recvqty as nvarchar(40)),
				@sOrlactive = l.orl_active ,
				@sOrlstatus = l.orl_rstatus
				FROM      r5orderlines l
				WHERE  l.orl_event     = @sKey1
				AND    l.orl_act       = cast( convert( numeric, @sKey2) as int)
				AND    l.orl_order     = @nOrderNumber
				AND    l.orl_order_org = @sOrderorg
				AND    l.orl_rtype IN ( N'SF', N'ST' )
				AND    ( l.orl_rstatus NOT IN ( 'C', 'J' ) OR ( l.orl_rstatus IN ( 'C', 'J' ) AND isnull( l.orl_recvvalue, 0 ) <> 0 ) )

			else
				begin
					if @nCount <= 0
						begin
							set @sChk = N'5' 
							return
						end
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'10'
							return 
						end
				end

			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5orders o
			WHERE  o.ord_code = @nOrderNumber
			AND    o.ord_org  = @sOrderorg

			if @nCount = 1
				SELECT @sOrdstatus =  o.ord_rstatus
				FROM   r5orders o
				WHERE  o.ord_code = @nOrderNumber
				AND    o.ord_org  = @sOrderorg
			else
				begin
					if @nCount <= 0
						begin
							set @sChk = N'995' 
							return
						end
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'996'
							return 
						end
				end


			--

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GPPREV(   @pWoOrg nvarchar(15),
                                @pEquipments nvarchar(310),
                                @pWOTypes nvarchar(90),
                                @pWOClasses nvarchar(90),
                                @pDepartments nvarchar(160),
                                @pPriorities nvarchar(90),
                                @pSupervisors nvarchar(310),
                                @pLocations nvarchar(310),
                                @pPersons nvarchar(160),
                                @pCostCodes nvarchar(310),
                                @pPMSchedules nvarchar(210),
                                @pPMClasses nvarchar(90),
                                @pRequestedStartDate datetime,
                                @pRequestedEndDate datetime,
                                @sProductPriority nvarchar(3000),
                                @pIncludeWoWithNoRes nvarchar(1),
                                @pSessionID numeric(18), 
                                @pUserID nvarchar(255),
                                @pResource nvarchar(80),
                                @pRole nvarchar(30) = '*' ) AS
    BEGIN
    
        DECLARE @vEventCode         nvarchar(30) -- r5events.evt_code
        DECLARE @vEventOrg          nvarchar(15) -- r5events.evt_org
        DECLARE @vEventStatus       nvarchar(4) -- r5events.evt_status
        DECLARE @vObject            nvarchar(30) -- r5objects.obj_code
        DECLARE @vObjectOrg         nvarchar(15) -- r5objects.obj_org
        DECLARE @vEventType         nvarchar(8) -- r5events.evt_jobtype
        DECLARE @vPPMCode           nvarchar(20) -- r5events.evt_ppm
        DECLARE @vPPMType           nvarchar(1) -- r5events.evt_isstype
        DECLARE @vEventStartDate    datetime
        DECLARE @vEventEndDate      datetime
        DECLARE @vScheduleStartDate datetime
        DECLARE @vScheduleEndDate   datetime
        DECLARE @vGroupSequence     numeric(3)
        DECLARE @vDEPTSEC           nvarchar(400)
        DECLARE @vJTAUTH            nvarchar(400)
        DECLARE @vINCRLINO          numeric(3)
        DECLARE @vInstallValue      nvarchar(400)
        DECLARE @vProdPriority      nvarchar(256)
        DECLARE @vPrevVal           nvarchar(4000)
        DECLARE @vCurrVal           nvarchar(4000)
        DECLARE @vSQL               nvarchar(4000)
        DECLARE @vInc               numeric(3)
        declare @dToday             datetime

        /* initialisation  */
        SET @vInc = 0
        SET @vCurrVal = N'#'
        SET @vPrevVal = N'#'
        set @dToday = dbo.o7gttime2( @pWoOrg )
        
        /* delete old unused data */
        delete from r5genproductrequest where gpr_created <  @dToday - 5
        delete from r5genprodreqwo where gpw_created <  @dToday - 5
        /* delete all the records from the given sessionid */
        delete from r5genproductrequest where gpr_sessionid = @pSessionID
        delete from r5genprodreqwo where gpw_sessionid = @pSessionID

        /* Get the Department Security setting */
        SET @vDEPTSEC = N'OFF'

        SELECT @vDEPTSEC = ins_desc
                FROM r5install
                WHERE ins_code = N'DEPTSEC'

        /* Get the JTAUTH Install Parameter value */
        SET @vJTAUTH = N'NO'

        SELECT @vJTAUTH = ins_desc
                FROM r5install
                WHERE ins_code = N'JTAUTH'

        /* Get the default Increment value from INCRLINO Install Parameter */
        SELECT @vInstallValue = ins_desc
                FROM r5install
                WHERE ins_code = N'INCRLINO'

        IF( ISNUMERIC( @vInstallValue ) = 1 )
            SET @vINCRLINO = COALESCE( CAST( @vInstallValue AS numeric ), 10 )
        ELSE
            SET @vINCRLINO = 10


        SET @vSQL = N'INSERT INTO #tWorkOrder ' + 
                    N'SELECT distinct(e.evt_code), e.evt_org, e.evt_status, e.evt_object, e.evt_object_org,' +
                    N' e.evt_jobtype, e.evt_ppm, case when e.evt_ppm is null then null else e.evt_isstype end, e.evt_requeststart, e.evt_requestend, e.evt_target, e.evt_schedend, e.evt_prodpriority' +
                    N' FROM  r5userorganization u, r5events e  LEFT OUTER JOIN r5ppms p ON  p.ppm_code = e.evt_ppm AND p.ppm_revision = e.evt_ppmrev ' +
                    N' WHERE e.evt_rstatus NOT IN ( ''A'', ''B'', ''C'' )' +
                    N' AND e.evt_multiequip <> N''+'' ' +
                    N' AND not exists (select 1 from r5ucodes where uco_rentity =N''JBTP''  AND uco_rcode =N''MEC'' and uco_code = evt_jobtype)' +
                    N' AND e.evt_productionrequest IS NULL ' +
                    N' AND e.evt_prodorder IS NULL ' +
                    N' AND e.evt_requeststart BETWEEN ''' + cast(@pRequestedStartDate as nvarchar(50)) + ''' AND ''' + cast(@pRequestedEndDate as nvarchar(50)) + ''' ' +
                    dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'e.evt_object', @pEquipments, N'+', 10 ) +
                    dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'e.evt_jobtype', @pWOTypes, N'+', 10 ) +
                    dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'e.evt_class', @pWOClasses, N'+', 10 ) +
                    dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'e.evt_mrc', @pDepartments, N'+', 10 ) +
                    dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'e.evt_priority', @pPriorities, N'+', 10 ) +
                    dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'e.evt_schedgrp', @pSupervisors, N'+', 10 ) +
                    dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'e.evt_location', @pLocations, N'+', 10 ) +
                    dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'e.evt_person', @pPersons, N'+', 10 ) +
                    dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'e.evt_costcode', @pCostCodes, N'+', 10 ) +
                    dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'e.evt_prodpriority', REPLACE(@sProductPriority, N'''', N''''''), N'+', 10 ) +
                    dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'p.ppm_code', @pPMSchedules, N'+', 10 ) +
                    dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND', N'p.ppm_class', @pPMClasses, N'+', 10 ) +
                    N' AND u.uog_user = N''' + @pUserID + ''' ' +
                    N' AND u.uog_role = N''' + @pRole + ''' ' +
                    N' AND u.uog_org = e.evt_org ' +
                    N' AND ( u.uog_org = N''' + @pWoOrg + ''' OR u.uog_common = N''+'')'
                    
                    
        /* Exclude WO Type that are listed in r5intgplanwotypes */

        IF( UPPER(@vDEPTSEC) IN (N'YES', N'Y', N'ON', N'+') )

        IF( UPPER(@vJTAUTH) IN (N'YES', N'Y', N'ON', N'+') )
            SET @vSQL = @vSQL + N' AND EXISTS (SELECT jta_jobtype FROM r5jobtypeauth WHERE jta_update =''+''  AND jta_jobtype = evt_jobtype AND (jta_status = N''ALLSTATS'' OR jta_status = evt_status) AND (jta_group =u.uog_group  OR jta_group = ''*'')) '

		/* Include Workorders with atleast 1 active Resource if no Resource is selected

		IF(@pIncludeWoWithNoRes = N'-') 
		BEGIN

		END

create procedure O7GPRICE
	@sTrans          nvarchar(30),
	@sPart           nvarchar(30),
	@sPartorg        nvarchar(15),
	@sStore          nvarchar(15),
	@nBaseprice      numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
	@sChk             nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sTracktype               nvarchar(4)-- r5parts.par_trackrtype%TYPE
	declare @sOrg                     nvarchar(15)--r5parts.par_org%TYPE
	declare @nCount 	int
	declare @nReturn	int

	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk = N'0'
	/* Check mandatory parameters */
	IF ( @sPart IS NULL )
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end
	/* Fetching cursor value into @sTracktype */
	SELECT @sTracktype = p.par_trackrtype
	FROM   r5parts    p
	WHERE  p.par_code = @sPart
	AND    p.par_org  = @sPartorg

	IF @sTracktype = N'TRQ'

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GREEN
AS 
  SET NOCOUNT ON

  DECLARE @dStartDate      DATETIME
  DECLARE @dCurrentDate    DATETIME
  DECLARE @dMinDate        DATETIME
  DECLARE @dMaxDate        DATETIME
  DECLARE @dMinDate2       DATETIME
  DECLARE @dMaxDate2       DATETIME
  DECLARE @dMinMinDate     DATETIME 
  DECLARE @sChk            NVARCHAR(4)
  DECLARE @sGdrv           NVARCHAR(200)
  DECLARE @nExtraDays      NUMERIC(6)
  DECLARE @sBillBased      NVARCHAR(1)

  DECLARE @nReturn         INTEGER

  DECLARE @nDesignValue    NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @nActualUsage    NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @sParent         NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sParentOrg      NVARCHAR(415)
  DECLARE @nEff            NUMERIC(24,6)

  DECLARE @nDownTime       NUMERIC(24,6)

  DECLARE @sInvoice        NVARCHAR(45)
  DECLARE @sInvoiceOrg     NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @nSequence       NUMERIC(6)
  DECLARE @sObject         NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sObjectOrg      NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sCommodity      NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @dFromDate       DATETIME
  DECLARE @dToDate         DATETIME
  DECLARE @sCurrency       NVARCHAR(3)
  DECLARE @sSupplier       NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sSupplierOrg    NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @sMeter          NVARCHAR(20)
  DECLARE @sUom            NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @nUomConversion  NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @sRateCode       NVARCHAR(8)
  DECLARE @nAvgConsumption NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @nRate           NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @nLoadFactor     INTEGER

  DECLARE @dDate           DATETIME
  DECLARE @nActConsumption NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @nUsage          NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @nSqlIdentity    INTEGER
  DECLARE @nActUsage       NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @sReadingUom     NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sDesignUsageUom NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @nCO2Emission    NUMERIC(24,6)

  /* Retrieve the value of install parameter GDRV. */
  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sGdrv OUTPUT, N'GDRV', @sChk OUTPUT
  IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
    RETURN -1
  SET @sGdrv = COALESCE( UPPER( @sGdrv ), N'OFF' )

  IF @sGdrv = N'OFF'
    /* Return if the Green Driver install parameter is set to 'OFF'. */
    RETURN
  ELSE IF @sGdrv IN ( N'PURGE', N'FULL' )
    BEGIN
      /* Delete all records. */
      DELETE FROM r5utilityrates
      DELETE FROM r5commodityenergyeff
      DELETE FROM r5commodityco2emission
      DELETE FROM r5objectgasindex
      IF @sGdrv = N'PURGE'
        /* Return if only purge required. */
        RETURN
      ELSE
        /* Otherwise set the start date to long, long ago. */
        SET @dStartDate = dbo.TO_DATE( N'01-01-1900', N'MM-DD-YYYY' )
    END
  ELSE
    /* The value of the install parameter should be a date. */
    /* Use it as the start date.                            */
    SET @dStartDate = dbo.TO_DATE( @sGdrv, N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) 

  /* Set new date, for the next run. */
  UPDATE r5install
  SET    ins_desc = dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( dbo.o7gttime2( NULL ), N'MM-DD-YYYY' )
  WHERE  ins_code = N'GDRV'


  /* *****   U T I L I T Y   R A T E   C A L C U L A T I O N   ***** */


  /* Loop through too old extrapolation records, and delete them. */
  DECLARE c_uil CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT uil_invoice,
           uil_invoice_org,
           uil_sequence,
           uil_object,
           uil_object_org,
           uil_commodity,
           dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( uil_todate, N'DD' ) + 1,
           dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( uil_todate, N'DD' ) + 
             ROUND( ( DATEDIFF( DAY, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( uil_fromdate, N'DD' ), 
                                     dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( uil_todate, N'DD' ) ) + 1 ) * 1.5, 0 )
    FROM   r5utilityinvlines
    WHERE  uil_todate < dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( NULL ), N'DD' ) - 
             ROUND( ( DATEDIFF( DAY, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( uil_fromdate, N'DD' ), 
                                     dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( uil_todate, N'DD' ) ) + 1 ) * 1.5, 0 )
    AND EXISTS( SELECT N'x'
                FROM   r5utilityrates
                WHERE  utr_calculatedaverage = N'-'
                AND    utr_billbased   = N'-'
                AND    utr_commodity   = uil_commodity
                AND    utr_object      = uil_object
                AND    utr_object_org  = uil_object_org
                AND    utr_invoice     = uil_invoice
                AND    utr_invoice_org = uil_invoice_org
                AND    utr_sequence    = uil_sequence )

  OPEN c_uil
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_uil INTO @sInvoice, @sInvoiceOrg, @nSequence, @sObject, 
                             @sObjectOrg, @sCommodity, @dFromDate, @dToDate
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @nReturn = O7GREEN_DELETEDATA @sInvoice, @sInvoiceOrg, @nSequence, @sObject, 
                                            @sObjectOrg, @sCommodity, NULL, NULL,
                                            @dFromDate, @dToDate, N'-', N'-' 
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
        BEGIN
          CLOSE c_uil
          DEALLOCATE c_uil 
          RETURN -1
        END

      EXECUTE @nReturn = O7GREEN_INSERTSUMUTR @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sCommodity, @dFromDate, @dToDate
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
        BEGIN
          CLOSE c_uil
          DEALLOCATE c_uil 
          RETURN -1
        END

      FETCH NEXT FROM c_uil INTO @sInvoice, @sInvoiceOrg, @nSequence, @sObject, 
                                 @sObjectOrg, @sCommodity, @dFromDate, @dToDate
    END
  CLOSE c_uil
  DEALLOCATE c_uil   

  SET @dMinMinDate = @dStartDate

  /* Loop through all utility invoice lines. */
  DECLARE c_uil2 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( uil_fromdate, N'DD' ),
           dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( uil_todate, N'DD' ),
           uil_invoice,
           uil_invoice_org,
           uil_sequence,
           org_curr,
           inv_supplier,
           inv_supplier_org,
           uil_object,
           uil_object_org,
           uil_meter,
           uil_commodity,
           cmd_uom,
           CASE uil_uom WHEN cmd_uom THEN 1 ELSE
                   COALESCE( ( SELECT uoc_confact 
                               FROM   r5uomconversion
                               WHERE  uoc_siteuom = uil_uom
                               AND    uoc_baseuom = cmd_uom ), 1 ) END,
           uil_ratecode,
           ROUND( ( uil_quantity * COALESCE( uil_corr_factor, 1 ) * COALESCE( uil_multiplier, 1 ) ) / 
                  ( DATEDIFF( DAY, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( uil_fromdate, N'DD' ), 
                                   dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( uil_todate, N'DD' ) ) + 1 ), 6 ),
           ROUND( uil_amount / ( uil_quantity * COALESCE( uil_corr_factor, 1 ) * COALESCE( uil_multiplier, 1 ) ), 6 ) /
           dbo.o7gtexch2( inv_curr, uil_object_org, inv_date )
    FROM   r5commodities, r5organization, r5invoices, r5utilityinvlines
    WHERE  cmd_code    = uil_commodity
    AND    inv_code    = uil_invoice
    AND    inv_org     = uil_invoice_org
    AND    org_code    = uil_object_org
    AND    inv_rstatus = N'A'
    AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( inv_approv, N'DD' ) >= @dStartDate
    ORDER BY uil_fromdate

  OPEN c_uil2
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_uil2 INTO @dFromDate, @dToDate, @sInvoice, @sInvoiceOrg, @nSequence, 
                              @sCurrency, @sSupplier, @sSupplierOrg, @sObject, @sObjectOrg, 
                              @sMeter, @sCommodity, @sUom, @nUomConversion, @sRateCode,
                              @nAvgConsumption, @nRate
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN

      SET @dCurrentDate = @dFromDate

      SET @nExtraDays = ROUND( ( DATEDIFF( DAY, @dFromDate, @dToDate ) + 1 ) * 1.5, 0 )

      /* Retrieve minimum and maximum date related to current utility invoice line. */
      SET @dMinDate = NULL
      SET @dMaxDate = NULL
      SELECT @dMinDate = MIN( utr_date ), @dMaxDate = MAX( utr_date )
      FROM   r5utilityrates 
      WHERE  utr_invoice     = @sInvoice
      AND    utr_invoice_org = @sInvoiceOrg
      AND    utr_sequence    = @nSequence
