CREATE PROCEDURE O7GREEN_INSERTINDEX
  @dDate      DATETIME,
  @sObj       NVARCHAR(30), 
  @sObjOrg    NVARCHAR(15), 
  @sCom       NVARCHAR(15)
AS 
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  DECLARE @nScheduledHours NUMERIC(24,6)        
  DECLARE @nAvailIndex     NUMERIC(24,6)        
  DECLARE @sX              NVARCHAR(1)

  /* Insert commodity energy efficiency record. */
  INSERT INTO r5commodityenergyeff( cee_date, cee_object, cee_object_org, cee_commodity )
  SELECT @dDate, @sObj, @sObjOrg, @sCom
  FROM   dual
  WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                    FROM   r5commodityenergyeff
                    WHERE  cee_date       = @dDate
                    AND    cee_object     = @sObj
                    AND    cee_object_org = @sObjOrg
                    AND    cee_commodity  = @sCom )

  /* Check whether gas index record already exists. */
  SELECT @sX = 'x'
  FROM   r5objectgasindex
  WHERE  ogi_date       = @dDate
  AND    ogi_object     = @sObj
  AND    ogi_object_org = @sObjOrg

  IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
    BEGIN
      /* If not, insert it now. */ 
      /* First retrieve the available scheduled hours. */
      SELECT @nScheduledHours = 
             CASE DATEPART( DW, @dDate ) 
                  WHEN 2 THEN ( cgp_monend   - cgp_monstart )
                  WHEN 3 THEN ( cgp_tuesend  - cgp_tuesstart )
                  WHEN 4 THEN ( cgp_wedend   - cgp_wedstart ) 
                  WHEN 5 THEN ( cgp_thursend - cgp_thursstart )
                  WHEN 6 THEN ( cgp_friend   - cgp_fristart )
                  WHEN 7 THEN ( cgp_satend   - cgp_satstart ) 
                  ELSE ( cgp_sunend   - cgp_sunstart ) END / 60  
      FROM   r5objects, r5cctrcalgroupperiods
      WHERE  obj_calgroup    = cgp_groupcode
      AND    obj_calgrouporg = cgp_grouporg
      AND    obj_code        = @sObj
      AND    obj_org         = @sObjOrg
      AND    @dDate BETWEEN cgp_start AND cgp_end
      AND    cgp_period = ( SELECT MIN( cgp_period )
                            FROM   r5cctrcalgroupperiods c2
                            WHERE  c2.cgp_groupcode = obj_calgroup
                            AND    c2.cgp_grouporg  = obj_calgrouporg
                            AND    @dDate BETWEEN c2.cgp_start AND c2.cgp_end )

      IF COALESCE( @nScheduledHours, 0 ) <> 0 
        SET @nAvailIndex = 1

      /* Insert object gas index record. */
      INSERT INTO r5objectgasindex( ogi_date, ogi_object, ogi_object_org, 
             ogi_availscheduledhours, ogi_availdowntime, ogi_availabilityindex )
      VALUES( @dDate, @sObj, @sObjOrg, @nScheduledHours, 0, @nAvailIndex )
    END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GREEN_INSERTSUMUTR
  @sObj       NVARCHAR(30), 
  @sObjOrg    NVARCHAR(15), 
  @sCom       NVARCHAR(15),
  @dFromDate  DATETIME,     
  @dToDate    DATETIME
AS 
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  /* Create sum records. */
  INSERT INTO r5utilityrates(
         utr_date,
         utr_curr,
         utr_object,
         utr_object_org,
         utr_commodity,
         utr_uom,
         utr_billbased,
         utr_calculatedaverage,
         utr_avgconsumption,
         utr_rate,
         utr_indexed )
  SELECT utr_date,
         utr_curr,
         utr_object,
         utr_object_org,
         utr_commodity,
         utr_uom,
         CASE WHEN SUM( CASE WHEN utr_billbased = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) = COUNT(*) THEN '+' ELSE '-' END,
         '+',
         SUM( utr_avgconsumption ),
         SUM( utr_avgconsumption * utr_rate) / SUM( utr_avgconsumption ),
         '-'
  FROM   r5utilityrates
  WHERE  utr_calculatedaverage = N'-'
  AND    utr_date BETWEEN @dFromDate AND @dToDate
  AND    utr_object     = @sObj
  AND    utr_object_org = @sObjOrg
  AND    utr_commodity  = @sCom
  GROUP BY utr_date, utr_curr, utr_object, utr_object_org, utr_commodity, utr_uom

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GREEN_INSERTUPDATEECD
  @sObj       NVARCHAR(30), 
  @sOrg       NVARCHAR(15), 
  @sCom       NVARCHAR(15),
  @sRtype     NVARCHAR(1)
AS 
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  DECLARE @nRate      NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @nCo2       NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @sRegion    NVARCHAR(30)
  DECLARE @sRegionorg NVARCHAR(15)
  DECLARE @nBaseload  NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @nSlopecd   NUMERIC(24,6)
  DECLARE @nSlopehd   NUMERIC(24,6)

  /* Do insert of equipment/commodity combination. */
  INSERT INTO r5equipcommoditydata( ecd_object, ecd_object_org, ecd_commodity )
  SELECT @sObj, @sOrg, @sCom
  FROM   dual
  WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x' 
                    FROM   r5equipcommoditydata
                    WHERE  ecd_object     = @sObj
                    AND    ecd_object_org = @sOrg
                    AND    ecd_commodity  = @sCom )

  IF @sRtype = N'+' 
    BEGIN
      /* Retrieve last rate and update. */ 
      SELECT @nRate = utr_rate
      FROM   r5utilityrates
      WHERE  utr_object     = @sObj
      AND    utr_object_org = @sOrg
      AND    utr_commodity  = @sCom
      AND    utr_calculatedaverage = N'+'
      ORDER BY utr_date DESC

      UPDATE r5equipcommoditydata
      SET    ecd_rate       = @nRate
      WHERE  ecd_object     = @sObj
      AND    ecd_object_org = @sOrg
      AND    ecd_commodity  = @sCom
    END  
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      /* Retrieve last co2 emission and update. */ 
      SELECT @nCo2 = cce_co2emission
      FROM   r5commodityco2emission
      WHERE  cce_object     = @sObj
      AND    cce_object_org = @sOrg
      AND    cce_commodity  = @sCom
      AND    cce_type       = N'UB'
      ORDER BY cce_date DESC

      /* Retrieve region of object. */
      SELECT @sRegion = obj_region,
             @sRegionorg = obj_region_org
      FROM   r5objects
      WHERE  obj_code = @sObj
      AND    obj_org  = @sOrg

      IF @sRegion IS NOT NULL
        /* Retrieve baseload. */
        BEGIN
          SELECT @nBaseload = AVG( oac_actualconsumption )
          FROM   r5regionactualtemps, r5objactualconsumption
          WHERE  rat_date       = oac_date
          AND    rat_region     = @sRegion
          AND    rat_region_org = @sRegionorg
          AND    oac_object     = @sObj
          AND    oac_object_org = @sOrg
          AND    oac_commodity  = @sCom
          AND    rat_coolingdegreedays < 1
          AND    rat_heatingdegreedays < 1  

          IF @nBaseload IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
              /* Retrieve slopes. */
              SELECT @nSlopecd = SUM( oac_actualconsumption - @nBaseload ) / SUM( rat_coolingdegreedays )
              FROM   r5regionactualtemps, r5objactualconsumption
              WHERE  rat_date       = oac_date
              AND    rat_region     = @sRegion
              AND    oac_object     = @sObj
              AND    oac_object_org = @sOrg
              AND    oac_commodity  = @sCom
              AND    rat_coolingdegreedays >= 1

              SELECT @nSlopehd = SUM( oac_actualconsumption - @nBaseload ) / SUM( rat_heatingdegreedays )
              FROM   r5regionactualtemps, r5objactualconsumption
              WHERE  rat_date       = oac_date
              AND    rat_region     = @sRegion
              AND    oac_object     = @sObj
              AND    oac_object_org = @sOrg
              AND    oac_commodity  = @sCom
              AND    rat_heatingdegreedays >= 1
            END
        END      

      UPDATE r5equipcommoditydata
      SET    ecd_co2emission = @nCo2,
             ecd_baseload    = @nBaseload,
	         ecd_slope_cd    = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( @nSlopecd, 0 ),
             ecd_slope_hd    = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( @nSlopehd, 0 )
      WHERE  ecd_object      = @sObj
      AND    ecd_object_org  = @sOrg
      AND    ecd_commodity   = @sCom 
    END

CREATE FUNCTION O7GRIDTABLES_GETSC (	
  @obj   NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @org   NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @lang  NVARCHAR(  2 ) )
RETURNS @t TABLE( 
  scpk          NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
  sccode        NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
  sccodeorg     NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  scskip        NVARCHAR( 1 )  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  scsource      NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  scsourceorg   NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  scentity      NVARCHAR( 80 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
AS
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO @t( scpk, sccode, sccodeorg, scskip, scsource, scsourceorg, scentity )
  SELECT COALESCE(o1.osc_parent, o1.osc_pk) scpk, 
         o1.osc_servicecode sccode, o1.osc_servicecode_org sccodeorg, CASE WHEN tree.lev = 1 THEN o1.osc_skipthislevel ELSE '-' END scskip,
         CASE WHEN tree.lev = 1 THEN o3.osc_object ELSE COALESCE( o3.osc_object, o1.osc_object ) END scsource,
         CASE WHEN tree.lev = 1 THEN o3.osc_object_org ELSE COALESCE( o3.osc_object_org, o1.osc_object_org ) END scsourceorg,
         dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang,'UCOD',
             ( SELECT obj_obtype FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = CASE WHEN tree.lev = 1 THEN o3.osc_object ELSE COALESCE( o3.osc_object, o1.osc_object ) END 
               AND obj_org = CASE WHEN tree.lev = 1 THEN o3.osc_object_org ELSE COALESCE( o3.osc_object_org, o1.osc_object_org ) END ), 
               'OBTP', NULL ) scentity 
  FROM   r5objectservicecodes o1 
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objectservicecodes o3 ON ( o3.osc_pk = o1.osc_parent ), 
         ( SELECT parent stc_parent, parentorg stc_parent_org, lev + 1 lev 
           FROM  dbo.o7getequipchildparent( @obj, @org ) 
           UNION 
           SELECT @obj, @org, 1 
           FROM   dual ) tree 
  WHERE  tree.stc_parent     = o1.osc_object 
  AND    tree.stc_parent_org = o1.osc_object_org  
  AND    tree.lev = ( SELECT MIN( tree2.lev )  
                      FROM   r5objectservicecodes o2, 
                             ( SELECT parent stc_parent, parentorg stc_parent_org, lev + 1 lev 
                               FROM   dbo.o7getequipchildparent( @obj, @org ) 
                               UNION 
                               SELECT @obj, @org, 1 
                               FROM   dual ) tree2 
                      WHERE  tree2.stc_parent   = o2.osc_object 
                      AND    tree2.stc_parent_org = o2.osc_object_org  
                      AND    o2.osc_servicecode   = o1.osc_servicecode 
                      AND    o2.osc_servicecode_org = o1.osc_servicecode_org ) 
  AND    ( ( tree.lev = 1 ) OR ( tree.lev > 1 AND o1.osc_applytochildren = '+' ) ) 
  RETURN
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7GRIDTABLES_GETSUP (	
  @obj   NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @org   NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @lang  NVARCHAR(  2 ) )
RETURNS @t TABLE( 
  pk          NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
  supplier    NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
  supplierorg NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  skip        NVARCHAR( 1 )  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  source      NVARCHAR( 30 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  sourceorg   NVARCHAR( 15 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
  sentity     NVARCHAR( 80 ) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
AS
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO @t( pk, supplier, supplierorg, skip, source, sourceorg, sentity )
  SELECT COALESCE(o1.osp_parent, o1.osp_pk),
         o1.osp_supplier,
         o1.osp_supplier_org, 
         CASE WHEN tree.lev = 1 THEN o1.osp_skipthislevel ELSE '-' END,
         CASE WHEN tree.lev = 1 THEN o3.osp_object ELSE COALESCE( o3.osp_object, o1.osp_object ) END,
         CASE WHEN tree.lev = 1 THEN o3.osp_object_org ELSE COALESCE( o3.osp_object_org, o1.osp_object_org ) END,
         dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @lang, 'UCOD', 
             ( SELECT obj_obtype FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = CASE WHEN tree.lev = 1 THEN o3.osp_object ELSE COALESCE( o3.osp_object, o1.osp_object ) END 
               AND obj_org = CASE WHEN tree.lev = 1 THEN o3.osp_object_org ELSE COALESCE( o3.osp_object_org, o1.osp_object_org ) END ), 
             'OBTP', NULL )
  FROM   r5objectsuppliers o1 
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objectsuppliers o3 ON ( o3.osp_pk = o1.osp_parent ), 
         ( SELECT parent stc_parent, parentorg stc_parent_org, lev + 1 lev 
           FROM   dbo.o7getequipchildparent( @obj, @org )  
           UNION  
           SELECT @obj, @org, 1 
           FROM   dual ) tree 
  WHERE  tree.stc_parent = o1.osp_object 
  AND    tree.stc_parent_org = o1.osp_object_org 
  AND    tree.lev = ( SELECT MIN( tree2.lev )  
                      FROM   r5objectsuppliers o2, 
                             ( SELECT parent stc_parent, parentorg stc_parent_org, lev+1 lev 
                               FROM   dbo.o7getequipchildparent( @obj, @org ) 
                               UNION 
                               SELECT @obj, @org, 1 
                               FROM   dual ) tree2 
                      WHERE  tree2.stc_parent     = o2.osp_object 
                      AND    tree2.stc_parent_org = o2.osp_object_org  
                      AND    o2.osp_supplier      = o1.osp_supplier 
                      AND    o2.osp_supplier_org  = o1.osp_supplier_org ) 
  AND    ( ( tree.lev = 1 )  OR ( tree.lev > 1 AND o1.osp_applytochildren = '+' ) ) 
  RETURN
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7GTASQY(   @sStore     nvarchar(15),
                            @sPart      nvarchar(30),
                            @sPartorg   nvarchar(15),
                            @sEvent     nvarchar(30),
                            @sReq       nvarchar(30),
                            @nReqline   numeric(8),
                            @sBin       nvarchar(15),
                            @sLot       nvarchar(12) ) 
RETURNS numeric(30,6)
as
begin
    declare @nReqqty    numeric(24,6)
    declare @nReturn    numeric(30,6)

    set @nReqqty = 0.000000

    SELECT @nReqqty = coalesce(SUM(rpb_qty),0.000000)
    FROM r5repairbins, r5requislines LEFT OUTER JOIN r5orderlines on (orl_req = rql_req
                                                                AND   orl_reqline = rql_reqline)
                                     LEFT OUTER JOIN r5orders on (ord_code = orl_order)
    WHERE rpb_req IS NOT NULL
    AND   rpb_reqline IS NOT NULL
    AND   ( ( @sReq IS NULL AND @nReqline IS NULL ) OR ( rpb_req <> @sReq AND rpb_reqline <> @nReqline) )
    AND   rpb_store = @sStore
    AND   rpb_part = @sPart
    AND   rpb_part_org = @sPartorg
    AND   rpb_bin = coalesce( @sBin, rpb_bin )
    AND   rpb_lot = coalesce( @sLot, rpb_lot )
    AND   rql_req = rpb_req
    AND   rql_reqline = rpb_reqline
    AND   coalesce(rql_active, N'-') = N'+'
    AND   rql_rstatus NOT IN ( N'C', N'J' )
    AND   coalesce(rql_recvqty, 0.000000) + coalesce(rql_scrapqty, 0.000000) < coalesce(rql_qty, 0.000000)
    AND   coalesce(orl_rstatus, N'U') NOT IN ( N'C', N'J' )
    AND   coalesce(ord_rstatus, N'U') <> N'A'

    set @nReturn = @nReqqty

    return @nReturn
end

CREATE FUNCTION O7GTCLAU(@pJoiner nvarchar(3), @pField nvarchar(30), @pValue nvarchar(330), @pIgnoreIfValueBlank nvarchar(1) = '-', @pMaxInValues int = 999) RETURNS nvarchar(500)
AS BEGIN
   DECLARE @sClause   nvarchar(500)
   DECLARE @sValue    nvarchar(330)
   DECLARE @nCommaPos int
   DECLARE @bAddComma bit
   DECLARE @nInCount  int

   SET @sClause = N''
   SET @sValue = @pValue
   SET @bAddComma = 0
   SET @nInCount = 0

   IF( NOT( @sValue IS NULL AND @pIgnoreIfValueBlank = N'+' ) )
      BEGIN
         SET @sClause = @pJoiner + N' '

         IF( @sValue IS NULL )
            SET @sClause = @sClause + N'COALESCE(' + @pField + N',''%'') LIKE ''%'' '
         ELSE IF( CHARINDEX( N'%', @sValue ) > 0 )
            SET @sClause = @sClause + @pField + N' LIKE N''' + @sValue + N''' '
         ELSE IF( @pMaxInValues > 0 AND CHARINDEX( N',', @sValue ) > 0 )
            BEGIN
               SET @sClause = @sClause + @pField + N' IN ('

               SET @nCommaPos = CHARINDEX( N',', @sValue )
               WHILE( 1 = 1 )
                  BEGIN
                     IF( @bAddComma = 1 )
                        SET @sClause = @sClause + N','
                     ELSE
                        SET @bAddComma = 1

                     SET @sClause = @sClause + N'N''' + RTRIM( LTRIM( SUBSTRING( @sValue, 1, @nCommaPos - 1 ) ) ) + N''''
                     SET @sValue = SUBSTRING( @sValue, @nCommaPos + 1, 330 )
                     SET @nCommaPos = CHARINDEX( N',', @sValue )
                     SET @nInCount = @nInCount + 1
                     IF( @nCommaPos < 1 OR @nInCount >= @pMaxInValues )
                       BREAK;
                  END

               IF( @sValue IS NOT NULL AND @nInCount < @pMaxInValues )
                  SET @sClause = @sClause + N',N''' + RTRIM( LTRIM( @sValue ) ) + N''''

               SET @sClause = @sClause + N') '
            END
         ELSE
            SET @sClause = @sClause + @pField + N' = N''' + @sValue + N''' '
      END

   return @sClause
end

create procedure O7GTCORE
	@nPrice		numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT,
	@sStore		nvarchar(15),
	@sPart		nvarchar(15),
	@sPartorg	nvarchar(30),
	@sOrg		nvarchar(15),
	@sLev		nvarchar(15),
	@sCom		nvarchar(15) 
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sPricelev nvarchar(  200 )--r5install.ins_desc%type
	declare @sChk      nvarchar(  4 )
	declare @sCommon   nvarchar(  1 ) --r5organization.org_common%type
	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @nCount		int
	declare @sX 	nvarchar(1)

   /* Retrieve level, if not already known */
	IF @sLev IS NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sPricelev OUTPUT, N'PRICELEV', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		end
	ELSE
		set @sPricelev = @sLev

	IF @sPricelev = 'P' OR  @sStore IS NULL 
		begin
			/* retrieve @sCommon, if not already known */
			IF @sCom IS NULL 
				SELECT @sCommon = org_common
				FROM   r5organization
				WHERE  org_code = @sPartorg
			ELSE
				set @sCommon = @sCom

			/* Get @nPrice from @sPart */
			SELECT @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5partprices
			WHERE  ppr_part     = @sPart
			AND    ppr_part_org = @sPartorg
			AND    ppr_org      = CASE @sCommon WHEN N'-' THEN @sPartorg ELSE @sOrg  END

			if @nCount = 1 
				SELECT @nPrice = ppr_corevalue
				FROM   r5partprices
				WHERE  ppr_part     = @sPart
				AND    ppr_part_org = @sPartorg
				AND    ppr_org      = CASE @sCommon WHEN N'-' THEN @sPartorg ELSE @sOrg  END
		end
	ELSE
		/* Get @nPrice from stock */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5stock
			WHERE  sto_store    = @sStore
			AND    sto_part     = @sPart
			AND    sto_part_org = @sPartorg

			if @nCount = 1 			
				SELECT @nPrice = sto_corevalue
				FROM   r5stock
				WHERE  sto_store    = @sStore
				AND    sto_part     = @sPart
				AND    sto_part_org = @sPartorg
		END

create PROCEDURE O7GTCRIT 
	@nKey			numeric(18,0),
	@sRisk			nvarchar(8),
	@nRiskrev		numeric(4),
	@sCrit			nvarchar(8)				OUTPUT,
	@nResult		numeric(38,0)			OUTPUT
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

	declare @nPk			numeric(18,0)
	declare @nValue			numeric(18,0)
	declare @nNorm			numeric(18,0)
	declare @nFound			INTEGER
	declare @sDone			nvarchar(1) 
	declare @sNoform		nvarchar(1) 
	declare @sFormula		nvarchar(2000)
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @nLoop			integer

	declare @nPk_ris         	numeric(18,0)       
	declare @nParent_ris     	numeric(18,0)       
	declare @sNormalize_ris  	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sType_ris       	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sNotused_ris    	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sFormula_ris    	nvarchar(2000) 

	declare @nPk_rep         	numeric(18,0)       
	declare @sCode_rep       	nvarchar(8) 

	if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
		COMMIT

	set @nLoop =	0
	set @sDone =	N'-'
	set @sNoform =	N'-'

	WHILE @nLoop = 0
		begin
			set @nFound = 0
			declare c_ris cursor local for   SELECT ris_pk, ris_parent, ris_normalize,
													 ris_type, ris_notused, ris_formula
												FROM   r5risk r1
												WHERE  ris_risk = @sRisk
												AND    ris_revision = @nRiskrev
												AND    ris_notused  = N'-'
												AND    ris_rankvalue IS NULL
												AND    ris_pk NOT IN ( SELECT ora_riskpk
																	 FROM   r5objectranking
																	 WHERE  ora_pk = @nPk )
												AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
															   FROM   r5risk r2
															   WHERE  r2.ris_parent = r1.ris_pk
															   AND    r2.ris_pk NOT IN ( SELECT ora_riskpk
																						 FROM   r5objectranking
																						 WHERE  ora_pk = @nPk ) )   

			open c_ris
			fetch next from c_ris into	@nPk_ris,@nParent_ris, @sNormalize_ris,  @sType_ris, @sNotused_ris, @sFormula_ris

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin

			 		set @nFound = @nFound + 1
					set @nResult = NULL
					set @sFormula = @sFormula_ris
					if @sFormula IS NULL 
						begin
						   set @sNoform = N'+'
						   BREAK
						end


					declare c_rep cursor local for SELECT ris_pk, ris_code
													FROM   r5risk
													WHERE  ris_parent = @nPk_ris
													ORDER BY len (ris_code ) DESC

					open c_rep
					fetch next from c_rep into	@nPk_rep, @sCode_rep

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							SELECT @nValue = ora_value
							FROM   r5objectranking
							WHERE  ora_pk = @nKey
							AND    ora_riskpk = @nPk_rep
							
							set @sFormula = REPLACE( @sFormula, @sCode_rep, convert( nvarchar(18),  @nValue ) )
						
							fetch next from c_rep into	@nPk_rep, @sCode_rep
						end
					close c_rep
					deallocate c_rep

					set @sFormula = N'SELECT @nResult = ' +  @sFormula  

					EXECUTE sp_executesql @sFormula, N'@nResult numeric(24,6) OUTPUT', @nResult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0
						begin
							close c_ris
							deallocate c_ris
							rollback transaction
							return -1
						end
				
					if coalesce( @sNormalize_ris, N'-' ) = N'+' 
						begin
							/* if necessary, do the normalization */
							set @nNorm = null

							SELECT @nNorm = rno_norm
							FROM   r5risknorm
							WHERE  rno_pk = @nPk_ris
							AND    @nResult > rno_min
							AND    @nResult <= rno_max

							if @nNorm IS NOT NULL 
								set @nResult = @nNorm
						end

					if @sType_ris = N'F' 
						begin
							set @sDone = N'+'
							SELECT @sCrit = rra_criticality
							FROM   r5riskrange
							WHERE  rra_pk = @nPk_ris
							AND    @nResult > rra_min
							AND    @nResult <= rra_max
						end
					else
						INSERT INTO r5objectranking ( ora_pk, ora_riskpk, ora_answer, ora_value )
												VALUES ( @nKey, @nPk_ris, null, @nResult )

					fetch next from c_ris into	@nPk_ris,@nParent_ris, @sNormalize_ris,  @sType_ris, @sNotused_ris, @sFormula_ris
				end

			close c_ris
			deallocate c_ris


			if @sDone = N'+' 
				begin
					if @sCrit IS NULL 
						set @sCrit = N'norange'
					BREAK
				end

			if @sNoform = N'+' 
				begin
					set @sCrit = N'@sNoform'
					BREAK
				end

			if @nFound = 0 
				begin
					set @sCrit = N'none'
					BREAK
				end
		end 
	rollback transaction

name: dbo.O7GTDATE

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GTDATE( @dDate      datetime,
                              @nWhich     nvarchar(1),
                              @nDayofweek numeric(1,0) )
  returns datetime 
as 
  begin
    declare @dRetdate   datetime
    declare @nDay       numeric(1,0)

    if @NWhich is null or @nDayofweek is null
      return @dDate

    if @nWhich != 'L'
      -- 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th week of the month:
      -- a) First calculate the first of the input month.
      -- b) Find out on which day of the week that first of the month falls ( 0=Sunday, 1=Monday ... ).
      -- c) Get a date on the requested day, by adding to the first of the month the difference between
      --    the requested day and the day of the first of the month.
      -- d) Add the requested number of weeks ( which week - 1 ).
      -- e) Add another week in case the date in c) falls in the previous month.
      begin
        set @dRetdate = dateadd( dd, - ( datepart( day, @dDate ) - 1 ), @dDate )
        set @nDay = datepart( dw, @dRetdate ) + ( @@DATEFIRST - 8 )
        if @nDay < 0
          set @nDay = @nDay + 7 
        set @dRetdate = dateadd( dd, ( @nDayofweek - @nDay ) + ( ( cast(@nWhich as integer ) - 1 ) * 7 ), @dRetdate )
        if @nDay > @nDayofweek
          set @dRetdate = dateadd( dd, 7, @dRetdate )
      end   
    else
      -- Last week of the month:
      -- a) First add a month to the input month.
      -- b) Subtract as many days from a) to get the date which is 1 week before the end of the input month.
      -- c) Find out on which day of the week b) falls ( 0=Sunday, 1=Monday ... ).
      -- d) Get a date on the requested day, by adding to b) the difference between the requested day and
      --    the day of b).
      -- e) Add a week in case the date in d) is more than a week away from the end of the month.
      begin
        set @dRetdate = dateadd( mm, 1, @dDate )
        set @dRetdate = dateadd( dd, - ( datepart( day, @dRetdate ) + 6 ), @dRetdate )
        set @nDay = datepart( dw, @dRetdate ) + ( @@DATEFIRST - 8 )
        if @nDay < 0
          set @nDay = @nDay + 7 
        set @dRetdate = dateadd( dd, ( @nDayofweek - @nDay ), @dRetdate )
        if @nDay > @nDayofweek
          set @dRetdate = dateadd( dd, 7, @dRetdate )
      end 
      
    return @dRetdate
  end
0

create procedure O7GTDDAY	@dReturn	datetime OUTPUT,
							@dDate		datetime,
							@sStore		nvarchar(15),
							@sChk		nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSunday	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sMonday	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sTuesday	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sWednesday	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sThursday	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sFriday	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sSaturday	nvarchar(1)
	declare @dThedate	datetime
	declare @bFound		bit

	declare @nI			smallint

	set @sSunday = N'-'
	set @sMonday = N'-'
	set @sTuesday = N'-'
	set @sWednesday = N'-'
	set @sThursday = N'-'
	set @sFriday = N'-'
	set @sSaturday = N'-'
	set @dThedate = @dDate
	set @bFound = 0

	set @sChk = N'0'

	SELECT  @sSunday = isnull(str_sunday,   '-'),
			@sMonday = isnull(str_monday,   '-'),
			@sTuesday = isnull(str_tuesday,  '-'),
			@sWednesday = isnull(str_wednesday,'-'),
			@sThursday = isnull(str_thursday, '-'),
			@sFriday = isnull(str_friday,   '-'),
			@sSaturday = isnull(str_saturday, '-')
	FROM    r5stores
	WHERE   str_code = @sStore

	set @nI = 1

	while @nI < 8
		begin
			if dbo.o7gtwday( @dThedate ) = 1
				begin
					if @sSunday = N'+'
						begin
							set @bFound = 1
							break
						end
					else
						set @dThedate = @dThedate + 1
				end
			if dbo.o7gtwday( @dThedate ) = 2
				begin
					if @sMonday = N'+'
						begin
							set @bFound = 1
							break
						end
					else
						set @dThedate = @dThedate + 1
				end
			if dbo.o7gtwday( @dThedate ) = 3
				begin
					if @sTuesday = N'+'
						begin
							set @bFound = 1
							break
						end
					else
						set @dThedate = @dThedate + 1
				end
			if dbo.o7gtwday( @dThedate ) = 4
				begin
					if @sWednesday = N'+'
						begin
							set @bFound = 1
							break
						end
					else
						set @dThedate = @dThedate + 1
				end
			if dbo.o7gtwday( @dThedate ) = 5
				begin
					if @sThursday = N'+'
						begin
							set @bFound = 1
							break
						end
					else
						set @dThedate = @dThedate + 1
				end
			if dbo.o7gtwday( @dThedate ) = 6
				begin
					if @sFriday = N'+'
						begin
							set @bFound = 1
							break
						end
					else
						set @dThedate = @dThedate + 1
				end
			if dbo.o7gtwday( @dThedate ) = 7
				begin
					if @sSaturday = N'+'
						begin
							set @bFound = 1
							break
						end
					else
						set @dThedate = @dThedate + 1
				end

			set @nI = @nI + 1
		end

	if @bFound = 1
		set @dReturn = @dThedate
	else
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			set @dReturn = null
		end

create procedure O7GTDUAL 
	@sCurr			nvarchar(4),
	@nValue			float,
	@nTodual		NUMERIC(24,12) OUTPUT,
	@nFromdual		NUMERIC(24,12) OUTPUT,
	@nExch			NUMERIC(24,12) OUTPUT,
	@sOrdorg		nvarchar(15),
	@dExchdate		datetime 
  
as

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sBasecurr			nvarchar(3)		--r5organization.org_curr%TYPE
	declare @sDualcurr			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nBasecurr_dual		NUMERIC(24,12)
	declare @nActcurr_dual		NUMERIC(24,12)
	declare @nBasevalue			NUMERIC(24,12)
	declare @nNvalue			float
	declare @sOrdorgcurr		nvarchar(3)		-- r5exchrates.crr_orgcurr%TYPE

  /* Set all out parameters to null. */
  SET @nTodual   = null
  SET @nFromdual = null
  SET @nExch     = null

  /* If no currency supplied  return without doing anything */
	IF @sCurr IS NULL 
		RETURN

 /* Make sure there is a @nValue unequal to zero */
	IF coalesce( @nValue, 0 ) = 0 
		SET @nNvalue = 1000
	ELSE
		SET @nNvalue = @nValue

  /* Get the base currency for the order organization. If no organization */
  /* supplied  return without doing anything. */
	IF @sOrdorg IS NOT NULL 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @sBasecurr = org_curr
			FROM   r5organization
			WHERE  org_code = @sOrdorg

			if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				RETURN
		END

  /* If the currency equals the base currency,  rate should always be 1. */
	SELECT @sDualcurr = ins_desc
	FROM   r5install
	WHERE  ins_code = N'DUALCURR'

	IF @sBasecurr = @sCurr 
		BEGIN
			SET @nExch = 1
			RETURN
		END

  /* Check whether base currency belongs to Euro. */
	SELECT @nBasecurr_dual = cur_dual
	FROM   r5currencies
	WHERE  cur_code = @sBasecurr


  /* Check whether given currency belongs to Euro. */
	SELECT @nActcurr_dual = cur_dual
	FROM   r5currencies
	WHERE  cur_code = @sCurr

  /* If given currency = dual currency and base currency belongs to Euro  */
  /* return reciproke of above retrieved rate.                                */
	IF @nBasecurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @sCurr = @sDualcurr 
		BEGIN
			SET @nExch = ROUND( 1 / @nBasecurr_dual, 6 )
			RETURN
		END

  /* If base currency = dual currency and given currency belongs to Euro  */
  /* return above retrieved rate.                                             */
	IF @nActcurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @sBasecurr = @sDualcurr 
		BEGIN
			SET @nExch = @nActcurr_dual
			RETURN
		END 

	IF @nBasecurr_dual IS NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NULL 
	 /* Normal exchange rate. */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nExch = crr_exch
			FROM   r5exchrates
			WHERE  crr_curr    = @sCurr
			AND    crr_orgcurr = @sBasecurr
			AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dExchdate, N'DD') BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE ( crr_start, N'DD' ) AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD' )
			
			return
		END

	IF @nBasecurr_dual IS NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NOT NULL 
	 /* Triangular!! */
		BEGIN
			SET @nTodual = @nActcurr_dual
			
			SELECT @nFromdual = crr_exch
			FROM   r5exchrates
			WHERE  crr_curr    = @sDualcurr
			AND    crr_orgcurr = @sBasecurr
			AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dExchdate, N'DD') BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE ( crr_start, N'DD' ) AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD' )
			
			SET @nBasevalue = round( @nNvalue / @nTodual / @nFromdual, 4 )
			SET @nExch = round( @nNvalue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
			
			return
		END

	IF @nBasecurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NULL 
	/* Triangular!! */
		BEGIN
			SET @nFromdual = @nBasecurr_dual

			SELECT @nTodual = crr_exch
			FROM   r5exchrates
			WHERE  crr_curr    = @sCurr
			AND    crr_orgcurr = @sDualcurr
			AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dExchdate, N'DD') BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE ( crr_start, N'DD' ) AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD' )

			SET @nBasevalue = round( @nNvalue / @nTodual * @nFromdual, 4 )
			SET @nExch = round( @nNvalue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
			
			return
		END

	--if you get this far tehn none of the above conditions were met
	/* Triangular!! */
	SET @nFromdual = @nBasecurr_dual
	SET @nTodual = @nActcurr_dual
	SET @nBasevalue = round( @nNvalue / @nTodual * @nFromdual, 4 )
	SET @nExch = round( @nNvalue / @nBasevalue, 6 )

create function O7GTERCOUNT (
    @sEquipmentCode   nvarchar(30),
    @sEquipmentOrg nvarchar(15))

returns integer
as
begin

	declare @nLevel		int
	declare @nLevelID		int
	declare @sParentObjectCode	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sParentObjectOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sParentEquipCode	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sParentEquipOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sEnableResource	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sResourcePresent	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sResource		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sHasResource		nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCount                 integer
	
	select @sResource =obj_resource, @sHasResource=obj_resourcepresent from r5objects where  obj_code = @sEquipmentCode and obj_org = @sEquipmentOrg

	if @sResource =N'+' and coalesce(@sHasResource, N'-') =N'-' 
	begin
		set @nLevel = 1
		declare c_structure cursor local for select stc_parent, 
						    stc_parent_org, 
						    levelID, 
						    obj_resource, 
						    obj_resourcepresent 
					            from dbo.F_OBJRESOURCE_HIER_1(@sEquipmentCode, @sEquipmentOrg)
		open c_structure
		fetch next from c_structure into    @sParentObjectCode, @sParentObjectOrg, @nLevelID, @sEnableResource, @sResourcePresent
		while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			begin
				if @nLevel = @nLevelID and  @sResourcePresent =N'+'
				begin
					set @sParentEquipCode = @sParentObjectCode
					set @sParentEquipOrg  = @sParentObjectOrg
					break
				end
				else if @nLevel <> @nLevelID 
					break
					set @nLevel = @nLevel +1

			fetch next from c_structure into   @sParentObjectCode, @sParentObjectOrg, @nLevelID, @sEnableResource, @sResourcePresent
		end
		close c_structure
		deallocate c_structure
	end
      else 
        begin
          if coalesce(@sHasResource, N'-') =N'+' and @sResource =N'+'
            begin
              set @sParentEquipCode = @sEquipmentCode
              set @sParentEquipOrg  = @sEquipmentOrg
            end
        end

    SELECT @nCount = count(*)
    FROM   r5objresources
    WHERE  ors_object = @sParentEquipCode
    AND    ors_object_org = @sParentEquipOrg


  RETURN (@nCount)
END

create procedure O7GTERPE	@sEquipmentCode		nvarchar(30),
				@sEquipmentOrg		nvarchar(15),
				@cReturnParentOnly      nvarchar(1),
				@sParentEquipmentCode	nvarchar(30) OUT,
				@sParentEquipmentOrg	nvarchar(15) OUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nLevel		int
	declare @nLevelID		int
	declare @sParentObjectCode	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sParentObjectOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sEnableResource	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sResourcePresent	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sResource		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sHasResource		nvarchar(1)
      	
      
	select @sResource =obj_resource, @sHasResource=obj_resourcepresent from r5objects where  obj_code = @sEquipmentCode and obj_org = @sEquipmentOrg
        
        set @sParentEquipmentCode = null
        set @sParentEquipmentOrg = null
              
        if @sResource =N'+' and (coalesce(@sHasResource, N'-') =N'-' or @cReturnParentOnly  =N'+') 
          begin
		set @nLevel = 1
		declare c_structure cursor local for select stc_parent, 
						    stc_parent_org, 
						    levelID, 
						    obj_resource, 
						    obj_resourcepresent 
					            from dbo.F_OBJRESOURCE_HIER_1(@sEquipmentCode, @sEquipmentOrg)
		open c_structure
		fetch next from c_structure into    @sParentObjectCode, @sParentObjectOrg, @nLevelID, @sEnableResource, @sResourcePresent
		while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			begin
				if @nLevel = @nLevelID and  @sResourcePresent =N'+'
			   	begin
				  	set @sParentEquipmentCode = @sParentObjectCode
				  	set @sParentEquipmentOrg  = @sParentObjectOrg
				  	break
		       		end
		        	else if @nLevel <> @nLevelID 
				  	break
		        	set @nLevel = @nLevel +1

			fetch next from c_structure into   @sParentObjectCode, @sParentObjectOrg, @nLevelID, @sEnableResource, @sResourcePresent
		end
		close c_structure
		deallocate c_structure
	end
      else 
        begin
          if coalesce(@sHasResource, N'-') =N'+' and @sResource =N'+' and coalesce (@cReturnParentOnly ,N'-') = N'-'
            begin
              set @sParentEquipmentCode = @sEquipmentCode
              set @sParentEquipmentOrg  = @sEquipmentOrg
            end
        end

create procedure O7GTEXCH   @nExch		numeric(24,12)			OUTPUT,
							@sCurr		nvarchar(4),
							@sVorg		nvarchar(15),
							@dExchdate	datetime
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sBasecurr			nvarchar(3)--r5organization.org_curr%type;
	declare @sDualcurr			nvarchar(200)--r5install.ins_desc%type;
	declare @nVdual				numeric(24,12)
	declare @nBasecurr_dual		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nActcurr_dual		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nBasevalue			numeric(24,4)
	declare @nValue				int --= 1000;
	declare @nOrdorgcurr		nvarchar(3)--r5exchrates.crr_orgcurr%type;
	declare @nCount				int
	declare @dTempDate			datetime
	declare @nReturn			int

	/* Set all out parameters to null. */
	set @nExch = null
	set @nValue = 1000

	/* if no currency supplied  return without doing anything */
	if @sCurr IS NULL OR @sVorg IS NULL 
		begin
			set @nExch = 1
			return
		end
	
	/* Get the base currency for the order organization. if no organization */
	/* supplied  return without doing anything. */
	SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5organization
	WHERE  org_code = @sVorg
	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT @sBasecurr = org_curr
		FROM   r5organization
		WHERE  org_code = @sVorg
	else
		begin	
			set @nExch = 1
			return
		end

	/* Get the dual currency */
	SELECT @sDualcurr = ins_desc
	FROM   r5install
	WHERE  ins_code = N'DUALCURR'

	/* if the currency equals the base currency,  rate should always be 1. */
	if @sBasecurr = @sCurr 
		begin	
			set @nExch = 1
			return
		end

	/* Check whether base currency belongs to Euro. */
	SELECT @nBasecurr_dual = cur_dual
	FROM   r5currencies
	WHERE  cur_code = @sBasecurr

    /* Check whether given currency belongs to Euro. */
	SELECT @nActcurr_dual = cur_dual
	FROM   r5currencies
	WHERE  cur_code = @sCurr

	/* if given currency = dual currency and base currency belongs to Euro  */
	/* return reciproke of above retrieved rate.                                */
	if @nBasecurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @sCurr = @sDualcurr 
		begin	
			set @nExch = ROUND( 1 / @nBasecurr_dual, 6 )
			return
		end

	/* if base currency = dual currency and given currency belongs to Euro  */
	/* return above retrieved rate.                                             */
	if @nActcurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @sBasecurr = @sDualcurr 
		begin	
			set @nExch = @nActcurr_dual
			return
		end

	if @nBasecurr_dual IS NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NULL 
		begin
			/* Normal exchange rate. */
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempDate OUTPUT, @sVorg
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			select @nExch = crr_exch
			FROM   r5exchrates
			WHERE  crr_curr    = @sCurr
			AND    crr_orgcurr = @sBasecurr
			AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(Coalesce ( @dExchdate,  @dTempDate), N'DD'  ) BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_start, N'DD') AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD')
		end
	else
		begin
			if @nBasecurr_dual IS NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempDate OUTPUT, @sVorg
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					select @nVdual = crr_exch
					FROM   r5exchrates
					WHERE  crr_curr    = @sDualcurr
					AND    crr_orgcurr = @sBasecurr
					AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(Coalesce ( @dExchdate,  @dTempDate), N'DD'  ) BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_start, N'DD') AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD')

					set @nBasevalue = round( @nValue / @nActcurr_dual / @nVdual, 4 )
					set @nExch      = round( @nValue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
				end
			else
				begin
					if @nBasecurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NULL 
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempDate OUTPUT, @sVorg
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1

							select @nVdual = crr_exch
							FROM   r5exchrates
							WHERE  crr_curr    = @sCurr
							AND    crr_orgcurr = @sDualcurr
							AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(Coalesce ( @dExchdate,  @dTempDate), N'DD'  ) BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_start, N'DD') AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD')
			
							set @nBasevalue = round( @nValue / @nVdual * @nBasecurr_dual, 4 )
							set @nExch      = round( @nValue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
						end
					else
						begin
							/* Triangular!! */
							set @nBasevalue = round( @nValue / @nActcurr_dual * @nBasecurr_dual, 4 )
							set @nExch      = round( @nValue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
						end
				end
		end
